Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the biggest highlight is undoubtedly “the legend of drizzt”, a custom class inspired by drizzt do'urden, the legendary drow ranger from the forgotten realms universe. If you've spent any time exploring the wider world of Dungeons & Dragons, chances are you've come across the character before. Now, players can bring some of that fantasy into their own Baldur's Gate 3 campaigns, which is pretty neat.

The acclaimed RPG has received another batch of mods approved for consoles, bringing 14 new additions to PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

And that's not all! Another mod adds Drizzt's famous swords, Icingdeath and Twinkle, giving players even more ways to recreate the character's fighting style – not a bad combination for anyone planning to return to the Sword Coast.

Massive Baldur's Gate 3 Expansion Mod for Act 2 releases after a hyped wait, adding over 50 new items and dozens of new fights.

Sebagaimana diketahui, beyond the drizzt-themed additions, this latest collection offers several new ways to experiment with character builds. “Way of the Sword Saint” introduces a Monk subclass focused on mastering weapon techniques, while “Wild Spring Barbarian” adds another subclass for players who prefer a more aggressive approach to combat. Diungkapkan bahwa moving on, the new selection also includes plenty of cosmetic additions. Sebagaimana diketahui, there’s even some love for character customization with “orion's tears” adding new earrings and to the photo mode with “zillionz of expressions” introducing additional expressions. But here's the complete list of additions (thanks, BG3mods subreddit, for reporting this first!):.

Larian Studios has just approved 20 new mods for BG3's console versions, including the half-elf, half-orc subrace.

Sebagaimana diketahui, all 14 mods are available through the game's built-in mod manager, accessible from the main menu. Larian introduced official mod support for consoles with Patch 7 in 2024, allowing PS5 and Xbox players to enjoy community creations without manually installing files. However, it is important to remember that, unlike PC players, console users can only access mods that have passed the studio's approval process.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's been quite some time since baldur's gate 3 received its last major official content update, but the modding community clearly isn't ready to leave the forgotten realms behind. And with additions like these arriving regularly, returning for another adventure might be more tempting than ever!.

#459. After gobbling up EA, Saudi Arabia and private equity firm Silver Lake reportedly looking to buy Unity

📅 06 Nov 2026

After gobbling up EA, Saudi Arabia and private equity firm Silver Lake reportedly looking to buy Unity

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/unity-game-engine-saudi-arabia-silver-lake

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after acquiring ea for $55bn earlier this year, saudi arabia and private equity firm silver lake are reportedly in the market for another massive video game company. And according to new reports, it's Unity.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, per reuters, saudi arabia's public investment fund (pif) and silver lake - two major actors in the ea acquisition - are in talks to acquire the video game engine company for around $25bn. Silver Lake's Egon Durban already sits on the Unity Board of Directors, and the firm owns around eight percent of its shares already thanks to a $400m investment.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this $25bn valuation should be taken with a grain of salt for two core reasons. For one, it was decided prior to Unity's latest quarterly financial report, which included a 59% increase in strategic revenue year-over-year and net income of $122m. So this could propel the valuation upwards.

Berdasarkan laporan, on the other hand, wider economic changes could have a detrimental effect. Reuters points out: "Strong ⁠growth in Unity's AI-powered Vector advertising platform helped it post its first quarterly profit on a GAAP basis since going public in September 2020. " Given we've seen the generative AI sector take a major hit this week following the US midterm elections, it's possible companies using the tech may be viewed with more fiscal skepticism. Or, maybe this dip is just temporary. In short, take the $25bn valuation as a ballpark figure.

Berdasarkan laporan, unity has had something of an interesting past. There was of course the banana's runtime fee scandal of 2024 in which the company attempted to charge developers a fee on each game sale using the engine, which proved a PR nightmare and was quickly walked back. Unity also recently partnered with Google for AI-game creation platforms Google PlayGround and Unity Spark. Spark is shown to have created a Space Corridor game on its website that looks dubious at best - not exactly a resounding testament to the future.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the last time ea and silver lake bought something gaming related it was ea, a western giant that would go on to lay off hundreds of staff and close bioware months later. As such if it does happen, it may be a good ol' fashioned private acquisition, not this terms and conditions-laden deal that EA, in its newest guises, must contend with. It is worth emphasising that the deal was a leveraged buyout, which saddles EA with substantial debt, whereas the exact nature of this proposed Unity deal is not confirmed. We've already seen BioWare closed down as a result of this acquisition.

Expect more news about the Unity buyout when official information comes to light.

#460. BioWare are gone, but at least you'll be able to watch their final days in a documentary next year and oh wait that's really sad actually

📅 05 Nov 2026

BioWare are gone, but at least you'll be able to watch their final days in a documentary next year and oh wait that's really sad actually

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/bioware-are-gone-but-at-least-youll-be-able-to-watch-their-final-days-in-a-documentary-next-year-and-oh-wait-thats-really-sad-actually

Diungkapkan bahwa it feels like every single week for the past few years has been the infinitely quotable 30 rock quote on repeat. That obviously resulted in the cancellation of Mass Effect 5, of which a leaked trailer and some, now former, devs made sound pretty interesting. That feeling struck particularly last month when EA decided to shut down the iconic Mass Effect and Dragon Age developer BioWare. But hey! At least there's a documentary coming next year all about the studio that managed to capture the studio's last days! Yeah, I'm not so convinced by this upside either.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as reported by deadline, shane fennessey and adam scorgie will be helming a documentary about the beloved rpg studio for canada's super channel. It's called, punnily enough, Massive Effect: The BioWare Story, and will apparently take a look at its origins in 1995 all the way up to its closure and a bit beyond, planned for release in 2027. Filming began two years ago, so clearly this was meant to be much more of a celebratory project than the funeral procession it's going to be.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, some big names from bioware's history will be appearing in the doc, including its founders ray muzyka, greg zeschuk and augustine yip, alongside the likes of longtime devs like mark darrah, david gaider, drew karpyshyn, aaryn flynn, mac walters, trent oster, james ohlen and caroline livingstone. You can also expect appearances from Jennifer Hale, Casey Hudson and, as if his sole goal is to haunt this industry everywhere, Geoff Keighley.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a statement, co-founders muzyka and zeschuk said, "when the production team asked for our blessing to tell the bioware story, we were honored and deeply moved. It was about the stories brought to life by the amazing people on our dev teams, and the fans who defended those worlds, championed them and carried them forward. BioWare was never just about the logo or the building. We’re proud this film honors those who made it all possible. The best stories never really end. They live on in our memories and wait for someone to pick them up again. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, obviously the documentary won't only be about the studio's closure, it sounds like a much bigger effort than that, so hopefully it will be a way to recognise how much of an influence bioware has had on rpgs. It's just a ridiculous shame that it's something of a posthumous release. Continued solidarity with all those at BioWare.

Diungkapkan bahwa but not everyone agrees. In fact, one of the most credible voices on Nvidia reckons there are "strong" and "excellent" candidates for a replacement. Tae Kim wrote the most well-known, authoritative book on the company—The Nvidia Way—and yesterday they explained:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "many people have cited my book as saying nvidia would be completely lost without jensen huang. My views have evolved in the several years since I wrote those passages. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "there is also one excellent external candidate who has been very successful outside of nvidia and offers both technical expertise and solid business management experience. Either one would be great. Employees loved working for him. ".

They're certainly optimistic comments, but your guess is as good as mine as to who they might be referring to—presumably someone on the list of potential replacement CEO candidates I put together earlier.

#465. Afterwords – Marvel’s Wolverine

📅 03 Nov 2026

Afterwords – Marvel’s Wolverine

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/afterwords/2026/11/03/marvels-wolverine

We interviewed game director Mike Daly after the launch of Insomniac’s recent Wolverine game to get his take on what makes Wolverine and Spidey different to work on, his thoughts on breadcrumb trails, and why Logan can’t ever seem to get the girl.

Berdasarkan laporan, insomniac had extensive experience working on well-known superhero characters before starting on wolverine. Early on, what traits or qualities of Logan as a story character and playable avatar did you know you wanted to focus on, distinct from the Spider-Man games and character?.

Berdasarkan laporan, from a story perspective, we wanted logan to be a man with centuries of experiences that he can’t remember, creating a mix of being worn, wizened, and cynical. His resilience makes him fearless, which comes through in his candid manner, and he can’t ignore his sense of justice, as much as he would like to.

For gameplay, it was important that players felt the difference made by his healing factor, claws, berserker rage, animalistic strength, enhanced senses, his adamantium skeleton, and corresponding weight.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in both story and gameplay, emotionally and physically, wolverine is a hero who gets hurt and feels that pain deeply but always gets back up again and presses on. This dogged resilience was really important to us and a central theme of story and gameplay.

Sebagaimana diketahui, wolverine is more of a linear adventure than the open-world exploration of a big city seen in spidey. In my playthrough, that added to the sense of relentless pacing that characterizes Wolverine as a fictional lead. Was that part of the thinking behind why the game was built that way, or was the more linear path there for other reasons?.

Ultimately, we made a game suited for a Wolverine story that had comic book pacing – action and meaningful story development on every page.

We experimented with different structures and stories, evaluating from the perspective of: “Is this the best way to do Wolverine justice?” As the various things we tried didn’t feel right, we had to challenge our assumptions and look to our favorite Wolverine stories for inspiration, which led us to where we ended up – a story with momentum in which every beat felt authentic to the character.

Scenes and gameplay sequences that might have been fine in other games but didn’t strongly evoke Wolverine undermined the consistency of the fantasy we were trying to create, so we tried to keep things very focused.

Diungkapkan bahwa after the game’s release, there was an active online conversation about some of the breadcrumb-trail guidance the game offers to lead you to pickups, or to mark the continued golden path of progression. What was the thinking internally about that design decision, and your take on the debate after the game launched?.

Berdasarkan laporan, our thinking was that it was essential to make the player feel like they were empowered by logan’s enhanced senses, a canonical mutant ability, enabling players to do things they could not with other characters. We wanted to weave that power into as many parts of the game as we could, so that if Logan could smell or hear something relevant, the player could see it too.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for collectibles, we wanted players to enjoy seeking out and spotting senses cues, enabling you to find things that would have been obscure to other characters. Using the cues, players can cover a lot of ground without feeling the need to scour, maintaining story and action momentum.

Sebagaimana diketahui, after the game launched, we saw feedback from players that interpreted senses as abstract designer guidance, along with a desire for options in how they approached exploration and discovery. One aspect we’ve improved is the scent trail’s organic presentation, so they give a stronger impression that they belong in the world rather than being an abstraction. Fortunately, we have been able to incorporate this feedback from players in our post-launch patches. For players that want to do more manual exploration, we’ve added options to remove the sense cues for optional collectibles, and one to make scent trails dimmer until the player requests a hint.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ultimately, enhanced senses are still essential to creating an authentic wolverine, and that’s still reflected in the cinematic and environmental storytelling of the game. I think it’s great that on top of that, players now have more flexibility in how they experience them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as a longtime comics fan, i found logan’s combat system especially exciting, particularly for the relentless forward momentum it provided. What do you think were some of the keys to nailing that dynamic, as distinct from other high-quality third-person action games?.

There were a few key elements we wanted to get right - Logan’s resilience, rage, claw feel, and overall lethality.

Diungkapkan bahwa for resilience, logan’s healing factor needed to feel important for survival - a prominent element of the system. A natural starting point there was to try continual regeneration so you could outlast enemies, but that quickly fell apart as it incentivized the player to slow the pace of combat or even retreat for maximum advantage. Even though it was incredibly effective at enabling survival, it was also hard to notice by the player so it didn’t feel prominent.

Diungkapkan bahwa the key to solving this problem was making a connection between rage and healing factor. The Last Stand mechanic is a healing surge that can happen when you lose all your health, themed as using adrenaline to keep Logan’s heart beating. This incentivized aggression and made a space for an up-close look at visceral healing.

Diungkapkan bahwa speaking of rage, it’s the backbone of the combat system where being an indicator of momentum is key. At the low end of rage, you don’t have the safety net of Last Stand, so your decision-making naturally biases towards survival; ensuring you prioritize threat assessment and defense. Finally, you get to rage tier 3, where the quick decay of rage makes your rate of kills the top priority, so you might prefer to attack groups over ranged stragglers just for the improved kill density. Beyond the mechanics, we change the presentation of combat, especially through Logan’s animations and exertion to reflect his state of mind. As you climb into the middle tier, you have the leeway to push your luck for longer combos or barrages that let you build up rage and get kills faster. The presentation and systemic incentives drive the player into a frenzy, just like Wolverine.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we invested a lot in the details of claw feel to make sure it was distinct from general game attacks. Severing limbs on these attacks is an occasional reminder of how sharp Logan’s adamantium claws are. Many kills throughout combat are punctuated with custom animations with cinematic camera work that pushes in and frames the puncturing of claws into the body for a strong impression of the connection and weight of the puncture. Claws shred, so we added locational body damage to our enemies to reflect that, along with a dynamic blood system where it globs together as it is spilled, splatters on contact with characters or the environment, drips down the walls, diffuses in the water, and other details. Reinforcing this is top-notch sound and haptics design, so each hit registers.

Berdasarkan laporan, the last aspect i’ll touch on is lethality, the rate at which wolverine is able to dispatch enemies and vice versa. We found that fights where enemies were more technical and could survive a lot undermined what players expected to experience as Wolverine, which was aggressively and lethally tearing through a lot of enemies. On the other hand, combat was less exciting if the enemies didn’t feel like a serious and deadly threat, and you didn’t feel like Wolverine if a little bit of caution could enable you to defend perfectly and avoid all damage.

Diungkapkan bahwa these aspects led us towards encounters where you confronted large groups of enemies that were highly aggressive, to the point of feeling unfair. Enemies can’t believably go toe-to-toe with Wolverine alone, even world-class mercenaries, so their strategy is in group coordination, which creates a counterweight to Wolverine’s own rage-based momentum.

Diungkapkan bahwa marvel’s wolverine draws in a number of characters from across the x-men comic mythology, but notably makes no mention of some foundational figures of that fiction – professor xavier and magneto. That, in turn, leads to dramatically different lives for characters like Jean Grey or Logan. Is the narrative you crafted an intentional exploration of a world where those figures weren’t present in the early days of mutant emergence?.

Berdasarkan laporan, i would say it was more of an exploration of the character than the world. His growth as a person should be a challenging journey, which could go unearned if he was surrounded by wise, supportive, heroic characters pushing him in the right direction. In contrast, his dynamic with the members of Team X evokes his struggle. We wanted a story where Logan is pulled into conflict not because he’s a crusader, but because there’s no other option. There are no X-Men to help. The adversity to personal growth is what makes it interesting.

Jean does end up being the person that pushes him in the right direction, and that works because they can relate to each other, having had similar struggles.

Berdasarkan laporan, in several versions of marvel storytelling, jean and logan share a special bond, but jean ultimately chooses scott summers as a partner. But even without that barrier in your story, Logan still hits some roadblocks to love. Is Wolverine fundamentally a better character when he just can’t get the girl?.

Berdasarkan laporan, the way i would put it is that a wolverine story is fundamentally better when you empathize with logan’s pain and admire him for pressing on despite it. That goes for his emotional pain as much as physical. He’s a tragic character in this regard – all he wants is to be at peace but can never find it for long.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, wolverine gets to take on a lot of the “heavy hitters” of his comic mythology in different boss fights throughout the game. When you began development, do you recall who the very first character was that you decided he simply had to fight in your game?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sabretooth. Sabretooth’s strength and mutant powers also provide a mirror to Logan in combat, and his savagery creates shocking moments that leave an impression. His inner turmoil and chaotic behavior helps illustrate Logan’s own inner beast and his struggle to resist it. No character is a better foil for Logan. We knew an epic confrontation with Sabretooth was going to be a thing from the start.

Thy wrists y-braced to a wan terminal of bone-whyte and tarnysshed latoun, þou steerest Ablahshikar by murke point-nettes and sputteryng tables. Reminds me of Hylics in that the game's world is not translating itself for its audience; you take what you're given, and you figure it out yourself.

Diungkapkan bahwa judging from trailers and screenshots, there's a mix of activities to be getting on with. #472. After a 16-year long dev period, Faraway, a shooting star arcade game about siphoning the energy of other stars, is out now

After a 16-year long dev period, Faraway, a shooting star arcade game about siphoning the energy of other stars, is out now

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/after-a-16-year-long-dev-period-faraway-a-shooting-star-arcade-game-about-siphoning-the-energy-of-other-stars-is-out-now

Diungkapkan bahwa lord almighty, video games take a while to make, 'ey? especially if you're just one person working on it by yourself. Such is the case with Faraway, out today, an arcade game that reminds me of the early days of PS3 indies "about a shooting star that creates constellations to stay alive," all made single-handedly by creator of cult-classic mobile game Eliss, Steph Thirion. Did I mention that Faraway took 16 years to make? Like I said, game development is a lengthy process.

Diungkapkan bahwa looking at faraway, and knowing how long it took to produce, it doesn't surprise me to come from a dev who managed to release a mobile game in the early days of the platform, long before free-to-play got its chokehold on the industry. It also really does feel like it should be sitting amongst the likes of PixelJunk, this thing should be something I'm desperate to play on my PS3 while I wait for my controller to charge.

Diungkapkan bahwa as mentioned, you are a shooting star, a "spark meant to shine and vanish in a blink. " But still you persist, connecting to and wrapping yourself around starts to "harvest their energy," in turn lengthening your own life, and of course, in arcadey fashion, racking up a nice score. It looks like game design as poetry, everything you're looking at procedurally generated to bring freshness to every run. I can fully envision this as a "one more run" kind of arcade game, the best kind, especially in an age long past the need to shove in another of your hard earned coins.

Sebagaimana diketahui, faraway conceptually charms me because it taps into a style of game we don't get to see much of any more. In any case, Faraway is available to pick up on Steam right now. Sure, arcade games might not be in vogue, I just miss them a bit. What I'm saying is, I'm just a teensy bit sick of how many roguelikes there are, but that doesn't mean I don't want a game I can just hop in and out of at my own whims. Seems like it'll be worth a punt!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it was a bad time to be a vampire fan and enjoyer of video games until precisely september 2, 2026, when a team of cd projekt red veterans released the blood of dawnwalker, easily the best vampire game in years. Rebel Wolves didn't take home any awards at the Golden Joysticks this year, but it showed a lot of class by congratulating and paying respect to its competition, including Ultimate Game of the Year, Resident Evil Requiem. We caught up with Rebel Wolves founder and Blood of Dawnwalker game director Konrad Tomaszkiewicz at the Golden Joysticks, and his mood was celebratory.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "many people told us the vampire genre is cursed somehow," tomaszkiewicz says. We have our own place in the genre also, with the narrative sandbox and hybrid combat and the other things we have, and it's great to have something like this because we already have ideas how to expand it and how to make even more crazy ideas in the game. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's definitely true that there's a stigma around vampire games in particular that's been hard to shake for, oh, i don't know, ever. The Castlevania series set an impossibly high standard going back to the '80s, and on second thought, may have inadvertently cursed the genre to be plagued by clunkers like Vampire Rain, Redfall, and most disappointingly, Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2. There have definitely been some moderate successes over the years; I liked Vampyr alright, and most recently Castlevania: Belmont's Curse has been a triumphant revival, but by and large vampire games really put the suck in I want to suck your blood.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the blood of dawnwalker isn't just an extraordinarily solid vampire game, it's also one of my favorite rpgs in recent memory, with the witcher 3-caliber writing across its entire main quest and every side quest i've encountered. I'm not sure exactly what Tomaszkiewicz means when he says Rebel Wolves has expansion ideas, but the studio has confirmed a sequel is on the way.

#476. Nintendo says it isn't planning any more Switch 2 price hikes

Nintendo says it isn't planning any more Switch 2 price hikes

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/nintendo-switch-2-no-plans-for-more-price-hikes

Nintendo, which unveiled the results of the first half of its fiscal year 2027 earlier today, has now said it has access to enough quantities of memory to manufacture more Switch 2 consoles.

Berdasarkan laporan, as a result, the platform holder does not plan to increase the price of the switch 2. That's according to Reuters, citing Nintendo president Shuntaro Furukawa.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nintendo, which has so far sold 26m switch 2 consoles, has already raised the price of the console earlier this year. The price hikes, which took effect on 1st September in the US, Canada, Japan and Europe, saw the console's price increase by $50 / €30 / ¥10,000. Although that was technically the first price hike for the console itself, prior to the Switch 2's launch last year, Nintendo raised the price of Switch 2 accessories in the US as a result of the Trump Administration's tariffs.

The reason that would cause Nintendo to raise prices again is the same that already caused rival PlayStation and Xbox to do so: AI-driven, global memory and storage shortages.

Sebagaimana diketahui, playstation already raised ps5 and ps5 pro prices, on several occasions. Xbox has likewise gone through multiple rounds of price hikes for its Series X and Series S consoles, with the most recent having taken place in August.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that same crisis pushed one of nintendo's longtime rom suppliers to exit the business, opting instead to focus on the more lucrative business segments. ROM memory is used in Switch cartridges, though Nintendo hasn't commented on the news.

Berdasarkan laporan, incidentally, switch 2 hardware sales have been in decline for several quarters now compared to its banner launch in 2025. Still, Switch 2 sales are tracking ahead of the Switch 1.

#477. Xbox Will Make You Watch Three Minutes of Ads for Just 30 Minutes of Gaming

📅 12 Nov 2026

Xbox Will Make You Watch Three Minutes of Ads for Just 30 Minutes of Gaming

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/xbox-will-make-you-watch-three-minutes-of-ads-for-just-30-minutes-of-gaming/

Sebagaimana diketahui, microsoft has found another way to make money from xbox, and this time, you'll be paying with your time rather than your wallet. The company has detailed its ad-supported cloud gaming service, which offers 30 minutes of gameplay in exchange for watching three minutes of commercials.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the service is being marketed to advertisers as xbox video for brands. For gamers, it's an alternative to the subscription-based Xbox Cloud Gaming service, allowing eligible users to stream games without an active Game Pass subscription.

A rising number of players are citing prohibitive monthly costs as their reason for canceling gaming subscriptions.

Free access to cloud gaming certainly sounds appealing, but half an hour isn't much time, especially when you have to sit through three minutes of ads before you can even start playing.

In a November 12 announcement, Microsoft confirmed that its ad-supported cloud gaming service will feature a three-minute pre-roll advertising block before each 30-minute gaming session.

Sebagaimana diketahui, these advertisements will be full-screen and non-skippable, although they won't interrupt active gameplay. Instead, they'll appear before the session begins, during the cloud-loading process.

Berdasarkan laporan, microsoft describes this as an opportunity for advertisers to reach gamers just as they're preparing to play. The company believes that this makes Xbox an attractive advertising platform, since the audience is already engaged and ready to start gaming.

Berdasarkan laporan, but from a gamer's perspective, three minutes of advertisements for just half an hour of gameplay doesn't sound particularly generous. The ads won't interrupt your gameplay, but the 30-minute session limit certainly will.

Berdasarkan laporan, consider how much time you might spend doing something relatively mundane in an rpg or an open-world game, whether that's exploring a new area, completing a quest, or simply getting sidetracked. You could easily spend most of your allotted time without making much progress.

The ads won't interrupt your gameplay, but the 30-minute session limit certainly will.

Sebagaimana diketahui, to be clear, microsoft isn't adding commercial breaks to games you've already purchased. The advertisements are limited to this optional cloud gaming tier, and they'll play before you start gaming rather than interrupting an ongoing session.

The announcement also leaves some details unclear, including whether every region and session will have precisely the same advertising requirements.

What's rather disappointing about the newly announced arrangement is that Microsoft's earlier ad-supported cloud gaming tests were considerably more generous.

Berdasarkan laporan, when the company began testing the service with xbox insiders in july, users could access one-hour gaming sessions after watching advertisements. Earlier reporting indicated that these introductory ads lasted approximately two minutes. That's twice the gameplay time, with fewer advertisements to sit through.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the new arrangement looks considerably less appealing by comparison, although free access still has its uses. If you occasionally want to try a game without committing to a Game Pass subscription, even 30 minutes might be enough. For anything more substantial, however, the time limit could become frustrating rather quickly.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's also the question of what happens when those 30 minutes run out. Can you immediately start another session after watching more ads, or will you have to wait in another queue? And how smoothly will the service handle resuming a game after the previous session expires?.

Microsoft hasn't explained these details in its latest announcement, so we'll have to see how the system works in practice.

Diungkapkan bahwa the introduction of advertisements is part of a much larger restructuring of xbox cloud gaming. As DualShockers previously reported, Microsoft has also introduced pay-as-you-go cloud gaming packages, allowing you to purchase streaming time without subscribing to Game Pass.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the introductory prices include $3. 99 for 50 hours of gameplay. 99 for 10 hours, $7. 99 for 25 hours, and $11. These packages offer ad-free streaming, and the purchased hours remain available until they're used.

Diungkapkan bahwa meanwhile, game pass subscriptions now have monthly cloud gaming allowances, with ultimate receiving 15 hours, premium receiving 10 hours, and essential receiving five hours. If you exhaust your included hours, you can purchase additional time or use the ad-supported service where available.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, microsoft has justified these changes by pointing to the growing costs of cloud gaming as more people use the service. Streaming certainly has its advantages, particularly if you don't own a powerful gaming PC or a modern console. And with the next Xbox reportedly carrying an eye-watering price tag, being able to play without buying new hardware might sound even more appealing.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but microsoft's approach to the service is changing. Instead of simply treating cloud gaming as another benefit of the Xbox ecosystem, the company is increasingly dividing it into subscriptions, purchased hours, and advertising-supported sessions.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and while the latter doesn't cost anything, you're still paying with your time. Watching a few advertisements to try a game might be reasonable enough, but sitting through three minutes of commercials every time you want another half hour of gameplay sounds considerably less appealing.

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has hinted that Xbox Game Pass prices could go down in the future, though this could be part of a shift to digital ownership.

#491. Nvidia ensure unboxing a ludicrously expensive new graphics card isn't limited to real life in these RAM crisis times by releasing a GeForce 8800 GTX unpacking sim

📅 05 Nov 2026

Nvidia ensure unboxing a ludicrously expensive new graphics card isn't limited to real life in these RAM crisis times by releasing a GeForce 8800 GTX unpacking sim

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/nvidia-ensure-unboxing-a-ludicrously-expensive-new-graphics-card-isnt-limited-to-real-life-in-these-ram-crisis-times-by-releasing-a-geforce-8800-gtx-unpacking-sim

Hey at least the card in this bit of 2006 nostalgia bait has only cost you a virtual arm and leg.

In what feels a fairly cheeky move during a time when memory shortages have infamously made it pretty much impossible to buy a decently powerful new graphics card without spending approximately a gazillion pounds/dollars/dollarpounds, Nvidia have decided to put out a Steam demo that allows folks to re-live the feeling of unboxing a ludicrously expensive graphics card in 2006.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the demo, dubbed geforce 8800 gtx - 20 years of a legend, has been developed by dylan browne. He previously made Through The Ages, a "real-time high end graphical cinematic that takes us on a nostalgic journey through three of NVIDIA's iconic GPUs" which is also on Steam for reasons.

Berdasarkan laporan, the geforce 8800 gtx demo, as you might've guessed, is a tribute to that specific card in the form of a tech demo simulating what it was like to unbox one in a mid-2000s bedroom. Seriously, there's a copy of Crysis on the desk so you know this is the domain of a true devotee to the best graphics available in around 2007.

Diungkapkan bahwa "step into a 2006-era pc gaming room, unbox the geforce 8800 gtx, inspect it up close, and install it in an era-accurate pc tower," the demo's description declares. 5 with Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, Ray Reconstruction, path tracing, and Mega Geometry bring the nostalgic setting to life. "Explore nods to GeForce history and hidden easter eggs as DLSS 4. From holding the card to the glow of the monitor, rediscover a moment in PC gaming history - or experience it for the first time!".

Berdasarkan laporan, as the geforce 8800 gtx was a top-line card that cost $599 on release in 2006 - about $1,000 in today's money if the online inflation calculator i've just used is on the money - this isn't really a 'we know cards are ludicrously expensive right now, but here's a reminder of when you used to be able to actually afford to unbox one' sort of demo. It is at least a free way to virtually experience having blown a chunk of your savings on something that can render really sexy textures without the existential dread of doing so in real life.

Diungkapkan bahwa well, i say that, i've just noticed the minimum requirements for the demo note that you'll need an rtx 4070 card. So, depending on your current setup, this might well be a case of Nvidia offering the chance to render unboxing a card you couldn't afford in 2006 via a card you can't afford in 2026.

Is that about the best we can all hope for in 2026? Probably.

#494. 10 Ocarina of Time Remake Changes That Break the Hearts of Nostalgic Fans

📅 12 Nov 2026

10 Ocarina of Time Remake Changes That Break the Hearts of Nostalgic Fans

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/ocarina-of-time-remake-changes-that-break-the-hearts-of-nostalgic-fans/

Diungkapkan bahwa covering the video games industry since 2017, with experience in news, articles, and reviews. Currently a writer at DualShockers and gaming magazines.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the remake of the legend of zelda: ocarina of time has brought one of the most beloved and iconic adventures in gaming history back to life with a revamped visual presentation, plenty of gameplay improvements, and a surprising number of small changes that make exploring hyrule feel fresh all over again. From quality-of-life improvements to the inventory and equipment systems to subtle environmental tweaks, there's literally a lot to appreciate about Nintendo's new take on this timeless classic.

However, as someone who grew up playing the original (and has an admittedly unhealthy amount of nostalgia running through my veins), I couldn't help but notice that some of the little things I loved are no longer around – or they are, but in a very different way.

Thomas Mahler believes Nintendo missed an opportunity to improve the level design in the Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake.

Don't get me wrong, I absolutely adore this remake and described it as a lovely modern remake with an old soul, but that doesn't mean I'm not allowed to miss a few things from my childhood, right? So, please allow me to put my nostalgic glasses on for a moment and revisit ten changes that have left a tiny hole in my heart.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of my favorite things about the original ocarina of time was starting a new save file and giving link the most ridiculous name i could think of. It was such a simple feature, but it opened the door to some quite hilarious moments, especially when characters started addressing the legendary hero using whatever silly name I'd come up with.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one of my personal favorites was naming him “bro. ” Suddenly, every conversation in Hyrule sounded like everyone was part of the most laid-back adventure imaginable.

Berdasarkan laporan, unfortunately, the remake has decided to put an end to our creative freedom by locking the protagonist's name to link. I can understand the reasoning, especially considering Nintendo's efforts to make the franchise more accessible to new generations and expand its presence across other media (since the live-action movie is coming hot). Still, I'll always miss my little adventures with Bro. You will be missed, buddy.

Berdasarkan laporan, one of the coolest easter eggs in the original ocarina of time was hidden in the courtyard where you first meet princess zelda. As Child Link, you must sneak past the castle guards to reach the princess without getting caught. Once you've had your little chat with her, however, there's nothing stopping you from exploring the area and discovering a few fun secrets.

Berdasarkan laporan, among them is a window you can shoot with your slingshot, prompting a particularly grumpy guard to throw a bomb in your direction (how rude!). But that's not all. If you look through the other windows, you'll find three familiar faces from the Super Mario universe: Mario, Luigi, and Bowser, all sporting their Super Mario 64 appearances.

Berdasarkan laporan, i was honestly expecting nintendo to bring this little crossover back using the characters' more modern designs, perhaps even their super mario odyssey models. It's a shame, considering how charming these little Nintendo Easter eggs can be. Instead, the entire reference has been removed from the remake. At least the guard is still there to throw a bomb at your face. Some traditions must be preserved, I suppose.

Berdasarkan laporan, if there's one thing every ocarina of time veteran knows, it's that rupees are important, and there's no shame in taking advantage of a good farming opportunity. One of the earliest places where you could stock up on some extra cash was a room inside Hyrule Castle's Market, conveniently filled with breakable pots.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as child link, you could simply walk inside, smash everything in sight, collect the rupees, leave, and come back to find the pots replenished. Rinse and repeat until your pockets were sufficiently full.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unfortunately, the remake has decided that we shouldn't be allowed to get rich quite so easily. While you can still find some pots containing Rupees in the room, they no longer respawn simply by leaving the castle and coming back inside. Instead, you'll have to wait quite a while and spend some time doing other activities before they return. I guess we'll just have to go back to cutting grass like the rest of Hyrule's hardworking citizens.

I know what you're thinking – why on earth would anyone miss Kaepora Gaebora being annoying? But hear me out, I promise there's a reason behind my questionable opinion!.

Diungkapkan bahwa i also ain't a fan of the original owl. And if you've played the original, you know exactly how frustrating that could be. However, there was something strangely entertaining about collectively hating this overly talkative bird. In fact, I probably spent more time than I'd like to admit accidentally answering “No” when he asked whether I wanted to hear his explanation again. Kaepora became one of those characters that practically every Ocarina of Time player had a story about, and that shared frustration was part of the experience.

Sebagaimana diketahui, now, the remake has given him a much cuter appearance, and he's also significantly less annoying, behaving much more like the wise and mysterious owl he's supposed to be. I mean, where’s the fun in that? I can't help missing the days when simply seeing him fly toward me filled me with dread.

Ocarina of Time has plenty of memorable exploit tricks, but one of my personal favorites involved getting a Heart Piece much earlier than Nintendo originally intended.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the original game, you could perform a particularly well-timed backflip from the top of death mountain, near the entrance to goron city, and land on the roof of dodongo's cavern. This allowed you to grab a Heart Piece that was normally intended for Adult Link, long before you were supposed to have access to it. It was just one of those silly little tricks that made exploring Hyrule feel even more rewarding.

Diungkapkan bahwa well, those days are over. The remake has adjusted the backflip's height, making it considerably less effective, and even tweaked the position of Dodongo's Cavern entrance to prevent players from pulling off the same trick (not that I tried to do it or anything).

From suspicious house designs to familiar songs, fans think they've found clues.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's an unwritten rule among players: the moment you unlock the hookshot, you must immediately equip it and start shooting at everything in sight. And one of your first destinations will probably be the rooftops of Kakariko Village.

Berdasarkan laporan, this was really fun because it offered more freedom than simply using it to reach the obvious targets. Apparently, however, that wasn't quite what Nintendo had in mind. You could experiment with different surfaces, discover unexpected ways to navigate the environment, and generally mess around with an incredibly useful piece of equipment. The remake has restricted the Hookshot's functionality, meaning it can now only latch onto specific designated targets, such as stone markers and certain treasure chests.

Berdasarkan laporan, i understand that this might have been done to prevent unintended shortcuts or make progression more controlled, but i can't help feeling that something has been lost in the process. One of the most enjoyable aspects of Ocarina of Time was experimenting with your equipment and discovering creative ways to use it. So, please, Nintendo, give us our old Hookshot back!.

One of my most vivid childhood memories of Ocarina of Time involves something that probably sounds completely ridiculous to anyone who didn't grow up playing the original: stepping into Hyrule Field for the very first time and desperately running toward Hyrule Castle like a lunatic.

That happened because, if night fell before we reached the castle gates, they would close, leaving Link stranded outside until morning – and Hyrule Field at night was not exactly the safest place to be.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and you’ve guessed: the remake has removed this particular inconvenience, meaning you no longer have to worry about being locked out of hyrule castle after sunset. My adult self appreciates not having to deal with that little problem, but the child in me misses those frantic nighttime sprints.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there's something wonderfully weird about the little laboratory at lake hylia. Inside, you'll find a rather eccentric scientist who spends most of his time complaining about his back pain while standing next to a water tank.

Diungkapkan bahwa he'll even offer you a reward if you manage to dive deep enough to touch the bottom of the pool. Naturally, being the helpful hero that you are, you'll want to give it a try. But once you reach the bottom, you'll discover something rather unexpected: a shark inside a cage.

Sebagaimana diketahui, what made this little discovery even funnier in the original game was the shark itself! rather than featuring a detailed 3d model, it was represented by a hilariously low-resolution, static image. While the remake has kept the shark in the aquarium, unfortunately, it has also given it a proper visual upgrade. It looked so out of place that it became one of those bizarre little details you simply couldn't forget. Sure, it looks considerably better now, but I miss the ridiculous charm of that pixelated little creature.

If there's one thing Ocarina of Time does exceptionally well, it's turning a seemingly innocent adventure into a horror game without any warning! One moment you're exploring a dungeon and collecting treasures, and the next you're desperately running for your life from something that looks like it escaped from your worst nightmare.

Few enemies capture that feeling better than the Wallmaster, a giant disembodied hand that suddenly drops from the ceiling, grabs Link, and sends him all the way back to the beginning of the area or dungeon.

Diungkapkan bahwa and what made this enemy so terrifying in the original was the anticipation. The remake preserves most of these elements, but introduces one rather important difference: a spotlight that illuminates the area whenever it’s about to appear. You couldn't simply look up to check whether it was coming, so you had to rely on an increasingly unsettling sound effect and the shadow that gradually appeared above Link. Combined with its shadow, this makes the enemy practically announce its arrival in the most dramatic way possible.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i appreciate the warning, but i honestly miss the uncertainty that made these encounters so frightening in the original. Thankfully, the Dead Hand is absolutely nightmare-inducing in the remake, so I'll let this one slide.

Remember the Water Temple? If you played the original Ocarina of Time back in the day, there's a good chance that simply reading those two words made you feel a little uncomfortable.

Berdasarkan laporan, for years, this dungeon had a reputation for being one of the most frustrating experiences in the entire game. Between constantly changing the water level and switching between the Iron Boots and other equipment, it was enough to test even the most patient players.

Diungkapkan bahwa there was also a particularly nasty small key hidden underneath the floor of the central pillar, which could only be accessed after raising the water level. It was incredibly easy to overlook, and if you ever found yourself seemingly stuck with no idea how to progress, there's a good chance this little key was the culprit!.

Diungkapkan bahwa despite keeping most of the original dungeon's layout intact, the remake has made things considerably easier by removing this easily missed small key altogether. This means players no longer have to spend ages retracing their steps and wondering whether they've somehow managed to softlock their game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, of course, the water temple is still a memorable dungeon, and i'm certainly not complaining about a more streamlined experience. But I do find it funny that an entire generation of players had to suffer through those confusing corridors just so newcomers could have a slightly more pleasant time! You're welcome, younger Zelda fans. We fought in the trenches so you wouldn't have to.

Eiji Aonuma and the development team for the Ocarina of Time remake discussed how one of the original's infamous dungeons is being improved.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, call of duty doesn't have much luck with its stunt casting. Two years after Infinity Ward put Kevin Spacey in Advanced Warfare—before he was accused of sexual assault—it turned MMA fighter Conor McGregor into a future soldier, Captain Bradley Fillion, in Infinite Warfare.

McGregor's role was quite small, despite being one of the game's antagonists, and ended in his character's demise, but co-directors Jordan Hirsh and Taylor Kurosaki didn't want to cut any corners when it came to the mo-cap.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i got to work with conor mcgregor, and the story about conor mcgregor… we shot that in either 2015 or early 2016, but this is the height of him as a ufc fighter. And so of course I wanted him to do something really physical, to demonstrate how capable he is. He's shorter than me, but I was trying to explain to him the choreography that I wanted him to do at the beginning there, where he smashes the guy, and he grabbed me and flipped me onto the ground—very gently. And then did this punch [right in front of my face] that I could feel the wind from.

Sebagaimana diketahui, at the time, co-directors hirsh and kurosaki were trying to shake things up in regards to mo-cap. "I think for every game they had done before that, you would maybe do some mocap or a cool takedown or a finisher, and then you'd have actors that would come into a VO booth and you'd have them come in one at a time and they'd read their lines and it’d be stitched together and then you're done. "I think that the folks at Infinity Ward probably thought I was a little crazy when I came in," Kurosaki tells us. And they built a performance capture stage specifically for this project. ".

With Infinite Warfare, the team was doing full performance capture, so it needed its actors to get more physical.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, kurosaki remembers, after mcgregor flipped him, that he "did this punch [right in front of my face] that i could feel the wind from. My body was just doing something that I couldn't control. Everyone on the stage was, ‘Whoa, that was crazy! It was so fast!’ And of course, I had a different perspective than everyone else. We're just rehearsing and figuring out the blocking. And then all of a sudden, this giant bead of sweat starts running down my face. I had this adrenaline, even though I knew I was perfectly safe. Then everyone was laughing, and he helped me up, and I'm laughing. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa a few years later, mcgregor started racking up criminal charges for assault. In 2019, he attacked a man for not accepting a drink in a Dublin pub. He pleaded guilty. He was not prosecuted, but a civil claim was made against him by Nikita Hand. In the same year, police in Ireland started investigating McGregor over allegations of multiple sexual assaults. In 2024, an Irish jury found that McGregor raped Hand.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, also in 2024, mcgregor starred in hitman, as one of its celebrity elusive targets—his second videogame role outside of the ufc games. IO Interactive stopped working with him after the ruling and removed him from the game as an Elusive Target.

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/goddess-of-victory-nikkes-pc-launcher-suffers-potential-malware-infection-with-its-publishers-suggesting-folks-whove-booted-since-late-september-do-a-security-check

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, goddess of victory: nikke, a gacha shooter/rpg developed by stellar blade makers shift up, has suffered a "security incident" which has seen its pc launcher potentially be infected with third-party malware. Thankfully, it seems a patch to make the launcher safe again has been quickly dished out, but publishers Level Infinite are still advising players who've booted the game up since September 27th to do some security checks.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we have identified that some files in the nikke windows pc launcher were recently tampered with by a third party, potentially allowing malicious programs to run when the launcher was launched," the developers of the game with anime girls who - judging by the promo art - breast boobily announced yesterday. "As a result, your PCs and account information may have been exposed to security risks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we are continuing to investigate the extent of the potential damage and review appropriate response measures. We are also conducting a thorough review of our network security environment, including our CDN, to determine how the PC launcher files were compromised. We will take all necessary precautions to prevent further damage and ensure that this issue does not happen again. We deeply regret that this security incident has caused Commanders significant concern and distress, when our responsibility should have been to provide a safe gaming environment. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa in order to try and help players "scan for and remove the malicious programs distributed in this incident", publishers level infinite have added a feature to nikke's official pc client that does just that. They're advising that anyone who's booted up the game at least once after September 27th at 15:41 (UTC+9) use that or perform a manual security check.

Berdasarkan laporan, once that's done, affected players are advised to change the passwords for any accounts they've used on the pc they used to boot the launcher, as well as generate new api keys and access tokens. "If you believe you may have been affected by this issue or suffered from any loss, please contact our customer support team. "We take very seriously the possibility that this incident may have affected not only your gaming experience but also your PC, accounts with external services, and personal assets," Level Infinite added. We will review each inquiry carefully and respond as promptly as possible. ".

Going forwards, they plan to improve their monitoring "so that any unauthorized file modifications or security threats can be detected early and addressed promptly", as well as "establish an integrity verification system for external resources accessed by the PC launcher" and ensure the launcher only requires "the minimum permissions necessary".

Here's hoping the studio are able to keep things more secure in the future and that affected players are able to get rid of any malware with minimal suffering or inconvenience.

Diungkapkan bahwa world of warcraft: forever came out last night. Those who stayed up were prepared for the usual from major WoW releases: long queues, disconnects, and server lag. However, save for a few minor hiccups here and there, things went off without a hitch.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, eurogamer can report first-hand that for european players who stayed up from, let's say 11pm - 3:50am last night, the login queues were short and constantly moving. Those who were very keen to get in the moment servers went live ran into unclickable server selection boxes, but backing out and re-joining the short queue fixed this problem swiftly.

Diungkapkan bahwa once you got in, there was very little server lag save for a lost spell cast or two, nor were constant random disconnects that would boot you out into the cold (i didn't get disconnected once - a record). As far as WoW launches go, an incredibly smooth first day.

Berdasarkan laporan, this was acknowledged by world of warcraft developers, such as executive producer holly longdale who wrote on x: "at the risk of jinxing things, so far so goodish which is crazy by itself. They are incredible in my opinion. And this launch was crazier than the insanity we imagined but thankfully the team built plans and contingencies. The team prepared a lot since the wildness of Beta. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, josh "aggrend" greenfield, a senior game designer on world of warcraft forever, addressed some minor issues that did pop up. These include a zone population problem: in basic terms the megaservers split players into different shards, and some of these felt a bit empty of players. There was also a quirk with the various big boats and zeppelins dotted around the map, which were busted. Temporary portals were added to provide a workaround.

Diungkapkan bahwa "thanks for everyone making this a great, super smooth launch," greenfield wrote. "I’m going to head home and 'go to sleep' now. Totally not playing WoW Forever until 3am. Nope. Yep, sleeping. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the reaction to this silky smooth launch has some players flabbergasted. They continue: "I fully expected to not be able to play today, but I logged in with no queue and no lag. "I can't believe how smooth this launch is" is the title of Reddit user Arizhela's post, currently topping the WoW Forever board. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, another post, created in the early hours of this morning, is dubbed: "never take a day off for launch, they said" in which a wow player regrets not booking some time off from work this week, expecting problems. "You've been finessed son," replied user SnooWalruses3948, while SirePuns shared in the shock: "The advice was sound, but this time around the developers hired a witch I tell you. The code must’ve been witchcraft, the hardware must’ve been blessed by a witch as well. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, it is unclear just how well world of warcraft: forever's launch was, given the unsocialable and employment-averse release time in the dead of night for us europeans, but it follows a record-breaking beta period in which many hopped back into the mmo. Impressions from this beta were largely positive, the magic of the old MMO seemingly recaptured.

Deadfire’s turn-based mode has also gotten a makeover.

Diungkapkan bahwa after gifting pillars of eternity a turn-based mode for its tenth anniversary, obsidian have now rolled out full pc controller support for both the rpg and its younger sibling pillars of eternity 2: deadfire. The support, along with some tweaks to Deadfire's turn-based mode, are currently out in public test form.

Berdasarkan laporan, "you can now play the whole of either game with a controller, from character creation to the end credits (and, in deadfire, all the way out to naval combat), in both real-time with pause and turn-based mode," the studio wrote in their announcement of the public test going live. Diungkapkan bahwa "deadfire’s turn-based mode has also been reworked with the improvements we made for pillars of eternity’s turn-based mode: turns now follow each character’s speed, combat is more lethal, and swapping weapons or drinking potions no longer costs your action. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, these additions are all part of patch 1. 0, the full notes for which can be found in the post I've embedded above, alongside instructions on how to get into the public test. Berdasarkan laporan, so i've been utterly consumed by wow: forever, which is a relief, because it's my job to write about it—and i've been powering ahead to 40, where a deeply oldschool grind to get my first mount awaits me. Before that, though, I had an absolutely lovely time futzing around The Riverglades, one of WoW: Forever's properly bespoke zones. As in, this thing wasn't in vanilla. This was cooked up and released in November.

Having quested through most of it in a blissful fugue state with some friends, we each came to the conclusion that it all feels very 2007, rather than 2006.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the riverglades, which you can head to at about level 38, is saturated with quests. Even more so than the revamped and revisited zones from vanilla World of Warcraft. And while it absolutely has the classic zone's sense of scale, and none of these quests have the retail aura of on-rails cutscenes about them, I wasn't actually tasting vanilla.

One of the hallmarks of older, classic-style quest design is a bunch of disparate quests that have you scattering out towards the map—Riverglades, then, feels a lot more modern, in that it uses that scattershot point-of-interest guide as a baseline, then cleverly tucks away even more quests at your destination.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in one case, fighting through a ruined village flooded with twilight's blade, me and my compatriot saw a quest marker underground. It took ages for us to find a basement, which then yawned out into an open cavern with shadow-infused ogres and a cunning woman trapped in a cage with her own quest chain.

Diungkapkan bahwa at which point it clicked: oh, i'm playing the burning crusade again. The template was classic, sure, but the density and the branching paths and the clever redirects—that's all Outland, baby. There's even a set of swampy flats in the middle of The Riverglades pock-marked by orcish poachers that made me say, out loud: Oh, I'm in Nagrand again. Just without the floating islands.

And you know what, having had this unexpectedly adjacent nostalgic experience, I didn't hate it.

Diungkapkan bahwa i do hope that forever manages to preserve its more vanilla aspects; i've written on this site quite recently about how i've adored just going on an adventure. Heck, I had the terrible idea to do the Scarlet Monastery as Alliance recently, and the quest chain leading up to the sword I wanted forced me to run all the way across Desolace to fight level 40 skeletons. It was great.

Diungkapkan bahwa but the burning crusade, in many senses, was the best of both worlds. WoW hadn't been claimed by its Cataclysm-era propensity for goofs and pop culture references over atmosphere yet, but it also hadn't stuck doggedly to its vanilla quest design that was sometimes just flat-out bad.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in fact, many of forever's new quests, even in other zones, have been built around plugging up awkward questing gaps, or giving players more to do in zones that've been otherwise barren. 0. Which, as it turns out, just produces Outland 2. If the other levelling zones Blizzard adds to Forever are as Nagrand-flavoured as the Riverglades, I really don't mind at all.

Zenelss Zone Zero's Encore for an Old Dream has a good excuse for introducing some new mechanics to the action game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, zenless zone zero’s latest special program has delivered a tonne of information about the game’s big upcoming update, version 2. 6. This latest addition kicks off celebrations in New Eridu, and it’s dubbed Encore for an Old Dream.

Sebagaimana diketahui, version 2. 6 is not far off, either, arriving in ZZZ on February 6 - exactly one week from today. Encore for an Old Dream is something of an in-between story that takes place after the end of Season 2.

Berdasarkan laporan, the narrative of 2. 6 sees the Proxies’ return to Sixth Street for New Eridu's annual Gilded Carrot Day. At the centre of the celebrations is the debut of idol group Angels of Delusion at the 404 Error music venue, but not all is as it seems.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the story follows the proxies getting invited backstage to support the group, which also includes helping them set up practice schedules, organise events and manage social media activities. There’s a rhythm minigame as part of that, along with new maps and mechanics for Marcel Adventure.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, angels of delusion is also the group that the two new agents being introduced in this update belong to. Members of the same group are capable of performing coordinated attacks. The new arrivals are Sunna and Aria.

Berdasarkan laporan, sunna is a an s-rank physical support agent who specialises in boosting teammates using attack and anomaly. Sunna’s companion, Bubblegum, can cast Cat's Gaze on enemies, marking them for detonation. Her Ultimate sees her pull out a giant hammer to land heavy damage, and bring teammates into combat using Quick Assist. Bubblegum can also buff the squad’s attack.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, aria is the other new arrival, the group’s lead vocalist who can shift between two forms, idol projection and construct. Aria is an Ether Anomaly Agent who also deals high burst damage, specifically against enemies who suffer from any Attribute Anomalies.

Sunna and Aria also benefit from the support of the amusingly named Bangboo Biggest Fan, a fan club president who can heal them over time, and boost the squad’s Attack any time two or more Angels of Delusion members are present.

Sebagaimana diketahui, version 2. 6’s S-Rank re-runs are Yixuan (Auric Ink - Rupture), and Yuzuha (Physical - Support), who you can look forward to as part of the banners.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, version 2. 6 will also expand Hollow Zero with a new game mode, Operation Matrix. The mode offers themed stages that rotate weekly, each offering new mechanics. You can now also Sweep in Hollow Zero.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, beyond all the celebrations, this update also brings combat kit overhauls to a couple of older s-rank characters, lycaon and harumasa. You can look forward to multiple limited-time events, too, including one where you can earn a new outfit for Pan Yinhu.

Berdasarkan laporan, the big event is naturally going to be themed around gilded carrot day, and it actually starts today. There’s the usual run of login rewards (about 3,300 Polychromes), as well as daily activities. Yet another login event - Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns - will be available February 14-23, offering daily draws from a pool of 4 billion Polychrome.

#509. The Video Games And More You Should Play This Weekend – October 30, 2026

📅 30 Oct 2026

The Video Games And More You Should Play This Weekend – October 30, 2026

Tanggal: 30 Oct 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/opinion/2026/10/30/the-video-games-and-more-you-should-play-this-weekend-october-30-2026

Sebagaimana diketahui, welcome to devil's night, the night before halloween, where video games are best served scary. At least not until mid-September, 2027. After tomorrow night – Halloween proper – no more scary video games allowed. I'm sorry, I don't make the rules. Below you will find our weekend gaming recommendations (which is actually surprisingly light on scary games – apologies), but before that, here are some of the biggest stories of the week.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, phantom blade zero is one of the best action games i’ve ever played, and it’s certainly one of the most impressive to watch. It will constantly leave you in awe that action combat can look this good. Fortunately, Phantom Blade Zero delivers on all fronts, with weapon mechanics so detailed that picking up a new blade can feel like unlocking a new character in a fighting game. Beijing-based developer S-Game uses China’s Wuxia brand of action (which was actually banned for some time during the 20th Century by the country’s government) to create a stylish, fluid, and hyper-engaging combat system. The story won’t blow your socks off, but it’s certainly engaging and enticing enough to bring you through Phantom Blade Zero’s 40 or so hours of content. But looks aren’t everything. If you’re not interested in the “perfect ending,” which is the only satisfactory one in my opinion, you can complete the game in less than 30 hours. S-Game mixes high-octane combat with sprawling and rewarding exploration to create a must-play during this already busy season of games. You can read more of my thoughts in the Game Informer Phantom Blade Zero review, and if you are hopping in this weekend, be sure to check out my list of Phantom Blade Zero tips and tricks I wish I knew before starting it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you have any fond memories of illfonic’s ill-fated friday the 13th: the game as i do, you simply must play the studio’s latest, halloween: the game. It is essentially Friday the 13th with Michael Myers instead of Jason, but with a decade of lessons learned from the team’s teeth carving in other horror properties and games. You’re either Michael or a citizen; the former wants to kill you and all the NPCs in various suburban maps, while the latter must rescue as many NPCs as possible while staying alive themselves. It’s that classic cat-and-mouse formula IllFonic is the master of, but with all the style, substance, and synths of John Carpenter’s Halloween masterpiece. Plus, Halloween: The Game features IllFonic’s first crack at a single-player campaign, and while it’s largely a tutorial for playing as Michael, if you’re a Halloween mega-fan like me, it’s worth checking out if only to take part in some of the film’s most iconic kills. You can read more of my thoughts in the Game Informer Halloween: The Game review here, and if you’re hopping in this weekend, there’s a new map, additional Halloween-themed cosmetics to unlock, and more waiting for you.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, overwatch is in the midst of its halloween event, which have always historically been pretty interesting. It can get really chaotic where by round three characters like Orisa might be three times her normal size or Torbjorn might have placed a giant turret on Mercy's making her a flying death machine. In it, you begin by picking one of three characters in a random role. This year it's Mystery Madness: Graveyard Games. And then, as the game progresses, you choose perks that upgrade, alter, or completely change what your character can do. There are also Halloween skins, as well.

Diungkapkan bahwa tom the postgirl is an odd little adventure that i'd recommend to fans of untitled goose game. You never know what each window might reveal, and I quickly sympathized with (and enabled) Tom's compulsion. You also have the capacity to cause quite a bit of trouble by stomping on flowers, haphazardly snipping strings and cords, or even stealing packages and using them for your own mischievous purposes. On the surface, you're delivering packages, but the game's real story is based on Tom's tendency to peep where she shouldn't, peering into townsfolks' windows to watch their odd lives. On house is full of kids who live like dogs; another has a couple with a bizarre obsession with tickling. You play as Tom, a creepy girl who's tasked with delivering packages to the people of her wacky town, which is depicted with storybook-style illustrations and a color palette limited to black, white, and red. It's a pretty short experience, completable in just a few hours, making it a nice palate cleanser between the massive releases at the end of the year.

Berdasarkan laporan, this devolver digital-published game has a simple but head-turning premise. You’re a profoundly angry woman who returns to her small hometown armed with nothing but a sledgehammer, which she uses to smash everything in sight. The town is also inhabited by robots possessing human consciousnesses. Swinging the hammer can either punch holes through walls or, with enough force, reduce entire buildings to rubble. But why is she doing this? Why is she so mad? A big part of Virtue and a Sledgehammer’s allure is its fascinating and well-written tale about the protagonist’s strained relationships with her sister and mother. Learning more about their lives requires you to keep smashing, but the more you learn, the more you begin to question whether smashing everything is actually a good idea.

Berdasarkan laporan, this bizarre indie blends fun match-3 puzzle-solving with tower defense gameplay wrapped around a funny but surreal story. The match-3 gameplay involves sliding tiles to match geographic elements like castles, trees, and rivers to collect resources that feed into the tower defense portion. Depending on how the board looks when the puzzle portion ends, you send troops (sustained by the resources you collected) to attack/defend against rival castles and gather more items; board positioning determines how well this can go. The two mechanics feed into each other to create a fun loop that grows in complexity as new mechanics are introduced. Did I mention the game is also very weird? The silly tale centers on a medieval court designating you the chosen savior to rescue their lost queen (and many other tasks), and the dumb tone adds personality to a sometimes dry genre. Titanium Court charmed and impressed us when it launched on PC earlier this year, and now console and mobile players get their chance to hold court.

Berdasarkan laporan, sword of the sea is a beautiful, 2025 game about surfing through the sand atop a floating sword. Giant Squid also made 2016's Abzû and 2020's The Pathless. And now you can play it on Switch 2. It recalls Journey, the emotional 2012 PlayStation game, which makes sense as it comes from the artists and developers that worked on that game, developer Giant Squid. It's a talented team and Sword of the Sea maintains that reputation. You can read my full review of the game (though this review pertains to the PlayStation 5 version) right here.

Berdasarkan laporan, cities: skylines arrived on pc more than a decade ago, but is still revered as one of the greatest modern city-builders. Even now, three years after the sequel's release, Paradox continues supporting and porting the original game. As of this week, Switch 2 owners can play a less compromised version, expanding the Switch's 9-tile limit to a much larger 25-tile limit, as well as better performance and textures, better control panels, and a ton of DLC and added content. A couple years after its initial release, Cities: Skylines received a strong console port, which did an admirable job of adapting the controls to gamepads, but the Switch version was always the weakest of the bunch. And on top of that, if you own the Switch 1 version, you get a deep discount on the Switch 2 version.

While not specifically about this new Switch 2 version, you can read our original reviews of the base PC version here, and the base console version here.

Berdasarkan laporan, minecraft has held its dominant spot in pop culture for so long that it's easy to forget a simple fact about it: the game is awesome. The opening gameplay loop is so satisfying that for many of my peers, whether they regularly play video games or not, it's only a matter of time before they boot up a new world again. You've certainly heard of it, and you've probably played it, but I still feel it often doesn't get the flowers it deserves in high-level critical discussions about games, despite its regular cadence of major updates. While you can never play the game for the first time again, if you haven't checked it out in a couple years, you might be surprised by the amount of new blocks, materials, and mobs they've added in recent updates. This week, it's coming to Switch 2, giving potential miners another platform to explore procedurally-generated caves in. And if you've never played before, the Switch 2 launch is as good a time as any to see what all the fuss is about.
