Contributor at DualShockers, former Esports Insider DACH content lead, former Escapist Magazine Germany content lead, software engineering background.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nvidia has announced that co-founder jensen huang has resigned as president, ceo and board member, effective immediately. The announcement didn’t give a reason, although it obviously arrived after very public reports of extramarital affairs, one of them reportedly with a woman US intelligence officials suspect of being a Chinese spy. CFO Colette Kress has been named interim CEO whilst continuing as CFO, with Harvey Jones becoming the board’s first-ever chair. Neither NVIDIA nor Huang has confirmed the reporting, but investors reacted regardless, with shares falling as much as 14% at the open.

Masato Kumzawa addresses fan reactions to Grace Ashcroft's design and the impact of NVIDIA's DLSS 5 AI technology.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ultimately, i’m not that interested in the gossip. What interests me far more is what happens to a company that has spent the last few years being defined by one man’s bet on AI, and whether that opens the door for the side of the business that first made NVIDIA a household name. For anyone who has tried to buy a graphics card recently, that is a rather important question.

Berdasarkan laporan, huang co-founded nvidia in 1993 and ran it for more than 33 years, with the move into ai being very much his decision. It has paid off enormously, because data centres now make up roughly 91. 5% of the company’s revenue. The flip side is that nobody else has been quite as closely tied to that strategy, which makes for some interesting possibilities for NVIDIA’s future.

Berdasarkan laporan, kress has been cfo since 2013 and is a well-respected voice with the market, and etoro’s josh gilbert described her as a familiar and trusted presence, whilst adding that a company known for its technical edge might want an engineer in the chair. Analyst Dan Ives expects her stint as interim CEO to last around a year before NVIDIA looks outside. NVIDIA’s company structure is interesting in that it doesn’t make finding a solution any easier: Huang had more than 60 people reporting to him directly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nvidia has no coo, and reports suggest there was no succession plan in place. The internal names analysts have put forward, such as Ian Buck, Bill Dally, Michael Kagan and Bryan Catanzaro, are largely AI and data centre figures, but none of them has been the face of the strategy in the way Huang was. Constellation Research’s Ray Wang pointed out that many of NVIDIA’s partnerships and investments came about because people trusted Jensen.

Diungkapkan bahwa which brings me to the hopium. NVIDIA started out making graphics cards for gamers, and CNBC has pointed out that those gamers helped keep the company afloat back in 1999 by buying the GeForce 256. These days they account for under 10% of revenue, and it shows: RTX 50-series production was reportedly cut by up to 40% earlier this year, the Super refresh was reportedly shelved, and the next generation has reportedly drifted towards 2028. Meanwhile, the RTX 5090 launched at $1,999 and third-party sellers have been asking far more than that ever since.

Nvidia DLSS 5 is officially supported in 2K27, but eager fans have found their own way to enable the software in a myriad of titles.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so it isn’t hard to see why some gamers are hoping the board promotes someone with roots on that side of the business. Jeff Fisher, SVP of GeForce, has been at NVIDIA since 1994, but it is obvious that Kress is probably the safer bet for investors. Jonah Alben, who has led GPU engineering since 2008, and co-founder Chris Malachowsky might also throw a hat into this race. It is however important to note that all of this is still very much speculation: nobody at NVIDIA has hinted at a gaming pivot, and whether that will happen with any likeliness will be heavily dependent on other factors.

Berdasarkan laporan, truth be told, i wouldn’t expect a new ceo to change much straight away, even one with a soft spot for gaming. The memory shortage squeezing GeForce is affecting the entire industry, with Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron reportedly prioritising AI customers for their high-bandwidth memory, and that won’t disappear because of who is sitting in the corner office.

Sebagaimana diketahui, whoever takes over will also inherit a company that has just lost its founder and a fair amount of investor confidence, which tends to make boards cautious rather than adventurous. Even so, I’d quite like to see someone in charge who remembers where GeForce came from, and who has some sympathy for the people still trying to buy one. For now, Kress is running both the company and its finances whilst the search for a permanent CEO gets under way.

New York Times report on Jensen Huang's unclear relationship with an alleged Chinese spy, Alice Huang.

Jensen Huang and Nvidia's board put out statements at the same time on Nvidia's newsroom.

Sebagaimana diketahui, export rules between the us and china go back to biden and that administration's trade war. The US had previously blocked China from accessing the latest in lithographic chipmaking machines, but started to go further into exports of high-end chips.

#520. Valve explains why it's running behind on Steam game approvals, asks developers to perform basic release checks to prevent re-reviews

📅 05 Nov 2026

Valve explains why it's running behind on Steam game approvals, asks developers to perform basic release checks to prevent re-reviews

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/steam-games-approvals-delayed-valve-response

In the wake of witnessing an unprecedented number of game submissions to Steam over the last few months, Valve has been forced to delay approvals in order to deal with the existing backlog.

Diungkapkan bahwa following complaints by game developers on social media and elsewhere, valve has now responded to explain why it's taking longer to get games approved. The short version: re-reviews are clogging up the system.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we aim to test every game build in a timely manner, typically within three-five business days," valve wrote in a steam post. "However, we're running a little behind right now and taking up to 12 business days. Much of that delay is due to having to re-review games, which isn't great for you or for us. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa as valve explained in the post, games need to be re-reviewed when they're rejected for missing key quality assurance checks. In an effort to make it easier for developers to get it right the first time, Valve updated the Steam release checklist to include new, tighter requirements.

Sebagaimana diketahui, these include a requirement to run the game through steam for at least five minutes. According to Valve, some of the games submitted have not been played through Steam.

"This means that even if a game runs smoothly when a dev launches their executable directly, they might have missed basic steps that would impact a user installing and playing via Steam," Valve explained.

Sebagaimana diketahui, valve is also making it a rule to mention whether the game requires common redistributables such as directx, visual c++,. While Steam can automatically install many common redistributables, it needs to know which ones are needed (if any). NET, XNA. There are also new rules about achievement readiness, cloud save detection, and some updates to Steam store page requirements.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we now surface some of the most common issues we see missed, along with asking for some information to help our reviewers from the start," valve added. "For example, if your game offers multiple languages and you've indicated that on your store page, we'll ask you to ensure you've included them in your build".

While Valve did not directly name gen-AI as a potential reason for this rise in the number of poor submissions, it's clear the Steam company needs to find a way to deal with the massive number of AI-assisted games.

Sebagaimana diketahui, valve recently addressed steam's ai game cloning problem by suggesting developers make their games less copyable. Incidentally, some of the developers whose game approvals are delayed now fear their games will be cloned by others using gen-AI and land a Steam page before the original article has made it out of submission.

Sebagaimana diketahui, published by french union le syndicat des travailleureuses du jeu vidéo - one of two unions who represent workers at arkane, the other being printemps écologique, who didn't issue a similar message - the official english translation of the statement begins by insisting that "work on blade is going fine". ".

"Nvidia Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately," a statement on Nvidia's newsroom says.

Jensen Huang has been embroiled in a scandal, or rather a couple of scandals, over the past few weeks.

First, an affair to which he later admitted; suggested to have been with a datacentre company executive suspected of working for Chinese intelligence.

Second, another alleged affair, this time with an executive at Nvidia.

The markets may get spooked by the announcement, as Huang was a co-founder of the business (founded in 1993, making Huang the longest CEO of a major tech firm) and has overseen the company through its latest and largest success.

The share price for the company had already plummeted to its lowest levels since June 2025 following a report that the company's board was considering ousting Huang.

The PC Gamer Circuit Breaker newsletter breaks down the latest PC gaming tech, and finds you the best deals on the best products.

Diungkapkan bahwa the move to appoint the company's long-standing cfo as interim ceo was an expected one, to help ease the transition from huang's leadership. Intel did something similar when the company ousted its CEO in 2018.

Berdasarkan laporan, "colette kress, current executive vice president and chief financial officer of nvidia, has agreed to serve as interim chief executive officer. #528. The Top 10 Best Horror Games To Play This Halloween

📅 30 Oct 2026

The Top 10 Best Horror Games To Play This Halloween

Tanggal: 30 Oct 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/feature/2026/10/30/the-top-10-best-horror-games-to-play-this-halloween

Berdasarkan laporan, humans are drawn to horror in all forms, real life and fiction. Perhaps it’s the desire to get as close to death as possible without actually dying; perhaps it’s the morality of life and knowing death comes for all of us; perhaps all our heads are just a little miswired. Whatever the reason, we flock to movies where supernatural entities and puppets on tricycles upend otherwise lovely lives, TV shows where murderous cults kill and stump local detectives, and books where the words on the page seem to follow you to bed. Games, however, go a step further, letting you enter the horror and control it (or become its victim), and you could argue that, as a result, they’re the most immersive form of fiction.

Berdasarkan laporan, we at game informer love a healthy dose of horror from time to time, and we often review games like this. This isn’t an all-time list, so don’t fret if your personal favorite isn’t here. Others… don’t. Below is a list of 10 of the best horror games we’ve played recently. Some terrify us. And the best ones stick with us for years and years after the credits. Instead, this is a collection of 10 horror games ordered by release date that we think are great for spooky season and beyond. Let us know in the comments what you would add to the list!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the cozy corner of the horror genre seems to have exploded overnight, and now tons of new slice-of-life horror games are in various stages of development. Just follow the important rules: don't go out at night, don't share secrets, and don't leave the village among others. The Village in the Shade takes things back to the homestead, giving you (a child who emerged from a hole in the ground and was immediately given the responsibility of running an entire farm by yourself) the freedom to plant, sow, reap, ranch, and more. You wouldn't want to break the rules, right? You could, theoretically, go about your idyllic rural living. That said, the team behind newcomer The Village in the Shade is no stranger to the form; they made the Yomawari series, a cute-and-terrifying collection of creepy virtual tales. But as you unravel the threads of what this village is, who you are, and why you're here, it's hard not to get drawn into the strange, mysterious, delightfully disturbing truths hiding in its shadows. Just don't forget to water your turnips before you go sneaking out again.

Berdasarkan laporan, fans of survival horror and old-school fmv adventure games will find plenty to love (and fear) in tenebris somnia. Tenebris Somnia may not look like much due to its classic pixelated presentation, but its scares and story captivate. High-production, live-action cutscenes help tell the story of a deteriorating relationship and the toll an indie horror film took on its creators, and they play an important role in gameplay. When a young woman visits her ex-boyfriend’s apartment and discovers he's trapped in a hellish dream world, it kicks off a well-executed survival-horror trek of inventive puzzles and resource management to overcome dangerous monsters. – Our Review.

Sebagaimana diketahui, resident evil requiem is not just one of the best resident evil games, but it’s also one of the best horror games ever made. Requiem splits its runtime between the two characters, letting you experience both sides of Capcom’s marquee survival-horror style. Kennedy, however, is a veteran of all that and more. It’s perfect for someone who wants to feel scared and then soon after receive the catharsis of being the one in control, like being the tragic victim who dies in Act One of the horror movie and the last one standing who lives to tell the tale. Leon’s sections leave your hands shaking with adrenaline and your blood pumping with excitement as he mows down zombies (sometimes literally, courtesy of those pesky chainsaws). The result is a Resident Evil game that blends two typical RE experiences – terrifying and tough or exhilarating over-the-top action – into one cohesive package. Leon S. Grace Ashcroft is timid, new to the whole “shooting zombies in the head while dealing with Umbrella viruses” thing, and is generally just trying to do her job. Grace’s sections leave your hands clammy and your blood pressure high as you desperately try to survive. It features a unique dual-protagonist structure. – Our Review.

Sebagaimana diketahui, little nightmares developer tarsier studios has a knack for delivering creepy side-scrolling adventures, but reanimal eschews any whimsy to become its scariest game yet. Escaping the game’s island setting is thrilling and chilling whether you’re playing alone or with a friend in co-op. While mechanically it is similar to Little Nightmares and still puts small children in unimaginable peril, Reanimal is capital-H horror thanks largely to its terrifying threats and disturbing animal-themed imagery (this probably isn’t the game for animal lovers; some messed-up stuff happens to these critters). Months after release, we’re still thinking about Reanimal’s memorable final sequence, which is worth the price of admission on its own. – Our Review.

Berdasarkan laporan, 2001’s silent hill 2 is considered one of the best horror video games of all time for good reason. The story of James Sunderland and his troubling relationship with his departed wife is complex, emotional, and – important for the purposes of this list – unsettling and scary. At release, it was a graphical powerhouse, using the PlayStation 2's horsepower to create a setting that begged to be explored, even though every bone in your body said you shouldn’t. The remake from developer Bloober Team took on a big task in modernizing the game without losing the original’s soul, and it did a great job. Among all the recent Silent Hill releases (Silent Hill f, Silent Hill: Townfall), the remake is our favorite. – Our Review.

Diungkapkan bahwa alan wake 2 is an excellent pick for some spooky madness, in the vein of david lynch’s seminal twin peaks mystery-surrealist series. Don’t worry too much about the “2” part of the game’s title. He’s only one half of the Alan Wake 2 equation, with his segments set in a dream-like version of New York City. Playing as him feels the most Twin Peaks-y. But this is still a Remedy Entertainment game, and without spoiling anything, it goes places. The other half is Saga, a police officer who arrives in the Pacific Northwest town of Bright Falls to investigate a murder that might be linked to a cult. And along the way, you can expect plenty of scares. Turn the lights down low (or off), light a candle, and sit back and enjoy one of Remedy’s best games. You can expect more traditional survival-horror gameplay from her. You just need to know that the titular Alan Wake character is a not-great writer who acts like he’s really great, his wife is missing, and he got trapped in the ambiguous Dark Place. – Our Review.

Sebagaimana diketahui, square enix has gone two-for-two with its paranormasight series, an anthology of stories about the strange and occult. And while the more recent Mermaid's Curse is a brilliant tale all its own, the first entry – The Seven Mysteries of Honjo – brings significantly more scares. A group of people in the city of Honjo find themselves caught in a spectral battle royale, using powerful objects and conditions to curse one another, with the allure of a prize at the end. Its magic isn't just in the flowchart timeline, where you can hop between different perspectives and protagonists to see how events play out from every angle, but also in the gorgeous stereoscopic environments and narrative puzzles. Adventure games are a classic genre, and Paranormasight will remind you of what the genre is capable of the moment you slowly spin your camera around, your eyes peeking out from behind your fingers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, survival horror can contain multitudes, and as the years have worn on, the genre has grown to encompass a wide range of action-combat mechanics. As the Replika unit Elster, you delve deep into a remote complex filled with horrors and monsters, searching for something, or someone, waiting down below. It's an isometric survival-horror indie project from developer rose-engine, filled with clever puzzles, scarce resources, limited inventory slots, and looming, oppressive dread. Signalis feels like a re-centering in that respect. While love for classic horror games and other hallmarks of genre fiction will certainly draw you in, the stylish presentation and devastatingly human core will keep you forging ahead to the finale. Once you've breached the surface of Signalis' retro-future super-structures, you won't be able to turn back.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in horror movies, audiences often groan at a protagonist for putting themselves in seemingly grave danger just to learn more about a cursed amulet or bloodthirsty killer. By scrubbing through footage, you can select people or items in each scene and jump to random footage from any other movie that includes the same person or item. It's a game about Marisa Marcel, an actress who almost starred in three movies in the late 20th century, but has since disappeared. None of the movies were ever released due to mysterious circumstances, but you have access to the archived, unedited live-action footage, including behind-the-scenes conversations. The approach to puzzle-solving is unique and keeps you appropriately disoriented. The mystery at the center is an unsettling treat to unravel, and scary in new and unexpected ways. But in Immortality, you are the protagonist, and despite a lingering sense that you shouldn't be digging into the archives of these abandoned films, each eerie new scene makes you want to dive deeper. Immortality is one of a kind and an easy recommendation for horror fans who want to try something a little different.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the decade since launch, dead by daylight has continued to succeed, thanks to a dedicated (and newcomer-friendly) fanbase and its towering roster of original and licensed personas from across pop culture horror. The asymmetrical multiplayer title has become an anthology of horror’s biggest faces, including Freddy Krueger, Ghostface, Pyramid Head, and even the Xenomorph. Whether you play as a Survivor, trying to escape all manner of nightmare locations through stealth and cunning, or as a Killer, whose experience feels more like a hunting club, you’ll understand why Dead by Daylight has become a recurring destination for fans of the gruesome and bizarre.

Berdasarkan laporan, read about the making of dead by daylight and how it sunk its teeth into millions of players in our six-page exclusive feature in issue 368 (p. 42), available in our magazine archive to anyone with a free Game Informer account.

#529. Oblivion and Skyrim’s gap was bridged by forward-looking books about a murderous floating island, so why is The Elder Scrolls 6 stuck reanimating a world that’s stood still since 2011

📅 04 Nov 2026

Oblivion and Skyrim’s gap was bridged by forward-looking books about a murderous floating island, so why is The Elder Scrolls 6 stuck reanimating a world that’s stood still since 2011

Tanggal: 04 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/oblivion-and-skyrims-gap-was-bridged-by-forward-looking-books-about-a-murderous-floating-island-so-why-is-the-elder-scrolls-6-stuck-reanimating-a-world-thats-stood-still-since-2011

Why the Umbri-hell has time stopped in Tamriel?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, long waits between mainline entries in a series aren’t a new phenomenon, if perhaps a bit more common nowadays due to big games' ballooning development cycles. It took about 23 years for BioWare’s Baldur's Gate 2 to be followed up by Larian’s Baldur’s Gate 3, though there were a decent amount of spin-offs and remasters peppered between the two.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the wait for the elder scrolls 6: sentinel hasn’t stretched on that long quite yet, but as bethesda finally revealed concrete details about it just in time for skyrim's 15th birthday, it really hit home for me that tes vi will be tasked with restoring motion to a world where calendars have been stuck in the 201st year of the 4th era since 2011. Perhaps it’s because I’m still in my twenties and haven’t lived long enough to see that many things I like pause their forward march for this long before returning. There’s also a good chance my expectations of timelines rolling forward on a regular basis without the need for a whole new entry are coloured by the constant stream of new stuff fed into most games via updates and live service passes these days.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, when i look back at the interregnum between the last two elder scrolls games, oblivion and skyrim, i can’t help but feel that what bethesda and zenimax have packed into the gap between skyrim and sentinel might have done the latter no favours. Sure, The Elder Scrolls Online has arguably meant that there’s been far more for series fans to sink their teeth into between mainline games than ever before, but because the MMO's a prequel, none of its tales and lore push the Elder Scrolls' timeline forwards. Meanwhile mobile and card game spin-offs like The Elder Scrolls: Blades, The Elder Scrolls: Legends, and The Elder Scrolls: Castles have all either slotted in before Skyrim or not been tied to a specific point in time.

Sebagaimana diketahui, on one hand, that leaves the devs a nice clean slate to take the sixth entry wherever they like narratively upon the conclusion of the dragonborn’s adventures. On the other, Bethesda has missed the opportunity to paint out the world and further set up the stakes for Sentinel in the interim. Back when we were waiting for Skyrim's original release, the developers were pumping out spin-off books that daubed some fresh adventures onto the Elder Scrolls' canvas.

I bought these books - 2009’s The Infernal City and 2011’s Lord of Souls - ages ago upon hearing their tales referenced in the sorts of Elder Scrolls lore videos which appeal to sad nerds of my ilk, but have only gotten around to reading past the opening chapters in recent months.

Diungkapkan bahwa in hindsight, i think i bounced off them that first time because it just felt a bit weird to be reading about set characters getting up to adventures in tamriel rather than setting off on them in the boots of my own custom created protagonist. Anyway, the two Elder Scrolls novels by American author Greg Keyes tell the tale of the Umbriel crisis which took place 48 years after the Oblivion crisis and about 153 years before Skyrim’s dragon crisis (Tamriel does love a crisis). The Umbriel crisis saw a floating island powered by souls and formed via some Daedric drama, carve a path of destruction from Black Marsh to the Imperial City. I didn’t run into the same with The Witcher, as you’re seeing that world through Gerry from the River’s eyes no matter where you turn. Yep, the empire’s not-Roman soldiers had to fight a flying hunk of land. At one point some mages had to float a legion up in the sky so they could get their bottoms kicked by Umbriel’s defenders.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as you might’ve gathered, the books take the opportunity to tell a story which - especially in terms of where tech was in 2009 - wouldn’t necessarily fit an elder scrolls game. A lot of time’s spent looking through the eyes of two characters who’ve snuck aboard Umbriel, the floating island, after it destroyed their hometown and have to adjust to the strange customs of its inhabitant lords and their underlings before finding ways to help take it down. Or, at least, not one of the more straight-laced variety Bethesda have made in their post-Morrowind days. On the ground, things take a more familiar form, as a very serious Dark Elf named Sul and a nepo baby Imperial prince trek across bits of Cyrodiil, Morrowind, and Elsweyr on a quest to do their bit in vanquishing the threat. Then, there’s a Penitus Oculatus spy named Colin trying to figure out if the Umbriel Crisis is an inside job of some sort and a few tales of regular Imperial troops working to evacuate citizens living in the floating island’s path. In an Elder Scrolls game, you’d get some of that, but not be able to hop from person to person chapter by chapter in the fashion the books do.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, umbriel slowly floats across black marsh, southern morrowind and cyrodiil with an army of zombies in tow, much like this article’s about to float into mildly spoilery territory for the two books. As the latter game’s lore books would subsequently set in stone, Baar Dau - the meteor suspended in the air above Vivec City at the time of Morrowind - fell and destroyed the city following the disappearance of the metropolis’ namesake ex-Tribunal god-king. The books reveal that the big rock didn’t fall the moment Vivec vanished, but was kept afloat by a device called the Ingenium, which is essentially a magic box powered by regular soul sacrifices. You see, The Infernal City and Lord of Souls outline what happened to cause the red year, a volcanic eruption which took the land of the Dark Elves from the beautifully alien place it was at the time of The Elder Scrolls 3 and reduced it to the ash-covered wasteland it’s outlined to be at the time of Skyrim. Two Dunmer, Vuhon and the aforementioned Sul, ended up having a fight rooted in the tech’s murderous nature and that’s actually what led Baar Dau to finally hit the ground.

Diungkapkan bahwa either way, the meteor falls, but that's not an insubstantial bit of backstory for a source outside of the games to add to the elder scrolls’ canon. In the games, the latter’s always just been a powerful sword which imprints a new personality onto its wielder, but in the books it’s portrayed as a being capable of nicking some of Vile’s godly power and plotting to escape the prince’s realm of Oblivion via the building of Umbriel. Also wound into the tale of how Umbriel came to be is a bunch of extra flesh on the bone of the relationship between Daedric prince Clavicus Vile and Umbra. Beyond those, the books also offer a chance to get to know emperor Titus Mede I, the warlord who took over the Empire following a post-Oblivion crisis interregnum and whose offspring you murder during Skyrim’s Dark Brotherhood questline.

Sebagaimana diketahui, none of this is anything close to required knowledge for playing skyrim. The sole reference I can recall comes via a chat about a location called Sleeping Tree Camp, which isn’t tied to any of the main questlines. No characters from the books pop up to say hello, likely because enough time’s passed for most to perish of natural causes. You can, and I did for a long time, totally ignore these time-bridging tomes. That said, I do feel that having now taken the time to read them has helped me see the history of Tamriel as something not as strictly limited to the specific snapshots in time presented by each of the games.

Berdasarkan laporan, tales like these, which aren’t conveyed with as much natural emotional detachment as i tend to feel when reading much-condensed accounts of historical events or far off places on the pages of in-game lore books, really help in creating the illusion that the elder scrolls’ world is growing and evolving as our own does. It’s not just a snow globe that only shifts whenever some prophesied hero piloted by a controller or keyboard rocks up to shake it.

Berdasarkan laporan, i do think, in large part due to the size of the real world gap between it and skyrim, the elder scrolls 6 would have and still could benefit from having spin-offs like these to keep gently nudging the timeline forwards. Unless Bethesda wanted to either put serious barriers up around where the spin-off could tread or get into a game of arbitrarily deciding what is or isn’t canon. That’d mean no 200-ish years of wiggle room in which to slot some spin-off stories without serious risk of influencing things that’d have to be reflected in the new game. A complicating factor is that judging by this week’s teaser, Sentinel seems like it could be set in the 206th year of the fourth era, a mere five years after the events of Skyrim. With some collaboration, it could certainly be done, but it could also be a headache the studio wouldn’t want.

It’s likely too late to start the ball rolling now anyway, but that doesn’t stop it being worth asking why Bethesda and their famously adaptation-loving corporate bosses at Microsoft didn’t make sure they had something akin to these books in the works when Sentinel was punted down the road in favour of Starfield.

Berdasarkan laporan, you did this well once, why haven’t you managed to pull it off again this time? i’m hoping that isn’t the inquiry which’ll come to define the elder scrolls 6 as much as questions about where a chunk of the old bethesda magic had gone did with the studio’s trip to space. Lest the next long wait for a game from them be packed with even more uncomfortable silence.

#532. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Navi actor reprises her role after 28 years, but it was a total accident due to Nintendo's blind auditions

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Navi actor reprises her role after 28 years, but it was a total accident due to Nintendo's blind auditions

Tanggal: 04 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/nintendo-cast-navi-actor-zelda-ocarina-of-time

For The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's shiny new remake, Nintendo unintentionally cast the same actor twice - 28 years apart - to deliver Navi's infamous "Heys!" and "Listens!".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the switch 2's ocarina of time makes a pretty substantial change to the n64's ocarina of time, released almost three decades prior. There's proper voice acting this time, of course - not just grunts and murmurs and hyahs. But even when retroactively adding new things, Nintendo wanted to ensure the remake's cast matched the original's pretty faithfully, so the developer held blind auditions that eventually paved the way for one actor to reprise their role during Link's adventure.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we felt that if we were going to improve the graphics so dramatically, the cutscenes needed to be fully voiced to match," director hokwai ng explained in the most recent ask the developer blog. We absolutely didn't want to change anything as iconic as that. Even someone who's never played The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time may have heard it before. "But at the same time, we knew we shouldn't mess with established perceptions of how certain characters sound based on the original. Navi's "Listen!" is one example. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to maintain the original's nostalgic sounds and voices, nintendo held blind auditions with the goal of finding actors who could recreate the "feel of the original game. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, series director eiji aonuma recalls that the team wanted to choose actors "based solely on which voices most closely resembled those of the original. " And, who woulda guessed? "As fate would have it, one of the actors we selected had actually voiced the same character in the Nintendo 64 version. None of us saw that coming. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the duo didn't outright name which character they're talking about, but fans have long been speculating that kaori mizuhashi might be reprising her role as link's trusty fairy companion navi - at least, in the japanese language version. A leaked online video of the game's credits now also confirms that Mizuhashi is back almost three decades later. I suppose it only makes sense that the person who most closely resembles Navi is Navi.

Sebagaimana diketahui, stardeus has received a gargantuan early access update that has been "a year in the making," according to developer kodo linija. It's still a game about being an AI running a badly damaged interstellar colony ship in top-down view – sending drones to restore the damage, before waking the quarrelsome human popsicles from their slumber. But the new version introduces a quest system and a new opening tutorial chain, the ability to form alliances with other starfaring factions, the possibility of lifelong injury due to failed surgery, and the timely option to become an evil AI and mind-control your crew with beta waves, amongst other dastardly antics.

Berdasarkan laporan, it introduces a new interface and a new ship aesthetic, a trust system that governs the odds of a mutiny, and a revised colonist skill system. There's also a freshened-up ground combat element that's now built around "cover, suppression, stuns and fleeing", and a new approach to space battles that's all about managing Flux generated when you fire weapons or take shield damage. The update notes on Steam tote more than 1,500 changes, with the dev enthusing that there is "hardly a system in the game that wasn't rebuilt, reworked or expanded".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i confess, i hadn't heard of stardeus before. It sounds like fun, in the Dwarf Fortressian sense. The 1. 0 rollout is due in "approximately Q1 2027".

#535. EA Reportedly Closed BioWare To Invest In Developing Star Wars Battlefront III Instead Of The Next Mass Effect

📅 30 Oct 2026

EA Reportedly Closed BioWare To Invest In Developing Star Wars Battlefront III Instead Of The Next Mass Effect

Tanggal: 30 Oct 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/2026/10/30/ea-reportedly-closed-bioware-to-invest-in-developing-star-wars-battlefront-iii-instead

Sebagaimana diketahui, electronic arts shut down the legendary rpg studio bioware last week, ending development on an untitled fifth mass effect game. Since then, we've seen what appears to be a leaked trailer for the game, which suggests it might have been called Mass Effect Universe, and heard a sneak peek at what Grammy-winning composer Austin Wintory was cooking up for the beloved sci-fi RPG series. Over the past week, fans across the internet have tried to piece together how a publisher could decide to shut down a studio as prolific as BioWare, but according to a new Bloomberg report, the answer is Star Wars.

Diungkapkan bahwa more specifically, bloomberg writes that, presented with the opportunity to develop star wars battlefront iii with disney, the publisher, which went private last year after a $55 billion acquisition,  chose to invest its money into that instead of bioware's in-development mass effect sequel. The publication writes that EA looked at its portfolio for the coming years and had two massive sci-fi investments it could continue: Star Wars Battlefront III or BioWare's next Mass Effect. Even though Mass Effect was well into development, and even though the Battlefront threequel hasn't even entered development, EA chose to continue with the latter. And so BioWare was shut down, and Mass Effect development ended, though Bloomberg's sources say there are other, less significant reasons the studio was shuttered, too.

Those other factors include the poor reception to 2017's Mass Effect: Andromeda, the failure of Anthem in 2019, and 2024's Dragon Age: The Veilguard, which, despite garnering positive critical reception, apparently missed EA's sales expectations by 50%.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's also the uncomfortable reality that bioware made progressive lgbtqia+ positive games but was a studio within a publisher house now partially owned by the public investment fund of saudi arabia, a government fund from a country where same-sex activity, including marriage, is criminalized, sometimes punishable by death; these harsh laws extend to other facets of the lgbtqia+ community. Another investment partner in this acquisition of EA is Affinity Partners, a Miami-based investment firm founded and run by former White House senior advisor Jared Kushner, who is the son-in-law of President Donald Trump, a political figure who imposes laws that discriminate against the LGBTQIA+ community, especially the 1% of Americans who are transgender; Trump has also been known to mock this community in various ways. No official statements say BioWare shut down because of its progressive leanings, but one has to wonder if that was a factor, especially after reports that BioWare scrubbed diversity from demos to avoid negative feedback from EA (thanks, Kotaku).

When BioWare closed last week, only 50 employees remained, all working on the next Mass Effect, after years of layoffs at the studio.

A Mass Effect TV series is still in the works at Amazon, even though EA seems to have hung up Commander Shepard's video game suit for good.

Apostoledes' remarks were followed up by pre-recorded comments from Requiem director Koshi Nakanishi, who said he was "thrilled" to accept the award, and spoke about how encouraging it was for a single-player game to win, especially in such a crowded field.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while resi itself will be making the big headlines, however, apostoledes touched on an interesting point: the legendary run that capcom itself is on. As well as claiming two GOTY titles for Requiem, that title also secured wins in the Best Game Trailer category, and a Best Lead Performer win for Grace Ashcroft actress Angela Sant'Albano. But two of Capcom's other titles - Pragmata and Onimusha: Way of the Sword - were also in contention for several categories, each one claiming its own win. Onimusha took the prize for Best Audio Design, while Diana actress Grace Saif took home Best Supporting Performer for her role in Pragmata. With three out of its four major releases this year claiming wins, perhaps it was of little surprise that Capcom would also take home the prize for Studio of the Year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, 2026 has been a jewel in a crown that capcom has been polishing for some time now. In the last four years, it's been on an excellent run. It's been a relatively slow, quiet process, but Capcom has rarely put a foot wrong since 2020, and the community is starting to take note. Elsewhere, it's been turning Resident Evil back into an essential release, breathing new life into classics, and successfully bringing life to new IP. The last time a new release has slipped below a MetaCritic score of 80 was 2023's Exoprimal, and the closest thing it's had to a flop was Monster Hunter Wilds, which was plagued by performance issues. 2027 looks like a quieter year for the studio, but with Resident Evil Veronica on the horizon, it looks like fans will still be eating pretty well.

#537. 5 new mobile games to try this week - November 12th, 2026

📅 12 Nov 2026

5 new mobile games to try this week - November 12th, 2026

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pocketgamer.com/new-weekly-mobile-games/november-12th-2026/

Fresh mobile picks you should give a go this week.

Who doesn't love new games? We certainly do - there's just something about the exhilaration of a new title you can't wait to dive into, as the loading screen pops up and you enter a brave new world.

Of course, new mobile games are a dime a dozen these days, and who has the time to scour the iPhone, iPad and/or Android stores to catch the latest title that drops? Fret not - we've gathered a quick list of 5 new mobile games you should try this week, whether that's an undiscovered indie gem or a high-profile AAA masterpiece.

That said, you can head on over to our NEW WEEKLY MOBILE GAMES hub if you're on the hunt for more curated adventures to obsess over!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, perhaps the release that a good number of people on our team are the most excited about is warhammer survivors, and despite not being a warhammer fan myself, i can totally understand why. This Survivors-like take on the popular franchise is, as Iwan and Will put it, the perfect pair, especially since it was crafted in partnership with poncle of Vampire Survivors fame.

You'll try to survive in this "bullet heaven" shooter using more than 40 characters from Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar, taking down endless hordes of foes across mobile-optimised controls to boot.

One of the most important elements of a classic whodunit is to piece together clues based on what suspects are saying - but what if you had to solve the case across an entirely wordless affair? I suppose that's the biggest challenge that Hillthorn poses to anyone who dares to take it on, as you'll have to put two and two together to get to the bottom of things using purely card-based clues.

Sebagaimana diketahui, time is of the essence, so you'll really need to put your detective cap on to find a child who's gone missing. There are multiple endings to discover, so it's safe to say that after every short run, you'll likely want to revisit the eerie mysteries of Hillthorn over and over again.

I don't think there's anything else that embodies the pick-up-and-play nature of mobile more perfectly than one-thumb portrait-mode endeavours, and Rocket Rally is right up that alley! It is, as you might expect, a quick arcade racer where you'll need to boost and drift to the finish line in just 30 seconds, and with a wide variety of rally cars you can add to your collection too.

As you progress, you'll unlock upgrades for your car to ramp up your races, all so you can beat your own best time or aim for the top spot in the leaderboards.

I feel like Crossy Road Rush is perfectly suited for Apple Arcade, as the absence of ads and in-app purchases definitely adds to the endless runner's charm - and especially so since Crossy Road is such a staple on mobile! This time around, you'll be running through colourful environments similar to Subway Surfers, with a whole bunch of cool stuff to collect and obstacles to overcome.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there are more than 50 levels to discover and daily challenges to take on, as well as family sessions you can join in on with up to four players. I'd say it's definitely a fresh take on the franchise - after all, where else can you squad up with your fam to take on a giant Octoboss?.

Berdasarkan laporan, the concept of climbing an endless tower is nothing new, but i suppose this is the first time i've ever encountered one where you're meant to crank it up - quite literally. A Fool's Errand was originally made for the Playdate, where you turn a literal crank to help your hero ascend. Now that it's out on mobile, you'll still do the same climbing without the physical crank - but with the same atmospheric visuals and intriguing story.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there are plenty of traps to avoid along the way, and it's really all about the journey as you keep climbing on - as the title suggests - a fool's errand. Whether or not what awaits you at the top is worth it is anybody's guess - and I suppose you'll just have to make the climb yourself to find out.

Diungkapkan bahwa things start getting interesting in february, when shrouded sky will begin. This chapter brings three exciting additions to Arc Raiders. There will be a new Map Condition, new Arc Threat, and the start of another Player Project.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the flashpoint chapter begins in march, when we’re expecting another new map condition, one more new arc threat, as well as another player project. March’s most interesting addition is an update to everyone’s trusty rooster friend, Scrappy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, finally, april is when the big guns come out, because that’s when the first new map of 2026 will arrive in arc raiders. With it, comes a new large Arc, which is to be expected. A new Map Condition will debut then, too, likely starting off on the new map.

#540. Fate of the Galaxy is a huge, fully-featured Star Wars space combat sim that, thanks to being a total conversion mod for Freespace Open, even runs on my rubbish laptop

📅 04 Nov 2026

Fate of the Galaxy is a huge, fully-featured Star Wars space combat sim that, thanks to being a total conversion mod for Freespace Open, even runs on my rubbish laptop

Tanggal: 04 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/fate-of-the-galaxy-is-a-huge-fully-featured-star-wars-space-combat-sim-that-thanks-to-being-a-total-conversion-mod-for-freespace-open-even-runs-on-my-rubbish-laptop

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, star wars has been back in the news recently because, to cut a long story short, the us alt-right have decided that darth vader was actually the good guy. We are here to talk about Fate of the Galaxy, a free unofficial space combat simulator set during the events of the original Star Wars trilogy, featuring several mission-based campaigns and a stable of Imperial and Rebel Alliance ships that ranges from the quad-blasting X-Wing to Boba Fett's Firespray 31. We are not here to indulge such buffoonery. Also, Naboo starfighters, if you really must.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's a total conversion of poor dead volition's venerable dogfighter freespace 2, running on the open source free space 2 open engine via the popular knossos launcher. You don't need a copy of FreeSpace 2 to play it. And nor do you need a whizbang PC – this bucket of bolts hums along happily on my i5-1145G7 with no dedicated graphics card. You also don't need to pay. As the Rancor said to the padawan: finally, some good food.

Diungkapkan bahwa fate of the galaxy has been in development off and on for almost two decades, weathering a number of team changes and shifts of focus. It's not quite as bizarre as Portsmouth Sinfonia's Also sprach Zarathustra but it did make me cackle like the Emperor contemplating a freshly made asteroid field. It's not an officially licensed Star Wars production, as made evident by a scrolling text intro which takes the official orchestral theme and moves every note up or down a place, as though spitefully jolting the piano around under John Williams' fingers. The FreeSpace Wiki has a longer account of its travels. But then I began playing, and my presumptuous merriment became a frown of concentration.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while hardly steel battalion, fate of the galaxy is a proper nerdy sim with a bustling 3d cockpit and all sorts of keyboard shortcuts to try once and immediately forget. I can run the game fine on my work laptop with integrated graphics, but I'm definitely feeling the need for a beefier keyboard. And also a joystick. You'll need to funnel energy between fore and aft shields during bombing runs on Star Destroyers, target individual subsystems with your ion cannon, give orders to other pilots, and consider whether to synch different guns for maximum effect. Certainly, I'm not going to get far in LAN multiplayer with this hunk of junk.

Berdasarkan laporan, it seems a very generous production, based on 30 minutes playing kiss-chase with tie bombers. There's also VR support with head-tracking, should you own one of those haunted helmets. The story campaigns and quickfix stand-alone skirmishes aside, there's a mission editor with text-based files for easier sharing. Learn more via the online manual (Google Doc), and find Fate of the Galaxy itself on Moddb. You'll need around seven gigs of disc space.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this being the year 2026, there's the question of generative ai usage - a topic of much concern lately in modding circles. The FreeSpace Open engine itself greatly pre-dates today's chatbot invasion. I'm less sure about other aspects – there's seemingly some artificial VO during the tutorial, though it sounds like antiquated, less insidious robocaller software. Fate of the Galaxy's official site boasts that all the visual assets were "made by humans only". The original FreeSpace 2 launched in 1999 - a more civilised age, when everybody still thought Darth Vader was an arsehole.

Naughty Dog has been keeping Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet under wraps for quite some time, and fans hoping for a surprise gameplay reveal before the end of the year might want to temper their expectations (and yes, that’s also a self-note).

Berdasarkan laporan, its creative director neil druckmann, best known for creating the last of us, has finally offered an update on the studio's upcoming sci-fi adventure, confirming that the game is now playable and entering its final stages of production. But sadly, that doesn't mean we're getting a closer look at it anytime soon.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, during a recent appearance at comic creators block party 2026, druckmann spoke with host patton oswalt about the project, which was first announced at the game awards in december 2024. While he was careful not to reveal too much, he did share that the development team has reached an important milestone.

“We’re kind of at the last stage of production, where we can play it, and we’re refining and polishing it, and I can’t wait to show it to the world,” Druckmann explained.

MGS, Uncharted, Halo, and Assassin's Creed veteran, Robin Atkins Downes, is joining the cast of Intergalactic, Naughty Dog's new title.

Berdasarkan laporan, that's certainly encouraging news, especially considering how little we've seen of intergalactic since its initial reveal. However, players shouldn't mistake this update for a sign that Naughty Dog is preparing to release the game in the near future.

Berdasarkan laporan, druckmann actually reiterated something that naughty dog already confirmed back in september this year: they will remain quiet about intergalactic for the rest of 2026, with a full reveal planned for sometime next year. According to the creative director, the team will show “a lot” of the game in 2027, including gameplay and more of its story. He also teased that the final experience might surprise people, particularly those who think they already have a good idea of what Intergalactic will be.

Druckmann actually reiterated something that Naughty Dog already confirmed back in September this year: they will remain quiet about Intergalactic for the rest of 2026, with a full reveal planned for sometime next year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, considering that the first trailer mostly introduced protagonist jordan a. Mun and the game's mysterious sci-fi setting, there's still plenty Naughty Dog hasn't shown us! And, honestly, after waiting this long, a proper gameplay showcase sounds like the least we can ask for.

Neil Druckmann announced that this isn't the last we've seen of The Last of Us, with two new projects already in development.

Diungkapkan bahwa besides, druckmann also offered a little more insight into the creative direction behind intergalactic, describing it as a combination of three of naughty dog's biggest franchises. He explained that the studio wanted to return to sci-fi and fantasy after spending so much time working on the relatively grounded worlds of Uncharted and The Last of Us.

Diungkapkan bahwa for that, the team is drawing inspiration from the sci-fi and fantasy elements of jak and daxter, the pulpy action-adventure style of uncharted that we all miss deeply, and the more serious drama found in the last of us. He also highlighted the studio's ambition to expand its gameplay systems, asking whether Naughty Dog could maintain the cinematic storytelling it's known for while offering deeper gameplay mechanics.

Berdasarkan laporan, that's an interesting combination for sure, especially for a studio that has spent much of the last decade focusing on cinematic adventures. So we still have no release date for Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, but at least 2027 is shaping up to be the year we'll finally understand what the studio has been working on.

Berdasarkan laporan, a new teaser trailer for death stranding isolations, an upcoming animated series coming exclusively to disney+ and hulu next year, premiered during kojima productions’ 10th anniversary exhibition beyond the strand. The series was first announced last year.

Diungkapkan bahwa death stranding isolations tells an original story in the death stranding universe set immediately after the events of the first game. Isolations is created by Japanese animation studio E&H Production (Ninja Kamui, Bullet/Bullet, Magic Knight Rayerath) and directed by Takayuki Sano. Death Stranding creator Hideo Kojima serves as executive producer.

Today’s teaser video provides the following story synopsis:.

The Death Stranding—a catastrophic series of explosions caused when the dead crept into our world and collided with the living.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the wake of this cataclysm, many were forced to live in absolute isolation—among them, a young girl. Although this lonely existence was forced upon her, she soon grows to prefer solitude, eschewing all opportunities for real human connection and allowing herself to be strung along by fate.

Berdasarkan laporan, in death stranding, legendary game creator hideo kojima brought you a haunting vision of a shattered world. Now, that world expands into new frontiers with a brand-new animation series.

Under the guidance of director Takayuki Sano, world-class hand-drawn animations have been brought to life by renowned studio “E&H production” (NINJA KAMUI, BULLET/BULLET, the Magic Knight Rayearth television series).

Sebagaimana diketahui, the story is set in north america immediately after sam—the protagonist of the game—reconnects the continent by means of the chiral network. However, as America is reborn from the ashes, the renewed connections that bind it together bring about new and unforeseen consequences.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in this tumultuous new landscape, there are some who walk a different path to the one chosen by sam and his bridges comrades: a wise old man who connects people through a method that defies all reckoning; a female soldier ensnared in a cycle of war and destruction; a boy who seethes with rage at the absurdity of his life. and of course, the girl who chose to sever all ties with the outside world. Fate has other plans for her, however, and chance encounters see her launched headfirst into a world she does not recognize.

Diungkapkan bahwa death stranding isolations is coming to disney+ and hulu in 2027. It’s one of the three planned big-screen adaptations of the series. An animated movie called Death Stranding: Mosquito (working title) is also in the works alongside a live-action Death Stranding film by A24.

#546. "Keep talking about it": Raw Power Games call for Wishlist aid as they, and their historical strategy sandbox Chronicles: Medieval, lose funding

📅 04 Nov 2026

"Keep talking about it": Raw Power Games call for Wishlist aid as they, and their historical strategy sandbox Chronicles: Medieval, lose funding

Tanggal: 04 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/keep-talking-about-it-raw-power-games-call-for-wishlist-aid-as-they-and-their-historical-strategy-sandbox-chronicles-medieval-lose-funding

Raw Power Games, an independent studio comprising veteran developers of The Witcher 3, Total War: Three Kingdoms, and Crusader Kings III (among others), have called on players for support after losing their funding - an existential threat to both the organisation and to their debut, the still-in-development historical strategy game Chronicles: Medieval.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in a statement posted last week, raw power announced that "the necessary funding" behind the studio was no longer in place, despite chronicles: medieval – which was unveiled last year with an expensive-looking, tom hardy-narrated trailer – apparently being within touching distance of its planned early access launch. Hardy or no Hardy, however, the statement declared that they aren't "going down without a fight", hinting at talks with what could be possible new investors, asking interested would-be fans to "keep talking about" the game, and encouraging its inclusion on Steam Wishlists.

Diungkapkan bahwa a few days on, the impact of this rallying call remains unclear. Raw Power Games have made no further statements, and Chronicles: Medieval does not seem to appear on Steam's own list of Top Wishlisted games. SteamDB have it at #26 in their desire-o-rankings, representing no change from its position immediately before the funding announcement was made, and while the game's Steam follower count has increased by over 1,000 week-on-week – significantly more so than surrounding games in the list – that doesn't feel like the kind of wild grassroots support that might save a dozens-strong studio.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, still, as my childhood television used to say, every little helps, and i'm inclined to hope for raw power's survival if only as an antidote to the enthusiasm-poisining dread of seeing so many other developers being laid off and shut down. Chronicles: Medieval looks promisingly ambitious too, mashing up sprawling Mount & Blade-style battles with an RPG-flavoured strategy layer that involves the player's custom-created character ascending the snooty social hierarchy of 14th century England. Best of luck to everyone trying to get it over the early access line.

#547. The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel fans ponder split timelines, alternative histories, and more as story speculation runs wild following latest teaser

The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel fans ponder split timelines, alternative histories, and more as story speculation runs wild following latest teaser

Tanggal: 04 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/the-elder-scrolls-6-sentinel-story-speculation

Following the release of yesterday's brief new The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel teaser trailer, story speculation is running rampant across communities dedicated to the fantasy series, with fans theorising everything from alternative histories to split timelines.

Diungkapkan bahwa yesterday's teaser - which arrived as part of bethesda's 40th anniversary celebrations and comes amid devastating cuts across xbox's first-party studios - was minimal. It opened with a shot of desert sand, before revealing the subtitle 'Sentinel' and ending with a quote from an unknown character. It's not much to go on, but is proving just enough to encourage discussion around what may be in store for Bethesda's next RPG.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and a good place to start is that quote. A victory undone. "The scroll offered only a shimmer, a veil thinly lifted to my eyes," it reads. "A future lost. Sands of time scattered by fate. " All this is attributed to Yazar, Moth Priest of High Queen Iradne of Hammerfell, , but some fans think the accompanying date - 4E 206 - might be just as significant.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "[sentinel] likely takes place five or more years after the start of skyrim," hypothesised reddit user 04nc1n9. The monarchy of Hammerfell has a Moth Priest on hand, even though the Moth Priests are generally an Imperial thing. Hammerfell's monarch has access to an Elder Scroll after the Elder Scrolls scattered. "Hammerfell is a monarchy, it hasn't changed to any other political system after their imperial secession. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, this unexpected link between moth priests and hammerfell's high queen has created speculation of its own. One theory, combined with the proximity of Sentinel's story to that of Skyrim, has the Thalmor play a key role. "[It's] likely the Thalmor being the antagonists with so little time having passed," wrote user Jonesketi, "and with justifiable knowledge of how to cause great harm with the Elder Scrolls, [this] would've prompted [Hammerfell] to begin their own preparations. [The Thalmor are] also such a fitting antagonist since we didn't get to kick them down in Skyrim, which would offer catharsis if it came in Sentinel. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, as for the quote itself, its vague wording has inspired some particularly out-there speculation. Some fans are looking back to previously vanquished forces in the series, in light of the phrase "a victory undone", and are theorising it might refer to a Dragon Break - an in-universe timeline split in which multiple events can all occur and simultaneously be true once the timelines reconverge. In previous games, Dragon Breaks have served as a handy explanation for the multiple endings.

Diungkapkan bahwa talk of "undone" events set user wafelze's mind to the numidium, a giant mechanical golem whose activation in the elder scrolls 2: daggerfall caused its own dragon break. "With how important time is to Skyrim’s story," they speculated, "it wouldn’t surprise me if this story is about time being entirely broken. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "see, i'm thinking it has to do with the creation of nirn and lorkhan," wrote potential film 7140. maybe they'll try to undo what created the divines so they can go back to their original ancestry. Wildly out-there take but that's what my brain tells me. The elves did not. "The Altmer hate Lorkhan and men see the creation of the world as a victory. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa what's more, the theories around split timelines and the thalmor have converged with thoughts of a possible 'man in the high castle'-style alternate history setting for sentinel, unfolding in a version of the world where the thalmor have power. "Maybe the Empire originally held together after Oblivion, and the Thalmor used some cheater Elder Scroll magic to rewrite history so that they dunked on the Empire," suggested Original League 6094. Maybe the version of events got overwritten and now Hammerfell is under Thalmor subjugation, and the Elder Scroll is giving her glimpses of the timeline where Hammerfell won. "Or if I recall, Hammerfell was doing a great job beating the Thalmor as of Skyrim. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa will these theories prove to be true? with the launch of sentinel still reportedly years away, it could be some time before we find out. And that's no real surprise. But if nothing else, this feverish story speculation suggests there's a major hunger among fans for information - any information - about Sentinel. After all, yesterday's teaser was only the second official look at a game whose reveal has been dragging on for over eight years now.

With the galaxy far, far away turning a half-century old next year, Hasbro is going back to basics with its Star Wars 50th Anniversary action figures; the Black Series, Vintage Collection, and Retro lines are all getting toys based on A New Hope.

Berdasarkan laporan, well over a dozen products are listed in this initial wave of star wars 50th anniversary action figures, and they're all based on characters from the original movie that kicked everything off - from major names like luke and leia to cantina wolfman arleil schous. They're all slated to arrive at some point in early 2027. While the Black Series and Vintage Collection Star Wars 50th Anniversary action figures are available to pre-order now at Hasbro Pulse and other retailers like Amazon, the Retro toys are exclusive to Target.

Berdasarkan laporan, adam biehl, head of disney action brands at hasbro, noted that "for decades, hasbro has been proud to partner with the star wars brand to bring its unforgettable characters and stories to fans through play and collecting. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa this version of our hero is in the middle of the death star escape, so he's wearing a stormtrooper belt and is wielding a grappling hook. The figure also comes with a blaster. Like all Black Series figures, this one is six inches and features multiple points of articulation for more convincing poses.

Diungkapkan bahwa this version of leia is so screen-accurate it took me aback. It comes with two blaster accessories and a hood, and comes in a 50th Anniversary black and gold packet modelled after old-school action figures.

This version of R2-D2 from the sands of Tatooine is a bit battered, but as is evident from the picture of his many accessories, he's ready to throw hands with anyone who'll get in his way.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a new, 50th anniversary stormtrooper snuck through the net of initial announcements and has been added to the lineup. It comes with a blaster accessory, ready to take the fight to the Rebels.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i have a suspicion this one's going to be very popular. They feature blasters and a grappling hook. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the dark lord of the sith is back again with a new vintage collection figure, and of course he comes with a lightsaber. You can have it ignited or just as a hilt.

Aren't you a little short to be a Stormtrooper? The classic baddie is ready to report, with blaster either in hand or holstered.

Remember this guy? The wolfman appeared as a background character in the Mos Eisley Cantina.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the lovable wookie is back in a nostalgic design, but by looking at his eyes i'm gonna guess this guy has seen things. He has a chunky blaster accessory rather than his bowcaster in its traditional form.

Sebagaimana diketahui, darth looks really snuggly in that sleeveless trenchcoat. Don't tell him that though, or he'll smack you with his retractable lightsaber.

Diungkapkan bahwa this old-school version of obi-wan has robes that wrap around him like a sleeping bag, recreating how those old kenner figures would look. The lightsaber is extendable, but locked to the toy's hand.

Featuring R2-D2, C-3PO, and a Death Squad Commander, this is inspired by an early bird certificate package from Kenner (a placeholder box with cardboard backdrop) back in 1978.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this pack is an ode to the opening of a new hope, where stormtroopers shoot their way through rebels on the tantive iv. Both come with blasters.

This double-pack includes a couple of strange denizens from Tatooine, with a blaster for the Jawa and a gaffi stick for the Tusken.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's all kicking off ahead of the saga's birthday with plenty of announcements. Although the new 50th anniversary Lego Star Wars sets are great, but I’m most interested in their weird collectible minifigures.

#550. Interview: Old School RuneScape's creative director on keeping the old school spirit alive - Part One

📅 11 Nov 2026

Interview: Old School RuneScape's creative director on keeping the old school spirit alive - Part One

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pocketgamer.com/old-school-runescape/kieren-charles-interview/

Diungkapkan bahwa the popularity of old school runescape can't be understated, in some ways even outweighing the popularity of the mainline runescape itself. So, it should be no surprise we found it difficult to pin down the Old School RuneScape development team for an interview back in summer!.

But, fortunately, a few months on, we've managed to put some of our most burning questions to none other than Old School RuneScape's creative director, Kieren Charles!.

Diungkapkan bahwa so, i'm creative director of old school, and that basically means i'm overseeing what it is we do and what our core fundamental strategy is behind our content, the way we try to do things, our philosophy, and the way we work with our players, and i'm overseeing everything the team does at the core of it. I've been a part of Old School for 11 and a half years since I joined as a member of QA.

The whole team was about 10 or 11 people back then, and so it kind of often feels quite surreal to be in the sort of role I am now, with a game that I've grown up with since I was a kid.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so, hardcore worlds came out last wednesday, and we're absolutely thrilled with the impact that it’s had and how smoothly the launch has gone. And thrilled with just ultimately how that's been received, and the team had to work really hard to get that over the line. Just seeing all of our content creators jump in. There have been so many amazing moments so far already. So, so proud of what they were able to do.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so there are multiple factors and things to talk about with this question, honestly. And so some things we backport, and often that's stuff that, with hindsight, we still think is amazing. If we think it could be improved or it doesn't quite fit Old School from a design philosophy perspective, then it's going to need changes or tweaks, and we will absolutely do that.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, chosen commander, which we're bringing out in early next year, is a backport of the first-ever quest finale runescape ever did back in back in 2009 or so. There's no reason to mess with it. People love that story and the character of Zanic, this cave goblin that you sort of befriend and take on a tour around Lumbridge and everything. But what we do need to mess with is why you do it, the rewards, what you unlock as a matter of progression through that story, and make sure that fits the bill.

Diungkapkan bahwa we did blood moon rises in summer this year, which is our grandmaster conclusion to the vampyre story, where you finally come face to face and fight drakan. And we did that because we ultimately just had a vision of something. We did that entirely our own way. We thought this was this is going to be absolutely amazing, let's do it this way. This fits Old School RuneScape better and the way we want to tell the story.

Berdasarkan laporan, and chosen commander was from 2009. So, it's very much already in the spirit of Old School, while the vampire finale that RuneScape did previously was much, much further in the future, much separate from the 2007 kind of era.

Berdasarkan laporan, that is one of the core requirements of how we think about updating this game. If you're hurting that familiarity, and that's an intangible thing really you can't really pin down.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i wish i had this epic bible i could just hand the team and say, 'this is the guide', right? but it's really not that simple. It's an intuition for, like, what's going to hurt when that changes; would players be hurt by it? Would nostalgia be hurt? Would familiarity be hurt? And then what's the spirit of the game design principles?.

Diungkapkan bahwa design principles might shift when running an mmo for 20 years, but for old school, we believe that those are the things that need to be retained. Old School won't ever be full of like daily stuff that you need to do every day. Temporary content that's like super FOMO oriented; we just don't do that kind of thing.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we have a real respect for the achievements and stuff the players have attained. Things we released in 2005 that predate Old School, like getting your fire cape. That is still to this day, 21 years later, a significant achievement and milestone on many player accounts.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that may have been the very end milestone back in 2005, but it's not the end milestone now; however, it's still a significant step, and that content will always be valuable. So every time we're adding something like Chosen Commander or Fractured Archive, that we just launched, we're building them in mind that they're going to be relevant for 20 years; forever, in theory.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's a significant overlap in how people use mobile. A humongous chunk sits in that category where you utilise both. You've got people who only play on mobile. And then you got a bunch of people who play on both. Like, you can imagine sort of three groups, right? You've got players who only play on an actual computer. And the reality is some things feel better on your PC, some things feel better can feel better on a phone.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i mentioned the raid we just launched [fractured archive], which is super challenging. People do do it on mobile, but it's extremely difficult to be doing that on a touchscreen where you just don't have the same level of control as keyboard and mouse control. But people can do it on mobile.

On the flip side, you have really chill content like, for example, you want to train your combat; you can go and kill the gemstone crab, and you just need to press it every five minutes while playing on mobile.

Diungkapkan bahwa and the point is you don't even have to pay attention to it in some activities. And mobile's so great for being able to do those sort of things on-the-go. So in terms of how we think about it, it's not necessarily something we need to think about all the time. The great thing is we have the entire game on mobile, and so everything we add to the game is for both platforms.

Berdasarkan laporan, that said, we do want the mobile experience to be better and we think there's so many things we can do to to make it to make it improved. I think we could make dialogue a little bit easier to interact with; it could be a little bit easier. Um, and that comes down to those core interactions. It's those sort of things where mobile needs attention, more than adding a new raid or a new quest.

Sebagaimana diketahui, old school is founded on what the player wants, right? like ultimately, it's the very nature of how we work. And so, it's scary. I do feel like we're I I see ourselves as more like we're looking after this game and making sure it's set up for a strong future and whatever happens.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and i want the version of the game that's available now to always be the best version we've ever had. And so ideally everything we do is making the game as a whole package better than it used to be. And that sounds so simple, but obviously that's easier said than done.

Berdasarkan laporan, and we've all had experiences of games we love changing in ways that we dislike. And that was the origin of Old School: changes were happening in RuneScape, the combat system being much more deeply modernised and so on. And ultimately you had a whole bunch of people who had that sudden feeling of 'I wish we had back what we used to have from that 2007 version'.

Diungkapkan bahwa people reference 2006-2007 as like the original sort of golden era of runescape; people were picking it up on a browser because it was playable on a school library computer. So people have that appetite for that era, which we need to look after. Like I've inherited it myself, and so many people on the team grew up playing this game; so we kind of just get it in a similar way.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but we don't do anything without players telling us they want it. We can't add the new raid to the game or Menaphos next year without players saying yes on a vote.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that's a difficult process to go through, and we have to basically sell players on it. So in some ways it takes a little bit of the pressure off. Why do we want to do this? What problems is it going to solve? Why should you be excited? And then players hopefully vote yes. But if people vote no, we can't do it. That would break our principles of how we work. If we get it wrong, we find out tomorrow; we don't find out when we've launched it.

Diungkapkan bahwa and i'd much rather find out at a poll and be disappointed that we're not moving forward than launch something that feels like it's damaged the game in players' eyes. Some people want the modern combat system, which is much more ability-driven. People want different things. There's some overlap. Some people want the laid-back Old School one where a lot of stuff is click and wait. And so with RuneScape and Old School, to me, they coexist nicely. And the best thing is you get to offer two RuneScapes to the world and now a third with Dragonwilds! This interview ended up being so long that we've actually split it into multiple parts! So, watch this space, and once part two of our interview with Old School RuneScape's creative director Kieren Charles is up, we'll link it through here!.
