Diungkapkan bahwa when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Berdasarkan laporan, there was some fun conversation here at pc gamer recently about the anachronistic name of the golden joystick awards, which are put on by pc gamer's publisher. Who even uses a joystick anymore? Flight sim diehards, fighting game enthusiasts, and not many others. So why is it called that? Joysticks, really?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, simply put, the name reflects the age of the awards, which debuted in 1983, making it the longest-running publicly-voted videogame awards show of all time, according to wikipedia. Back in those days, joysticks were it, and trust me, they weren't the sweet pieces of hardware we have access to now. But we loved 'em! And we used them to play games like the Golden Joysticks' first-ever game of the year, Jetpac. It was a banger!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, here we are, 43 years later, and much has changed: from a tiny ceremony handing out five trophies, the golden joysticks have grown to become one of the biggest videogame awards events of the year, watched by millions of people around the world on just about every streaming platform you can name. Yet that name, the Golden Joystick Awards, remains. Frankly, I'm glad about that. A little bit of reliability in this world is good for everyone.

Which leads me to the point: The 44th annual Golden Joystick Awards has now concluded, and the top gong, as my UK compatriots like to say for some reason—the Ultimate Game of the Year award, for the rest of us—has gone to Resident Evil Requiem, Capcom's latest tale of zombie-fueled bad news.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, can't really argue with that call: pc gamer's elie gould gave resident evil requiem a whopping 92% score in their review, saying it "feels like you're playing a highlight reel of the best moments in the series. " Requiem claimed three other wins on the night: Console Game of the Year, Best Game Trailer, and Best Lead Performer for Angela Sant'Albano's turn as Grace Ashcroft.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, crimson desert won for pc game of the year, which surprises me a bit given that it's also on consoles and pretty much the same experience. We liked that one too: Not quite as enthusiastically, but it still earned an enviable 80% review score. "Vast and obtuse in a way that is going to frustrate some and exhilarate others," as reviewer Mollie Taylor put it: "A fascinating journey, even when the destination isn't all that. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa multiplayer hide-and-seek game meccha chameleon was the night's other big winner, taking home four awards for best multiplayer game, best indie game (self-published), the steamers' choice award, and developer's choice award. Dispatch won twice, for Best Storytelling and Best Soundtrack, and The Witcher also sort of claimed two wins as well: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered took the trophy for Best Remake/Remaster, while The Witcher 4 won for Most Wanted Game.

Berdasarkan laporan, so there you have it, 44 years down and hopefully many more to come—all of them bearing that glorious golden name. Here's your full list of 2026 Golden Joystick Awards winners:.

He covers all aspects of the industry, from new game announcements and patch notes to legal disputes, Twitch beefs, esports, and Henry Cavill. He began writing videogame news in 2007 for The Escapist and somehow managed to avoid getting fired until 2014, when he joined the storied ranks of PC Gamer. From there he graduated to the glory days of Sierra Online adventures and Microprose sims, ran a local BBS, learned how to build PCs, and developed a longstanding love of RPGs, immersive sims, and shooters. Lots of Henry Cavill.

#655. Arc Raiders gets a few map exploit fixes in latest patch as Embark prepares to slow down how often patches are released

📅 11 Dec 2025

Arc Raiders gets a few map exploit fixes in latest patch as Embark prepares to slow down how often patches are released

Tanggal: 11 Dec 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/arc-raiders-1-6-0-patch-exploit-fixes-slower-cadence

There's a new Arc Raiders patch that's fairly small, but one with fixes everyone is going to appreciate.

Berdasarkan laporan, the time has arrived for another arc raiders update, and embark has certainly delivered. 6. Today’s patch, version 1. 0, is among the smallest the game has received so far, focusing almost exclusively on disabling map exploits.

Perhaps more important than the patch itself, however, is the announcement the developer made around it.

Diungkapkan bahwa starting off with patch 1. 0, it takes out a particular zipline on Stella Montis, the game’s most recent addition ot the map roster. 6. Some players used said zipline to get out of bounds, something the game has been battling on several of its maps.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on blue gate, the patch fixes a collision issue that allowed players to vault through a wall, and fall to their death. The map fixes continue with another on Spaceport Launch Tower, which takes out a gap in collision that players have been able to shoot through.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the last change in this update affects gameplay feel around arc enemies. Certain materials in the game’s world weren’t blocking their vision - or fire - when they should have, and this has now been fixed.

Diungkapkan bahwa alongside today’s patch, embark also announced that going forward, we’re going to see fewer patches for arc raiders. The game has been getting updates almost every Thursday since it launched in late October.

Berdasarkan laporan, now that most of the major problems have been fixed, the studio is shifting to a slower patching cadence. Critical fixes will still be issued as soon as they’re developed, but don’t expect a patch each week going forward.

Diungkapkan bahwa embark also revealed that patch releases and in-game store rotations will now occur on tuesdays. You should also expect the next few weeks to be quiet, as members of the team go on holiday breaks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but, before everyone goes away, the game is going to get one more big update. The last item on Arc Raiders’ roadmap, revealed in early November, is the Cold Snap event. This is on track for Tuesday, bringing some new content alongside a few other fixes.

#656. Delve into "a deep underground facility full of secrets and horrors" in the latest Fallout 4 quest mod from the Commonwealth Story Expansion Project

📅 02 Nov 2026

Delve into "a deep underground facility full of secrets and horrors" in the latest Fallout 4 quest mod from the Commonwealth Story Expansion Project

Tanggal: 02 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/delve-into-a-deep-underground-facility-full-of-secrets-and-horrors-in-the-latest-fallout-4-quest-mod-from-the-commonwealth-story-expansion-project

A mysterious bunker with out of this world contents.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after adding a whole new town to fallout 4 last month, a group of modders have released another in their long string of extra quests for the rpg. This latest mission revolves around a dungeon delve in the Glowing Sea, where a mysterious bunker's just been unearthed.

"The harsh radioactive winds of the Glowing Sea have uncovered a deep underground facility full of secrets and horrors," the group behind the Commonwealth Story Expansion Project (CSEP) declared the description of this latest work, Under The Stars.

Berdasarkan laporan, a fresh dungeon with a quest attached, the mod tasks you with donning your hazmat suit for a trip to a sunken bunker in the region of post-apocalyptic boston with the least chill weather. Inside await voiced holotapes and puzzles offering clues as to what went down in this cosy corner of the Commonwealth, plus some new gear to make braving whatever lurks within worth it.

Spoilers: Judging by the screenshots, it looks like the place is an Area 51-esque hidey-hole for evidence of aliens and other cryptic oddities.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you're unfamiliar, the csep lot are responsible for a bunch of popular fallout 4 quest mods based around the likes of deadly cults, underground wars, post-apocalyptic detective work, and brotherhood of steel drama. While Under The Stars doesn't look have been as big an undertaking as those, that previous form points to it being an expertly-crafted addition that'll slot seamlessly into the game.

Berdasarkan laporan, the modders have put under the stars together as part of a community-hosted modding jam called fallout flood, with this latest one based around the theme of being underground. Among the other works to have come out of it thus far are another Fallout 4 quest mod dubbed Stranded - The Oasis, a dungeon full of funky rats called the S'Laven, and a new robot enemy you can wear as a hat. It's also produced a New Vegas quest mod about exploring an abandoned NCR railway, so seems to have been very productive gathering of modding minds.

To give Under The Stars a go, your copy of Fallout 4 will need to have the Automatron and Vault-Tec Workshop DLCs.

#658. Battlefield 6's latest update dubbed the game's simultaneously best and worst patch as it runs into all kinds of issues

📅 10 Dec 2025

Battlefield 6's latest update dubbed the game's simultaneously best and worst patch as it runs into all kinds of issues

Tanggal: 10 Dec 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/battlefield-6-1-1-3-0-patch-problems-everywhere

What's likely going to be the last major Battlefield 6 update of the year has launched with a number of unexpected issues.

Diungkapkan bahwa there’s been a lot of anticipation for battlefield 6’s version 1. 1. 0 patch. The patch kicks off the third and final phase of the game’s first season, adding some new holiday-themed content. 3. More the new content itself, the update’s biggest additions are almost entirely gameplay-related.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unfortunately, for as much as the changes in 1. 1. 3. 0 have been well received, the launch has been marred by a series of technical issues, some of which are a little unusual.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, immediately after patch 1. 1. 3. 0 went live, players on PC started reporting massive stutters that would occur every few seconds. The issue is especially pronounced in Redsec Battle Royale, but much deadlier in traditional multiplayer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, battlefield studios quickly acknowledged it, pointing out a workaround that appears to be working for players on steam. According to those players, going offline on Steam’s friends menu has fixed stuttering for them.

The issue remains for other players on PC, however, and the developer said it’s working on a proper fix.

Sebagaimana diketahui, perhaps the most disrupting problem the patch has caused is one that prevents players from being able to interact with the game’s menu. Tiles become unresponsive, or outright unselectable when you try to hover near them.

Diungkapkan bahwa ironically, the top set of tiles designed to make it easy for players to quickly jump into the new content has been the most affected. Restarting the game sometimes fixes the issue, and some players report that it only happens upon first launch after installing the update.

Berdasarkan laporan, but battlefield studios later clarified that, unsurprisingly, there’s an actual reason behind the bug. Once again, a fix is being investigated, and the developer will offer an update once some progress has been made.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a little further down the list of importance is an issue that stops players from being able to skip tiers within the new winter offensive bonus path in the game’s battle pass. BF Studios took out the feature entirely while it works on a fix, so while you can continue making progress in the bonus path, you won’t be able to skip tiers.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is all a shame to see. Outside of all the problems, the meat of the new update has been almost universally praised. The visibility improvements, and netcode updates have been celebrated. Many players were also happy to see meaningful updates to footstep audio and overall clarity.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s also unusual for a battlefield 6 patch to run into so many issues at launch. 3. 1. 0 so far is that it’s the game’s best and worst update yet. The sentiment around 1. Hopefully those issues will be fixed before the development team breaks for the holidays.

Thankfully due to some of our volunteers stepping up and simply learning new skill sets, as well as help from prominent Skyrim modders and permissions to use and integrate existing Skyrim mods, we've been able to implement replacements that we think fit Skyblivion's needs, in some cases even better than what we had before. "We have removed that work entirely. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa however, rebel and co claim that despite them making it "clear multiple times to this former volunteer that we have removed their contributions", the ex-skyblivion dev is "threatening to sue for damages upwards of €30,000". They claim that the ex-volunteer's legal threats "demand personal information of multiple volunteers [on Skyblivion] including full names and addresses". Rebel noted that the team see these demands as "something that we are simply not willing to share with someone that we don't even know" and feel are "just completely disproportionate for what's really going on".

Berdasarkan laporan, the modders say they've consulted with legal counsel already and have a lawyer on standby if necessary. Though, since said lawyer's services will - the Skyblivion team claim - cost €2,500, they've put out a call for anyone with "a background in IP law or GDPR law" willing to offer them pro bono legal aid to get in touch via the mod's website.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "please don't turn this into any kind of witch hunt, despite this very unfortunate situation," rebel said in closing. You will hear more from us soon on the actual release. "We don't wish ill on a former volunteer over all this and I just hope that we can get this resolved as soon as possible and get on with the planned release, which is really what we're working towards. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, this situation makes it two years running that skyblivion's found itself engulfed in drama during the final months of what's supposed to be its release year. In 2025, former volunteer Dee Keyes had a public disagreement with the project's leads over whether releasing the mod that year was a reasonable or achievable goal. Skyblivion was subsequently delayed into 2026.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this past weekend, keyes tweeted a response to the skyblivion team's statement on the alleged legal threats. "I've had my issues with the project and left because of it, but I left knowing that my work would remain with [Skyblivion] (happily so) and didn't want to hurt the project's progress," he wrote. "I understand [the former volunteer] being upset, but I really don't see why they'd go so far as to demand their work ripped out. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa here's hoping the skyblivion team and the ex-volunteer can resolve things without all the expense and effort that'd inevitably be necessary if the dispute ends up in court. Given there are now less than two months left of 2026, and Skyblivion's modders have this on their plates on top of any remaining work needed to finish their creation, I'd personally be very surprised if its release doesn't end up being pushed into next year.

Diungkapkan bahwa chief people officer elain laird echoes the sentiment and highlights the importance of events like logi game day: "when people have dedicated time to log off, decompress, and immerse themselves in play, they return with clearer focus, renewed energy, and fresh approaches to complex challenges. #664. Tomorrow’s Battlefield 6 patch is the first step towards improving footstep audio, and it might actually fix the settings reset bug

📅 08 Dec 2025

Tomorrow’s Battlefield 6 patch is the first step towards improving footstep audio, and it might actually fix the settings reset bug

Tanggal: 08 Dec 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/battlefield-6-1-1-3-0-patch-footstep-audio-settings-reset-winter-offensive

The next major Battlefield 6 patch is nearly upon us, and Battlefield Studios is promising a bounty of changes - including a couple of fixes to some big bugs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, battlefield 6 is about to receive a new update. 1. 0 is set to arrive tomorrow, December 9 to kick off the third and final phase of the game’s first season. Version 1. 3. Winter Offensive brings some holiday-themed new content to the game, but it’s not the most interesting part of the patch.

That honour goes to a couple of the high-level changes Battlefield Studios has included with the new patch, which range from a major pass on audio to a fix for a particularly annoying bug that’s been seemingly introduced with a recent patch.

Berdasarkan laporan, thew new content takes the form of a limited-time version of the game’s empire state map, which covers it in snow and tweaks its layout slightly. To go along with that there are new limited-time modes for both multiplayer and Redsec’s Gauntlet. The event mode will be available in Conquest, and Domination.

Berdasarkan laporan, the ice climbing axe is the only new weapon in this drop. The battle pass gets a new Winter Offensive bonus path, just like we’ve seen with previous seasonal stages. This is how you unlock the axe, too.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, easily the most interesting change in this update is the range of improvements to audio across the board. First, footstep audio received a big pass that should make it easier to hear enemy footsteps, easier to locate them, and across different surfaces.

Diungkapkan bahwa some of the bugs that caused certain sounds to simply vanish have been fixed. BF Studios explained in the patch notes that it has adjusted memory priorities for in-game sounds in order to prioritise the most crucial ones. This was especially prevalent in battle royale matches. This is not the end of the road on audio, however, as the developer continues to work on making the soundscape more stable and reliable.

Some of those audio changes are the result of recent testing done in Battlefield Labs, which is also responsible for another exciting addition in this latest patch: improvements to hit registration.

While BF6 has had solid and stable netcode, certain situations would sometimes create uncertainty about how you died, and why certain actions seemingly failed to perform at that particular moment.

The focus in this update is to improve the reliability of how actions in close-quarter combat are translated, which includes firing before fully going into ADS, quick aim changes and more.

Berdasarkan laporan, speaking of close-range, the patch also brings another pass to soldier visibility to make it easier for enemies to stand out from the background. This is particularly relevant in areas with low contrast, or busy environments with lots of particle and visual effects.

Sebagaimana diketahui, 1. 3. 0 also brings yet another set of weapon handling and gunplay tweaks, this time focusing on accuracy issues with first shots. 1. You can also expect more tweaks to attachment behaviour with regards to recoil.

Sebagaimana diketahui, something else worth highlighting is that vehicle gameplay is getting several smaller tweaks that have to do with how they interact with the world, how their huds behave and more. Finally, your settings should no longer be reset after applying an update. BF Studios says there are still some instances where that might happen, but the issue should be fixed for the majority of players.

You can read the full change log on the Battlefield blog.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as part of its july 2026 wave of xbox job cuts, microsoft laid off a reported 136 developers from id software, a studio whose name is synonymous with expertise in shooter design and engineering. Today, "approximately 20" of those former id developers announced the formation of Hidden Horses, an employee-owned game studio boasting "over 250 collective years" of game dev experience between its co-founders.

Diungkapkan bahwa "this team has spent years building games together, and we realized that what made that experience special wasn't just the projects we worked on; it was the people we worked with," hidden horses engine programmer and co-founder dustin land said in a press release. "Hidden Horses is an opportunity to keep that team together, build something of our own, and create the kind of old school shooters that we think people want more of. ".

On its website, the studio says it was formed as a democratically governed, developer-owned company so it can prioritize "long-term health over short-term growth, longevity over quarterly returns, and innovative gameplay over shady monetization"—for the sake of its games, and the studio staff creating them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we're creating a studio where the developers share in its success and have a commitment to it beyond just another job," said co-founder and executive producer andrew willis, "i think that when people have a stake in something’s success, they are more committed to it. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the studio is planning to launch a kickstarter campaign to support the development of its first planned game: a singleplayer arena shooter called danger pay, in which players will participate in a televised ultraviolent game show inspired by works like the running man (the 1987 movie, not the 2025 one) and 1990's smash tv—a game that, i've just now learned, got a novella adaptation in 1992. So. Now I get to have that knowledge bouncing around.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we've had the privilege of spending our careers making games for incredible communities of players," said johnmichael quinlin, studio co-founder and tools programmer. "Now we have the chance to build something new together, and we're excited to invite those players along for the journey from the very beginning. ".

Before joining DualShockers, Aden contributed to GameRant, XDA, Gamepur, I.

Diungkapkan bahwa the original legend of zelda: ocarina of time is one of the most speedrun games ever, with numerous people making new record attempts on a yearly basis. These many attempts have led to countless glitches and exploits being found throughout the game.

Berdasarkan laporan, with the release of the legend of zelda: ocarina of time remake, it was only a matter of time speedrunners discovered new glitches and exploits to break the game wide open. Well, it only took them a few days to find ways to get items early, infinitely jump, and more.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it will only be a matter of time before the newer version of the game becomes just as broken as the original. Maybe Speedrunners will be able to teleport to the end of the game as well.

Diungkapkan bahwa you end up getting the hylian shield very early on in the ocarina of time, and the same can be said in the remake. Thanks to this, you can perform a very simple super jump that takes advantage of the interaction between objects in the game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, don’t worry, there are plenty of other jump glitches that have been found, but this is the most simple. For this glitch, you need to be child Link. Stand on or in some type of interactable object. This can be a box or standing inside a chest.

Berdasarkan laporan, hold down zl with the hylian shield equipped, angle your camera to look down at link, and then press x. This will give you a high jump that you can use to reach ledges and get places early. Of course, there are other jumps that are more effective, but this one is very easy to use.

Sebagaimana diketahui, whenever you are a child in ocarina of time, you can purchase magic beans. These Magic Beans are an item that you can plant in dirt mounds, and when you come back as an adult, find plants that will float you to new areas.

Diungkapkan bahwa well, it was discovered that you can use the game’s physics against it to achieve an impossible jump. When standing on one of the flowers, if you jump at the right time after using the Hookshot on the ground in front of you, it will launch you into the air.

This has allowed speedrunnners to skip portions of the game, with the most notable being that they can get the Silver Gauntlets early.

The speedrunning community in Breath of the Wild is thriving in the game's freedom.

Berdasarkan laporan, there are a lot of times where jumping is what will break the game for you, and this is the case after you get the silver gauntlets. Once you have obtained the Silver Gauntlets, jump into the chest as adult Link.

Diungkapkan bahwa once you are in the chest, run forward against the back wall, then pull out your shield and quickly swap to the ocarina while still holding the shield button. While performing this action, hold the angle of your walk the entire way to the right.

Sebagaimana diketahui, now, cancel out the ocarina and jump immediately. When performed correctly, this glitch sends you flying up onto the giant statue outside of the Spirit Temple. You can then walk around the statue and drop onto the other side, allowing you to get the Mirror Shield early.

Berdasarkan laporan, i swear this is the last jump i will talk about, but this one matters a lot, as it lets you reach areas early. Essentially, you are trying to get the game’s frames to buffer and send you higher and higher into the air. This allows you to jump very high, reaching new areas early where Magic Bean flowers don’t exist.

Berdasarkan laporan, what you want to do is perform a forward jump attack with a deku stick. As soon as you start the jump, press the ZR button to open the item menu. This pauses the screen, and rapidly swapping to another item will keep your momentum going up.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, throughout the process, you will need to continuously tap zr rapidly to get the menu to open so you can swap items back and forth between something and the deku stick. This will keep your momentum going up, allowing you to jump over high walls and even get to areas like the Shadow Temple early.

Diungkapkan bahwa it is nice that nintendo decided to give link a sprint button in the ocarina of time remake. However, speedrunners have already found a way to make that button obsolete, as you can move faster by roll canceling.

Berdasarkan laporan, what is roll canceling? glad you asked! it is when you cancel a roll midway through and start a new one. This makes the roll happen very quickly, allowing you to get places at a faster rate. It is also easy to do.

Berdasarkan laporan, basically, you just want to start a roll and attack midway through, and then roll again immediately, and attack again midway through. Keep doing this and you get a roll that is much faster than sprinting. You just look silly doing it.

Tears of the Kingdom is a fertile ground for experimentation, and fans are already breaking the game's rules as we speak.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this skip uses the same idea as the infinite jump with the deku stick, but you can use it early to skip part of the deku tree dungeon. In the basement of the Deku Tree dungeon, you will find a ledge that spawns a Deku Baba.

Diungkapkan bahwa here, you can hug the wall and use a small jump to get onto a tiny ledge. From here, you can jump with the Deku Stick and quickly swap over to another item to get a tiny bit of extra height out of the jump.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this allows link to grab the ledge, pulling himself up to the area. Normally, you need to go through the entire dungeon, but using this method, you can push a box down early, giving you access to the end of the dungeon in a much quicker way. Better yet, this is also a glitch from the original game, but it has become easier thanks to item swapping.

Diungkapkan bahwa the hover boots are an interesting item in ocarina of time. When equipped, they allow Link to walk a short distance in the air after walking off a ledge. However, this use is momentary, and you fall shortly after doing so.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, speedrunners have discovered a means of letting the boots last an infinite amount of time, and all you need is a bottle. When you walk off a ledge, you just need to spam the use of a bottle.

Berdasarkan laporan, each time you spam the bottle, it refills your hover boot time, allowing you to take a few extra steps in the air. Keep repeating using the bottle every couple of steps, and you can keep walking across the air infinitely. This has already been used to skip the fire trial, and people are trying to figure out other uses for it.

From suspicious house designs to familiar songs, fans think they've found clues.

#669. Battlefield Labs is coming back for a short session to test out next week's Battlefield 6 update, and you can expect more tests in the future, too

📅 02 Dec 2025

Battlefield Labs is coming back for a short session to test out next week's Battlefield 6 update, and you can expect more tests in the future, too

Tanggal: 02 Dec 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/battlefield-labs-battlefield-6-december-patch-testing

Battlefield Labs is evolving, as it reopens its doors for its next - unusual - session.

Battlefield Studios is seemingly trying something different with Battlefield 6’s next patch, which everyone assumed would be a standard, mid-season update not intended to change the game significantly.

However, it appears that it may bring more to the game than we realised, enough that the developer sees it as an excuse to bring back the pre-launch Battlefield Labs testing initiative.

Berdasarkan laporan, the december 9 patch kicks off the final phase of the game’s first season, which is set to take the game through the holidays and into the new year. We’ve known about its content for a while, and it’s definitely the lightest, compared to the two previous phases.

Diungkapkan bahwa battlefield studios announced a host of new changes that will be included in the same patch, which are apparently significant enough to require player testing. The developer is reviving Battlefield Labs to help it do so, but only for three two-hour sessions, split across the game’s three main server regions (EU, NA, APAC).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, all tests are scheduled for today, december 2, and they remain under nda. Battlefield Labs is also sticking with PC as its chosen platform yet again, though you will be able to join through Steam this time, alongside the EA app.

Diungkapkan bahwa the focus of the test will be on three key areas that the december 9 patch will be touching. First, there’s footstep audio, an issue that was really brought into focus with the launch of Redsec Battle Royale. You can expect to hear enemy footsteps from farther away, and intuitively know the type of surface they’re moving on.

Diungkapkan bahwa the patch also brings another pass to hit registration and netcode, which bf studios says should improve responsiveness in close-quarter situations. Finally, there are broader changes to other combat areas that the announcement didn’t elaborate on.

All testing will take place on Eastwood, and Operation Firestorm, rotating between Conquest, and Escalation.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, going forward, battlefield studios said to expect labs to be open to more players, and for the process itself to be smoother. The developer wants to have faster turnaround times, after all, so that the initiative can test smaller changes and be more responsive to player feedback.

Sebagaimana diketahui, some of the more involved, future sessions will include experiments with map layout changes and various other non-standard compositions of player and vehicle numbers. Of course, you can also expect new maps and modes to be tested in Labs, similar to how the CTE was used in Battlefield 4’s long life.

The Dead By Daylight studio takes on a co-op shooter.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's best to go into game demos with a clear mind, but that was never in the cards for exterminauts, the new co-op game from dead by daylight studio behavior interactive. Everything about Exterminauts, externally, screams Helldivers 2, from its working class soldiers and anonymized outfits to its hostile wildlife and colorfully pulpy planets.

Exterminauts' developers, who are a distinct team from the one making Dead By Daylight, see the comparisons coming and don't shy away from them, but they also point out that their game was in development for years before Arrowhead's hit shooter came out in 2024.

Berdasarkan laporan, they also draw a distinction in tone: exterminauts does not cast you as a dedicated servant of intergalactic democracy, but as militarized, blue-collar pest control cleansing the planet of tian so that corporate interests can better sap the land of its resources. In that way and more, Exterminauts has more in common with Deep Rock Galactic or Mycopunk.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that's a realization that helped me acclimate to exterminauts after a few hours with an alpha build—it's got deep rock-like milestones, class roles, and mission types. There's one that comes with a medic tool and a damage-focused lightning gun that I gravitated toward. Loadouts begin with a choice of a soft class (called sponsors) that grants passive bonuses and a unique power weapon. You can also bring along gadgets like ammo boxes, med packs, and automated turrets that could singlehandedly flatten a horde (Behaviour admitted these were overpowered at the moment).

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's relevant to note that my developer-led demo stayed on the lower difficulties, but even with that in mind, exterminauts struck me as more casual than games like it. Guns are very easy to control with a mouse, friendly fire is either barely there or nonexistent, ammo was readily available through pickups at every point of interest, and there's a generous respawn mechanic that lets you summon teammates back into the action.

Diungkapkan bahwa the maps i played were straightforward canyons littered with corporate mining facilities. Objectives were clearly marked on the map from the start, as are side tasks. There's clear Helldivers inspiration in the jobs themselves—there's a lot of solving micro puzzles on computer screens to get a facility back online—but I never really felt rushed to complete them because the fauna barely put up a fight.

Berdasarkan laporan, i'd like to see what exterminauts is like when it's challenging, because its creative creatures have a lot more bark than they do bite. No bugs or robot hordes here—Behaviour is leaning into freaky plant monsters and flying squids. I especially enjoyed the giant carnivorous flytraps that crawl on six feet and the flying, spiky tulips that slow down enemies until they're dealt with.

Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.

Berdasarkan laporan, cranking up the difficulty might also bring the depth of its classes into focus—each sponsor (class) can be modified through firmware unlocked through play. These looked like small bonuses, like extra freeze damage or HP gained on kill, that can be stacked to make a bigger impact.

Berdasarkan laporan, behaviour is planning large and frequent updates for exterminauts, including 12-week seasons and a constant drip feed of sponsorship packages that introduce new weapons, gadgets, cosmetics, and firmware modifiers. The idea is to make these relatively easy to unlock through normal play, but you'll be able to buy them early for real money, too.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a general lack of energy led to my demo feeling rudimentary and sometimes boring—i was craving a sense of risk or struggle that gives co-op shooters moment-to-moment stakes, but never got it. These strike me as problems that can be solved, and Exterminauts does have good bones, so I'll be interested to try it again when it's more complete.

#672. The latest Arc Raiders patch is almost entirely about fixing exploits, including all the clipping through locked rooms business

📅 27 Nov 2025

The latest Arc Raiders patch is almost entirely about fixing exploits, including all the clipping through locked rooms business

Tanggal: 27 Nov 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/arc-raiders-patch-1-4-0-locked-rooms-exploit-fixes

Embark is clearly sick of Arc Raiders players exploiting the game's mechanics to push each other around, and clip through doors and walls.

A fresh Arc Raiders patch has arrived, bringing a host of new fixes to several exploits players have recently been relying on to do things they’re not supposed to, and bypass certain mechanics to get into areas without having to go through proper channels.

The patch is fairly small, and surprisingly doesn’t include any buffs or nerfs to anything in particular.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the list of notes for update 1. 0 is compact, with a clear focus on addressing several exploits. 4. The biggest one, of course, is the addition of “exploit mitigation mechanisms” to stop players from glitching through locked doors.

Berdasarkan laporan, this fix applies to all maps, and it’s intended to address an issue whereby players would not bring the required keys to access those areas of the various maps. Locked rooms, if they can be unlocked, often hide a wealth of high-tier and rare loot.

But players have also been using similar exploits to clip through walls and access areas outside the playspace, allowing them to ambush enemy players and set up traps that would be impossible for others to detect.

Diungkapkan bahwa the game’s recent patch, which was released exactly one week ago, mainly consisted of balance tweaks to some of the more popular weapons and mines. However, it also introduced a few fixes to prevent players from clipping through walls by using barricades.

While on the subject of being in places where you’re not supposed to, the patch blocked exterior access to the locked room inside Spaceport's Control Tower, making it only accessible from inside the tower.

Diungkapkan bahwa 1. 4. 0 also fixes an especially nasty exploit that allowed players to bring up their weapons much faster than normal by quickly swapping to the quick use menu. There’s a range of smaller fixes for lighting and texture bugs here, too, and you can read all about it in the full change log below:.

#675. Blizzard Posts Hotfix After WoW: Forever Players Mourn Lost Gold

📅 11 Nov 2026

Blizzard Posts Hotfix After WoW: Forever Players Mourn Lost Gold

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/blizzard-posts-hotfix-after-wow-forever-players-mourn-lost-gold/

Daniel is a lifelong gamer with a love for various genres and gameplay styles who enjoys exploring games and playing from various angles.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the release of world of warcraft: forever has, for the most part, been a very successful and welcome endeavor. Many players who got into the original game in its heyday have appreciated the return to form, and newer players enjoy its relatively simpler, smaller framework compared to the much more sprawling modern WoW experience. That said, the transition to the new face of the past has not been without its hiccups.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one particular element that many higher-level players have noticed is that, unlike in vanilla wow, forever doesn’t automatically convert earned experience to gold when you’re at max level. This has proven to be frustrating for players used to the conversion feature, as it essentially robbed them of one of their major in-game income streams. In a thread on the official WoW: Forever forums, players confirmed the change to one another, with some expressing intent to quit the game if it wasn’t remedied.

Find the best class for leveling in World of Warcraft: Forever, with every class ranked by its strengths and weaknesses on the journey from 1 to 60.

Sebagaimana diketahui, luckily, it seems the devs were listening in and took the complaints to heart. One of the forum’s community managers, Kaivax, chimed into the thread to announce that the game would be receiving a hotfix in short order in order to remedy the income disparity while still preserving the quest-focused spirit of classic WoW.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as kaivax explained in their post, the xp-to-gold conversion feature was added back in vanilla wow ahead of the lead-up to its first major expansion pack, the burning crusade. The idea was to give the game’s economy a little jolt and get some extra gold in everyone’s pockets so that, once the expansion dropped, everyone would have some extra cheddar to play with in the new content.

The XP-to-gold conversion feature was added back in vanilla WoW ahead of the lead-up to its first major expansion pack.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, the conversion was never taken back out of the game even after burning crusade dropped, and became a standard part of the wow formula. The devs of WoW: Forever thought that went against the game’s spirit, and so removed the conversion. This resulted in players largely ignoring quests in favor of just farming enemies and reaping the cash that came from their XP. However, there was an oversight here: the vast majority of the game’s quests don’t actually reward gold, and so without the conversion, they inadvertently took a huge chunk of players’ income out with nothing to replace it.

RP PVP servers are back on the menu for World of Warcraft: Forever!.

Berdasarkan laporan, this brings us to the hotfix, which has likely already been implemented into the game at the time of writing. As Kaivax explains, the hotfix will “add additional gold rewards to most quests with a quest level of level 48 or higher, including adding gold to quests above level 48 that never previously rewarded gold at all. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, kaivax said that the point of this change is to help players “feel good about doing quests at the appropriate level to progress your character, and you should feel adequately rewarded with gold for doing so. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is a good showing from blizzard in the ongoing course of wow: forever’s development, and hopefully, a positive sign of things to come as the game releases more content and picks up more and higher-leveled players. For as beloved as the original, vanilla release of World of Warcraft was and is, it pays to remember that game launched over 20 years ago in 2004. Gaming standards, particularly in regard to progression and quality of life, have changed exponentially in that time, and if the devs just ported over the game 1-to-1 with no changes at all, we’d all feel the growing pains something fierce.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, making these kinds of little tweaks while still preserving the overall framework of the base game should be the optimal goal, something that feels true to that classic experience while carefully pruning out all the little sticking points of early-2000s mmo game design. Responses in that forum thread certainly seemed positive, or at least less overtly hostile, so that’s a good sign.

#676. Battlefield 6 kicks off its first free trial post the Black Ops 7 launch to twist that knife

📅 25 Nov 2025

Battlefield 6 kicks off its first free trial post the Black Ops 7 launch to twist that knife

Tanggal: 25 Nov 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/battlefield-6-free-trial-dates-details

Activision has done its own fair share of Battlefield 6 counterprogramming prior to that game's release, and EA is here to repay the favour with Black Ops 7.

Even if you don’t care about the rivalries between the top multiplayer first-person shooters series, it’s hard to ignore how much EA wanted to stick it to Call of Duty this year with Battlefield 6.

Activision saw that coming early enough that it ran multiple free weekends around major moments for EA’s game, including its launch, seemingly in an effort to capture some of those players and keep them away from BF6.

Both Battlefield 6, and Black Ops 7 have now launched, and though exact sales figures may never be detrmined (though EA did announce 7 million sold in the first week), it’s very clear at this point from every metric we can see that BF6 came out on top this year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the recent black ops 7 launch clearly hasn’t made many people happy, so just like activision made black ops 6 free to play at bf6’s launch, ea has now done the same with its own game. The Battlefield 6 free trial, which was announced last week, is just an hour away at the time of this writing.

This is the first trial for the core game, and it arrives some six weeks after Battlefield 6 officialy launched, and four weeks following the release of the free-to-play Battlefield Redsec, which has battle royale and other components.

Beyond all the drama surrounding the two rival shooter franchises, the Battlefield 6 trial is itself pretty straightfoward, and is notably nowhere near as genrous as some of the Call of Duty ones we’ve seen recently.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the trial goes live today at 4am pt, 7am et, 12pm gmt across all platforms, and will be available for a week; ending tuesday, december 2. It includes three core maps: Siege of Cairo, Eastwood, and Blackwell Fields.

Diungkapkan bahwa players will have access to four game modes, played on different versions of the same maps. Conquest, Breakthrough, Sabotage, and Team Deathmatch will all be available to choose from, and there don’t appear to be any level or XP limits in the trial.

Unfortunatley, just as the free trial was about to go live, the game got hit with a major matchmaking outage that took down all matchmaking in the core game, leaving Redsec unaffected.

Hopefully EA can resolve this issue before the trial officially kicks off.

Berdasarkan laporan, the events of this new chapter take place following rarcher of solnari’s defeat. The victory has given way to the Moon-Prayer Night celebrations, which brings various stalls to the Nasha Town, alongside a new souvenir stamp book where you can record your memories.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, all is not fine, however, as alice and nicole reeyn come bearing some bad news about phantoms appearing across the nod-krai region at teyvat's borders. There’s a mystery to be uncovered here, and your journey to do so won’t be a lonely one.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the highly-anticipated durin is at last the new playable character. A 5-Star Pyro Sword wielder, Durin can switch between two different forms: one lets him deal damage, while the other is best suited to supporting the team.

The effect boosts the entire party’s combat effectiveness.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the other new character in luna 3 is jahoda, a 4-star anemo bow wielder who’s great at healing teammates and absorbing elements, which she can then use to deal damage. The first phase of Luna 3 will feature Durin and Jahoda, alongside the return of Venti. The second phase sees no new character debuts, but does feature the return of Varesa and Xilonen.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there’s more to get excited about in luna 3, even if you don’t feel like spending most of your time in nod-krai. The Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey event will take you back to Dragonspine, where you’ll find winter-theme minigames appropriate to an update cycle spanning December to January. #679. PUBG's extraction shooter spin-off, Black Budget, is finally going to be playable next month

PUBG's extraction shooter spin-off, Black Budget, is finally going to be playable next month

Tanggal: 21 Nov 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/pubg-black-budget-closed-alpha-test-dates-details

The most interesting development in the PUBG universe, PUBG: Black Budget, is almost ready to show itself off to a wider group of players.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you’d be forgiven for not remembering pubg: black budget, the extraction off-shoot of the original battle royale shooter, pubg. Black Budget has been sort of floating around the internet for months, but Krafton never really committed to revealing core details about the game, or when players will actually get to play it.

This changes today, as the publisher - along with the game’s developer, PUBG Studios, have finally lifted the lid off the upcoming shooter.

Diungkapkan bahwa black budget is described as a “tactical” extraction shooter. Squads of players infiltrate a mysterious island trapped in a time loop. There’s a bit of a STALKER element here with anomalies and various, unpredictable environmental shifts.

Berdasarkan laporan, coli, the island in question, hides a research facility that holds secrets and artefacts, which is what players will be attempting to extract. This is very much a PvPvE shooter, though PUBG Studios says the focus will be on exploration and discovery, rather than constant combat.

Diungkapkan bahwa the game’s first set of closed alpha tests is set for december. That’s six days across two weeks, with the test only being available on PC. The first takes place December 12-14, and another is scheduled for December 19-21. Both sessions will be open to players in North America, Europe, and Asia.

Diungkapkan bahwa as it usually works with these sorts of tets on steam, the game’s steam page has a link where you can request access. If granted, you’ll be able to find the closed alpha in your library and download it when the time comes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, though this is a closed test, krafton confirmed that players will be able to capture and livestream their gameplay. In fact, watching content creators might be how you get access, as Black Budget is going to have a Twitch Drops event running alongside those sessions.

When I played Arc Raiders prior to its launch, I likened its tense and uncertain atmosphere to that of the early days of PUBG, so it’s going to be very interesting to see what actual PUBG does with the extraction shooter premise.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so far, it sounds like it’s going to be doing its own thing, leaning more into the adventure side of the subgenre, but we’ll have to see how it all shakes out when the tests start. Indeed, the BR-like constantly shrinking circle sounds like it could be a game-changing twist.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, another day, another cybersecurity update. This time, it's the turn of immensely popular NAS provider Synology to advise its users about some now-fixed gaping holes. The company has updated its DiskStation Manager (DSM) operating system, patching out two security vulnerabilities in various product versions.

Sebagaimana diketahui, just another patch? not quite. 8 out of 10, which makes it of "critical" severity (via International Cyber Digest on X). The first of these vulnerabilities has a CVSS3 base score of 9. According to the company:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "an improper neutralization of special elements used in an sql command vulnerability in the auth api in synology diskstation manager (dsm). allows remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, that's a pretty big security hole if i've ever seen one, particularly for those storing extremely important data on their home nas setup. The second one gets a lower severity rating of 8. 6, but also manages to allow attackers to skip the login process.

Synology describes the second vulnerability as "An authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the rsync in Synology DiskStation Manager," which can again lead to unwanted reads, writes, and DDOS shenanigans.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ‼️breaking: a critical flaw in synology nas devices lets attackers read and write any file on them without logging in. 8 out of 10. A second flaw, in rsync, skips the login too. https://t. The SQL injection bug in their login system scores 9. Synology patched both today. Update ASAP. co/LlS328SBf4November 11, 2026.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the company also notified users late last month of ransomware attacks related to a 2024 security advisory, for what looks to be a series of separate vulnerabilities. One way or the other, the latest updates look to have rolled out to many users already, but it's still worth checking to make sure you're on the newest builds to plug all these leaks.

Sebagaimana diketahui, after all, auto updaters are far from perfect. 2026 has been a year characterised by cybersecurity issues, and it'd really put the tin lid on it if your home NAS was broken into by some unscrupulous character. A reminder to keep on top of your updates no matter the device, methinks. Stay safe out there, folks.

#681. Battlefield 6 may have actually done it: beaten Call of Duty

📅 21 Nov 2025

Battlefield 6 may have actually done it: beaten Call of Duty

Tanggal: 21 Nov 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/battlefield-6-us-game-launch-sales-record-circana

Battlefield 6 sales are setting all kinds of records, but one in particular has long eluded the Battlefield series.

If you’ve been paying any attention to the shooter market these past few months, you won’t be surprised to learn that Battlefield 6 has been an unprecedented success for EA, and the Battlefield series as a whole.

Diungkapkan bahwa the game managed to sell over 7 million units at launch, climbing to the top of the charts anywhere you look, including setting new series concurrent player records on steam. Thanks to new data, we now better understand the true scale of this launch.

Diungkapkan bahwa the latest circana report, which looks at game and hardware sales in the united states, has arrived. This iteration covers the month of October, which is when Battlefield 6 was released.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, battlefield 6 was the top-selling game across all platforms during october - which isn’t surprising. It has overtaken NBA 2K26 to become 2025’s best-selling game year-to-date, making it the best-selling Battlefield game ever.

In October alone, the game sold more than the lifetime sales of Battlefield 1, previously the best-selling entry in the franchise.

Sebagaimana diketahui, battlefield 6 even set records beyond just its own series, having now produced the highest single-month dollar sales (physical and digital) total for any full game released in the last three years. The previous record holder was 2022’s Modern Warfare 2.

Diungkapkan bahwa november’s report, which is set to arrive midway through december, will show, once and for all, whether battlefield 6 has been able to overtake black ops 7. With one exception, Call of Duty games have, for more than a decade, topped the best-selling year-to-date chart. Regardless of the quality of the individual titles, or the competition in any given year, nothing has been able to shake that dominance.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, given all this momentum, battlefield 6 has a shot at dethroning call of duty this year, beating black ops 7 to become the year’s best-seller. You never want to count out the sheer popularity of Call of Duty among casual players, however, which is what’s going to make December’s report all the more interesting.

There are six Great Fairy Fountains in Zelda OoT, each one with a power and upgrade.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the great fairy fountains in zelda ocarina of time remake are unlocked in different ways, and each of the six fairies will grant you a brand new power or upgrade that can't be unlocked any other way. Some of these are hugely important, and though none of the Great Fairies are mandatory to progress, they can make the OoT hugely easier and arguably more fun - as long as you can afford the hefty prices involved in getting them to bestow their powers and gifts on you. Below I'll tell you where to find all Great Fairy Fountains in Zelda Ocarina of Time Remake, what you need to open their sealed locations, and how to get the powers that they bestow. Trying to get to grips with locations and fast travel in Hyrule? We've got a full map for the Zelda Ocarina of Time Lost Woods to help with just that!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there are six great fairies in the legend of zelda: ocarina of time. Below I'll lay out a quick summary of how to find all of them, and go into further depth on each one below.

North Death Mountain Trail (Child), left of the entrance to the Death Mountain Summit behind a cracked rock.

Berdasarkan laporan, din's fire. Summon a firestorm around Link that burns nearby enemies at the cost of 2 Magic.

Hyrule Castle (Child), on the righthand side just past the gatehouse behind a cracked rock.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, gift of improved spin. Increase the range and damage of your spin attack.

Zora's Fountain (Child), on the Southeast Wall behind a cracked rock.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, farore's wind. Place a marker that you can warp back to at any time at the cost of 2 Magic.

Death Mountain Crater, (Adult), on the West wall behind a stronger boulder.

Diungkapkan bahwa gift of doubled magic. Double the maximum capacity of your magic meter.

Evil Desert Colossus (Adult), on the North cliff face behind a cracked rock.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nayru's love. Trigger temporary invulnerability at the cost of 4 Magic.

Ganondorf's Castle (Adult), on the North wall, to the right of the entrance bridge, behind a very heavy stone you need to lift.

Sebagaimana diketahui, gift of halved damage. Permanently take half damage from all enemies and damage sources.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, whenever you find a great fairy fountain, you'll have to give them a certain amount of rupees in order to get their gift. Because of the high costs involved in the later fountains, you'll have to unlock larger wallets through the Gold Skulltula side quest simply to be able to pay for the high cost Fairies.

Diungkapkan bahwa the first great fairy most will find is in the north of the death mountain trail, behind a rock that can be destroyed with bombs. You'll need to have cleared Goron City and Dodongo's Cavern to unlock Bombs, but you can come straight here as a child afterwards.

Berdasarkan laporan, straight after unlocking bombs, you can also head back to hyrule castle. Past the gatehouse, just on the right hand side, is another rock you can blow up with explosives. The Great Fairy's fountain is just past that.

Diungkapkan bahwa as part of the quest to find ruto in zelda ocarina of time, you'll be given access to the zora's fountain, behind the zora's domain. Once you make it here, head to the Southernmost point to find a wall you can blow up with bombs to find the Farore's Wind fairy.

Diungkapkan bahwa after having completed the fire temple as an adult, you'll be returned to this entrance area, now having unlocked the megaton hammer, used to destroy larger boulders. Go to the West side of the area and there'll be one you can smash to gain access to the fountain.

Having made it to the Desert Colossus as an adult, before you go inside, check the Northern cliffs to find a rock that can be destroyed either with Bombs or the Hammer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the final, most powerful fairy is found as an adult at the entrance to ganondorf's castle, on the east wall. There's a boulder here you need the Golden Gauntlets to lift, which are found in Ganondorf's Castle itself. Once you have them, come back out and pay the 500 Rupees for this major endgame buff.

#683. Arc Raiders patch nerfs the Deadline mine, ends the menace of the Venator

📅 20 Nov 2025

Arc Raiders patch nerfs the Deadline mine, ends the menace of the Venator

Tanggal: 20 Nov 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/arc-raiders-patch-1-3-0-deadline-venator-nerf

The first post-Stella Montis patch for Arc Raiders has arrived, and it predictably touches much of what people brought to the latest map.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, arc raiders has received a new update today that’s almost entirely dedicated to balance and economy tweaks. 3. 0 arrived earlier across all platforms, coming in at just under 1GB. Patch 1. This is an especially interesting patch because many of the changes it makes can be seen as a response to player behaviour on Stella Montis, the game’s latest map, which just joined the roster last week.

Stella Montis is available for players who’ve put in a decent number of rounds, and its close-quarters, enclosed environments have essentially turned it into the new “PvP map”, where constant action can be found.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that, of course, also means that the map has exposed a few balance issues with some of the game’s weapons and tools. Case in point: the Venator, a pistol that saw a lot of use recently. The weapon is especially powerful when fully-upgraded, something Arc Raiders developer Embark said pushed it beyond what had been originally intended.

Diungkapkan bahwa in today’s update, the venator's fire rate is the thing getting hit the hardest, with each upgrade now offering slower gains to the weapon's rate-of-fire compared to the way things were. The weapon’s weight is also being increased to five from two.

Berdasarkan laporan, another powerful item players have been getting a lot of mileage out of recently has been the deadline mine. Unlike the Venator, the Deadline is mainly a threat to Arc enemies, and it’s proven incredibly powerful against the largest and most fearsome, such as the Bastion, and Leaper. In fact, the mine was considered essential when taking down a Queen.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the patch vastly increases its purchase price, and makes it more difficult to craft by upping the amount each of its components requires. Perhaps the most effective nerf, however, is the reduction to the Deadline’s stock at traders from three to just one, which means you’re going to be seeing a lot less of it topside.

Diungkapkan bahwa beyond those specific changes, embark has also tweaked explosive damage across the board. According to the developer, explosive damage was being applied to multiple parts at once, which trivialised some encounters.

Berdasarkan laporan, this change mainly affects larger arc units, such as the bastion, allowing them to withstand more explosive damage before bits start coming off of them. The Hullcracker, one of the best explosive damage weapons, has also caught a nerf as part of that.

Berdasarkan laporan, check the official blog for the full change log for patch 1. 3. 0. #685. Battlefield 6 streamlines some of the most annoying Challenges yet again, takes out a few of them entirely

📅 20 Nov 2025

Battlefield 6 streamlines some of the most annoying Challenges yet again, takes out a few of them entirely

Tanggal: 20 Nov 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/battlefield-6-more-challenge-assignment-changes

The easier and more accessible Battlefield Studios makes those Battlefield 6 Challenges, the better.

Diungkapkan bahwa the work to continue streamlining challenges in battlefield 6 is clearly not done. Having just released a new patch - which already included several updates to Challenges and Assignments - Battlefield Studios has gone in and made even more changes.

This latest round includes far fewer tweaks, but quite surprisingly, it also removes a few of the more annoying ones from the game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the updated list, which battlefield shared on twitter, includes changes to the dreaded recon 2 headshots beyond 150m challenge. Now, any headshot beyond 75m will count. Recon Expert 3 is another headshot-themed one that’s been updated, and now requires getting headshot kills beyond 125m, rather than the practically impossible beyond 200m that it required previously.

Berdasarkan laporan, the rapid fire 2 challenge, which required getting kills beyond 50m with assault rifles, has been changed so it now tracks anything beyond 40m. The painful ‘Inflict damage under 15m while hip-firing with Assault Rifles’ has been entirely replaced with one that requires - the far more sensible - inflicting damage while in ADS with Assault Rifles.

A couple of Challenges, such as the one that required suppressing enemies with LMGs, and another that wanted you to deal damage to laser-designated vehicles using lock-on weapons, have both been removed.

Berdasarkan laporan, the journey to make challenges and assignments easier to complete has been a long one. Progression has been one of the key areas of criticism Battlefield 6 received at launch. The issue encompassed more than just slow player and weapon XP earn rates, it also prevented players from accessing new Training Paths for the various classes, and several of the game's weapons.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, battlefield studios attacked the problem from multiple angles, initially boosting the xp players and their weapons would earn, before later reducing the requirements of the challenges themselves. The developer continued to streamline those requirements over multiple patches, including majorly overhauling the system earlier this month.

It seems the studio is more confident than ever in the game, as it recently announced that Battlefield 6 will be getting its first free trial next week, offering players who do not own the full game access to iconic modes like Conquest, and Breakthrough - though on an unusual selection of maps.

The ReDeads that haunted my childhood nightmares got so scary in the remake that Nintendo had to "dial it back" during development.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of my most enduring memories of playing the original ocarina of time as a kid is being absolutely terrified of redeads as a kid. With The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake on Switch 2, Nintendo had an opportunity to make the zombie-like enemies even more terrifying – and I can't decide if I'm relieved or disappointed that the devs decided to tone it down.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "with this remake, the graphics are a lot improved," producer hidemaro fujibayashi tells gamespot, "and so the redead – the sound, the graphics, and the movement – ended up being very, very scary. And the staff wanted to make this in service of making a good gameplay experience. But from our perspective, taking a step back, we felt like, let's remember the experience that we don't want to change, and taking that into consideration, maybe we've gone a step too far, so let's dial it back. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, redeads are still plenty creepy in the remake – certainly the scariest they've appeared since the n64 games – but the audio changes alone make their presence a lot easier to bear. In the original game, they'd let out these horrible, low moans, which somehow got even more upsetting filtered through the console's low-fidelity sound processor.

Berdasarkan laporan, dead hand might be the more infamous ocarina of time enemy these days, but the redeads were the ones that haunted my childhood nightmares. Any time I entered one of the areas where they lurk, my heart would be racing as I muted the TV so I wouldn't have to hear their horrible shrieks and moans.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as upsetting as it was at the time, i still look back fondly on overcoming that childhood fear, and some part of me is a little disappointed nintendo pulled back from the horror for the remake. But if it saves a new generation of young Zelda players from a few sleepless nights, it's probably the right decision.

#687. Battlefield 6 is getting a free trial next week with... a questionable selection of maps, but at least the modes are good

📅 19 Nov 2025

Battlefield 6 is getting a free trial next week with... a questionable selection of maps, but at least the modes are good

Tanggal: 19 Nov 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/battlefield-6-free-multiplayer-trial-november-25

If Redsec got you hooked on Battlefield gameplay but you never experienced traditional multiplayer in Battlefield 6, there's an upcoming moment you might want to pay attention to.

Presumably as a way of marching ever forward towards its (alleged) 100 million player goal for Battlefield 6, EA has announced that the multiplayer shooter will be getting its first free trial later this month.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is, of course, specifically for players to sample the core, paid component of the game, as the recently launched redsec remains free-to-play. Redsec, however, offers modes like battle royale and Gauntlet, which aren’t quite the traditional Battlefield experience.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the battlefield 6 trial arrives next tuesday, november 25. It will run for one week, ending the following Tuesday, December 2. The trial will be available on all platforms, but won’t include all content from the full game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, instead, players will have access to three of the game’s maps and five of its modes. Siege of Cairo will be there alongside Season 1’s two new maps: Eastwood, and Blackwell Fields. It’s not the strongest line-up of maps, considering Eastwood is already cut from the larger Fort Lyndon battle royale map that Redsec players should be quite familiar with, but it’s something.

Diungkapkan bahwa as for modes, you can pick from conquest, breakthrough, sabotage, and team deathmatch. Battlefield Studios didn’t say what the fifth mode is going to be, but a dedicated blog post with more information is set to arrive next week.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, beyond the trial's content itself, the timing is certainly great. Battlefield 6 just received one of its biggest patches, kicking off the second phase of its first season. So far this season, we’ve seen two new maps, several new weapons - but more importantly, solutions to problems the game’s had since launch, as well as fixes to longstanding bugs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the miserable xp progression battlefield 6 launched with is far more tolerable. Some of the wildest vehicle bugs have been fixed. The often maligned weapon dispersion has been toned down. Challenges and Assignments are much easier to understand and actually finish. And Portal has a host of experiences that go beyond just bot farms.

Diungkapkan bahwa in essence, battlefield 6 feels like its reached its 1. 0 status, which makes this a great entry point for new players, even if the trial could've used more of the game's better maps.

A "server issue" knocked both games offline, across all platforms, for nearly two weeks.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

A little less than two weeks after their multiplayer features were taken offline because of a mysterious "server issue," multiplayer functionality in Dark Souls 2 and Dark Souls 3 has been restored, meaning invasions and messages are once again working as they should.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, word of the service restoration game via a very businesslike message on the dark souls website: "regarding the temporary suspension of the game server for dark souls 2 and dark souls 3, the investigation has been completed and the fix has been applied. The game server and online features are now restored.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused, and thank you for your patience and understanding. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, so what exactly went wrong? well, that's the mysterious part. Aside from intermittent apologies for the inconvenience and thanks for your patience in messages posted to X, FromSoft's had nothing to say about it—and that remains the case now: It's back, be happy, speak of the matter no more.

Diungkapkan bahwa whatever happened, it clearly wasn't as serious a problem as the 2022 mess that saw pc servers for all dark souls games shut down for the better part of a year. In that case, FromSoft copped to the problem: A security vulnerability that allowed malicious code to be executed via the games' online services. But that fix was also long in coming because FromSoft was busy with other things, like finishing Elden Ring, which was kind of a big deal.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, anyway, aside from the relative brevity of the downtime, we had something else that made the outage a little more bearable than it was back in '22: the dark souls 2 and dark souls 3 seamless co-op mods that operate independently of fromsoft's servers. They also enable a far more flexible multiplayer experience than what's offered by the games themselves, letting players team up to run through the games at will, and without having to deal with disconnects when somebody dies or a boss gets smoked.

But if your preference is for the chaos of native Dark Souls multiplayer? Now that option's back on the table too.

#689. Battlefield 6 gets a new map today alongside major changes to controller aim assist, and even more weapon dispersion tweaks

📅 18 Nov 2025

Battlefield 6 gets a new map today alongside major changes to controller aim assist, and even more weapon dispersion tweaks

Tanggal: 18 Nov 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/battlefield-6-patch-1-1-2-0-new-map-new-weapons-aim-assist-bloom-fixes

Right on schedule, the latest Battlefield 6 patch has arrived to kick off the next stage of Season 1.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, battlefield 6’s first season has entered its second phase. 1. The game received a major update earlier today, version 1. 2. 0, which delivers a host of changes to the game, many of which have been expected.

The update, of course, also adds new content to the game in the form of the map Eastwood, as well as new hardware and fresh features for the multiplayer sandbox.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we’ve known about the new content side of today’s patch for quite some time. The update kicks off the California Resistance stage of Season 1, which is the second of three. The new Eastwood map takes place in California, and it’s a map cut from the larger Battlefield Redsec battle royale map of Fort Lyndon.

Berdasarkan laporan, there’s a new limited-time mode called sabotage - a tactical, 8v8 mode where two teams attempt to destroy as many bomb sites as possible. The other big new feature that arrives today is Battle Pickups.

Berdasarkan laporan, these are powerful weapons which can be found in specific game modes (and in portal), scattered around the map for players to pick up and use. They have limited ammo that cannot be replenished, and deliver incredible firepower.

Diungkapkan bahwa redsec players have a new gauntlet mission to look forward to that joins the existing modes. Finally, everyone gets to unlock two new weapons: the the DB-12 shotgun, and the M327 Trait revolver sidearm. It’s called Rodeo and it involves a lot of vehicular action. There’s also a new angled grip attachment.

Berdasarkan laporan, the fixes and tweaks side of the patch is arguably the more interesting. Controller aim assist has received a big overhaul that essentially resets everything to open beta settings. The goal is to make infantry targeting more consistent.

Sebagaimana diketahui, controller players actually get the bulk of the changes in this update, which also improves input latency and stick response. Several issues that reset aim assist values, or make it behave erratically, have been addressed.

The conversation around weapon bloom/spread doesn’t look like it’s ever going to end, because Battlefield Studios is yet again tuning gunplay to fix unintended dispersion behaviour, and decrease its intensity across the board.

Sebagaimana diketahui, certain challenges have had their description rewritten so their requirements can be better understood. Beyond that, you can expect several deployables to behave much more consistently, including several bug fixes there, too.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, head to the official blog for the full rundown of patch 1. 1. 2. 0.

Sebagaimana diketahui, controversy is swirling around big walk right now due to the discovery that ai was used in parts of the game's development. One of the central creatives behind Gears of War has come to the friendslop indie hit's defense, claiming there's now some review bombing going on in response to the discovery.

Berdasarkan laporan, on twitter, cliff bleszinski, the lead designer of the original gears of war trilogy, makes his thoughts extremely clear. "Wow, they're review-bombing Big Walk because it used some AI help to get out the door," he writes. "People really need to get over themselves with this shit. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, in replies, he falls back on the argument that ai is already commonplace in the industry, to the point its usage should be an accepted reality. "Problem is the mob doesn't see it that way," he says in response to another tweet. "SO many if not all devs are using it and no one can/wants to admit it now because of this crap. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, wow, they're review bombing big walk because it used some ai help to get out the door. People really need to get over themselves with this shit. November 11, 2026.

Sebagaimana diketahui, big walk developer house house admitted to using ai tools earlier this week, after a number of jurors at the independent games festival put out a statement saying they wouldn't vote for any production that used the technology under any circumstances. The studio told the IGF small parts of the game made use of LLMs – "well under 0. 1%" of the overall code, according to House House – and thus said it publicly, too.

Diungkapkan bahwa an issue here is that big walk didn't have any labelling for such on steam, even though valve's store requires one if ai was involved. "We have not made any disclosure on Steam as the platform does not request disclosure of code or chatbot usage," reads the statement. "We are posting this disclosure as it has become a matter of public interest. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, steam reviews took a hit as a result, but at time of writing, they're back up at very positive. Recent reviews are at 87%, with a cavalcade of players who're pushing back against the negativity. "AI sucks, but this got blown way out of proportion," writes one player.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i'm all for hopping on the bandwagon when it comes to stopping generative ai from essentially making an entire game from scratch," writes another, "but the love of god, ai being used as a tool to fix a bug that not even unity themselves could fix might be one of the most reasonable uses for it i could imagine. ".
