#691. Zenless Zone Zero's new Krampus squad know when you've been bad or good in a Christmas-y update to close out 2025

📅 14 Nov 2025

Zenless Zone Zero's new Krampus squad know when you've been bad or good in a Christmas-y update to close out 2025

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/zenless-zone-zero-update-2-4-new-faction-new-area-all-details

Berdasarkan laporan, zenless zone zero's 2. 4 update is a chunky one, adding a new faction to the action RPG's roster alongside a new area, and fresh playable characters.

Sebagaimana diketahui, zenless zone zero’s latest special program was a big one, bringing us all the news about version 2. 4, the next major update. It’s called On the Precipice of the Abyss, and it will be available to download on November 26.

On the Precipice of the Abyss has tendrils in many areas of the game, touching several parts of its fiction as well as gameplay, so it’s one to watch out for.

Diungkapkan bahwa version 2. 4’s biggest claim to fame is the introduction of the Krampus Compliance Authority, a new faction that’s affiliated with TOPS. This looks to be the oversight committee, dispatched after the squad’s adventure beneath Timesworn Hill.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the events of this narrative arch follow on from the timesworn hill crisis, which is partly why we’re going to a new area as part of this update. The old mining site can now be explored for the first time in a decade, now that the Miasma has begun to recede.

Berdasarkan laporan, our newcomers this time around are dialyn and banyue. Dialyn is an S-Rank Physical Stun Agent who’s a former customer service specialist. This isn’t just a backstory, however, as it plays into her gameplay.

Dialyn relies on two resources: Customer Complaint and Positive Review, but her core role is to stun enemies and allow teammates to unleash their Ults, with a nice boost to boot.

Berdasarkan laporan, banyue is another s-rank, though he’s a fire rupture agent. In combat, he pulls from Adrenaline and Wrathful Fires, alternating between the two to fuel his actions. He uses his martial arts expertise to create combinations of might and grandeur. There’s a bit of rhythm to his gameplay that might take you a little while to master.

Berdasarkan laporan, even more characters will join as part of this update, in the form of not one but two new bangboo units. Then there’s Bild N. Birkblick is Krampus' own proprietary lil bunny fella, who brings a sensor array that can transform into a cannon in combat, essentially tracking and immediately nuking targets. Boolok, a Support Agent-affiliated Physical damage dealing Bangboo bringing a giant block hammer to the fight to, well, smash enemies with.

Berdasarkan laporan, it’s a bit of a winter party in version 2. 4, it seems, as the update will bring back Hugo (Attack - Ice), and Ellen (Attack - Ice), too.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you can also look forward to the return of the bangboo auto chess event, which now includes pve stages with unique rewards. In fact, playing this event is how you could get Bild N. Boolok for free. Lightstream Notes is another event that will be available for the duration of this update, and it will let you tag along with Ye Shunguang to New Eridu.

Seeing In Polychrome Zenless Zone Zero codes.

Diungkapkan bahwa hoyo on steam zenless zone zero version 2. 8 is refreshing your team comps with a new mechanic, and the game is coming to Steam.

Berdasarkan laporan, lethal talent zenless zone zero version 2. 7 brings Angels of Delusion to the battlefield with playable Nangong Yu.

#692. Arc Raiders' new map will be unlocked through a community event that starts today, and everyone has to donate

📅 13 Nov 2025

Arc Raiders' new map will be unlocked through a community event that starts today, and everyone has to donate

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/arc-raiders-stella-montis-new-map-community-unlock-event-donations-new-patch

It looks like it's going to take the Arc Raiders community a bit of work to unlock the game's next map.

Berdasarkan laporan, as many of arc raiders’ regular players predicted, the game’s first post-launch map won’t just be available for everyone, it will instead be closely tied to a community event. Breaking New Ground is the name of that event, and it’s one where everyone will need to contribute in order to rebuild some old tunnels and unlock the way to Stella Montis.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the event kicks off today alongside the release of the game’s latest patch. The ask is relatively simple: players must commit Basic Materials to the project so that the tunnels can be rebuilt. This option will be available to anyone who’s played at least five rounds.

If you’ve spent any time in Arc Raiders, you’ll know that Basic Materials are things like Metal parts, Fabric, Chemicals, Rubber Parts, and Plastic Parts - most of which are easy to find in the game’s various maps.

Even beyond the ultimate goal of unlocking the new map, donations will also reward you with Merits, which is a new event currency, though there’s a cap on how many you can earn.

Once enough materials have been collected, the next phase of the event, Staking Our Claim, will begin, which will bring a new progression track to the game, and make Stella Montis available for players to visit.

Diungkapkan bahwa developer embark describes the new environment as unlike any that we have seen in the game so far. It’s a facility carved into the northern mountains, which means it’s going to have a near-pristine look; quite the contrast with the rest of the game’s environments.

Diungkapkan bahwa stella montis also has its own arc enemies, loot, schematics, and other gameplay items. You can look forward to coming across the Shredder, a close-quarter Arc unit exclusive to the new map for now.

Diungkapkan bahwa then there’s the matriarch, a somehow even larger version of the queen. Thankfully, it will only be available under a specific map condition, so you’re in no danger of running into her randomly. The update will also introduce a new legendary weapon, two new grenades, and three new mines.

Sebagaimana diketahui, staking our claim will only run until december, which is when the next stage of the game’s roadmap will kick off. Then, the Cold Snap update will introduce the Flickering Flames event, the first snowfall Map Condition, and the Expedition Project voluntary wipe.

An entire battalion's worth of new Lego Star Wars sets have dropped out of hyperspace like a Rebel fleet about to take on the Empire, and while they look incredible (I'm genuinely excited to grab some of these), I'm most interested in the bizarro minifigures some come with.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unveiled at the lego store as part of a new hope's 50th anniversary, there are seven new lego star wars sets in total spanning a host of budgets and styles. The lineup includes massive display pieces you can hang on your wall alongside dioramas and playsets, but a few have a special bonus feature - an extra minifigure based on concept art for the original Star Wars. Han Solo, Luke Skywalker, Darth Vader, and Princess Leia all looked pretty different with their original designs, and they stand out from their usual iterations from the best Lego sets. You can see them in the image above.

Want a better look at the sets themselves? I've listed them below, and they all hit shelves at the beginning of January 2027.

Berdasarkan laporan, made up of 718 pieces, this empire strikes back diorama recreates one of the most famous moments (and lines) in movie history. It's quite a lot bigger than the 295-piece version we got 10 years ago. This one also features an extra concept art minifigure version of Darth Vader. UK: £69. 99 at Lego.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this is one of the cheaper 50th anniversary sets so far, and the smallest; it's 372 pieces. However, it comes on a diorama base with two minifigures (Obi-Wan and Anakin), so should serve well as either a display piece or a playset for younger Padawans who want to recreate that pivotal moment from Revenge of the Sith. It also comes with a concept art version of Han Solo, back when he had a lightsaber in early drafts. UK: £34. 99 at Lego.

Diungkapkan bahwa i think this might be one of the nicest minifigure-scale ships lego's put out in quite a while, with exposed studs and greebles brilliantly recreating the y-wing's scrappy design. It comes with a concept art version of Luke Skywalker, who is markedly different from the final design; he's rocking a gas mask and has a yellow lightsaber in tow. UK: £69. 99 at Lego.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at 23 inches (59cm) tall and with 3,209 pieces behind it, this display piece is gonna take pride of place in any collection. While most have to wait until January 4, members of the free Lego Insiders program get early access from January 1. UK: £269. It cleverly recreates the original 1970s New Hope poster in 3D, and it's stunning. 99 at Lego.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i was a little confused when i first saw this kit, because it wasn't clear what else it could become. Besides being an imposing rendition of Darth's helmet, it can also be made into Vader's lit lightsaber behind the words "I am your father. " Either way, the box contains 628 pieces. UK: £59. but the answer is very cool and quite unexpected. 99 at Lego.

Diungkapkan bahwa did you know that stormtroopers almost looked like this? the fearsome design featured in concept art for a new hope, and now you can immortalize it on your shelf. UK: £69. Sadly, this one doesn't come with any extras. 99 at Lego.

Berdasarkan laporan, creating huge versions of minifigures has really taken off for lego recently, and we got a darth vader version a little while back. so it's only right that the hero of the story gets their own. It's made up of 981 pieces, and comes with a concept art version of Princess Leia. UK: £89. 99 at Lego.

Speaking of new kits, a Lego Yoshi set has been teased for 2027, and clues suggest it'll be pretty big.

#694. Arc Raiders has proven that extraction shooters can be popular, with over 4 million copies sold in under two weeks

📅 11 Nov 2025

Arc Raiders has proven that extraction shooters can be popular, with over 4 million copies sold in under two weeks

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/arc-raiders-four-million-sales-new-peak-concurrent-record

Arc Raiders has sold even more copies, which we should've guessed, given that the game keeps breaking its own concurrent player records.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s pretty clear at this stage that arc raiders is one of the biggest launches of 2025. More interesting than the numbers themselves, however, is that this is an extraction shooter - a subgenre which has typically been thought of as niche.

If you’ve been paying the PvPvE game any attention, you could easily see how (and why) it keeps breaking its own records.

Sebagaimana diketahui, today, publisher nexon announced in a press release (via gematsu) that arc raiders has now sold over 4 million copies. The game came out on October 30, which means it managed to sell that many copies in a little over 10 days.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the news comes on the same day that developer embark studios announced that the game had more than 700,000 concurrent players across all platforms over the weekend. Over the same weekend on Steam alone, Arc Raiders broke its own Steam concurrent record with a new peak of 462,488 players - which is a significant chunk of that 700,000+ player base.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this marks the second time the extraction shooter has broken its own concurrent player records, which is something very few games have managed in the past. Arc Raiders remains a top-seller, too. On Steam, it’s currently the second-best seller globally (by revenue), sitting just below Counter-Strike 2.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “the many different ways you play and participate in arc raiders have completely blown us away, going far beyond what we ever imagined. You surprise us, you outsmart us, and you keep us on our toes. We wouldn’t have it any other way,” the developer wrote on Twitter.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, embark recently published a roadmap to highlight all the new content coming to the game over the remainder of this year. The first new map is set to arrive this month alongside new Arc units, new gameplay items, new events and more.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, just over the weekend, the game received several new map conditions that completely alter the way they play. The developer has already rolled out a couple of updates since launch, in order to tackle exploits and fix a few launchday bugs.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you’re currently hooked on this gem of a game, we guarantee that our arc raiders gameplay tips will have at least one you didn’t know about. We also have more guides on how to find some of the more elusive items in the game, such as olives, lemons and apricots, and prickly pears.

#696. Arc Raiders just keeps breaking its own Steam player records

📅 10 Nov 2025

Arc Raiders just keeps breaking its own Steam player records

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/arc-raiders-steam-concurrent-record-broken-again

Word of mouth has done wonders for the popularity of Arc Raiders, clearly more than all the pre-launch marketing and hype.

Diungkapkan bahwa arc raiders just cannot be stopped. The extraction shooter from Embark Studios has once again attracted more players over the weekend than it has in its launch week, and over its first weekend on the market.

The positive reception the PvPvE game has garnered from players has clearly caused many of them to convince their friends to jump into this unique gem of a game.

Diungkapkan bahwa the day arc raiders launched, it peaked at 264,673 concurrent players on steam. Although not massive, it was quite a bit more than the game’s most popular - free - beta test managed to attract.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that figure was broken yet again over the game’s first weekend, with arc raiders having reached 354,836 concurrent players on steam. This is where many thought it would settle, as we start to see the gradual - and expected - decline of player numbers.

Sebagaimana diketahui, to everyone’s surprise, however, arc raiders shattered even that record yet again on sunday, november 9. According to SteamDB, the game peaked at 462,488 concurrent players on Steam, which is a sizeable increase on its launch day numbers. Indeed, should this trend continue, Arc Raiders is going to be well on its way to doubling its initial launch record.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while a few games have broken their launch steam player records in the past, it’s incredibly rare to see it happen - especially twice in such a short period after launch. Embark clearly has a winner on its hands here.

Sebagaimana diketahui, arc raiders’ next big moment is the game’s first post-launch map, which is set to arrive at some point this month, alongside new quests and other gameplay items. Seeing as how the Steam concurrent record has been broken twice, there’s every chance the arrival of the new map will bring another boost to player numbers.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you’re among the millions of players who have been exploring the rust belt, you’re probably wondering where to find prickly pears, where to find lemons and apricots, and where to find olives - and those links will answer all of those questions. And, if you just jumped in over the weekend, you’re definitely going to find these Arc Raiders tips very helpful.

Having completed the quest myself, here's a full breakdown of how I found Cui's grandfather and parents in Phantom Blade.

Diungkapkan bahwa after finding cui in the village of lu smuggler's tunnel, nothing happens with this quest until you reach the mountain of imprisonment, which is an optional region of the game accessed via meigu lake – it's a crucial area for a few sidequests, including phantom blade zero whence the weeping. This stage of the quest is much simpler than finding and helping Cui's grandfather, but bear in mind that if you have not done all the above, you will be locked out of completing these final steps:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and that's the end of the cui quest in phantom blade, though it's not quite the end for lu jieyuan. From Deepground to Glenn, will the FF7 Remake finale manage to tie up all the series' loose ends?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Berdasarkan laporan, square enix has given itself a monumental task with the final fantasy 7 remake trilogy. You would think simply retelling the story of the 1997 PS1 RPG classic with modern production values would be a tall order in itself, but this reimagining ambitiously pulls in elements from the metaseries that is Compilation of Final Fantasy 7 while also expanding it with multiple, even infinite, timelines.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in a gamesradar+ interview, game director naoki hamaguchi told us, "the mission the team has is to basically recreate a new final fantasy 7 that includes all of that wider universe content from the start. So that's all consistently part of the world in the games that people will be playing. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, with final fantasy 7 revelation being the final part to this trilogy, and reportedly no dlc to follow, it's essentially the last chance to, as hamaguchi puts it, "give the fans as much of the things that we know they want to see, the content that they want to look at, and we've included quite a lot of those references and connections to the wider final fantasy 7 universe in the last game. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it won't however just be a case of dolloping fan service for the sake of it, because if this finale is to truly stick the landing, it will also need to resolve the many new dangling narrative threads it has created in the previous instalments. Here's just 8 questions I have that I hope Final Fantasy 7 Revelation answers before I finally see credits on this epic reimagining. And of course, when you turn 8 on its side, it's also infinity!.

Be warned, there will be some major spoilers covered here! And if you want to get caught up, we already have the Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy story-so-far to help you out.

With the remake trilogy drawing to a close early 2027, we get ready for the epic conclusion with our Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Big Preview across hands-on impressions, dev access, and deep dives into the whole adventure so far.

Diungkapkan bahwa the most devastating part of the original final fantasy 7, and worst kept spoiler, is aerith's death. Its impact is all the more heartbreaking as she really is gone for good in your party. However, Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth's handling of the beloved flower girl's fate is more ambiguous, as even though a timeline distortion means Sephiroth does kill her and we see the party mourning her, Cloud still perceives her presence, though whether this is her ghost or perhaps an Aerith from an alternate timeline or an omnipresent form from the Lifestream is unclear.

But, even if I don't expect Aerith to be among your party members in Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, her prominent appearance in the game's key art should be enough evidence that she still has a significant role to play in this reimagining's story, whether in the current timeline or another.

Sign up to our Switch 2 Spotlight newsletter to make sure you get the very latest news on Nintendo's new console and its games every week.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while final fantasy 7 rebirth explores a timeline where zack survived the ending of crisis core, it largely amounts to him existing in an alternate timeline separate to what cloud's party is doing until its mind-bending cross-universe final boss. But will he stay benched in Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, or is it possible that he could find a way to play a bigger role by crossing into the current timeline, much like Biggs (who crossed the other way)?.

Either way, if Final Fantasy 7 Revelation continues following the original plot beats, then the truth behind Cloud's role in the events of Nibelheim will definitely involve Zack, though it's also possible that the Zack of this alternate timeline will also experience these events as a flashback through a different perspective when it comes to helping Cloud reconstruct his true memories.

Final Fantasy 7 Remake's Intermission DLC had thrown a curveball by introducing Shinra's top-secret military organization Deepground, having first appeared in PS2 spin-off Dirge of Cerberus as part of the Compilation of Final Fantasy 7.

Diungkapkan bahwa supersoldier tsviet, nero – intermission's final boss – is undefeated, and sonon ended up sacrificing himself so that yuffie could escape, so there's a chance that we won't have seen the last of him, or indeed other tsviet members. Tsviet leader Weiss, for instance, only makes a brief appearance, and his own boss fight is an optional one within the virtual reality training device.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the group are conspicuously absent throughout ff7 rebirth. Perhaps they will come to the foreground during the section in Final Fantasy 7 Revelation that takes the party back to Midgar, maybe as a chance for Yuffie to get revenge and to show how far she's come.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the tensions between shinra and wutai have had more prominence in the remake, with the latter openly declaring war on the former towards the end of final fantasy 7 rebirth. From our previous hands-on of Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, we know that the Wutai region itself will feature in the main story, whereas it had been completely optional in the original game (as was Yuffie, herself, as a party member).

Berdasarkan laporan, the big question that remains is the driving force behind this conflict, which comes from former soldier and shinra defect glenn lodbrok, a character who incidentally first appeared in the now-defunct mobile battle royale spin-off final fantasy 7 the first soldier, and who had already died at rufus' hand. (A popular fan theory even persists that Lodbrok may actually be Cloud's father). While the end of Rebirth reveals that this version of Lodbrok was merely a black robe used by Sephiroth, it still leaves questions over his relationship with Wutai's interim Viceroy Sarruf, whose identity remains a mystery, and which our party may uncover while they are in the region.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, of the new characters introduced to final fantasy 7 remake's universe, roche might be one of the most intriguing. Essentially Final Fantasy's equivalent of Yakuza's Majima, he seems to just live for the thrill of taking on Cloud, who he considers his rival, despite being just a 3rd class SOLDIER. Yet his flamboyant motorcycling days were also tragically cut short when he volunteered to become a Sephiroth clone for Hojo, and ultimately became another lifeless black robe, encountered in the Temple of the Ancients. But, unlike the others, he still seems to hold onto some memories of his rivalry with Cloud.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, yet, if that was the end of roche, it doesn't explain how he managed to survive the events at the end of final fantasy 7 rebirth. He's the only one of the black robes retrieved from the temple by Hojo and Rufus, and taken back to Midgar. Could it be that there's a chance of redemption for this former SOLDIER to return to his former self in the same way Cloud does in the original story? Or does something worse await at the plated city?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with this finale the last chance to pull in other characters and references from the wider compilation of final fantasy 7 universe, there's a likelihood that no character however minor isn't on the table for final fantasy 7 revelation. While we've already speculated another return for Deepground, and it was already teased from the State of Play that former Turk Cissnei – vital to the plot of PSP prequel Crisis Core: Final Fantasy 7 – will be having a more proactive role in the main story following her appearance in Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth, there's the possibility that another character could make an 11th hour debut.

Berdasarkan laporan, given that there's already been more backstory to the black robes, and if more of zack's story is explored, it would make sense to carry over the prequel's continuity, which may mean the appearance of its antagonist, genesis. But, with different timelines, anything is possible, so perhaps this will now finally matter. Sure, he may have been out of action by the events of the original story, only to re-emerge at the end of Dirge of Cerberus to little consequence like a botched Marvel Cinematic Universe post-credits scene. After all, the original game was remade in 2022 as Crisis Core: Final Fantasy 7 Reunion, so it'd be weird if it didn't add to the remake saga's narrative proper.

Cid's appearance in Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth meant rejigging the original story's chronology of when the party meets him, but in Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, the pilot is a fully playable party member, which also means we should expect to uncover his backstory in Rocket Town.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fans will however note that cid's personality in final fantasy 7 rebirth isn't quite the foul-mouthed chain-smoker that he was in the original game, though given he introduced himself to the party as the business owner of bronco airlines, you can probably reason that he needed a more courteous facade for his customers. The question is whether or not that mask will slip once we get to Rocket Town, and just how faithful the modern retelling will be to Cid's emotionally and mentally abusive treatment of Shera.

Berdasarkan laporan, sephiroth had been an elusive villain for much of the original final fantasy 7 until you finally faced him in the endgame. However, given he has been the final boss in both Final Fantasy 7 Remake and Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth, with each encounter more epic than the last, it presents a problem of just how on earth Final Fantasy 7 Revelation's final battle is going to play out without running out of steam.

Berdasarkan laporan, it should be noted the game has yet to reveal sephiroth's final, angelic 'safer' form, although the party has already faced his 'reborn' form (referred to as bizarro in the original game) in final fantasy rebirth, while a scene between cloud and sephiroth at the end of final fantasy 7 remake was almost a shot-for-shot recreation of the very final cinematic fight at the end of the original game. Perhaps we'll see an all new ultimate form, and potentially another battle that transcends timelines, but I'm intrigued how the developers aim to top what has been done already while staying fresh. Whatever it is, I suspect you won't be able to win just by summoning Knights of the Round.

Berdasarkan laporan, whether you've earned one of the various mw4 dmz keys by completing a story mission, finding it somewhere on the map, or, dare i say, by killing another player (shame on you), then you might be wondering where to use it. In MW4's DMZ mode, there are loads of keys that unlock valuable lockers and vaults, but their description only gets you to a general area - not the precise location of the wares. To help you out, here's a full list of every DMZ key and where to use it, so if you're looking something in particular, find it with CTRL+F or your browser's search function.

These are all the keys that can be used in the Political Prison area of the map:.

Berdasarkan laporan, some of the keys can be used at different locations, including the likes of blackmarket weapons lockers and silo control rooms, both of which you can find in this northwest part of the map. This is a common spawn area, as well, so if you have one of these multi-use keys, this is a good place to use it.

Keys 5 to 11 in this list are a little harder to use as you'll need to breach the actual prison, and you'll of course encounter plenty of hostility as you do so.

These are all the DMZ keys that can be used in the Cheongun Village and Mirae Hospital areas of the map:.

Diungkapkan bahwa the village is a fairly simple area to loot as it's lots of small buildings rather than one well-locked down area like the hospital or the casino. The casino is a particularly tough location to get into, so make sure you're well kitted out with your best MW4 guns and a medkit or two.

Speaking of the Casino, the Counting Room Vault key is one of the better keys you'll get early on if you're completing Story Missions, and we've got a handy guide to getting into the DMZ Counting Room Vault if you'd like some help.

These are the keys that can be used in the Hanuel Nuclear Reactor area of the map:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the nuclear reactor area is the hardest location to enter as you'll be faced with a radiation field that will quickly deal you damage if you're not wearing a gas mask. You're still not immune even with a gas mask, though, as they deteriorate in time, so plan your entry into this area carefully, and keep any keys safely in your stash until you're fully ready for the challenge.

These are the keys that can be used in the Songdo Wharf and The Grid areas of the map:.

Diungkapkan bahwa this area is a good place to use any dmz bank vault keys, as explained in more detail in our standalone guide, as there are three different banks here you can attempt to access (including the one slightly further south, as you'll see below). One is the main bank tower located inside The Grid, though, which itself is a high-threat area, so enter at your own risk.

The following keys are used in the Wolves Stadium and Hajin River Heights areas of the map:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as i've mentioned above, you've got a bank vault on the boundary between this area and the grid above it, plus another one to the south of the stadium, both of which are pretty easy to access with the right materials. Meanwhile, another of the DMZ police stations is located here, so if you've got both keys and a big enough backpack, it's a great place to hit.

These are the keys that you can use in the Imjin Farmland area of the map:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there isn't much need to come to this area unless you have any of the specific keys above as it's quite an isolated area with not much else going on. Other than the Fire Station Storage key, though, these are all unique to this area, so if you find any, you might want to collect them and hit the area in one go. You may even find some others while you're looking around, so dedicate your entire match to this zone and have a good search.

These are all the keys that are used in the Air Base and Deadtown areas of the map:.

Berdasarkan laporan, this western area of the map is another common spawn area, so if you've got a blackmarket locker key or silo control room key, this is a good place to consider. There are also plenty of good weapons to grab around here, so take your time and explore carefully.

Quentin Tarantino revealed he once fired one of his Inglourious Basterds lead actors after a "terrible" table read.

In an excerpt from Jay Glennie's The Making of Quentin Tarantino’s Inglourious Basterds (via People), the director said Mélanie Laurent – who played cinema owner Shosanna in the 2009 film – didn't make a good first impression.

Berdasarkan laporan, "mélanie laurent’s table read was terrible," tarantino recalled, adding, "it wasn’t good enough to be terrible. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, tarantino wrote of the experience, "a table read with the whole cast is so exciting and so important to me. Well, Mélanie was terrible, so I fired her. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, of course, that wasn't the end for the french actor. Laurent said she was ill and would wait to read again for Tarantino – who agreed to "turn the clock" back across multiple days of rehearsals.

Sebagaimana diketahui, some on inglourious basterds weren't so lucky, however. Tarantino said Isabelle Huppert was replaced by Maggie Cheung for a role that was ultimately cut after missing the table read entirely.

Diungkapkan bahwa on chopping and changing actors prior to filming, tarantino remarked, “i have fired actors in the past. I don’t owe them shit. I owe my film the best actors I can find. Period. If it’s not right, it is not right. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, inglourious basterds stands as one of tarantino's most iconic, and instantly quotable, movies. Starring Brad Pitt, Christoph Waltz, Eli Roth, and Michael Fassbender, follows an alt-history revolution against Nazi leadership in 1940s France.

Berdasarkan laporan, next up from tarantino is new play the popinjay cavalier, starring sacha baron cohen. The production is set to debut in London's West End from February 2027. The wait, then, for the director's 10th – and possibly final – film goes on.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned "effective immediately," the company has announced following allegations of the leader having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy – and further reports of a second affair surfacing just yesterday.

In a press release shared today, Nvidia confirms that chief financial officer and executive vice president Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while the company's board searches for a permanent replacement for Huang.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, despite the circumstances, nvidia still speaks highly of huang in the statement. "NVIDIA is one of the most consequential technology companies in the world. The Board and the company thank Jensen for his immeasurable contributions to the company and the industry. "Jensen's contributions to NVIDIA are profound," it begins. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, huang admitted to having an affair earlier this week, but the situation was even more complicated than it could have been due to allegations that the person he was having that affair with might be a chinese spy. I am committed to protecting NVIDIA and supporting America's national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American. Nvidia launched an investigation, with Huang acknowledging the "national security concerns" and saying he will "cooperate fully. " He added: "I love our country and our company. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, beyond that, more recent reports alleged that huang was also engaged in a second affair with one of his employees – specifically, nvidia's vice president of healthcare, kimberly powell. After this, it was claimed that the company's board was meeting to decide whether to oust Huang.

Berdasarkan laporan, nvidia's leadership change here is unprecedented – huang has served as the company's sole ceo since its founding 33 years ago. In addition to Kress taking over in the interim, Nvidia has announced that it has appointed its first chair of the board, Harvey C. Jones, the former CEO of Synopsys.

Diungkapkan bahwa “nvidia's strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, i am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation jensen created over the last 33 years," kress says. "We will continue advancing the work that has made NVIDIA a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead. Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Berdasarkan laporan, gta 6 is fast approaching, but a pc release is still nowhere in sight. For many content creators who only play and share gameplay from a PC, that means a heavy adjustment to their setup if they want to create content around Rockstar's heavily anticipated title. It seems like Elgato and Twitch are all too aware of this, because the two brands have made a bundle that makes new console-tilted gear for live streamers a bit more accessible.

Twitch and Elgato (owned by Corsair) have announced the Elgato X Twitch Streaming Kit, a bundle of an up-to-date capture card, PS5 SSD, and a 10% discount for active Twitch partners and affiliates.

“Twitch is where so many gaming moments become shared experiences,” said Taylor Ward, Senior Director of Ecosystem at Elgato.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “our role is to make the step between playing on console and creating live content as simple as possible. By working with Twitch to put capture tools and guidance directly in front of creators, we can remove some of that friction and help more people go live when the moment matters. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unfortunately, i'm not sure execution of this new bundle has been all that helpful - even for the wealthiest full-time content creators. The only capture card included in the bundle is the (flagship) Elgato Game Capture 4K X, and the only SSD in the bundle is the Corsair MP600 Elite (Corsair's flagship storage device for the PS5).

Sebagaimana diketahui, fair enough if you're a pro level content creator with plenty of money to spend on this sort of thing, and fair enough if you want to spare no expense to get the best spec of capture card available. For most content creators though, I just don't think this sort of expense is going to be necessary, so read on to see what more affordable options exist, and why I'd recommend them.

Diungkapkan bahwa in times like these for ssd prices, that means a 1tb ssd along with the capture card brings the price up to $554. If you opt for a 2TB SSD, the price is a ludicrous $694. For Twitch affiliates and partners with a 10% discount, the price comes down to $499. The Capture card alone will set you back $249. 99. 99. 98 at Corsair. 98 for us normies, and $625 for Twitch folk.

With early Black Friday PS5 deals already starting to pick up, I think you can do a lot better.

Hardware nerds unite, sign up to our free tech newsletter for a weekly digest of the hottest new tech, the latest gadgets on the test bench, and much more from the team at GamesRadar+.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you actually need one of the fastest and best all-round ps5 ssds, and you want one of the best capture cards that can capture and passthrough 4k 144 frames per second then go for it - but i really don't think that's necessary for anyone just buying this stuff for gta 6. Case in point, the game will only run at 30fps, regardless of the platform you're playing on, and broadcasting in 4K60 is still the limit for streaming on Twitch and YouTube.

Sebagaimana diketahui, on a similar note, gta 6's install size is monstrous, but let's assume for a minute that content creators who are being pitched this bundle do 90% of their gaming on a pc. They'll either have bought a brand new PS5 just for the luxury of playing GTA 6 at launch - and will thus have a clean drive with more than 210GB of space. Or, they'll have so few games on their machines anyway that an extra terabyte of internal storage won't really come in that handy anyway.

Diungkapkan bahwa it's not as though having more internal space for clips and onboard recordings will help either. With an external capture card, everything will be stored on a PC, where more storage would actually be more helpful, probably with an external drive to save money. In recent years, PlayStation has made it more and more difficult to get your recorded gameplay clips off the PS5 and make them usable due to formatting anyway.

The Legend of Zelda was in "dire straits" before Breath of the Wild gave the beloved series a massive second wind, according to two former Nintendo marketing leads.

Berdasarkan laporan, the legend of zelda: ocarina of time's most recent remake has been a mega success, becoming the fastest-selling switch 2 game so far, but the shiny new adventure has also prompted some online debate over where the series should go next. Should Zelda lean into its carefully directed history - like the one brilliantly remade in Ocarina of Time - or keep the ball rolling with Breath of the Wild's wide open, spontaneous sandbox?.

Nintendo of America's ex-director of social media marketing Kit Ellis and former public relations manager Krysta Yang chimed in on the discourse in their latest podcast (below), and explained that Zelda wasn't doing too hot before the Switch era.

"There has been some revisionist history out there lately," Ellis said in response to fans who reckon "the Zelda team ripped away" series staples, like classic dungeons and linear worlds, at the height of their popularity.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i remember, i was going to the focus groups where it was a really dark moment," ellis continued. This is not bringing in new players. "The feedback was like, 'The fan base is dwindling. '".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the legend of zelda was supposedly "shrinking," while "interest in the audience was getting smaller and smaller" with each new entry. "They had to do something dramatic," Ellis said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "this series was in dire straits. They were selling, like, nothing," Yang added.

The Zelda series was certainly never irrelevant, but there's a pretty big gap between the roughly 8m copies Twilight Princess sold at the beginning of the Wii generation, the roughly 3m copies Skyward Sword sold at the end of the console's life, and the 34m copies that Breath of the Wild sold just one console generation later.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it was a success so big it spawned a wildly ambitious sequel, tears of the kingdom, and even influenced the latest 2d zelda, echoes of wisdom. Now that classic Zelda's back in the spotlight, though, I do hope Nintendo's able to slot the series' curated dungeons into whatever the next mainline game becomes.

#716. Just how many games were born out of this silly Japanese commercial from 1986?

📅 13 Nov 2026

Just how many games were born out of this silly Japanese commercial from 1986?

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/just-how-many-games-were-born-out-of-this-silly-japanese-commercial-from-1986/

Does your mind get blown when you find out that the origin story of something you love is nothing like you pictured it? Like, how wild would it be to learn that the Final Fantasy series was inspired by a beverage commercial? Well, buckle up.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one of the most famous pieces of final fantasy trivia says squaresoft picked that name because the company was in dire straits, knew it would be their last game, and wanted to go out with a bang. Cool story, bro; too bad it’s bunk. The original Japanese name for Final Fantasy actually translated to something closer to Fighting Fantasy in English, which immediately proves that whole story is rubbish. Also, why would a company expect to close after making a great, successful game? Final Fantasy wasn’t made in 2026, after all.

I’m reasonably well-versed in video game history, knowledgeable enough to know that many of the game development tales we’ve been hearing throughout the decades are completely fabricated, but a lot about Final Fantasy‘s origins remains a mystery, so I was pretty surprised when I stumbled upon a post on Bluesky putting forward the idea that a lot of Final Fantasy was actually inspired by a pretty silly energy drink commercial, starring Cindy Crawford, where the supermodel dons a set of armor to seemingly battle it out with an invisible enemy.

It's funny how much Final Fantasy 1 owes to this 1986 Japanese Cindy Crawford Pocari Sweat ad, art directed by Moebius.

Sebagaimana diketahui, no offense to crawford, who’s not really a fantasy knight, but her sword moves are so stiff they seem straight out of an old game. All meanness aside, even if that armor heavily resembles the outfits of Yoshitaka Amano’s era, it’s hard to tell whether the commercial itself inspired the people behind the popular RPG series. Still, we do know the commercial’s art direction was handled by the late French comic book artist Jean Giraud, aka Moebius, who is one of the greatest names in manga and anime. To give you an idea, the creators of Akira, Ghost in the Shell, and many of Studio Ghibli’s works cite Moebius as a main source of inspiration. I find it incredibly interesting that, even if unintentionally, his stint with commercials might’ve proved equally inspiring to a completely different type of media.

So, if you’re of the mind that the French completely ripped off Final Fantasy and Japanese RPGs to make Expedition 33, well, then think again, as they might’ve just been reaping what they’d sowed over 30 years ago.

To make matters even more interesting, the same thread revealed that Cindy Crawford’s adventure with games wasn’t over after that commercial, as she’d go on to model for none other than Samus Aran in an early iteration of Metroid Prime.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i had no idea about any of this. Regardless, did the aesthetics of Final Fantasy really originate from the commercial for a drink with a name as dumb as “Pocari Sweat”? I don’t know. I do know, however, that in the 2000s, SquareSoft made an actual soda commercial starring the characters of the most nostalgia-bait-y of all Final Fantasy games, so there’s some food for thought.

Berdasarkan laporan, there’s no way of knowing for sure, just like you can’t count just how many other cool pieces of media might’ve gotten inspiration out of such a then-peculiar ad. What I do know for sure, however, is that Final Fantasy fans sure do like a good fan theory, even ones that have been thoroughly debunked by the game’s creators—which is not the case with this one—so good luck getting this one out of your heads whenever you see classic Final Fantasy popping up anywhere.

Diungkapkan bahwa tiago is a freelancer who used to write about video games, cults, and video game cults. He now writes for Destructoid in an attempt to find himself on the winning side when the robot uprising comes.

Topics covered: Video editing, photography, photo editing, English Literature, World Cinema, International Politics, Video Game History, Comedy Writing.

#717. While soulslikes went bigger than big, Death's Door swung open the appeal of a tighter adventure

📅 13 Nov 2026

While soulslikes went bigger than big, Death's Door swung open the appeal of a tighter adventure

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/have-you-played-deaths-door

Berdasarkan laporan, declaring a best way of doing things is a fool’s game, though in recent years my favourite entries in the tricky hitting genre – inclusive of soulslikes and their hybridised disciples – have been the big, bulging ones. Elden Rings and Silksongs, with vast kingdoms and deep, rattling toolkits for surviving them. The reason it’s a fool’s game is because you can also have something like Death’s Door, a taut, compact, lighthearted little actioner that fills eight hours instead of 80 and yet never feels underwhelming or compromised for it.

Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives.

Sebagaimana diketahui, even in the latter stages, with a full kit of precisely four ranged spells, death’s door is a simple proposition. You are a crow. You collect the souls of a frog, a yeti, and a grandmother. You hit things. Occasionally you shoot things. Everything in-between directly relates to finding the errant monster/pensioner, or at a stretch, upgrading one of those four abilities.

Berdasarkan laporan, still, it’s clever with its limitations. Environments are small in number but vary wildly in tone and texture, and they tightly weave their paths into criss-crossing bundles that maximise travel – evoking the sense of a great, ranging adventure within relatively tiny spaces. The lack of a wiki’s worth of combat options also never becomes a problem, partly because it spreads out its spell unlocks, and partly because the smooth, flowing back-and-forths of its central swordplay are pleasurable enough to carry it anyway. Good bosses, too! They’re all characterful, memorable weirdoes who fight unlike anyone in their minion armies, and usually come with a hidden weakness to deduce and exploit.

Diungkapkan bahwa which is welcome, as these big lads and lasses do tend to launch difficulty spikes right up your feathered backside, and do so in a game that isn’t otherwise as fussed about trial-and-error pain endurance as some of its inspirations. They don’t, however, bring the mood down. At times, this tale of a pitch-black soul reaper working as an agent of Death (complete with an office of Death and embittered co-workers of Death) can get downright cosy, leading through you through warmly-lit jungles and breezy waterside ruins.

Diungkapkan bahwa recently replaying, i’d also forgotten how witty it can be. Little gaglets are sprinkled throughout, both visual and verbal, but the best jokes are saved for – funnily enough – the bosses, who’ll raise your pre-fight spirit with some amusingly terrible trash talk before becoming the punchline themselves. I audibly wheezed the first time a death animation immediately cut to the foe’s impromptu funeral, their beaked killer among the precious few guests. And even when the joke is recycled later, I couldn’t help tittering at the sight of my enemy – who seconds earlier, had been attempting to fatally sit on me – lying nobly in state.

Berdasarkan laporan, i previously considered ending my valor mortis review by calling it a gateway into the more demanding side of action-rpgs; a shorter, simpler alternative to fromsoft’s overwhelming titans that might nonetheless serve to introduce curious newcomers to their shared quirks and qualities. The game equivalent of splashing your chest with water before jumping into a pool. In hindsight, Death’s Door was always a better fit for that description, though there’s enough else here you don’t need to be prepping for something tougher to appreciate its lean, keen adventuring.

Berdasarkan laporan, "this enables a more efficient allocation of development resources and enhances overall production speed. ".

Crimson Desert and DokeV developer Pearl Abyss is planning to further integrate generative AI into its workflow.

Berdasarkan laporan, the south korean studio said as much in its latest quarterly earnings letter, explaining that it had previously "validated game systems only after implementing them manually. " Now, Pearl Abyss is using AI "to rapidly validate diverse design concepts prior to actual implementation," and argues the move "enables a more efficient allocation of development resources and enhances overall production speed. ".

"However, AI serves strictly as a tool to support concept validation and pipeline productivity, while the core gameplay experience and actual content creation remain fully driven by our development team," the developer said.

Diungkapkan bahwa when crimson desert first launched, players spotted a crop of suspicious in-game images that looked like they were prompted into existence. Pearl Abyss soon explained that some "2D visual props" were generated with AI tools, but were always intended to be replaced with human-made art, before quickly patching them out of the hit open-world game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it seems pearl abyss is now even more keen on the controversial tech, however: "we are integrating ai technologies to enhance development productivity and overall quality. AI is being utilized across various stages of development - including the automation of repetitive tasks, content creation support, and test optimization - and we are expanding its implementation throughout our entire development pipeline. We will continue to expand our application of AI to deliver higher-fidelity games to the market more expeditiously. We view AI not as a substitute for human developers, but as a tool to elevate development efficiency and quality. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, elsewhere in the letter, the studio said its previously announced creature-collector dokev is "targeting a launch in the second half of 2028" and we should hear more about it within the year. Meanwhile, Crimson Desert is being prepped for a Nintendo Switch 2 launch "in the first half of next year. DokeV was initially targeting a 2023 launch a few years ago. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the use of generative ai in game development has been a hot topic for years, though it's only become more prevalent in recent months as 'ai slop' floods steam and big companies like epic games proudly adopt the tech. What's the best prank you ever pulled on a teacher in school, assuming you went to school? By which I mean, a genuinely funny prank that didn't cause any injuries, break any of the more important laws (legal or ethical), or leave anybody with years of mental distress.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i'll start: i once had to write a four-page punishment essay with the topic "silence is golden", after being caught talking in class. but not as golden as my arse. " The teacher who set me the essay smugly tore it up without reading it - as I knew he would. I took the essay very seriously for the first three pages, only to end it with the phrase ". Checkmate, Mr Thompson. Decades later, the last laugh remains mine.

Sebagaimana diketahui, worst class ever is a new don't-call-it-friendslop asymmetrical multiplayer game dedicated to such larks. One player is a teacher, and seven others are naughty delinquent children, hiding in amongst some well-brought-up and obedient NPCs. As the wayward tykes, your goal is to do mischievous things like eating at your desk, passing notes, dropping banana skins, and playing on your phone, without being spotted by Teach.

Sebagaimana diketahui, all of this takes place in a breezy modern japanese high school, the kind familiar from a million animes. Bagsy the Protagonist Desk by the window at the back of the class! The maplist spans the curriculum, from computer labs to gym tracks to stepped lecture theatres. I don't think there are any covert edu-tainment mechanics, but if you're playing Teacher, I guess there's nothing to stop you actually explaining the periodic table while trying to work out who keeps throwing chalk at your head.

Berdasarkan laporan, what a wholesome and whimsical place! such happy memories! oh crikey, the male teacher is terrifying – why can't he stop grinning? and why do i have a smoke grenade? why is this lesson taking place in the dark? why are the teachers permitted to punch the students and tie them to wooden posts? worst class ever definitely isn't a horror game, but i'm not sure i'd send my kids to this particular institution. I feel like we're one texture pack away from playing a more sociable version of Little Nightmares. Read more on Steam.

#727. A new report reckons 40% of developers in the video games industry are using generative AI - but even more think it's harmful

📅 13 Nov 2026

A new report reckons 40% of developers in the video games industry are using generative AI - but even more think it's harmful

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/gdc-report-40-percent-developers-generative-ai

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i did not get into a creative industry to hand over the creativity to an algorithm. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, despite all the outrage and criticism around game developers and publishers using generative ai in gaming, a new report from the game developers conference (gdc) calculates that as many as 40 percent of developers active in the industry use the controversial tools in their work. This is up four percent compared to the same report last year.

That's according to the latest State of the Game Industry report from GDC, which gathers data from more than 2,300 respondents including, but not limited to, game industry professionals, made up of developers, producers, marketers, executives, and investors.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the report notes that 57 percent of developers who say they do use it, use gen-ai for "text generation, research, early prototyping, coding, and presentations". There appears to be a big split between triple-A studios that use gen-AI (with 27 percent of triple-A developers noting that they "feel encouraged or pressured" to use it) and indie devs, of which only nine percent say the same. Perhaps unsurprisingly - given how vocally against gen-AI a lot of 'frontline developers' have been - the tools are mostly used by "business operations and services, mobile-only studios, and free-to-play developers".

Diungkapkan bahwa there seems to be a gap in the ages of those willing to use ai tools as well; per the report, over half (54 percent) of people 45 years or older reported using the tools - an eight-point increase from last year's survey. There is also more usage among men (45 percent) than women (33 percent).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, what is perhaps more striking is that more people responded to the survey saying that they think ai is having a negative impact on games (55 percent) than responded saying they use the tech, suggesting a trend of caution rather than widespread adoption. Perhaps that's because of the sweeping layoffs we've seen across the games industry, often mentioned in the same breath as AI. Or the 'AI slop' that's been flooding Steam and pushing more traditional developers out. Notably, respondents saying they are wary of the technology increased one percent since last year, so more people think AI is having a negative effect on the industry now than at the same time in 2025. Orr some of the abysmal projects we've seen launch that have clearly used gen-AI assets.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i did not get into a creative industry to hand over the creativity to an algorithm," said one respondent from the uk when explaining why they don't use gen-ai tools. "I got into this industry to collaborate with creative people, not to have an advanced chatbot riff on the ideas of someone who was laid off," said another from California. "I believe that no one should have to read what no human has written and shouldn't have to see what no human has created," said yet another from Minnesota.

The use of generative AI remains controversial in the games industry, though with big companies like Epic and Microsoft doubling down on the tech, it seems this split between developers that want to embrace it and those that don't is only growing larger.

Diungkapkan bahwa blizzard entertainment is about to make good on the promise of delivering 10 new heroes to overwatch in 2026, with the final addition arriving in december. The 10th new hero coming to Overwatch in 2026 is an Omnic detective named Hudson, and he'll arrive alongside the launch of season 6. Hudson was officially revealed on Thursday, but many Overwatch fans aren't pleased with a key aspect of his character.

Originally pitched as a new Support hero for Overwatch, Hudson will instead be part of the hero shooter's Damage (DPS) roster.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, overwatch game director aaron keller and associate director alec dawson discussed the new hero — the game's 55th overall — during a video interview with creators emongg and flats, where the two revealed the character's name and role change. Keller called the role switch a late-in-development "pivot. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "as the hero developed, as we look at the mechanics, how they match with the aesthetic, how they match with who the hero is supposed to be, how they’re supposed to be represented in our game, season 6’s hero will be a dps," dawson explained. "He's really fun. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, dawson added, "during development, we iterated a lot, we playtested a lot, and the core mechanic and the thing that we were really falling in love with on this hero didn’t really match with being a support. We kind of leaned into the things we loved the most about the hero, and it definitely fit DPS a lot better. So we’re really excited for him pretty soon. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, overwatch players who wanted a new support hero were less excited to learn that they weren't getting the cool omnic detective they were promised. Some called it a "bait and switch. " Overwatch currently has 23 damage heroes. Hudson will be the 24th.

Berdasarkan laporan, on friday, keller responded to backlash about hudson's place on the overwatch roster, offering more context on the decision to "help players understand it, even as some of them are disappointed. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "when we started work on the detective, he was a support," keller said in a thread on x. "But as time went on and the kit continued development we realized that it wasn’t working. Once we tested Hudson as a DPS, the turn around in our feelings for him was instantaneous and dramatic.

Berdasarkan laporan, "this decision ultimately wasn't whether we release a dps or a support hero, it was whether we release a great character or one we didn't believe in. I hope you all feel the same way when he launches in Season 6. Sometimes we need to adapt to create the best version of something. Building Heroes for OW is as much of an art form as a technical challenge. Game dev isn’t always straightforward. The team is incredibly proud of this Hero. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa overwatch season 6 is expected to arrive on tuesday, dec. 8.

Blizzard's ambitious plan to release 10 heroes this year may never be repeated, but seasonal releases are sticking.

#729. Crusader Kings publishers Paradox announce CEO swap, say they're "in a strong position at a time when much of the industry is facing major challenges"

📅 13 Nov 2026

Crusader Kings publishers Paradox announce CEO swap, say they're "in a strong position at a time when much of the industry is facing major challenges"

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/crusader-kings-publishers-paradox-announce-ceo-swap-say-theyre-in-a-strong-position-at-a-time-when-much-of-the-industry-is-facing-major-challenges

"My plan was never to be CEO for life", says man clearly not embracing the grand strategy despot spirit.

Diungkapkan bahwa paradox interactive, publishers of umpteen strategy genre stalwarts including crusader kings, europa universalis, and hearts of iron, have announced plans to switch overlords early next year. Fredrik Wester will make way for Mattias Lilja, as the deputy CEO takes the throne.

Berdasarkan laporan, while the move's been announced this week, lilja will properly become boss from january 4th, making this a case of getting a new figurehead in place as the calendars swap. Departing CEO Fredrik Wester isn't going far, at least for now, as he'll "continue focusing on the company's long-term development as a member of the board".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "my plan was never to be ceo for life," wester said. Since I returned as CEO, we’ve streamlined our strategy, rebuilt our pipeline and developed our commercial offering. "The goal was to build the foundation before passing the baton on for the next chapter in the company’s journey. Mattias has had a central role in laying this foundation, and now is the right time to hand over. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "the board wants to thank fredrik for his visionary leadership and outstanding contributions over these years," stated chairman håkan sjunnesson. "As a result, Paradox is in a strong position at a time when much of the industry is facing major challenges. " He added that Lilja is "more than ready to assume the role and lead Paradox towards new gaming experiences that last for decades".

Berdasarkan laporan, lilja himself declared that paradox have "a unique dna that has made us one of the greats in deep and engaging strategy and management games" and will be "stepping up the pace". "We will make further investments in our core business, push the boundaries of our game design, work even more closely with our loyal players, develop more and better tools and services that benefit both modders and players, and continue to sharpen our ways of working and our organisation, with player value in focus," he said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as wester alluded to, he previously served as paradox ceo from 2009 to 2018, with a brief stint as executive chairman of the board sandwiched between that and his latest stint as ceo since 2021. Lilja has been deputy CEO since 2024 and chief of staff since 2021, having originally joined Paradox as a producer in 2009.

Berdasarkan laporan, the past half decade has been a very mixed bag for paradox. Their big strategy flagships keep ticking along, albeit with the question of whether their next DLC will feel worth it hovering overhead near-permanently. Outside of that, however, the likes of Cities: Skylines 2, Vampire: The Masquerade Bloodlines 2, and cancelled Sims competitor Life By You have made for a track record heavy on questionable decisions and games which either flopped hard or failed to blow away expectations. Wester acknowledged back in 2024 that the company had "made the wrong calls in several projects, especially outside of our core".

With the likes of post-apocalyptic strategy game Afterworld currently in the works, it'll be interesting to see if Lilja's tenure can see Paradox finally start to nail not just their nerdy bread and butter, but also games that don't involve staring down at a big map.

#732. How does tanking work in WoW Forever?

📅 13 Nov 2026

How does tanking work in WoW Forever?

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/how-does-tanking-work-in-wow-forever/

Sebagaimana diketahui, being a tank in wow: forever can be serious business. Let's get it right.

Berdasarkan laporan, tanks in world of warcraft: forever form the bastion of every adventuring party. In front of every DPS who sneaks in a hit and healers who keep everyone alive is a tank who takes on the biggest threats. And unlike other games where getting in front of an enemy is enough, some of WoW‘s toughest dungeons need tanks who focus on both the enemy and their allies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and finding a tank who knows their way around can be difficult. But if you’re a hopeful adventurer who wants to take their step into tankhood, we’ll walk you through the basics. So grab your shield, prep your auras, and let’s pull mobs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, threat is the most important term in any tank’s vocabulary, since every other tanking concept stems from it. “Threat” is something you generate that determines how likely an NPC is to get aggressive towards you. When an enemy starts attacking you, you’ve generated enough Threat for them to get aggro (aggressive).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, no in-game setting reveals how much threat someone generates, and we’ve often had to rely on add-ons (we’ll get to that later) to determine that number. Based on Classic data, Threat usually works like this:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, tanks who attack first secure the threat. So tanks have to “steal” that Threat back through special abilities. But other party members can easily bypass your Threat level if their damage and heals are absurdly high, usually from DPS and healers. This is where tanks come in with Taunts.

Sebagaimana diketahui, these are abilities that bypass current threat levels entirely, so npcs who are affected are forced to attack the caster (tank) instead. Most Taunts last a short while, so tanks usually start rotations with them or whenever tanks feel they need to yoink attention back from mobs. All tanking Classes have Taunts or some other way of stealing aggro back.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, tanks share common qualities even in mmos. More often than not, they’re the bulkiest units of any party. They’re built to hold the front line, take punishment, and give the rest of the team enough time to finish the fight.

These principles still apply when building a tank in Forever, and these stats are also your ideal targets when pursuing gear in dungeons or crafting them through Professions:.

The only stats where these differ would be based on your chosen tanking Class, as some of them have additional stats you should take note of.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the big tl;dr for tanks is to rush to a mob, attack all of them, and use taunts to keep them away from the party. But that’s just the beginning. Your tank must maintain this momentum regardless of what happens on the battlefield, and these techniques help you adjust to the most common situations:.

Diungkapkan bahwa the ideal scenario in any dungeon is to go to a cluster of mobs, pull them from their general location, and kill them. If you’re with an experienced group, they’d tell you to go to maybe three mob spots at once, pull all of them, and let the team handle it. Both scenarios are correct, but ideally you’d want to take it slow.

Berdasarkan laporan, pings are in the game for a reason. Mark your priority target with a skull and a secondary one with a cross. That ensures everyone knows who you plan to focus on stealing Threat from, and they can attack accordingly. Normally, you’d want to target spellcasters first.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when you rush to the mob and start attacking, try not to have your party behind you. Instead, move slowly so the mob follows your general direction until their backs are on the rest of your party. Keep on Taunting throughout the process, so even if Rogues dish out enough DPS to steal Threat, you can force their attention on you. This also ensures your party isn’t being harassed by some stray mob.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as a tank, you likely have spells and abilities that help you absorb damage or resist attacks. Find rotations where there’s a balance of proccing buffs, attacking mobs, refreshing buffs, and doing it again. Don’t use those buffs all at once. If you have instant blocks, save them for critical moments or incorporate them in your rotations.

Berdasarkan laporan, your dps have crowd control abilities to “control” the flow of enemies, and you should take advantage of that. When your damage-dealers stun or slow opponents (Mages with sheep, Rogues with sap, Hunters with traps), try to damage the non-controlled mobs first. Then alternate.

Sebagaimana diketahui, healers have it tough, as they can generate so much threat even when they’re not attacking. As a tank, your main priority is to keep the healer alive, since they keep everyone else alive. Ideally, you’d pause if the healer is out of mana so they can recover. A great way to know is to turn on power bars in your party so you can track their resources.

Diungkapkan bahwa besides healers, dps can get ridiculously squishy as their damage numbers can get off the charts. Now a DPS isn’t as useful to the party if they end up soloing mobs or a boss with no one to give backup. Remind your DPS to stay behind mobs at all times, or pull mobs in such a way that they’re facing away from the DPS. Make it a habit to mark your targets, so everyone knows where to focus their attack and who you’re stealing Threat from.

Read what’s behind the latest news in gaming (with a bit of snark) by subscribing to the Destructoid Checkpoint newsletter!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, tanking in wow: forever is usually reserved for a select number of classes with specs tailored for the role. As tanking relies heavily on defense, the Classes that can reliably tank are often the ones that can handle getting hit, can heal themselves after getting hit, or annoy the enemy enough to always stay aggro’d:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, warriors depend on rage, which they get from hitting and being hit. Their Protection spec is mostly built for tanking, and they have some of the strongest Threat-stealing abilities in the game. Base Warrior alone gets bonus Threat from Defensive Stance and can steal Threat from single targets (Shield Slam, Sunder Armor), mobs (Taunt), and in emergencies (Mocking Blow, Challenging Shout).

They also have nifty tools in their arsenal, such as an early-game interrupt (Shield Bash) and a damage debuff (Demoralizing Shout), among other attacks that often punish opponents.

Berdasarkan laporan, paladins are part magic-users, so they also rely on mana to cast spells. Their Righteous Fury gets them more Threat as they use their toolkit. And just like other tanks, they have their fair share of taunts for single-target (Holy Strike, Seal of Fury and Judgment), and mobs (Consecration).

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, paladins set themselves apart for their party-wide buffs that reduce damage (devotion aura) and give a 10% overall stat boost (blessing of kings). Protection is their main tanking spec, but you can also go for Holy if you want to be a sub-healer.

Berdasarkan laporan, druids are perhaps the most versatile class in forever due to their many forms, and they still have potent heals even as tanks. Feral is their main tanking spec, which grants them a decent single-target taunt (Primal Bite). Their Bear Form is what gets the most threat, and Druids have many mob-based taunts (Challenging Roar, Growl, Swipe) as well. When transformed, Rage is also their primary resource, and it can facilitate vicious combos.

Berdasarkan laporan, aside from tanking, druids can become competent emergency healers. They have access to an instant-cast heal-over-time (Rejuvenation), an instant heal that is upgradeable to an HoT (Regrowth), and a decent AOE (Wild Growth),.

If you want serious upgrades for your tanking experience, you can also try these Forever add-ons:.

Diungkapkan bahwa fans have been pondering gta 6's map for some time now, cross-referencing previous map leaks with official trailer footage in an attempt to gain some insight into the major landmarks and regions rockstar has in store. And while the newly leaked map is far from granular, it does at least appear to confirm Leonida's rough layout and the key locations players can visit this time.

Assuming the map's veracity, it's all rendered in an art style somewhere between mid-century tourism poster and Adult Swim, featuring the phrase "The Goodtime State" up top - a riff on the actual Florida's nickname, The Sunshine State - while Leonida's most notable points of interest are interspersed with cartoon figures.

I'll spare you the geographic details confirmed on the map in case you want to go in unspoiled. One point of amusement though: the way the map photo is cropped means fans searching for confirmation of an in-game Key West are still none the wiser.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's not entirely clear where the wonkily angled photo originated from, but prominent rockstar games community insider videotech, who shared the image on social media, suggested it came from a "naughty selfridges employee" during selfridges' gta 6 takeover. #735. Warhammer Survivors Puts Your Brain In A Mindless Blender Of Non-Stop Action

📅 13 Nov 2026

Warhammer Survivors Puts Your Brain In A Mindless Blender Of Non-Stop Action

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://kotaku.com/warhammer-survivors-puts-your-brain-in-a-blender-with-non-stop-action-but-precious-little-engagement-2000756655

Berdasarkan laporan, my quest to play every genre of warhammer 40,000 video game has led me now to warhammer survivors. Since I’ve fallen and I can’t get out of the Warhammer brain-rot swamp, this grimdark palette swap of Luca Galante’s make the brain go brrr-like Vampire Survivors should be extremely my shit. But not only does playing it makes me feel like something is being extracted from me, be it time, mental energy, or life force, but the game is also just…not my scene.

Berdasarkan laporan, i’ve never played vampire survivors or its roguelike deckbuilder spinoff, vampire crawlers, but i watched my husband surrender his life to the game last year so i have a basic understanding of how it works. Pick a character, kill an ever-growing, nigh-endless horde of enemies, get upgrades to increase your power, rinse and repeat.

Diungkapkan bahwa what surprised and impressed me the most about ws is, for however much the game’s description makes it seem mindless, there’s some strategy to be had. Because it doesn’t proc as often nor do as much damage as my chainsword or bolter, I thought it was worthless and ignored it my first few runs. There’s an item called vuln oil which randomly spits out gobs of black sludge at regular intervals. How you move around structures, knowing when to deploy items like grenades or flamethrowers, and which upgrades to prioritize during a run, all required more brain power than I expected the game would demand. After being forced into the item from a treasure chest and seeing how it worked after a few upgrades, I’ve now decided it’s a must-have.

Diungkapkan bahwa i’m not fond of the obvious dark pattern-ification inherent in the game, the way it uses psychological tactics to keep you playing. Yuck. Not going crazy, but like my brain is atrophying in real time. Getting a treasure chest in Warhammer Survivors and seeing coins spit out of it slot-machine style while jubilant music plays is extremely off-putting. Playing Warhammer Survivors also makes me feel like I’m actively losing my mind. It involves a ton of focus, which I generally enjoy in a game, but it’s a passive kind of focus. I know why it’s designed like that. I know the emotion it’s trying to evoke. Like with the awareness you need to drive a car, your brain is on but it’s not really engaged in any kind of problem solving.

Diungkapkan bahwa but honestly, i can forgive all that. I think my biggest, pettiest complaint about Warhammer Survivors is that…it’s just not the flavor of Warhammer I want. Ultramarines are to Warhammer what the Yankees are to Major League Baseball. Firstly, your starting character is an Ultramarine and I’m sick to the back teeth of fucking Ultramarines in Warhammer video games. Yes they put up a bunch of Ws; they have the biggest, loudest fanbase; and they once counted among their number some legendary guys. I’m not immune to dark pattern exploitation and want to spend a little more time with it to unlock the Sister of Battle character. Space Marine, Space Marine 2, both Boltgun games and now Warhammer Survivors. But there are far more interesting factions out there worth paying attention to.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, secondly, and i really must stress this is a petty complaint, where’s the love for the horus heresy, man? at the beginning of the game you can choose to play in the 40,000 universe or in the sword-and-board variant, age of sigmar. Walk with me here. You’re a little Salamander space marine, trudging around Isstvan V fighting off wave after wave of Death Guards, Emperor’s Children, World Eaters, and more. I would have loved to get one extra option to play in the Horus Heresy universe. As you get stronger, you progress from regular space marines to space marines in terminator armor, then chaos corrupted space marines, then a first captain, then Horus himself. Do you know how hard that would go?? I was ready to scrap this entire blog because I thought I had unlocked my absolute favorite character from the Horus Heresy, the goodest boy Tarik Torgaddon, but when I realized his name was actually Tor Garadon I was crushed.

Berdasarkan laporan, i know as a horus heresy girlie i’m spoiled for choice when it comes to books, animated series, and audio dramas. I know. But sometimes a girl needs a video game that will let her kill her mortal enemy, Horus Lupercal. Warhammer Survivors, then, isn’t the one she’s looking for.
