PS5 QSSR support added to Marvel’s Spider-Man 2, CONTROL Resonant, ARC Raiders, THE FINALS, No Man’s Sky, and Hell Let Loose: Vietnam

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.gematsu.com/2026/11/ps5-qssr-support-added-to-marvels-spider-man-2-control-resonant-arc-raiders-the-finals-no-mans-sky-and-hell-let-loose-vietnam

PlayStation 5‘s Quick Spectral Super Resolution—the base console equivalent of PlayStation 5 Pro’s artificial intelligence upscaling solution PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution—will add Marvel’s Spider-Man 2, CONTROL Resonant, ARC Raiders, THE FINALS, No Man’s Sky, and Hell Let Loose: Vietnam to its lineup of supported titles, Sony Interactive Entertainment announced.

Berdasarkan laporan, “having seen great results integrating [quick spectral super resolution] in marvel’s wolverine, our team decided to bring it to marvel’s spider-man 2 as well, in an update that’s live now!,” said insomniac games head of technology mike fitzgerald. “We’re excited for players to swing back into our 2023 title and see [Quick Spectral Super Resolution]’s exciting image stability and sharpness benefits in both Fidelity and Performance modes. ”.

Remedy Entertainment is bringing Quick Spectral Super Resolution to CONTROL Resonant on PlayStation 5, with noticeable improvements in image stability and fine detail.

Diungkapkan bahwa “it’s great to see playstation bringing the same kind of leap on the playstation 5 that [playstation spectral super resolution] brought to playstation 5 pro,” said remedy entertainment senior graphics programmer erik jansson. “[Quick Spectral Super Resolution] gives CONTROL Resonant a much more stable and detailed image, and we’ve worked closely with Sony to have it ready in an update coming in December. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “with the new [quick spectral super resolution] coming soon to arc raiders and the finals, we can deliver increased sharpness, better environmental clarity and overall visual improvements to even more playstation players,” said embark studios technical art director mikael linderholm. “We are very happy to see Sony’s continued investment in PlayStation technology translate into meaningful improvements for all players, bringing more immersive experiences across the PlayStation ecosystem. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa “no man’s sky gives players an infinite procedural universe to explore,” said hello games founder sean murray. “When every star in the night sky is a real solar system players can visit, we care a great deal about the quality of every pixel.

Diungkapkan bahwa “the team has always been passionate about pushing the boundaries of technology on playstation. [Quick Spectral Super Resolution] allows us to render the universe in sharper, cleaner and more beautiful detail, while delivering the best possible framerate. Look for it in the next few weeks.

Diungkapkan bahwa “it’s another step towards making the universe of no man’s sky even more immersive to explore. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we’re delighted to confirm that we are adding [quick spectral super resolution] to hell let loose: vietnam on playstation 5 through an upcoming update,” said expression games game director paul rustchynsky. We can’t wait for our PlayStation players to see the difference. “Console visuals are something our community has been passionate about, and [Quick Spectral Super Resolution] will bring sharper, cleaner image quality to the battlefield, from dense jungle to the chaos of a full-scale firefight. ”.

#737. How Origame Digital are channelling and defacing Lovecraft over a trilogy of "inherently indigenous" anti-fascist games

📅 13 Nov 2026

How Origame Digital are channelling and defacing Lovecraft over a trilogy of "inherently indigenous" anti-fascist games

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/how-origame-digital-are-channelling-and-defacing-lovecraft-over-a-trilogy-of-inherently-indigenous-anti-fascist-games

Revisiting the secretive design of Penguin Colony.

Diungkapkan bahwa much like the h. Lovecraft novella it alternately riffs on and skewers, Penguin Colony takes you to an ancient alien city of crabby cuboid geometry and helical designs – comparable at a glance to Lovecraft's "terraces of every sort of provocative disproportion", but here given strangely everyday, anachronistic-seeming labels, such as "Downtown". P. Later, you're shown flashes of footage of the streets of Melbourne in Australia - developer Origame Digital's base of operations, and a city built on stolen Wurundjeri Woi-wurrung and Bunurong Boon Wurrung land.

Diungkapkan bahwa when i first set foot in downtown, in the unassuming body of a rockhopper penguin, i thought the broad idea was to satirically redefine modern settlements built by european colonisers as lovecraftian relics, intrusions from the cosmic beyond. This irony seems most pointed in sections where you steer a group of Māori characters, journeying south to prevent an expedition of German and British Nazi occultists from resurrecting a surviving elder being they call the "one true Aryan king". Playing as one of the Māori voyagers, you witness the cyclopean city as a realm of spectral high rises and square windows, rearing out of a swamp of blood and bone.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'm only somewhat correct about all this. Penguin Colony's reference points are wide-ranging and precise, with the persona of a disinterested penguin serving partly as a means of critical distance from Lovecraft, and partly, as a kind of camouflage for an extremely complex political artwork. It's easy to treat the game's critique as wholly retrospective - an alternately mocking and outraged investigation of a horror author whose bigotry is often reduced to an apologetic footnote or tinny performative disclaimer, drowned out by dread augurs of tentacles in the dark. It's a test of interpretative rigour, amongst other things, for hasty white European reviewers who might slip and slide past the more elaborate allusions into idle chat about Soulslikes.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, speaking to me over videocall, origame digital founder and director naphtali faulkner acknowledged the broad objective of reframing colonial cities as unearthly aberrations, cutting against cosier visions of colonised australian land. But also, you have this sort of 'Australiana' stuff happen quite a lot, where it's tin roofs and red dirt, that kind of look you see on a postcard. "There's a bit of an issue with Australian games, where they tend to be tourism pieces, sometimes," he comments. They will comfortably sidestep that for a lot of reasons – one is, a lot of the families that are affected by that are still around. "Not in a bad way, but they do not bring up the violence of this country, in anything. Is it [a non-indigenous developer's] place to tell that story? No. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, still, penguin colony's "first colonial city" isn't just a response to 'australiana'. 2b2t is an incarnation of Mojang's sandbox building sim that is so 'pure' and unsparing in its priorities that license owners Microsoft can't entirely acknowledge it. It's also a monument to 2b2t, the ancient Minecraft "anarchy" server that is infamous for its vicious player culture, and somewhat admired for the colossal strangeness of its desecrated geography. The server's central spawn has been repeatedly built up, defaced and degraded over 16 years of constant operation, forming a nightmare landscape of lavafalls and Wither holes and floating seas and basalt barricades.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we took data from that, and we modified it, and made it playable," faulkner tells me. When you do Minecraft, it's basically a colonisation simulator where you go extract the trees and stuff but it all magically regrows. You have the Spawn - the Spawn is the most heart-wrenching thing to look at when you first see it, because you know what Minecraft is in your head, you've seen those rolling green hills, and then to see it basically be destroyed into oblivion, is a very strong emotion. 2b2t's only rules are there's no rules, and also nothing respawns. "We had to subdivide it, and it had more detail and stuff, and really transform it a lot, but the whole thing was: what is 2b2t? It's the most realistic depiction of colonisation in a videogame. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, as an inadvertent digital document of colonialism, 2b2t doesn't offer much hope of reparation and redress. "And you know, fix the damage that was done, but we all know what gamers did to it, right? They've done various incursions and things like covering it in lava or water, or making it so that you can't leave without cheats. In general, he is interested in how fiction makers might preserve virtual landscapes that reflect "player-run digital ecosystems of people basically going beyond what the designers thought. " Still, Faulkner considers it "a fascinating relic of gaming". "The only way to build back the Spawn is to go back and replant everything," Faulkner says. ".

2b2t's presence within Penguin Colony is illustrative of how Origame Digital are using Lovecraft over the course of a planned trilogy of "inherently indigenous" Lovecraftian games – not just rebutting the author's anglophilia and white supremacism, not merely flipping the racial power dynamics so as to "make the indigenous people the skull-measuring scientists", but taking Lovecraft's mythos to unfamiliar places and forcing it to serve a politics that Lovecraft himself would despise.

Sebagaimana diketahui, faulkner himself came across lovecraft's work around 15 years ago, having been introduced to it by a university friend. "I started to understand that Lovecraft isn't just the author's works," he says. "It's this all-encompassing thing that has inspired so much stuff. He points to the Shadows Over Innsmouth music video created by Carpenter Brut - a contributor to Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number's OST - and also, to Victor LaValle's The Ballad of Black Tom, an adaptation of Lovecraft's The Horror at Red Hook written from the perspective of a Black man. "You know how Lovecraft's described, with Cthulhu - 'unknowable horror', 'madness inducing'," he says. " Faulkner grew more intrigued by Lovecraft, however, after seeing other artists adapt his work. "And then you see it and it's kind of like an octopus. He was unmoved, initially, by the author's descriptions of eldritch threats and incomprehensible dimensions. It's a bit underwhelming. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, even as he pondered lovecraft and the broader, somewhat dissociative genre of the lovecraftian, faulkner was also investigating his own heritage as a ngāi te rangi person living in a former british colony, tracing patterns of invasion, conquest and assimilation that, he says, have repeated themselves since the days of the romans and vikings. "You know, where you have to learn your own family history, and you have to learn why things are the way they are at the moment. "I think the reason that I decided to do this, was that when I started to get Lovecraft, it was when I was really starting to have the understanding that every indigenous person has at some point about what colonisation is," he says. And so to me, it was like that thing of, when you start seeing Lovecraft as this thing about displacement, invasion, destruction, language - it reached me at the perfect time in my life when I was already looking at this stuff, and I thought that it was a really apt analogy. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, faulkner also sensed that even lovecraft enthusiasts who are less mindful of the author's politics were yearning for a fresher kind of lovecraftian fable. "When it comes to indigenous stuff, the thing is that we're not really represented in anything, and our histories are rarely given a platform to say stuff, especially in games," he goes on. "But what I'd sort of looked at with Lovecraft, was that I think fans were ready for it, because people had gotten a little tired of these direct, 1-to-1 adaptations, that still exist in the space of the unknowable horror is unknowable, rather than trying to say, why is the unknowable horror scary?".

Berdasarkan laporan, the idea of the "unknowable" pervades lovecraftian fiction, as does the idea of "cosmic indifference", that terror of being engulfed in a vaster universe of forms and forces that barely register the existence of human beings. I am not even a speck of inane curiosity. This "unknowability" is concentrated in the balefully blank gaze of Psurumin, the otherworldly entity at the far end of Penguin Colony - the last Earthly remnant of an empire spanning hundreds of planets. "I stare deep within, and yet I see nothing. "I stare into its eyes," intones Howard Blakely, the game's English narrator, and an initially unconsenting member of the doomed Nazi expedition. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, penguin colony overlaps this lovecraftian "cosmic indifference" with faulkner's grief and bewilderment at how perpetrators of empire have insulated themselves from feelings of responsibility or shame. "For example in the southern hemisphere here, Australia and New Zealand, the idea was that the missionaries would say 'don't worry, we're saving them, we're turning them into Christians, we had to kill the ones who resist'," he says. "And the soldiers that had immense trauma and guilt from doing that would be consulted by a priest and told, 'you were doing it for the greater good'. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "to me it's saying: how could they do that to us?" faulkner goes on. how could someone choose to do that? And even to this day, there's a question around even saying sorry about it. "What made them do that? To me as a younger person, it was very 'unknowable'. Or there's questions around people, they want to sort of move on from history, and never bring it up, never acknowledge it again, whilst the injustice of colonisation is still present. You've probably talked to other indigenous people, I hope, before in your life, and it's this kind of thing especially where there's a lot of pain there, because. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, howard blakely is a mirror of sorts for this culture of denial and obfuscation. For all his apparent awareness that Psurumin does not regard him as a fellow being, and that to release the creature would be calamitous, he succumbs to the idea that he can ship the starspawn home as yet another trophy for the British Empire. He dreams of being honoured as a great pioneer by "the London School of Eugenics", and retiring to a cottage in Western Victoria. These reflections are accompanied by archive illustrations of colonial officers storming the frontier, and video snapshots of Psurumin statues in Melbourne's civic centres.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, blakely is similarly befuddled about his german nazi hosts, who are initially his captors. " In this, Blakely echoes Dyer, narrator of Lovecraft's At The Mountain Of Madness, who comes to admire the star-faring colonisers his team unearth in the far south, calling them "men of another age and another order of being". While cautious of them, he also doesn't see the Nazis as altogether bad. After all, some of them are fellow scholars – surely, they are too refined, too cultured, to be altogether irredeemable. "He doesn't see himself in history, as he walks through this place," Faulkner comments. "He doesn't see the Nazis as the people that we see them as. But he is also an expression of political myopia and creeping fascism in the present.

Diungkapkan bahwa the inspiration for blakely came partly from faulkner's own time in the academic world. "There are tonnes of people who are scientists first, and political thinkers 17th in their thoughts," he comments, recalling his encounters with Trump supporters as a student. "People who don't consider themselves political and then end up taking incredible political stances on stuff, until it becomes clear that they do actually have a political ideology, that's sort of formed by being around the people they're around. " Faulkner's other reference points for Blakely include Elon Musk, once "washed through the media as a green, eco-warrior guy", latterly an advocate for 'great replacement' theories and far-right uprisings.

Diungkapkan bahwa faulkner says that penguin colony's anti-fascist sentiments are especially aimed at "the rise of gen-z fascism", expressed in online transphobia and anti-semitic memes. "What they say is things like 'the painter was right'. " Faulkner thinks that this neofascism has "petered out a little bit" over the past ten years, but is still on the march. "There's been a huge uptick in people trying to vindicate Hitler, and trying to rehabilitate him in the eyes of this young generation," he says. Above all, he sees its resurgence in the genocide of Palestinians in Gaza, and in the qualms many self-described anti-fascists have about condemning it.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i and every indigenous person i know, in and out of the games industry, have no nuanced emotions about what is happening there," faulkner continues. We're not just hearing stories anymore. We're noticing how the mostly white, non-indigenous people are still conflicted on it and confused on it, and they don't have clarity on this. The idea with this game was to really bring this into focus, because the games industry likes to say that indigenous people are welcome. And they want to welcome us at our events. And we're not just noticing the violence happening to the indigenous people right now. "We know what this is. Like, it's our family stories come to life. What does that mean? You guys want us here to talk, but you're not going to acknowledge the genocide of indigenous people that's happening in front of you, that every single human being at this point knows about. We can see what this was. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, penguin colony ends with a statement calling out the games industry at large for holding its collective tongue about the israeli military's brutal campaign, noting that such "cowardice" will be "recorded by the art that it makes". The flipside of that sentiment is that art can be a record of courage and principle, advancing and nourishing a culture in which xenophobia and colonial ideology are unable to thrive. I see this idea expressed, again, in the journey of the Māori group, who are equipped to prevent Psurumin's return because they have made doing so a tradition and a practice.

Berdasarkan laporan, "they know from generations of story, that you have to do it," says faulkner. " Thwarting Psurumin is part of the Māori's creative lifework, part of their journey together. "It is the job of our descendants to carry forward the story of our resistance," intones one of their group, the game's second narrator. Every 100 years, to compose new haka and follow new paths unknown to our enemy. "To create song, dance and story, so our people move toward the light and away from darkness. "That it's a responsibility to do it, when it happens. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as a whole, penguin colony aims to be one such path away from darkness, its methods a mixture of bald and oblique, overt and covert. There's an angry hopefulness to the game that coexists with the spectacle of a distinctly 'double-A' penguin bumping and slithering along boulevards of blue-toned, recessed stone. I have barely broken the surface in this piece. The player is invited to participate in that hope by the game's closing "expedition" screens, which present all the lore you've gathered – including photographs taken by the Nazis, and textual fragments of devious origin – as a web of stars, floating over an illustration of the Zodiac.

Berdasarkan laporan, the invocation of constellations is gently subversive because a constellation is an act of selective reading, stringing together sparks in a void. Treat the lore as something you can individually exhaust or "100%", as in many RPGs, and your selective reading will vanish into the mass of motes. Rather than 'completing' the star map in solitude, the game invites players to reach out to each other and compare their constellations – a homage to a "pre-social media" era when the distribution of information was less the province of monolithic digital platforms, and also, a framework for political solidarity. "As we live in a world which continues to push us further apart, we invite you to come together, talk, share, and interpret what you saw," the game suggests.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the call isn't open to all, however. "It just makes their skin crawl. As a rhetorical apparatus, Penguin Colony is full of traps, easily overlooked if you focus on its headline politics. Penguin Colony is consciously designed to repel those who might identify with its Nazis, appropriating the portrayal much as alt-right memesters sought to deify Anakin Skywalker, in the run-up to this year's US midterms. " There are many more such snares in the game. "We have a character voiced by a German trans woman – they can't enjoy it," notes Faulkner. The commentary on Israel and Palestine, especially, pervades Penguin Colony in ways I don't think any player has yet discovered.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the lore of penguin colony also harbours clues about origame's future "inherently indigenous" lovecraftian games. "It's this idea of, what does Lovecraft look like in a future that we're heading towards, in the sense of social isolation and landscapes of small town decay. The next game in that trilogy was actually conceived before Penguin Colony, and will be set decades from now. Faulkner envisages it as a loose retelling of Shadows Over Innsmouth, Lovecraft's story about fishpeople cults and miscegenation in a remote coastal town. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in place of a dagon cult, origame digital's next game will focus on groups of secretive violent bigots, with the player playing the part of a detective - a premise that, more superficially, makes me eager for a resurrection of the photography mechanics in origame's reputation-making umurangi generation. As with Penguin Colony, the concept draws heavily on Faulkner's own life experiences.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i grew up in a cattle town, and cattle towns are notoriously pretty racist places," he says. "The whole thing is when I left the town, when I was 18, just because I was going to university, I learned that the town had an active KKK [branch] that was being run out of the Anglican church. And this town is one town away from Grafton, which is where the white supremacist terrorist Brenton Tarrant is from – the guy who went and shot up the mosque in Christchurch. How does that happen? Where everyone knows about it, but they hush up?" The forthcoming game will look at how bitterness and neglect may give rise to such hatred, as local economies dry up and support structures are stripped away.

Berdasarkan laporan, the second game will also take inspiration from the north american concept of a "sundown town", in which non-white people face violence if they linger outdoors after sunset - a vicious history also explored in matt ruff's hbo-adapted novel lovecraft country. And then suddenly they're followed on the highway for an hour. And the clerk just sort of gives them a look, and then nudges over to them that there's a guy in the back of the shop just looking at them. They go to pay. "They stopped there. "I went through a big rabbit hole on Youtube of hearing stories of people talking about, like, getting lost on the highway, needing to stop for gas, and then realising they had to stop it for gas at a sundown town," Faulkner explains. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the final game in origame digital's planned trilogy is far more formless, right now, but faulkner has dreams of venturing into the realm of cooperative multiplayer. "It's not even written down on paper yet," he says. For one thing, I don't know if I've got the skills to do it, because Penguin Colony had some jank, and had some technical issues at launch, but I'm getting better at making games. "We've just talked about it. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this multiplayer project would build on penguin colony's premise of playing a colony, hopping between penguin bodies while shadowing blakely's expedition. It would also follow through on the former game's closing encouragement to make allies against inhumanity via the collective interpretation of a celestial expanse of lore. "It's about the whole group, and I think if the third one was going to make a point about coming together to solve the problem… you probably want to make that a mechanical issue," Faulkner speculates, "where we have to actually make players do these sorts of actions together. ".

#739. Horde PVP character lock in WoW Forever, explained

📅 13 Nov 2026

Horde PVP character lock in WoW Forever, explained

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/horde-pvp-character-lock-in-wow-forever-explained/

Having trouble making a Horde character in PvP lately? You're not alone.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you’ve been eager to hop into world of warcraft: forever, create a horde character, say “lok’tar ogar!” (victory or death!) after an intense pvp match, you’re going to have to wait. There’s an ongoing faction lock on Horde characters in PvP rulesets until further notice.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in a game like wow, premised on being big on faction warfare, achieving some form of balance across player numbers ensures no one side dominates pvp. And since Forever does have a dedicated mega-realm (ruleset) for PvP players, this faction lock has become a source of frustration.

We’ll look into what we know so far, and update you once it’s finally been lifted.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the faction lock happens when you try to switch over to the pvp ruleset and create a horde character. The error box will state this is due to a “population imbalance. Chances are, you’ll be stopped by the game. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you’ve ever encountered faction restrictions in wow before, this is a similar situation. Just like the error says, it’s very likely that one faction probably had a lot more players than the other.

Diungkapkan bahwa “while even the most extreme case in a region is currently at roughly a 55/45 split, that is not as close as we want it to be,” community manager kaivax said in a post. “Our goal is to bring things as close to a 50/50 faction balance as possible. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, there is no definitive fix for the faction lock as of writing. Some common (albeit unproven) solutions include the following:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there has been no proof that paying for a new account or getting an account boost can fix the lock, so better to stay safe and avoid these. If you want to wait a couple of minutes, avoid using an auto-clicker to be on the safe side.

While waiting, you could also do the following:.

Diungkapkan bahwa perhaps the most common “answer” to the lock problem is to create a character in the other faction to help balance the population. Unfortunately, this will lock your account’s PvP ruleset to that faction.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you already have a character in the pve ruleset, you can hop on there and enjoy its more casual leveling experience. You can still toggle World PvP via the options menu.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, should you want to take the game’s adventuring fantasy more seriously, maybe the rp-pvp ruleset works for you. This just has the added requirement of actually roleplaying your character, so speaking in dialogue, following cues for anything out-of-character, and just fully immersing in Azeroth. Perfect if you want to roleplay your character’s heritage on top of high-stakes PvP.

Berdasarkan laporan, character creation restrictions in pvp rulesets weren’t just exclusive to the horde, however. Blizzard also locked the creation of Alliance characters to some degree, in a bid to ensure character populations across each faction are as balanced as realistically possible.

As such, you might have some difficulty creating characters of a specific faction in a specific region:.

Kaivax assured this is temporary and helps the “long-term health of the ruleset,” especially now when guilds are slowly being established.

Read what’s behind the latest news in gaming (with a bit of snark) by subscribing to the Destructoid Checkpoint newsletter!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, other players took to other avenues to explore the faction lock situation as well. While there’s no definite solution aside from waiting, here are other things you should take into account:.

Berdasarkan laporan, there are also other players who have already experienced some version of faction locking before it got widespread. They also posted about it in the Blizzard forums.

However, Yryadorne from customer service clarified that their team isn’t able to unlock this manually.

Diungkapkan bahwa some players asked whether trial accounts also affected the count. These are accounts where you could only play for free until Level 20 (with restrictions) without a subscription. Kaivax replied that their testing concluded the trial accounts had nothing to do with the imbalance. They explained that the 55/45 split focused on the “active logged-in population” of players across all levels.

There’s no evidence that creating a lot of trial accounts would fix the faction balance, especially if part of the consideration is that they are “actively” logged in.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, just to be on the safe side, it might be a good idea to check if your horde lock is related ot any other character creation errors. Blizzard outlined this list, which could be a useful reference:.

A lot of players expressed frustration with the inability to create characters in their favored Faction, especially those who want to sink their teeth into PvP in Forever.

The situation has been particularly difficult for players who also want to play with friends of one faction, only to find out it’s currently locked.

Diungkapkan bahwa one blizzard forum post even requested some form of compensation, as there’s no proper communication surrounding the faction lock. Other threads also called out the lack of any virtual queue, estimated waiting time, or any way of knowing how long until the restriction is lifted.

The idea of faction-locking isn’t new to Forever, but it certainly came as a shocker to players still getting used to the idea of having one mega-realm to play on.

Diungkapkan bahwa things were different in the og release and classic, where you could have characters in different realms. Back then, you could only be Horde on one PvP realm and Alliance on another. Faction rules only applied to new players when one faction was starting to crowd a specific realm, so newcomers had to adjust by joining the rival group.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "physical" copies of gta 6 started shipping out to early buyers this week, including several members of gamesradar+ staff. As players start to worry that their codes may be stolen with a bizarre flashlight trick, we had to see if we could steal our own – and honestly, I wouldn't be too worried about the possibility.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rockstar's approach to its code-in-box release of gta 6 is slightly different from most publishers. Rather than including the game code printed on a slip of paper in the case, the code is printed inside the back cover art itself. Social media is starting to be washed over with reports that if you shine a very bright flashlight just right into the edge of a GTA 6 case, you can make out the code without even breaking the seal on the game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i tried the trick with my own us copy of the ps5 physical edition, and it did not work. There's a strip of camouflage patterning underneath the code that renders it unreadable from the opposite side no matter how bright a light you shine at it. My colleague Catherine tried the trick with her UK PS5 copy, and same deal – the code is unreadable through that camo pattern.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there is a catch here: not every code-in-box copy of gta 6 has the camo strip. I've combed through unboxing videos of the game, and while I can't find any examples of US copies without the protective camouflage, some copies with a PEGI rating only have a plain black strip in the background. This, it seems, is the one that could be vulnerable to the apparent flashlight trick.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, i haven't managed to track down anybody reporting that they've fallen victim to a stolen code. Most retailers keep their games behind locked glass cases, so a prospective code thief would probably have to buy the game, hope that it's a black background version, get an unusually powerful flashlight, shine it in, and then convince the retailer to take the game back for a refund in order for anyone to fall afoul of the potential scam.

Sebagaimana diketahui, is that a level of trouble anyone's willing to go to in order to play gta 6 for free? well, yeah, i guess so. But it's also not an issue unique to GTA's code-in-box release – I've had a few occasions where I've purchased a new, "sealed" copy of a traditional physical game only to find that someone had carefully snuck the disc out of the package and returned it to the retailer where I eventually bought it.

Berdasarkan laporan, and, well, if you're that worried, you can just buy the game digitally. Yeah, I know, I'm the exact kind of sicko who bought the physical version to have a box on my shelf and a poster on my wall, but it's not as if there's a real difference between getting the box and just doing a digital GTA 6 pre-order. Now, if there was actually a map in the box, that might be a different story.

Diungkapkan bahwa slay the spire 2, which released into early access earlier this year, is expanding once more with a major new beta update. This introduces the deckbuilder's first new character since launch - a whimsical musician armed with a bow - alongside two new modes, and more.

Berdasarkan laporan, when slay the spire 2 arrived back in march, it was to much enthusiastic acclaim. Eurogamer's Bertie Purchie is a big fan, and has trumpeted its successes on multiple occasions, calling the sequel's co-op mode "transformative". And it was a commercial hit too, managing to shift over 5m copies in just a month of release. All of which means there are plenty of eyes on Slay the Spire 2, eager to see what developer MegaCrit does next.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so far major updates have brought the likes of buffs, balance adjustments, art updates, ui improvements, bug fixes, and more - and megacrit has also made other substantial adjustments including the jettisoning of third act boss doormaker, after it decided the encounter was overly complex. And now, as 2026 nears its conclusion, the studio has released its "biggest (beta) patch yet", including a sweep of major additions.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as per megacrit's v0. 0 patch notes, the headliner is The Fool; Slay the Spire 2's first new character, who's described as a "silly musician who wields a bow". 113. Unsurprisingly, The Fool doesn't arrive in their final form, and the studio says it expects to make a "great number of content and balance changes" before the character is ready for the main branch.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, accompanying the fool are two new game modes: blitz and dread. Unlocked after completing an Ascension run of any difficulty, it comes with five levels of Ascension shared across all characters. Blitz is described as a "condensed and chaotic" mode focused on deckbuilding. "The Merchant's wares feel a bit off," MegaCrit teases, "the map is gone, and Gold no longer matters??".

Berdasarkan laporan, if you're looking for a more gruelling challenge, though, there's the "brutally difficult" new blitz mode, designed for players who've reached ascension 10 on all characters, including the fool. All ascension modifiers are enabled, according to MegaCrit, while bosses are stronger and buff all enemies found across their Act. And if that's still not enough to get your heart racing, MegaCrit notes curses will also pile up as you climb the Spire.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, beyond the headline stuff, v0. 0 tweaks rest sites so they appear one floor earlier every act, and that's alongside the usual list of UI changes, art additions, nerfs, balance adjustments, and more. 113. Full patch notes can be found on Steam.

Berdasarkan laporan, those players eager to put slay the spire 2's latest additions through their paces will need to enable the beta branch by right-clicking on slay the spire 2 in their steam library and navigating to properties > game versions & betas and selecting 'public-beta' from the dropdown menu. MegaCrit notes the game's main branch has also been updated with all content and changes from the previous beta.

Oh the adventures weâd go on and monsters weâd face. â When I was in elementary school playing The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the first time, I was young enough that Linkâs seven-year slumber seemed like a dream come true. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, itâs been years since i revisited ocarina of time, and while iâd always known the series to be tinged with melancholy, one thing that nearly 30 years of distance from the original nintendo 64 game has given me is an understanding that ocarina of time is a tragedy. The Hero of Time wins the day and saves Hyrule, but at a great cost of his own innocence. You can put the Master Sword back into its pedestal and go back to your childhood, but youâll never erase the horrors of seeing every safe haven you once knew desecrated beyond recognition while youâre still carrying the heart and soul of a child, even as your body grows older and stronger.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if youâve already played ocarina of time, the lead-up to the eventual time skip in the remake feels dreadful in a way that even all the childlike whimsy happening around link canât cure. On top of young Linkâs appearance being much more expressive and youthful than it was on the Nintendo 64, there are a bunch of small details in dialogue that make it clear this is a little baby pushed out of the nest. Little dude calls the king of all evil âDanondorf,â is three apples tall, and has the resting pout of a baby who doesnât cover his mouth when he coughs. This isnât the classical vision of a hero, itâs a wide-eyed baby who slaps around wooden sticks with his friends in a playground, imitating the heroic soldiers theyâve been told tall tales of in just the few years theyâve been able to walk.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as you grow older, you learn that those tales of heroism arenât all theyâre chalked up to be. Many still make the decision to reach for the sword, but in Ocarina of Time, Link doesnât get to make that decision, it is thrust upon him at an age when his whole understanding of what being a hero means would be shaped by those simple childhoodÂ  stories. The realities of being a hero canât be understood by a mere child, and thatâs why he is forcibly aged up seven years: so that he can wield the sword he was destined to carry and defeat an evil no one else can.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the concept of âstolenâ lives comes up throughout ocarina of time, though many of the people who are âdestinedâ to save the world take comfort in the sense of purpose they find in becoming a pawn in the grand design. At the very least, the Ocarina of Time remake makes that terrible fate more clear. Link, on the other hand, who has been dragged into this as a child with no time to grow up and decide for himself, is treated as a tragic figure, one that Zelda sends back to his childhood in the hopes that he can live out the life he deserved. If only it were that simple. Rather than just pointing out that Link has aged up, Rauru, the Sage of Light, breaks the news to Link that he has lost seven years, expressing this with remorse, rather than simply as a matter of fact. Many of the Sages say this to Link directly; though they canât return to the family and friends they once knew, it brings them joy to know they are part of something bigger than themselves. Â.

Thus, he teaches the Link of Twilight Princess skills that help him defeat Ganondorf in his own timeline, ensuring that even if everything heâd done has been forgotten, it will live on in future generations. Perhaps, if he cannot be remembered as a hero, everything he learned in these invisible lives can be passed down to someone who can be. Centuries later, the Hero of Time is still protecting his inner child, because even if he has finally been able to age as he should have, he canât let go of all that he was forced to watch unfold in his multiple childhoods.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the zelda series has always been replete with somber stories, and while theyâve often been communicated subtly and left for fans to theorize about, lore bibles and official materials have turned theories into reality. #745. 10 New Movies to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO Max (November 13 - 15)

10 New Movies to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO Max (November 13 - 15)

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/new-movies-streaming-this-weekend-netflix-november-13-15/

A big horror movie, one of the best dinosaur movies of the year, and more.

Happy weekend! Several movies are hitting theaters this week, from the action-comedy How to Rob a Bank, starring Nicholas Hoult, Zoë Kravitz, and Christian Slater, to Ti West’s take on A Christmas Carol, titled Ebenezer and starring Johnny Depp.

Diungkapkan bahwa if that’s not enough to get you into theaters, we understand. The End of Oak Street is available on HBO Max, taking the crown for the best dinosaur movie since Steven Spielberg's Jurassic Park. Thankfully, Polygon has a full slate of new movie recommendations, available on streaming and VOD. It also has one of the scariest T-Rexes ever captured on film. Heart of the Beast is now available on VOD, following Brad Pitt and an adorable German Shepherd as they try their best to survive the harsh Alaskan wilderness.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you’re looking for netflix dramas, there’s heartland, a musical-crime-western mashup starring jessica chastain and garrett hedlund. There’s also Chris Rock’s latest feature, Misty Green, following an out-of-work actress in Los Angeles desperate to make a career comeback. If you're into documentaries, there’s Avedon, exploring the life of career of the life of the beloved photographer whose work left a big imprint on fashion photography.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lastly, being heumann, based on the autobiography of judy heumann’s life as an activist, is now streaming on apple tv. There’s also a new 4K reissue of one of Guillermo del Toro’s most beloved movies, Pan’s Labyrinth.

Diungkapkan bahwa david robert mitchell’s the end of oak street is an incredible riff on spielberg’s jurassic park, following a family in the '80s going through some personal challenges. As the parents contemplate a divorce, their neighborhood gets hurled back in time to the dinosaur era, with the outside of their home crawling with all sorts of terrifying pre-historic reptiles.

Berdasarkan laporan, the dinosaurs themselves are magnificent, rendered with the feathers and fuzzy hair that we now know dinosaurs sported without losing the fearsome nature imbued by spielberg 30 years ago. This is a movie where dinosaurs repeatedly slaughter and eat random humans, and each kill got an applause from my theater's rowdy audience every time. Mitchell and his team also take some creative swings with the creature designs that largely pay off, including a family of large rocky turtles and a terrifying silent serpent as long as a train with rows of impossibly sharp teeth.

Sebagaimana diketahui, heartland is one of the strangest movies in jessica chastain’s career. The Oscar-winner plays Misty Jones, a former country megastar who returns home to Nashville to investigate the sudden disappearance of her niece, Charlie Hart, who’s following in her footsteps as a country musician.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, being heumann is based on judy heumann's memoir, "being heumann: an unrepentant memoir of a disability rights activist," dramatizing the 28-day sit-in protest at the san francisco federal building by disability activists. The demonstration led to the first U. S. federal civil rights protections for people with disabilities.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ron howard’s most recent film is a documentary centered on richard avedon, one of the most important photographers in fashion history. The film has great access to Avedon’s personal files, showing never-before-seen images and interviews with family members and figures like Twiggy, Isabella Rossellini, and more.

Berdasarkan laporan, misty green follows a once-successful actress and performer whose career has been derailed due to addiction, self-sabotage, and an evolving, challenging industry. After facing challenges from all sides, Misty goes on a desperate job hunt, pursuing a starring role in a remake of the musical Dreamgirls.

Diungkapkan bahwa heart of the beast follows brad pitt as a traumatized soldier who gets stranded in the alaskan wilderness alongside his combat-trained german shepard. The two band together to survive and return to civilization.

Sebagaimana diketahui, two isolated middle-aged siblings' lives (gayle rankin and grant o’rourke) are disrupted when they receive an eviction notice from the government. Raised to view all outsiders as threats, the siblings are shocked by the arrival of a mild-mannered land recovery coordinator (Domhnall Gleeson), who doesn’t know how to communicate with them.

Berdasarkan laporan, pan’s labyrinth is a special film in guillermo del toro’s filmography, and his most direct exploration of fairy tales. The series is set in the aftermath of the Spanish Civil War and follows Ofelia (Ivana Baquero), a 12-year-old girl who’s just moved to a military outpost managed by her terrifying stepfather (Sergi Lopez). She uncovers a rich fantasy world after stumbling upon a labyrinth and a faun, who informs her that she’s the reincarnation of a Princess and must complete three tasks to return to her kingdom.

Berdasarkan laporan, after terrifying everyone with its amazing trailer, other mommy is finally available on streaming. The film follows Bela (Arabella Olivia Clark), the daughter of parents who are going through a marital crisis. She starts to form a relationship with a malignant shapeshifting entity that calls itself Other Mommy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, v/h/s mixtape is the latest entry in the vhs franchise, a found-footage horror anthology that has featured directors like ti west, adam wingard, scott derrickson, and more. This year’s version is centered on the music industry and framed in the style of an MTV news show.

#747. Layoffs, generative AI, and overtime: New study paints bleak picture of 2026 gaming industry

📅 13 Nov 2026

Layoffs, generative AI, and overtime: New study paints bleak picture of 2026 gaming industry

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/layoffs-gen-ai-overtime-study-bleak-2026-gaming-industry/

Berdasarkan laporan, there’s a lot to be excited about in the gaming industry, as new awesome games are constantly being released. But the sad reality is that game development and the industry in general are in a very tough spot.

Berdasarkan laporan, a new report, gdc’s state of the game industry: november 2026, illustrates this unfortunate sentiment and is quite depressing to read through. The top two topics in it are industry layoffs and generative AI, and yeah, that sounds about right when it comes to everybody’s mood inside game dev these days.

Sebagaimana diketahui, citing people who work in the games industry surveyed from across the world (but mostly the us), gdc also pulled from a pool of 900 laid-off game workers to “dive deeper into their lived experiences. ” And here’s the experience: a whopping 68 percent of those laid off from AAA studios were affected in the past year, while 27 percent of them have sent 100 or more job applications since being let go, and 54 percent of them are still unemployed.

And when it comes to sentiment within studios, things are looking and feeling bleak as a result of everything that’s been happening over the past few years, as evidenced by this chart:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a lot of that may have to do with ai usage in the industry, how much it’s being used, and how it’s threatening to take jobs. There’s no good answer for AI in game dev, but most surveyed agree that it should stay in non-creative use only.

But in general, 40 percent of those surveyed say that they use generative AI tools as part of their job, up from 36 percent last year, and 55 percent say that it’s having a negative impact on the industry.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the survey states that “55 percent of game industry professionals think generative ai is having a negative impact on the game industry, unchanged from last year’s 54 percent” and “workers in quality assurance and community support (76 percent) held the most unfavorable views, followed by game design (65 percent), visual and technical arts (65 percent), and audio (57 percent). ” Meanwhile, 35% said, “generative AI is having a mixed impact on the game industry, while eight percent said it’s having a positive impact. ”.

And even with AI, work hours are getting hectic for many: 53 percent said they work over 40 hours weekly, with 13 percent saying they work 51 hours or more, on average, per week.

If you’d like to read the full report, check out the GDC website for all the detailed info.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the first reference to ai comes midway through the letter: "while we previously validated game systems only after implementing them manually, we now utilize ai to rapidly validate diverse design concepts prior to actual implementation," it states. Berdasarkan laporan, "we view ai not as a substitute for human developers, but as a tool to elevate development efficiency and quality. We will continue to expand our application of AI to deliver higher-fidelity games to the market more expeditiously. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, that essentially repeats what pearl abyss said in february when players discovered the presence of generative ai art in crimson desert: it acknowledged that "some 2d visual props" had been created by ai during the early stages of development, but said they were supposed to be replaced "following final work and review by our art and development teams, with work that aligned with our quality standards and creative direction. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, somehow, some way, the ps5 has been an extraordinary sales success despite launching in the middle of a global pandemic that caused massive supply chain issues and continuing on today amidst an unprecedented memory shortage and economic headwinds driving hardware prices sky high. Despite it all, people are buying PS5s, and many of them.

Berdasarkan laporan, sony confirmed just this week that ps5 has hit an incredible milestone of 100 million units sold in its six years on the market. That's not quite as fast as the PS2 or PS4, but it's a much more impressive achievement when you consider one crucial difference between the current-gen PlayStation and literally every other generation before it. Typically, games consoles decrease in price throughout their life cycles, but because of the disadvantages outlined above, the PS5 has only gotten more expensive, right alongside its competitors, the Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch 2.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so, even though the ps5 failed to hit 100 million units sold faster than its predecessors, it still reached the record for units sold without any sort of permanent price cut from sony. And before you head to the comments section to point out that you got a PS5 at a discount for Black Friday one year, we're talking about official, permanent price decreases from Sony, not temporary sales from retailers. That is seriously impressive considering the economic difficulties not only Sony and other hardware manufacturers are grappling with today, but consumers as well.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you could almost, almost make the case for ps5 being the first console period to hit that sales milestone without a price cut, but for the mighty nintendo switch. The Switch hit 100 million units sold in December 2021, and Nintendo never lowered its price globally. There was a price cut in Europe in September 2021, notably just before the Switch reached 100 million units, but it doesn't feel fair disqualifying it from claiming Sony's title for a small, regional price decrease alone.

Diungkapkan bahwa when i was a very little kid, i went to disneyland with my parents. One was labeled âGoudaâ and the other âNot So Gouda. There were two wheels of cheese. But I remember visiting Minnie Mouseâs house in the newly built ToonTown, and I remember my mom explaining a joke to me that we saw inside Minnieâs fridge. I donât remember much about that trip. â Once I understood it, I thought it was hilarious, and (apparently) remembered this tiny, specific, incidental detail forever.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i keep hearing friends and colleagues positively describe the legend of zelda: ocarina of time remake as a disney theme park, and i think theyâre onto something. Having revisited multiple Disneys fairly recently, I would readily believe that whoever drew up the plans for its reimagination of Castle Town did so after seeing the castle at Tokyo Disney, centered through archways, ablaze with lights, surrounded by colorful towers and European architecture and cobblestone streets.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but itâs more than just that single snapshot. Even so, the Ocarina of Time remake immediately invokes a powerful feeling of nostalgia in me despite me having nothing in particular to be nostalgic about, in the same way Tokyo Disney did the second that curry popcorn smell hit. Itâs that feeling of being overwhelmed by the density of detail, the care someone took to ensure that everything, all the way down to the items in the fridge or the slight way Link smiles (or doesnât) when he receives a Medallion, is exactly correct. Iâm not a Disney fiend, and I didnât grow up with Ocarina of Time; I played it for the first time this past January. In both situations, that inescapable cartoon fantasy magic overtook me, drawing me back in the second anything resembling cynicism tried to pull me away.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once, ocarina of timeâs hyrule was considered vastâas big as a video game world conceivably could be. Quaint. Now, after the soaring heights and dark depths of Tears of the Kingdom, it comes off as small. Thereâs less specificity, less intention. The houses start to look the same. Iâm not saying such games have none! There are so many open-world marvels! But thereâs a reason the Great Plateau remains one of the most memorable and well-regarded segments of Breath of the Wild so many years laterâitâs compact and immaculately designed, down to a microscopic level, in a way that Nintendo or anyone could not have possibly managed for every single corner of the rest of that Hyrule. Eventually, you start copying and pasting trees and grasses. The whole world is, what, equivalent to maybe one major region in Tears? Two, generously? Look, no matter what people proclaim AI will allow them to do or how fantastic GTA 6 ends up being, I struggle to believe you donât lose something in the minute details as you make a video game world more and more massive. It takes too long, and you have to have too many people care too much.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so in returning to a world with such a comparatively small scope after years of stretch, stretch, stretching, nintendo was able to focus its time, talent, and energy on making ocarina of time so deliciously, visually dense. Every single house, exterior and interior where available, is remarkably different from the next, its intricacies speaking to the sort of person who might live there. Another belongs to a clearly wealthy individual, another place looks a touch shady. Castle Town has been transformed from some vague polygons and a few Encarta-ass backdrops to a playground stuffed with detail. You can feel it, in every last corner, every blade of grass. One has an elaborate garden, different pots of flowers carefully arranged just as oneâs neighbor might do. I fully believe that Nintendo had a specific character in mind for each one, possibly even characters we will never see.

Sebagaimana diketahui, everything is like this! the individual tree huts in kokiri forest! the elaborate embroidery on womenâs skirts, the subtle pattern differences on menâs poofy pants! how dungeon mechanisms are now fully operational as coherent little machines instead of magic video game platforms! the directional sound, guiding you, siren-like, through the lost woods! the dungeons, fleshed out beyond just solid-colored walls into believable complexes with distinct rooms and themes, as if someone had been using them, at one point, for a real purpose (god, the forest temple!). The people who made this must love Ocarina of Time. Someone thought about every last blade of grass. â It is that. Itâs more than simply saying, âOh, Ocarina of Time is graphically impressive. Itâs a genuine, noticeable leap for Nintendo and a shining proof of what the Nintendo Switch 2 is capable of. Even the foliage is never, ever uniform, but grows in tufts and swaths varying by how much sunlight its space receives, how close it is to water, what foot traffic might be like. I believe this. But more importantly, I believe it to be a testament of what people are capable of when they are given the time, space, energy, and support to really craft something lovingly. It shows.

Diungkapkan bahwa over 25 hours for main quest plus all major sidequests (masks, biggoron sword) and 60+ gold skulltulas. I will not be gathering all 100 thank you.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, gorgeous. Exhorbitant amounts of visual and written detail. Lovely redone soundtrack including excellent new pieces. Appropriately faithful to original material.

Berdasarkan laporan, almost too easy, both because i am an adult now and also because of improved controls. Voice acting and some main story writing a bit juvenile.

Berdasarkan laporan, it would be rude of me to imply that this level of attention extended only to what we can see. That same intense commitment to specifics is everywhere. I have particular fondness for how it manifests in all the incidental writing, the little throwaway lines of dialogue with random NPCs around Hyrule. More characters have more dialogue than they ever did (especially if you include the Mask of Truth additions as both child and adult Link), and that dialogue is fleshed out with little jokes, hyperspecific details about characters and the world, and tiny nods to Linkâs personality (âDanondorf?â). Itâs genuinely entertaining just to talk to people.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and look, not every detail-based decision works for me. I blame much of the early script, which consists of instance after instance of Nintendo clearly being concerned that players new to Ocarina of Time will have no idea what is going on. Everyone insists on sitting Link down and patiently explaining things to him in far more detail than they did in the original, instead of just letting him at it. You may as well have put a giant âHYRULE CASTLE THIS WAYâ banner with big arrows and lights up when Link first arrives in Castle Town, the way most of the NPCs were acting. I find the English voice direction (and I do think this is an issue of direction, not acting talent) grating. Having gone back and watched some clips of later scenes in English, I believe the worst offenders of these types of conversations are in the first half of the game. Several performances (Saria, Ruto, Navi, the Great Deku Tree, and Kaepora Gaebora) sound like theyâre out of a piece of programming for very young children airing at 9am on PBS. I am willing to admit that my tolerance for the second act might be in part because I just got used to this tone as time went on, and again, from switching the voices. I swapped the voices to Japanese halfway through, which solved it for me because I simply could not understand them anymoreâI cannot comment on whether the Japanese performances are actually better or worse. But I do also think that the second half has significantly better writing, and trusts the player more to explore and sort things out for themselves.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, does ocarina of time âhold upâ? iâve been asked that a lot this year, on the heels of my january playthrough of the original and now as i work through the remake. I appreciated the original for the groundbreaking design work that it was in its combat, camera, dungeons, and two-sided, then-massive world to explore. Itâs good that games have evolved since then. I donât think thereâs a holistic answer. In 2026, literally none of it is revelatory anymore. Original Ocarina of Time is a relic nowâfun, fascinating, and clever, but still a relic. Itâs now more obvious than ever that despite its visual density, Hyrule Field is an empty space. You can argue that space between dungeons leaves room for contemplation, for slowness, but the practical reality is that most people are just going to start fast-traveling the second they can. There actually isnât that much to do, a bit like the spaces in Disneyland between theme park rides where all you can do is walk and shop. But whatâs funny about a remake is that it naturally smooths out so many of those edges with its modernity that I think it loses something in the translation. Once I learned the songs, I barely went out there again.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and this remake is so buttery. Jabu Jabu went from my least favorite dungeon in the original because of how annoying it was to my least favorite dungeon because of how easy and uneventful it was. On rails. Thereâs no fight to lock onto the target you want to hit, no confusion as you putter around a room trying to angle the camera to figure out where a hidden switch is. Iâve seen hundreds of more complex, more interesting, and more challenging dungeon puzzles in video games over the years, including many in later Zelda games. In Ocarinaâs, I never died, never struggled. Link slides through dungeons gracefully, solving puzzle after puzzle with ease. Like I said, a theme park ride. The controls are light and mostly intuitive (the return of the item selection wheel can kiss my ass). I donât have an answer for how Nintendo could have bridged that gap without making an entirely new game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but i think it also gains something here: a refreshed perspective. It is, at times, moving. It is beautiful. Despite its ease, despite the fact that Ocarina of Time in remake form is inventing nothing and surprising no one, it is fun. The incredible lessons these developers have learned over the years that have allowed them to make bigger and bigger Zelda adventures can also be condensed and focused to great effect. Itâs a testament to the excellence of all the pieces of this remake: its excellent cinematography, pacing, sound, look, feel, all of it, that it can still evoke that in me even when my heart is somewhat hardened against it. Even with no nostalgia to speak of, and full knowledge of the gameâs plot, I couldnât help but feel a swell of emotion when I first looked out on Hyrule Field, when Ruto and Saria became sages, and when Zelda revealed herself at last. Â.

Diungkapkan bahwa the old guard has said it is handing this series off to a new generation of zelda developers, who might use their work on ocarina of time as a learning experience that will allow them to do things their seniors never thought of doing. Iâm excited to see what comes of that. And maybe Iâm a bit relieved, too, to see a game so thoroughly melt away the tension between what is old and what is new. In fantasy worlds like these, thereâs nothing stopping us from having it all.

The Legend Of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake wants you to know this is a tragedy.

Lucky Luke: The Lonesome Cowboy Collection brings seven Lucky Luke titles from the 8-, 16-, and 32-bit eras to all modern platforms for the first time.

Over the past 70 years the cowboy has gone on to feature in numerous comics, several animated television series, feature films, and most recently a 2026 live-action television series.

Diungkapkan bahwa the lonesome cowboy collection reunites infogrames with the popular western franchise. Infogrames published several Lucky Luke titles in the late 90s and early 2000’s, including the incredibly rare Playstation Platinum edition of Lucky Luke: Western Fever.

The collection includes four games that were only released here in Europe and never made it to the United States, including the 1997 Super Nintendo Entertainment System release of Lucky Luke, the 2000 Game Boy Color release of Lucky Luke: Desperado Train, the 2001 PlayStation release of Lucky Luke: Western Fever, and the 2001 Game Boy Advance release of Lucky Luke: Wanted!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sometimes when we put together a new installment of wishlister, polygon’s weekly newsletter that highlights upcoming steam games, we look to events like steam next fest and the triple-i initiative to dig up gems. But the most tried-and-true method we’ve found for finding promising games is simply stumbling into them by accident.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

Sebagaimana diketahui, all of the games in this week’s wishlister follow that methodology. These are six games that flew onto our radar without looking for them, whether we bumped into their demos at live events or had them recommended to us by friends. We’re paying that energy forward this week, as you’ll see in this grab bag of upcoming PC games that deserve a spot on your Steam wishlist.

Diungkapkan bahwa with bub, developer paperfrog looks well on its way to delivering a jaw-dropping debut. The narrative game takes anxiety around a developer’s real-life Multiple Sclerosis diagnosis and channels it into a personal story about preserving your memory in art. That’s reinforced by an analog art style that looks downright incredible.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, false echo turns wartime cryptography into a life-or-death narrative game. You play as a code cracker aboard a submarine in 1942, and you’re tasked with processing incoming transmissions. There are some clear shades of Papers, Please here, which should make for a brainy political thriller steeped in World War II history.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you’re looking for your next high-score chasing game after this month’s great faraway, strikemania is one to watch. The retro arcade game is basically a reverse Missile Command; you control the missile attacking enemy defenses. With slick 2D art that evokes Geometry Wars, it should be a direct hit for fans of retro games.

Berdasarkan laporan, floor plan: slap it out! hinges on a satisfyingly goofy gameplay hook: you can slap the crap out of everything. The latest game from developer Turbo Button is a physical comedy that has you solving puzzles using your noodly arms. It’s also the developer’s first non-VR game, so you’ll be able to enjoy the studio’s quirky brand of humor without a headset.

Berdasarkan laporan, a perfect compliment to this year’s excellent over the hill, hodka is an open-world driving game that has you fixing up an old rv. You’ll use a metal detector to dig up scrap that can be used to upgrade your van. It also seems to have a spooky undertone to it, making it look like an on-land alternative to Dredge.

Diungkapkan bahwa for those who love rpgs that give you a lot of freedom, world of anterra seems poised to become a hidden gem. The retro-inspired game drops you in a pixel art world and sets you loose to discover its non-linear story. It’s all meticulously hand-crafted to give players a retro RPG that’s as rich with secrets as an Elder Scrolls game. (And it will likely be out before Sentinel!).

#757. Mini Review: Shrek 2 Remastered (PS5) - Far Far Away Gets an All-Star Makeover

📅 13 Nov 2026

Mini Review: Shrek 2 Remastered (PS5) - Far Far Away Gets an All-Star Makeover

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pushsquare.com/reviews/ps5/shrek-2-remastered

I believe, I believe, I believe this is a good time.

Version Reviewed: PS5 (Standard) / European.

While DreamWorks' tales of an ogre and his mates are hit or miss, there's no denying that Shrek 2 Remastered is a winning overhaul of a mid-2000s gem.

It comes from an era when movie tie-in games were all the rage, whether that meant half-arsed Harry Potter adventures or excellent efforts like X-Men Origins: Wolverine.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, shrek 2 is a thoroughly joyous time, adopting a marvel ultimate alliance-style formula for its antics. Shrek, Fiona, and Donkey form the core team you'll swap between, with familiar faces like Lil Red and the Gingerbread Man joining the squad from time to time.

Berdasarkan laporan, each character packs special abilities, whether that's donkey's 'burro blast' or fiona's power to slow down time, matrix-style. It's incredibly silly, and never commented on by our delightful cast. We wouldn't have it any other way.

Across a variety of locales from the titular movie, you'll squash, splatter, and swashbuckle through puzzles that take advantage of everyone's unique abilities.

Whether that's using Shrek's strength to hurl chickens into a pen for a fast food chain, or Donkey's agility to sneak up on a goblin that poops gems in a museum, there's plenty of variety.

'Hero Time' moments also spice things up, ranging from QTEs involving Fiona singing (badly) to birds, to Donkey riding Elizabeth the Dragon in a fiery chase.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's more depth here than your usual movie game slop, too, with friendly leprechaun crazy larry selling stat increases and upgrades in exchange for your hard-earned coins. It scratches that familiar LEGO game itch of smashing objects, platforming, and exploring every nook and cranny for collectibles.

All of it looks and sounds the part, with a faithful recreation of DreamWorks' fantastical art direction and an appropriately over-the-top score.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, where shrek 2 remastered really comes together is its brand-new co-op multiplayer. Played locally or online, the latter requiring an Epic Games Account, you can team up with three other players. It's a neat inclusion for a game that's over two decades old.

There's also a basic but enjoyable Photo Mode, perfect for capturing some amusing shots of the gang.

Diungkapkan bahwa performance on base ps5 is generally stable, although frame drops occasionally rear their ugly heads during crowded skirmishes or when loading new areas. Paired with an occasionally awkward camera, these blemishes don't hurt the experience too much.

Shrek 2 Remastered doesn't quite polish away all the rough edges of its original release, but there's so much charm here that it's difficult to hold them against it.

With a varied adventure, plenty of laughs, and the welcome addition of online co-op, this is a lovely reminder of when movie tie-in games could be just as entertaining as the films that inspired them.
