#758. Phantom Blade Zero: The Kotaku Review

📅 13 Nov 2026

Phantom Blade Zero: The Kotaku Review

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://kotaku.com/phantom-blade-zero-the-kotaku-review-2000756640

Sebagaimana diketahui, as i launched phantom blade zero for the first time and began what i can only describe as a belabored compiling of shaders, i used the time to dig out a notebook buried at the bottom of a moving box containing notes i took during a preview of the game in 2024. No one was expecting this action game with flashy trailers and an overly wordy title would be all that worth paying attention to, so it was handed to me to see what it was all about. At the time, I was tapped by another outlet to take the Summer Game Fest preview because everyone on staff was busy. Â.

Sebagaimana diketahui, two years later, sitting down to play the final game, i kept flashing back to that demo with developer s-game, who were so desperate to get media attention on their title in the very first appointment of the very first day. They were so worried every time I died, asking me if I needed to turn down the difficulty, deathly afraid I was going to saunter over to the media room and lambast the game for my many deaths during a half-hour demo. And some part of me wonders, playing the final game, is past-me the reason for the annoyances current-me has with an otherwise incredible action game?.

Diungkapkan bahwa âiâve got soul but iâm not a soldier. â.

The feel is incredible, combat is intense, the game is content-packed, some of the boss fights are among the best Iâve ever seen.

Way too easy to miss quests and items, some gimmick bosses just donât work, Iâm conflicted on the way standard enemy encounter design functions, story is frustratingly told.

Sebagaimana diketahui, 65 hours. Despite missing a few quests, finished every side quest and got the True Ending. Thereâs a âsecond cycleâ plus game for the real sickos.

Sebagaimana diketahui, phantom blade zero is an action game that is more 3d ninja gaiden than soulslike, though it absorbs and molds some soulslike traditions and mechanics to varying degrees of success. The core act of pressing buttons to attack, parry, and dodge feels immaculately wonderful, especially given that the premise demands you do all those things at once. Where Phantom Blade differs from, say, a Sekiro or Onimusha: Way of the Sword is in the way it expectsânay, demandsâthat you throw the traditional notion of balancing attack and defense out the window. As a multitude of combat scenarios, Phantom Blade is an unqualified success. Phantom Blade will occasionally present enemies that attack you utterly relentlessly, with literally only frames of breathing room between flurries.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the solution is not one of timing, but of boldness. The game isnât trying to force you to find the right opportunity; it wants you to keep parrying or keep the block button held down and also attack or dodge as the situation demands. Trusting that protagonist Soul can handle this is the first major difficulty spike to overcome, because it does not feel at all like something you should be able to do, and morphs into the only way you can perceive playing action games by the end of your journey.

Diungkapkan bahwa you might be tempted to take that as an exaggeration, but i insist that itâs not. Once Phantom Blade Zeroâs everything-all-at-once combat clicked for me, it genuinely felt like I was going to have trouble going back to melee systems that do not require beckoning the icy touch of arthritis at a young age. It is not particularly deepâyou pretty much learn to tap the parry button with a constant rhythm and time the bigger hits for combat advantages and dopamine releaseâbut it feels exciting and active. If Phantom Blade ZeroÂ was only going to nail one thing, itâs an overwhelmingly good thing the game nailed this.

Berdasarkan laporan, one thing that phantom blade zeroâ does not nail, however, is the story. The narrative has the unfortunate combination of being both overbearing and incomprehensible for much of its dozens of hours, throwing a tome of unexplained proper nouns at you so large that it would make Final Fantasy XIIIâs opening hours blush.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the genre is no stranger to bad or underexplained stories; it might even be argued that the disposable narratives are part and parcel of excellent character action. It does not treat its narrative or worldbuilding as something that most players will discard and ignore. But Phantom Blade Zero is not that. For whatever reason, S-Game has decided that the story in this title must be omnipresent and decidedly interruptive, littering the game with cutscenes, lore scrolls, collectibles of magic audio logs, and pages and pages of descriptions of weapons and enemies.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i do not wish to turn my nose up at this out of hand. A strong story can and should enhance a game, but I cannot overemphasize how spitefully Phantom Blade tells its story in its early hours. It is borderline frustrating how little the game tells you of what any of the names and terms the dialogue is constantly throwing around actually mean. It was dozens of hours before I grasped what was going on in the story, a timeframe not aided by the fact that its writers insist on forcing it to unfold like a mystery. Poring over the logs of enemies to understand who it was I was just fighting and what relationship they had to the act of Transcension, or the organization of the Order, or maybe itâs the Mandate, or perhaps he was with the Thread-Binding Sect, or the Baishan Sect, or maybe Iâm just going to go take a nap because this is too much, it all ended up just making me feel like I came into a movie midway through and everyone is having a good time but me.

When I did eventually wrap my mind around the ongoing plot, I enjoyed learning about the various ways the world had essentially ended, though it took me a long time to understand if it had happened a hundred years ago, or one year ago, or was currently happening, and it was not worth the miles the game dragged my captive and ignorant ass across to get there.

That the gameâs story has a climax that breaks down major revelations in a 20-minute Chinese Opera performed with shadow puppets leaves me scratching my head over whether I should be applauding the ambition or tut-tutting the sledgehammer taken to the pacing, but either way I was not having a good time.

Berdasarkan laporan, the story may be burdensome, but it is not what iâm thinking about when fighting the gameâs copious amount of bosses. There are boss fights that I can truthfully say are among the best Iâve seen in an action game, both in terms of gameplay and aesthetics. One such example is the consummate rival fight, where Soul defends himself against his former student and her two bodyguards. Soul steps into a new boss fight every few feet, often for spurious narrative reasons, and the quality of these fights varies wildly, with some extreme high points and some unfortunate low points. The battle is a pitch-perfect realization of proper escalation, with you fighting the boss in a clash of swords, then tackling a second phase in which she transforms into a pugilist with fists of iron, and finally taking on all three enemies at once while the sun sets in the background and the slow piano music adds more instruments and intensity.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there are some gimmick fights that try to play with the mechanics and force you to act in different ways that mostly donât work. One fight tries to punish you for parrying, another only lets you damage the enemy after parrying certain attacks, and the novelty of these battles wears off when youâre midway through their large HP bars and realize you still have half a fight left to go. Thankfully, the good boss encounters greatly outnumber these, but they do make you feel a bit like you just slammed face-first into a tunnel painted onto the side of a wall.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one boss fight has soul taking on a troupe of lion dancers who spit fire and, midway through the encounter, the head lion dancer dances on some poles across the arena while he and soul fling fireballs at each other as soul gets up on his own set of dancing poles. Itâs a really smart way to break up the boss fight, but I also feel like it would not have needed to break up the boss fight if it werenât so long and the effort to chip away HP so arduous.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, structurally, phantom blade has soul running through various environments with numerous branching paths at every turn and a smattering of enemies along the way. This means that combat with minor enemies is never an insurmountable obstacle; definitionally, it cannot be. These enemies arenât meant to be overly difficult and nothing bears that out more obviously than the fact that, when one is defeated, they stay defeated. Encounters are not puzzles for you to solve; you just throw Soul at them, defeating one member of the group and then having an easier time the next time you arrive at full health. Considering thereâs no punishment for death, this design choice feels like it boils the game down to an exploratory boss rush with some enemies hanging around between them, just to keep you pressing buttons.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, thatâs not to say youâll never have a problem with a standard enemy, but that ultimately those problems do not really matter. Given enough time, enemies are merely rocks being shaped by erosion, and you are the wind sending waves to crash against them. Maybe that makes the game easier for some, but itâs a design decision that inherently feels like it robs you of stakes that would have otherwise been interesting.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, iâve gone back and forth on whether the permanently despawned enemies make for a good idea or not. On one hand, it does make much of the encounter design feel like a conveyer belt with no sense that I was overcoming obstacles. It would be beyond wearisome to have to search for the gameâs optional areas and collectibles while fighting through the respawning enemies. But flipping a switch to change that one thing would not work with the rest of the game as itâs currently designed. Phantom Blade doesnât have many Soulslike runbacks to bosses, but those that exist would become significantly more aggravating if you had to burn a heal on the way thanks to an overly aggressive enemy swiping at you from offscreen.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, toward the end of the game, this does change, though perhaps the pendulum swings a little too far the other way as enemies with tediously large health pools and hyperaggressive attack patterns become significantly more common. While I would have liked a more considered sense of balance in the encounter design throughout, I prefer the back half, where the game offers a bit more bite, to its early sections which hand-wave you through.

Diungkapkan bahwa the number of optional paths in the game is truly worthy of awe. Within the first half hour, youâre given a side quest that wonât t resolve until near the end of the game, you may encounter an optional boss thatâll slice Soul in half in a single hit with verbal warnings to come back later, and you can pick up another side quest to find a flower for a girl that ends up taking you multiple chapters to fully suss out. No one can accuse Phantom Blade Zero of not playing the long game, and I think that aspect on its own both feels cool and aids in making the quests feel like part of a journey.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but as with many things this game does, it sometimes feels like the cool aspects are simply giving s-game permission to do something extremely annoying on the other side of them. In the case of side quests, Phantom Blade revels in having missable objectives that can end up fully locking you out of things you might have wanted to see, up to and including the self-titled True Ending. It doesnât take much to miss a quest, either through progressing a little too far without reaching a satisfactory movement point in the questline, answering with the wrong dialogue choices, defeating a boss you werenât supposed to, or in one case, not talking to NPCs before picking up an item.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sometimes you get a warning about this happening and maybe only have yourself to blame, but many times you do not. In a breezy action game that youâll be running through multiple times, I can get the desire to cheekily tell the player, too bad, try again on the next cycle! But motherfucker, this game is at least 50 hours long on a casual initial playthrough. If I miss a side quest, I am done. It might as well not exist at that point. This is the kind of game where youâll have to consult a guide at the beginning of every chapter and follow it thoroughly if you want to see everything, or just make peace with the fact that you just wonât see it all.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one aspect of phantom blade that deserves calling out is the gameâs soundtrack, which is largely quiet and ambient, but occasionally comes roaring out of its self-contained cage to be a special kind of weird. Hip-hop, throat-singing, dubstep, rock guitar, Chinese opera, all of these coalesce into something more interesting like youâre listening to the most eclectic random-order playlist you can find, yet it all works together and fits. Sometimes a song will grate on you after youâve tried a boss for the 20th time, but it certainly never stops being inventive.

Sebagaimana diketahui, itâs rare to be as conflicted with a game as i am with phantom blade zero. It is, on paper, exactly what most character action fans would want, but there are just a few choices it makes where I wish someone had shaken the person in charge of making that decision and set them straight, and I canât help but let those things gnaw at me. There are several ways in which this game defies any kind of score I could give it, so Iâm left with just a swirling feeling that we âmerelyâ got a fantastic game with some decisions I think could be changed to create an even better one.

Pioner seemed headed in the right direction when it went into early access in late 2025, but it all went wrong just a few months later.

Diungkapkan bahwa when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Diungkapkan bahwa pioner, a survival-shooter we said looked like "stalker and tarkov's alien baby" when we first laid eyes on it in 2021, is ending development and closing down. In an announcement posted today on Steam, developer GFAGames said further work on the game and continued operation of its servers requires more money, and it just doesn't have any.

"Over the past few months, we have been in talks with existing and potential partners about investment and new ways of working together that would allow us to preserve the project and the team," the studio wrote.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we were unable to agree on the funding needed to continue the project. The studio no longer has sufficient funds of its own to continue development and keep the servers running. ".

Pioner looked promising when it turned up at the PC Gaming Show in 2021: A mash-up of Stalker, Metro, and Escape From Tarkov that featured both a singleplayer campaign and online co-op and PvP survival action, all of it built around late Soviet-era technology.

It launched into early access in December 2025 and worked its way to a peak concurrent player count of 1,686 on Steam a few months later—not huge, but far from catastrophic, and trending in the right direction.

Sebagaimana diketahui, those numbers tailed off badly over the summer, though, as the dev team struggled with technical issues and updates came at a much slower pace than promised. August saw player counts collapse almost completely, and by mid-September only a couple dozen people were still playing.

Diungkapkan bahwa numerous replies to the shutdown announcement call for refunds to be issued, but gfagames hasn't commented on those demands at this point. It also hasn't said when the game will actually be taken offline—I've reached out to ask and will update if I receive a reply.

#762. Cities: Skylines 2 goes free-to-play, but only for a limited time

📅 13 Nov 2026

Cities: Skylines 2 goes free-to-play, but only for a limited time

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/cities-skylines-2-goes-free-to-play-but-only-for-a-limited-time/

Diungkapkan bahwa cities: skylines 2, paradox interactive’s ambitious follow-up to one of the best city builders of all time, has gone free-to-play. However, this will only apply for this weekend, with the event closing in the afternoon hours of Nov. 16.

Berdasarkan laporan, the free-to-play model has more than doubled the game’s concurrent player count, bumping it from about 8,000 to over 16,000, according to steamdb. People seem genuinely interested in checking the game out, though its less-than-stellar reviews and horrible reputation still seem to impact players’ willingness to actually spend any money on it, despite numerous discounts.

Speaking of which, Cities: Skylines 2 is also 30 percent off, or more if you go for the bundle and already own the original.

Berdasarkan laporan, ever since its original creators, colossal order, gave the game up to paradox interactive and iceflake studios, the game has gradually improved in overall quality. Things are undoubtedly moving at a snail’s pace, with Iceflake doing as much as it possibly can to salvage the title and reclaim some of that lost trust from the players. Despite their best efforts and, of course, several DLC releases, Cities: Skylines 2 still has a “mixed” rating on Steam, meaning it cannot be featured on the store’s front page or get any of that juicy free exposure from Valve.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the recent reviews fare much better, though. With 72 percent of those being positive, Cities 2 thus holds a “mostly positive” rating in this category, but players still have a lot of bones to pick with the game’s many systems, namely traffic and simulation, whereby bugs and issues that’ve been there from the start remain in the game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i, for one, was extremely excited to get into cities 2 ahead of its original release in 2023. The original Cities: Skylines is one of my favorite games of all time, and certainly my favorite city builder, and its sequel promised to up the ante on so many different levels. I was chiefly enamored by how detailed the new assets were in Cities 2, how big everything was, and how that would allow me to zoom in and see the minutiae from up close, but my hype evaporated once I got my hands on it.

The jank was unbearable, and the faulty simulation meant the game lied to you all the time, feeding you false information to make it seem like simulation was happening when, in fact, it was all fake.

Iceflake has since fixed many of these issues, and I will definitely be revisiting the game in the coming days.

#766. New York City, Mayor Mamdani to host youth game dev contest to help boost local game industry growth

📅 13 Nov 2026

New York City, Mayor Mamdani to host youth game dev contest to help boost local game industry growth

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/nyc-mayor-mamdani-to-host-game-dev-contest-game-industry-growth/

The home locale of Rockstar Games’ corporate headquarters is trying to invest in further game development locally, thanks in large part to a certain popular mayor and his office.

Berdasarkan laporan, today, new york city and mayor zohran mamdani announced nyc game jam, a two-day youth competition for game development in which young new yorkers “design and build a video game around a set theme,” according to a report by variety. It will take place this weekend.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but don’t expect a return to liberty city here. The competition’s theme is “Get There Already,” focused on the city’s transit, and according to the Mayor’s Office of Media and Entertainment, “participants will build a game about getting across the city” and “every game must be about transit or the experience of getting around a city, suitable for all ages, and free of violence, weapons, and other illicit activity. ” No grand theft here.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the office also said that nyc’s gaming sector lists “about 7,900 jobs across approximately 380 firms and generates $2. 6 billion in annual economic impact,” so this competition is an effort to continue that trend and keep games being developed in the city.

Diungkapkan bahwa “whether you’re exploring the forests of hyrule or riding across the frontier at nuevo paraíso, video games invite us into worlds born from the imagination of their designers. “As the industry grows, we want to make sure the next generation of game developers and designers can build their futures right here at home. And that creativity represents an enormous opportunity here in New York City,” Mamdani said. This Game Jam is a chance to open the door to that industry for young New Yorkers, connect them with the people shaping it, and give them the tools and support to turn their biggest ideas into careers. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, a panel of industry veterans will select three finalists in the contest, with first place winning $3,000, second place $1,500, and third place $500, with the winnings to be split amongst all members of the game-making teams. It’s unclear if generative AI will be allowed in the contest.

Berdasarkan laporan, as a native new yorker, this excites me. I’d love more studios to work out of Manhattan rather than California, selfishly, because it’s less travel for me.

#768. Strategy RPG Guild Saga: Vanished Worlds coming to PS5 in May 2027

📅 13 Nov 2026

Strategy RPG Guild Saga: Vanished Worlds coming to PS5 in May 2027

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.gematsu.com/2026/11/strategy-rpg-guild-saga-vanished-worlds-coming-to-ps5-in-may-2027

Ontario-based developer Ocelot Technologies will release strategy RPG Guild Saga: Vanished Worlds for PlayStation 5 alongside its full release for PC via Steam in May 2027, the developer announced.

Guild Saga: Vanished Worlds first launched in Early Access for PC on October 10, 2024.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “we’ve been very happy with how much our audience has embraced guild saga: vanished worlds throughout its early access era, but we’ve always dreamt of bringing it to consoles, where our love of the genre first began,” said ocelot technologies ceo mike in a press release. “PlayStation is the perfect place for Guild Saga, as we were massively inspired by the JRPGs that have long made PlayStation such a titan in the industry. Having it available on [PlayStation 5] feels like a homecoming, so we can’t wait for PlayStation fans to set sail to the Respite Archipelago in May!”.

Here is an overview of the game, via lead developer Yasser Saleem on PlayStation Blog:.

Create your hero’s appearance and choose their background, talents, and skills.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we wanted character building to leave room for creativity and experimentation. The progression system lets you combine skills across disciplines freely, as opposed to a more rigid class system. Skills let you deal damage, heal allies, change the environment, reposition across the battlefield, summon creatures, and alter the turn sequence. With hundreds of items, you can shape both your character’s build and their appearance, choosing gear that suits your playstyle and the look you want.

Diungkapkan bahwa your companions offer more opportunities to shape the party. Each brings a distinct history and personal quests, while their equipment, abilities, and attributes can be completely customized.

Sebagaimana diketahui, through dialogue and shared experiences, you’ll discover more about the companions you choose to bring along. Friendships and romance can become part of your journey, giving you connections to your party members beyond the battlefield.

Berdasarkan laporan, guild saga: vanished worlds features tactical turn-based combat with approximately 200 skills across ten disciplines. Express your tactical creativity by exploring how skills across different schools work together and with the environment around you.

Diungkapkan bahwa surface interactions and weather are an important consideration in combat. Players will need to be mindful of how surfaces interact, how weather affects the battle, and how those conditions might alter their skills.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for example, a party member with points invested in geomancer may summon a mandrake to join the fight. Across three disciplines, you’ve summoned an ally, strengthened it through the weather, and turned the resulting surfaces into a tactical advantage. A companion with Hydromancer skills can then make it rain, watering the mandrake and causing it to grow into a more formidable force. A party member with Aeromancer skills may then use lightning to electrify the puddles, paralyzing anyone standing in them. We want players to discover combinations like this and experiment with how their party’s abilities work together.

Sebagaimana diketahui, preparation matters too. Looting, mining, and gathering herbs provide materials you can craft into weapons, equipment, arrows, potions, and food. Whether you’re replenishing supplies or crafting new gear for a companion, taking time to explore and gather resources can help your party prepare for the next battle.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when designing exploration, we wanted players to feel that taking their time could lead to something worth finding. The main quest gives your journey direction, but the islands also invite you to wander, speak to NPCs, and investigate what catches your attention.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you might find yourself solving a murder mystery, hunting feared monsters for bounty money, or settling a deadly dispute between farm animals. Elsewhere, you can follow the imagination of a famed explorer or uncover an alchemical conspiracy. These side quests give you reasons to get to know the archipelago’s inhabitants and become involved in their troubles, whether sinister, strange, or absurd.

Berdasarkan laporan, we wanted that variety to make following a new lead feel exciting. A conversation that seems like a small diversion can draw you into a story with its own characters, conflicts, and discoveries. Taking a detour is an opportunity to experience another side of the world and the people inhabiting it.

Berdasarkan laporan, hidden treasures, puzzles, valuable crafting resources, and unexpected encounters also reward exploration. Ancient books and forgotten notes offer glimpses into the world’s past, giving curious players more to uncover along the way.

Berdasarkan laporan, we’re looking forward to welcoming playstation players into guild saga: vanished worlds when it launches on playstation 5 in may 2027. We’ll share the exact release date closer to launch.

As we get ready to wrap up the working week here at Pure Xbox, we wanted to alert you to a couple of new updates that have been pushed out in recent days - one for Xbox consoles in general, and another specifically for GTA 6.

The Xbox console update was actually released on Wednesday, but nobody made a song and dance about it whatsoever, while the patch notes only referenced "general stability and performance improvements".

However, we now know that the update was related to the addition of achievements in four original Xbox games, and unless you download the update, you won't be able to see those achievements right now.

There's a chance your console may have downloaded this automatically but to check, go to "Settings", "System", "Updates" and then see if there's an update waiting to be downloaded or not.

#770. Nintendo's On The Hunt For A Digital Archivist To Preserve Its Rich History

📅 13 Nov 2026

Nintendo's On The Hunt For A Digital Archivist To Preserve Its Rich History

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2026/11/nintendos-on-the-hunt-for-a-digital-archivist-to-preserve-its-rich-history

Sebagaimana diketahui, with closing online storefronts, the move to digital media and the rise of streaming, there are few gaming industry topics more discussed right now than preservation. Fortunately, it looks like Nintendo is making an effort to ensure that its history doesn't get lost to time (thanks, Time Extension).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nintendo of america is currently hiring a digital archivist to "support the preservation, organization, and accessibility of historical hardware and software information," according to the job description. In short, this person would be responsible for ensuring that all things Nintendo are kept safely stored away and easily accessible.

Berdasarkan laporan, we're sure that there are a few of you lovely lot reading whose brains are already like a nintendo archive, and it certainly sounds like the job comes with its fair share of perks. The chosen applicant will surely have unrivalled access to Nintendo's historical records, get the chance to "Interview subject matter experts and long-tenured employees to capture institutional knowledge," and organise one of the richest histories in gaming. Damn, and there we were getting a kick out of putting our important paperwork into colour-coded binders.

What's extra cool is that this will be the person responsible for finding and dishing out these records to anyone at Nintendo for future use — you know, for when someone comes asking who that moustachioed fella in the denim overalls is.

Berdasarkan laporan, of course, the job comes with a huge amount of technicalities, too. The listing requires "Experience developing metadata structures, taxonomies, classification systems, or naming conventions," is looking for someone familiar with "metadata and archival standards such as Dublin Core, DACS, EAD, PREMIS, MODS, or similar frameworks," and has at least two years of previous work in Records, Metadata, Knowledge, or Digital asset management. In short, it isn't for any old Joe.

But hey, what an opportunity! This is a 12-month contract based out of Redmond, WA, and it will presumably result in Nintendo's 100+ year history living on for many more to come.

If you think this one might be for you, you'll find even more about the job in the official listing.

Feature The Nintendo Museum Goes Hard On Merch & Fun, But Could Dive Deeper Into History.

The developers at Collision Games are offering $5,000 USD toward the divorce (or wedding!) of the first person who can beat their love lock-picking game, Love Locks. Â.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the rules are simple. Register your email and SteamID; then, when the game launches on December 3rd, be the fastest to unlock 100,000 love locks that have been plastered across a bridge in Paris, making this perfect for speedrunners looking to make a…quick buck. Players will have all kinds of tools at their disposal including bolt cutters and a drone they can use to go magnet-fishing for keys in the River Seine. The competition ends on December 10th, giving players roughly seven days to chew through all 100,000 of the game’s love locks.

Diungkapkan bahwa once the competition period ends, the devs will announce the winner, and they’ll have two years to send collision games a bill for an eligible wedding or divorce expense like buying a pretty dress or hiring an expensive lawyer (no, really). ‘The name’s Cullen. Edward Cullen’: Robert Pattinson reportedly top choice for next James Bond

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/robert-pattinson-rumored-as-the-next-bond/

It'll be exciting to see how he pulls it off if selected.

Diungkapkan bahwa bond. James Bond. Sharp, striking, piercing your chest as soon as they are uttered. Two syllables. Two words. They mean a lot to many, and every so often they are thrown into the ether, like a phonetic parasite seeking their next host. Who will carry them for the next year, two, five, a decade? A hard question to answer.

Berdasarkan laporan, but according to a new rumor, robert pattinson is the top choice to embody ian fleming’s womanizer spy, with amazon mgm reportedly considering him their favorite for the role. As first reported by Matthew Belloni in Puck (via The Guardian), Pattinson was given “favorable contract terms” to play this legendary character, which would see him star in three movies rather than the four expected of other candidates. The actor would also be paid significantly more, which signals how keen Amazon MGM is to get his face and name associated with the brand and character.

Read what’s behind the latest news in gaming (with a bit of snark) by subscribing to the Destructoid Checkpoint newsletter!.

Berdasarkan laporan, previously, it was claimed callum turner was in the running for bond going forward, according to deadline, with jack lowden and josh o’connor also putting themselves up. That outlet did say four offers were sent out but managed to confirm just these three, and it would appear now that Pattinson was the ultimate contender.

Diungkapkan bahwa now, if you asked me, i’d say turner was, at least in terms of physical appearance and stature (which, of course, is almost just as important as actual acting skills for a character like james bond) suits the character much more than pattinson. The latter practically kills every role involving strange, mysterious, and at times evidently neurodivergent characters, and while he did nail the strong, silent stoic in 2022’s The Batman, I still fail to see how he could handle a highly sexualized, outgoing, womanizer Bond.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, daniel craig’s bond was markedly different than what we were used to. He had a lot more depth and a broad, emotionally charged backstory that fundamentally altered how he behaved. The core tenets of the character remained intact, though Craig did give them somewhat of a sociopathic tone.

How Pattinson will play the character and what flair he will end up giving him remains to be seen, but I’m confident enough in his acting skills to believe just enough that he can actually pull it off.

Diungkapkan bahwa grace ashcroft, the freshly minted protagonist of resident evil requiem, has all the makings of a great video game scream queen. She overcomes immense adversity even while suffering a severe anxiety condition and she's the new face of one of the most iconic franchises in horror gaming. Capcom has yet to outright confirm she'll return in future Resident Evil games, but the actor who portrays her seems to think she will.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, grace actor angela sant'albano recently took home the golden joystick award for best lead performer, and with resident evil requiem having won ultimate game of the year, it was a big night for the actor. We caught up with her during the event, and she shared her hopes for the future of Grace Ashcroft.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i would really love to see how her relationship with leon blossoms," sant'albano tells us. " Sant'Albano says she's developed a close friendship with Emily actor Emma Rose, and she wants to see Grace take on "a more maternal role and see how she carries that forward. And I also want to know what happens with her and Emily. "I think we have a beautiful mentorship, almost brotherly, sisterly relationship brewing. ".

Throughout the absolute nightmare that Grace endures through Resident Evil Requiem, she evolves from a state of anxiety-induced paralysis to having just enough confidence to shakily defend herself with a gun, and Sant'Albano is looking forward to seeing her reach her full potential, even if she'll never be an action hero like Leon Kennedy.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i don't think she'll ever be a leon character. "But I do think her courage and her self-esteem will grow the more that she trusts herself and forgives herself for a lot of the things that I think tie her down. So I think there's a long way to go with her. She's never going to be badass, you know, doing roundhouse kicks," she says. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa resident evil veronica, a remake of code veronica, is the next big resident evil game to come after requiem, and i think it's safe to say we won't see any grace ashcroft. Capcom has yet to reveal the next mainline installment, but after Sant'Albano's win at the Golden Joysticks, I think I can speak for Resident Evil fans everywhere when I say she's a fan-favorite to return in later entries.

The Last of Us inspired Resident Evil 7's course correction because the devs "wanted the critical acclaim other games were garnering," ex-Capcom senior dev says.

Spider-Man 2 And A Bunch Of Other Great Games Are About To Look Even Better On Base PS5

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, spider-man 2‘s dazzling cityscapes are about to be even more breathtaking. It’s one of several games that are adding support for Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR), Sony’s new AI upscaling tech for improving resolution on base PS5.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s essentially a weaker version of the pssr upscaling used on ps5 pro to boost image quality even at higher framerates. Ghost of Yotei and Marvel’s Wolverine were the first games to support QSSR when it was revealed back in early October. Now the following games have been added to the list and will be rolling out support throughout the rest of 2026:.

Diungkapkan bahwa remedy entertainment graphics programmer erik jansson said qssr creates a more stable and detailed image. “We can deliver increased sharpness, better environmental clarity and overall visual improvements to even more PlayStation players,” said Embark Studios technical director Mikael Linderholm.

Berdasarkan laporan, some players might hurt themselves squinting to see the differences, even in side-by-side comparisons, but it’s still cool to see the six-year-old ps5 being able to deliver improved graphics without any actual hardware changes. QSSR grew out of Sony’s collaboration with AMD called Project Amethyst. Hopefully it leads to more post-processing improvements in the future, and ones that more games are able to take advantage of without too much extra work.

#777. Mini Review: Sonic Pico Park (Switch) - Charming Puzzle-Platformer Returns With A Nostalgic Co-Op Collab

📅 13 Nov 2026

Mini Review: Sonic Pico Park (Switch) - Charming Puzzle-Platformer Returns With A Nostalgic Co-Op Collab

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/switch-eshop/sonic-pico-park

Berdasarkan laporan, pico park is a fascinating success story for developer shunsuke miyake, who created the original game over a decade ago while working at sega. A cute, minimalist and deceptively challenging puzzler, it exploded in popularity with the introduction of online co-op and a feature-packed sequel that was released on Switch in 2024.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this new spin-off takes the escalating challenge of multiple puzzle modes and invites sonic and his ever-expanding menagerie of friends to the party. Available on both Switch 1 and 2, Sonic Pico Park takes the core mechanics of Pico Park and adds a suite of design features from the Blue Blur's 16-bit heyday.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, challenges range from effortless, like walking forward and pressing a button, to lateral conundrums involving spikes and insta-kill barriers. Other mechanics offer slightly taxing fun, especially anything that requires the party to be tethered together. Then there are the absolutely punishing experiences that will have you yelling at each other or laughing your heads off (sometimes both).

Diungkapkan bahwa three distinct modes offer a balanced spread of co-operative and adversarial challenges. World Mode separates 15 distinct puzzle scenarios into four stages of increasing difficulty. Battle pits teams against each other to collect the most rings. Endless has you run a gauntlet, trying to last the longest without making a mistake.

Berdasarkan laporan, all of this is livened up by the inclusion of sonic and pals, with some nicely presented nostalgia to help ring (pun intended) in his 35th anniversary. The series' iconic rings form the basis of Battle mode while also adding an extra mechanic to certain puzzles that require precise calculation of invincibility frames. All of the series' characters are selectable, with a couple specifically tuned for large-character puzzles, like Big the Cat. Elsewhere, there's a pinball minigame and a top-down version of the Sonic 2 bonus stage.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's a great game to play on the go, although you will need others, because there is no solo play available. Its bright colours and visually sparse stages are complemented by simple controls well suited to the Joy-Con. There's also something deeply satisfying about hearing those classic Sega sound effects coming out of the undocked speakers.

Sonic Pico Park is a good little game for multiple players to have fun with, and it more than caters for Sonic fans looking for yet another nostalgia fix.

#778. 'We Want to Create Franchises That Withstand Decades': Sony Reveals Ambition to Dominate Anime

📅 13 Nov 2026

'We Want to Create Franchises That Withstand Decades': Sony Reveals Ambition to Dominate Anime

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/11/we-want-to-create-franchises-that-withstand-decades-sony-reveals-ambition-to-dominate-anime

Sony’s gradual transition from consumer electronics to entertainment giant is paying dividends, as the firm’s value continues to rise on the back of hits like Spider-Man: Brand New Day and the overall PlayStation business.

But the manufacturer has one big ambition that will bring all its divisions together: anime.

Diungkapkan bahwa a big bloomberg report, focusing on subsidiary aniplex’s boss atsuhiro iwakami, shed some light on the firm’s strategy. It’s moving aggressively to dominate an industry that’s booming in popularity worldwide.

Iwakami points to Demon’s Slayer as justification for its approach.

Sebagaimana diketahui, its first movie, 2020’s mugen soul, dethroned spirited away to become japan’s highest-grossing film. Its successor, 2025’s Infinity Castle, went on to gross almost $1 billion worldwide.

Iwakami’s goal is simple: to find or create the next One Piece, a franchise that could become the centrepiece of its entertainment division for potentially decades to come.

As the article points out, anime unifies all of Sony’s divisions in an unprecedented way: content can be created by Aniplex, distributed by Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures, promoted by PlayStation (where there’s an inherent overlap in audiences), and even supported by Sony Music (anime theme songs et al are wildly popular).

To support its ambitions, the company has become one of the biggest investors in light novel powerhouse Kadokawa, and Iwakami admits it would invest in sector stalwart Shueisha as well should the opportunity arise.

But original content will be foundational to Sony moving forwards, as it faces aggressive competition from Netflix and Disney, both of which are competing for content in the wake of the anime boom.

Sony ultimately wants a franchise it owns outright, where it can control all merchandise sales and more.

Diungkapkan bahwa it recently founded a new studio, hayate, as part of a joint collaboration between aniplex and crunchyroll. Its remit is to create original anime for a global audience.

Next year, Sony will add an anime tab to the PS5’s homepage, giving it another opportunity to promote its content to players around the world.

I’m particularly interested to see if PS Studios is eventually recruited to create original games based on some of these properties, and how it approaches those.

Obviously, if the goal is to create franchises that reach as many people worldwide as possible, then exclusivity may not necessarily be the play here.

Diungkapkan bahwa but while sony already has a strong foot in the door, it admits it’s still at the start of its strategy right now. It’s going to be interesting to see how things evolve over the coming years.

#780. Cities: Skylines' Best Replacement Is Finally Here and Better than Expected

📅 13 Nov 2026

Cities: Skylines' Best Replacement Is Finally Here and Better than Expected

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/transport-fever-3-logistics-city-builder-game/

Transport Fever 3 turned me into a logistics nerd.

Transport Fever 3 turned me into a logistics nerd.

Diungkapkan bahwa 2026 is the year i got massively into city builders, and by massively i mean i played cities: skylines more than anything else for the first half of the year. When I first learned about Transport Fever 3, I called it "like" Cities: Skylines. It looked a lot like a traditional city builder, albeit one where you focus on roads more than zoning. I started dabbling with city builder-slash-logistics games in the second half of the year, like Anno 117, and turned my attention to Transport Fever 3 soon after. After playing it over the last month or so, though, I realize the difference between city builder and logistics planner is a lot more distinct than I initially gave it credit for — and I've irreversibly become a logistics sicko.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the first thing you do in cities: skylines is build a road, and then you start earmarking plots of land for residential and commercial zoning. The biggest logistics puzzles you end up solving involve road improvements, or more accurately, managing traffic as your city gets bigger. It's a design and aesthetics challenge more than anything, though. In the struggle to make roads big enough to handle the needs of a growing city, keeping things from looking like a dystopian hellscape is more important than optimizing traffic flow. Well, for me it is anyway, but the game's comparatively lax management requirements let personal preference prevail over logistical needs.

Diungkapkan bahwa not so with transport fever 3. The first task is creating a small network of transport lines to support consumer travel and industrial growth. Most resource nodes exist on map tiles outside your main metro area anyway, so you can just position any old road how you’d like and go on about your business. Then you encourage new industry by making more lines that connect resource deposits with processing facilities in, or near, the town. Once you have the money, you just construct the necessary buildings as close to the resource as possible and make sure there's a road that can link them back to the main city for deliveries. This small-but-important difference captured me instantly. Planning industries in Cities usually takes little foresight. Here, you start with a small town and a burgeoning transport company. Or you can just ignore industry entirely and turn your town into a strip mall paradise.

Berdasarkan laporan, but the goal in transport fever 3 is to grow the existing town, and it won't grow without industry. Opting for a country road influences the kind of residential areas that will populate along it and makes it easier to create neighborhood-like areas, for example, as opposed to having homes just pop up inconveniently on a standard road. Country roads aren't suitable for all types of travel, though, so you have to find alternative solutions to ensure the people living there have access to all the goods and transportation methods they need. More people need more food, more places to work, and more ways to get to work, ideally on time and without being crammed on a tiny coach ill-adapted for the purpose. You find places suitable for residential building and industry like in Cities, but it all builds up based on roads and road types, which gives you more control over how everything develops and more challenges to solve. Multiply those considerations for every new residential and commercial area, imagine designing a functional and aesthetically pleasing infrastructure network to accommodate them, and you've got an idea of how this game works.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there are a slew of other considerations to deal with, too. Trains are wonderful for moving goods and people, but require special production chains in place to operate, which puts another burden on your local infrastructure. Terrain gradient determines the type of road you need — and now much it'll cost to maintain — so freight vehicles don't get stuck. That's true for pretty much every transport improvement. It makes one area easier, but requires a lot more planning and work to keep others from spiraling out of control.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's all comparatively easy to maintain when settlements are smaller, and in sandbox mode, the game doesn't punish you for keeping things small. Heck, you can have a bunch of mid-sized towns connected via water transport and airports if you want. As long as your business isn't bankrupt, you're winning. But once your town grows into a city with multiple districts, managing everything is a nested stack of challenges that just gets more complex as time passes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

Berdasarkan laporan, which, it turns out, is exactly what i want. I frequently find myself speeding up the simulation in Cities until some disaster or other requires my direct intervention. It's very passive once you get to a certain point, where improvements are additive and routine. I certainly still enjoy designing a huge city and seeing the results of my planning pay off, but I miss the hands-on requirements of early city building. That hands-off feeling never disappears in Transport Fever 3. Make a new district, zone it like the last one — or, how about this for excitement, get a bit wild and invert the zoning swatches — connect the roads, add more power and water, proceed like before. It's a never-ending puzzle that captured me and won't let me go, and I couldn't be happier about it.

Combolands: Roguelike Citybuilder has one heck of a foundation.

#781. Ads are coming to Xbox Cloud Gaming, and an executive thinks this is the only way to avoid ‘dramatic’ price increases in the industry

📅 13 Nov 2026

Ads are coming to Xbox Cloud Gaming, and an executive thinks this is the only way to avoid ‘dramatic’ price increases in the industry

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.destructoid.com/xbox-cloud-gaming-ads/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, advertisements in subscription services are nothing new. Netflix, Amazon, and every other company out there has some sort of ad-supported tier, which is often way cheaper or even entirely free depending on the service and how aggressive the ads are. However, gaming is a different beast, and we companies haven’t found ways to implement them outside the mobile space, where they remain on a quid-pro-quo basis anyway.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but that is slowly changing with the prevalence of subscriptions, and xbox cloud gaming has just received an ad-based free edition players can hop onto without paying a single dime. Xbox Cloud Gaming has long been in decline and probably quite expensive for Microsoft to run and sustain, which led to time limits implemented across every Game Pass tier. With ads, things could turn the tide on Microsoft’s cloud gaming service and, according to Xbox general manager Jonathan Stringfield, potentially avert inevitable price hikes throughout the industry.

Read what’s behind the latest news in gaming (with a bit of snark) by subscribing to the Destructoid Checkpoint newsletter!.

Stringfield predicts that, in the coming years, the games industry will inevitably be faced with rising costs and sustainability issues, which will then produce “dramatic” results whereby the costs will be offloaded to the end-user.

Berdasarkan laporan, “either of two things need to happen if we want to stick with the model as it exists today: we either need to dramatically increase the price of games, which i don’t think would be terribly popular with folks, or we need to find other mechanisms to allow access,” stringfield said to games beat. One of these “other mechanisms” is, of course, ads.

“When we talk about advertising—and things that are adjacent to it that amount to recurrent revenue, whether it’s subscriptions or otherwise—what this allows for is an alternative,” he explained.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, stringfield prefaced these comments by saying advertising definitely cannot work in every game and probably not even every console or platform, and it isn’t necessarily going to be hammered into everything under the sun. However, they are to be viewed as a potential way to offset costs without extracting more money out of the end-user via higher prices. The very existence of premium platforms, and quite popular ones at that, whose sole stated purpose is to delete ads, does run counter to this somewhat.

Berdasarkan laporan, people are very obviously willing to pay not to see ads or be interrupted during their viewing or gaming, so it remains to be seen if or how advertisements can be used in gaming broadly, outside of the limited scope of ad-based subscription services. Maybe we will all end up on the cloud eventually (Sam Altman does seem keen on the idea) and thus be forced to watch ads and, like Sony’s patent says, even be made to stand up and scream the product’s name on the screen to be given the ability to continue.

Grim ideas, and I hope they never come true.

Berdasarkan laporan, writer. Joined the Robot Side in 2025. Been in the field for five years. Kojima enthusiast. English Major. Cormac McCarthy fan.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nintendo's official website for the zelda series has updated its entry for a link between worlds with a mysterious 'playable with nintendo switch online' icon, leading some to believe that it's a hint of an upcoming expansion to the paid service. However, we're not so sure.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the site is home to a series timeline, listing every mainline game from the nes original through to the ocarina of time remake. The likes of A Link to the Past, Link's Awakening and Oracle of Seasons are all marked with a 'Playable on NSO' button and, indeed, you can play all of them on the service. A Link Between Worlds has been locked to the 3DS since its launch back in 2013, however. Not only is it decidedly not playable on Nintendo Switch Online, but there isn't even a library for the console.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, there are just as many replies that seem to take a similarly cautious approach to us. You see, the button is missing on Oracle of Ages — a game that notably is on the NSO library — and none of the series' other DS games have any sign that they're playable, too. Hmm.

Berdasarkan laporan, we're chalking this one up to a simple mistake, then — we wouldn't be surprised to see the message removed soon enough. There have been rumblings of a dual-screen addition to the NSO library ever since we first learnt about the Switch 2's bonus USB-C port (remember those mock-ups for an extra screen add-on?), but it feels very unlikely we'd find out like this.

Ah well, back to our 3DS copies we go, then.

Diungkapkan bahwa today is friday the 13th, but let's not dwell on that. Here are some weekend video games to play. Well, actually, here are some of our biggest stories of the week, and then you can check out some weekend game recommendations.

Sebagaimana diketahui, also, go ahead and make some space on your xbox or playstation hard drive to make room for gtavi. Delete those games you're not going to return to. And you know what? Sebagaimana diketahui, calling all sickos of the rootrees are dead, return of the obra dinn, the incident at galley house, and everything in between: there’s another good deduction game to obsess over. You even keep track of information using a multi-function notebook à la The Roottrees Are Dead. Supernatural forces allow players to peer into the town’s past to learn about key people potentially responsible for the calamity, who they must identify by name, establish relationships between, and even match younger and older versions of themselves. Funeral for the Sun stars a historian who visits an abandoned Latin American town to piece together its turbulent history, chiefly the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of its hundreds of residents (who were, officially speaking, lost in a fire). Boasting an enticing story, a beautiful painterly art direction, and a tight runtime at roughly 8-hours (or less if you’re really on a roll), Funeral for the Sun is a mystery worth unraveling if you need a new deduction game to cozy up with.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, netease has continued to impress with the pace and quality of its regular updates to marvel rivals, which continues today with the release of an 11th season for the superhero battler. As is almost always the case right at a new hero’s launch, it can be hard to snag him on the roster on opening day to see how he plays, but once you do, I expect you’ll find him a versatile healer who can pretty dramatically shake up the battlefield, especially with his Ultimate, which basically consolidates allies and enemies together in one central clump for a frenzied exchange of blows. Right here at launch, the notable addition is he arrival of X-Men hero Nightcrawler, who BAMFs his way into battle as a strategist, equally capable of healing allies and taking out foes with his sword and brimstone bombs. Alongside the new batch of seasonal cosmetics and events to dive into, it’s once again a good time to don your hero outfit and take on some matches.

Berdasarkan laporan, pikmin 4 released on switch 2 this week (or upgraded to switch 2 depending on how you look at it), and that's a good thing. Pikmin 4 is the best game in the series and the Switch 2 version is the best version. That's great for those who never finished the game (your save does transfer) or skipped Pikmin 4 when it released in 2023, but if you're looking for an excuse to return to the game and play new content, the Dandori Academy addition is underwhelming. You can read my full thoughts here.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, metaphor: refantazio, originally released in 2024, is a great rpg from the creators of persona. And the Persona lineage is obvious throughout the full game. You have to pick and choose where and with whom you should be spending your time, all while a big world-saving RPG with a memorable party of characters plays out in the foreground.

Diungkapkan bahwa it released this week for switch 2 and it’s a game that i think would play well on a handheld device. It’s also just a good RPG to play if you missed it previously.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fun fact: metaphor: refantazio was the game we had lined up to be the next cover when we were temporarily shut down in in 2024. We went to the studio and had a cover drawn up and everything. You can read the full details of the cover story that never was right here.

You can also read Game Informer's review of Metaphor: ReFantazio by following the link.

Diungkapkan bahwa as we enjoy the final week in a pre-gta vi world, what better way to gird your loins for next week’s release, so to speak, than by revisiting the last adventures set in rockstar’s take on miami. 2002’s Grand Theft Auto: Vice City is a certified classic that, if you’ve never played it, offers nice foundational insight into what Vice City was like in the ’80s (spoiler: it was a lot like Scarface and Miami Vice). Best of all, Vice City is easily available on modern platforms and with modernized improvements to boot.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you want to go even further back, chronologically speaking, grand theft auto: vice city stories is a prequel set two years before the events of vice city. It’s unlikely, but you never know. Maybe, in some extremely minute way, Vice City Stories lays narrative groundwork for GTA VI. Originally released for PSP in 2006, Vice City Stories is trickier to play if you don’t own the retired handheld or a PlayStation 2, which it was ported to in 2007. But if you can find the means, there’s no better time to check out this often overlooked chapter of Vice City’s history.

Berdasarkan laporan, i usually hold off on early access games, to preserve my experience for the finished product, but i just couldn’t resist slay the spire 2. The co-op gameplay is an awesome, major change, but even just adding a couple of new characters and cards would have satisfied my cravings. To that end, this week’s free update adds a brand new character, the Fool, who I’m eager to test out.

Berdasarkan laporan, fyi, this new character is only available on the game’s beta, so you’ll have to go into the game settings on steam, click properties, then game versions & betas, and then opt into the “public-beta” version of the game to check the new content out. The new beta update also adds two more game modes: Dread and Blitz, which drastically alter your runs. If you want to wait a little while, the team at Mega Crit will refine these options into a more final form. The patch notes for this update specifically say, “We expect to make a great number of content and balance changes before the Fool is ready for the main branch,” so expect frequent tweaks and a bit of a wait before the Fool joins the main Early Access branch. But if you’re like me, more Slay the Spire 2 is more Slay the Spire 2, and I’m hopping in as soon as I can.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, monster train 2 was one of my favorite games of last year, so i’m always glad to have a reason to jump back in. As the DLC’s name implies, the new Punished clan gains buffs when taking damage, and you get new suite of cards that damages the whole playing field at once, harming foes and bolstering your allies. This week’s DLC, The Punished, is a perfect opportunity to do so, adding a new clan to the base game’s already packed roster. Since any clan can be combined with a second one to start a run, adding just one more option at the game’s start has an exponential effect, expanding the ways you can approach each attempt. Even if you’re not checking out the DLC, the base game is absolutely worth picking up – just read my glowing review.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you’ve been hankering for a new direction to go with your tabletop rpg group, may i recommend the incredibly versatile cypher system from monte cook games? the new character rulebook includes everything you need to get started, and set your adventures in virtually any fictional backdrop you can imagine, from hard sci-fi to gritty horror to high fantasy. Cypher’s polished approach to narrative-first and player-focused game sessions is much easier to pick up than many new rules systems, but it has enormous flexibility to deliver smart, creative, and exciting adventures that can help to change things up if your playing group has been in a rut.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Get ready for some wheels within wheels, as DiscussingFilm has revealed an animated trailer for a Grand Theft Auto 6 TV show—and I don't mean a trailer for a show about GTA 6, but a trailer for a show in GTA 6.

Sebagaimana diketahui, macca and friends, as the show is known, follows the adventures of a gang of anthropomorphic floridian—leonidan, i suppose—animals as they try to find their way in the world, accompanied to some extent by a beefed-up cop. The animals are cops too. It's a bit like Scooby Doo, maybe, but more egalitarian.

Rockstar hasn't said anything about the show, but this isn't the first appearance of Macca: A Macca and Friends mural appeared in a real-life BurgerShot that was set up in Miami's Kaseya Center in October, and a billboard for the show was erected in Miami as well.

Both advertised Macca and Friends as "coming November 19 on Weazel," a Fox-like television channel that exists within the GTA universe.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rockstar is now marketing gta 6 with a real-life burger shot food stand in kaseya center, miami. They continue preparing for the major Miami Heat event on November 18. (via @nvtnp_) https://t. co/hbAlRKP4A4October 21, 2026.

Berdasarkan laporan, how much of an actual, full-on show rockstar has constructed here, i cannot say. Remedy has done similar things with its games, but those are just brief snippets delivering a little bit of meta narrative; Rockstar, by comparison, gave us multiple stand-up comedy shows in GTA 5 and black-and-white films in Red Dead Redemption 2… not to mention, fully animated horse testicles. In that light, is it hard to believe they may have created an entire animated series for GTA 6?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it might just be another blast from the gta marketing machine—rockstar is also literally renting the miami heat to promote its game, after all. At this point I don't think anything's off the table.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, playstation and xbox owners will find out in less than a week: grand theft auto 6 launches on november 19. A PC release date (or any kind of PC announcement at all) remains elusive.

The CEO of the publishers behind GTA 6, Take-Two Interactive, isn't quite ready to go on his victory lap just yet, but he is once again enjoying what he thinks might be the most valuable entertainment IP in the world.

Diungkapkan bahwa speaking to david rubenstein, take-two ceo strauss zelnick was asked about the size of of gta 6's impending launch. In traditional fashion, Zelnick remained pretty humble, telling Rubenstein that "we never claim success before it occurs. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, in this instance, he notes, take-two and rockstar have had plenty of success together. "It sold in over 230 million units, and we believe the Grand Theft Auto franchise as a whole is probably the most valuable intellectual property in the entertainment business, of any type, because of its enormous reach to consumers worldwide. "It's true that GTA 5 was a massive hit," he admits. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, zelnick's argument is a potent one, but it's also a little hard to pin down. Off the top of my head, Pokémon and Marvel have certainly generated more money, but that's admittedly off the back of many hundreds more releases (and many more decades, in Marvel's case). Clearly, however, neither of those franchises can match the billions of dollars off a single launch that GTA 6 is set to make next week, or the other billions that the long tail of GTA Online is likely to secure. Pound-for-pound, GTA certainly sends those other heavyweights back to the corner, even if the 13-year gap between releases might be hurting a little.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, despite his quiet confidence in the brand, however, zelnick is still refusing to count his chickens before they hatch. "I believe they will, I'm very optimistic, but as for success, we'll have to wait until November 19 and beyond. "The team at Rockstar has been working diligently to try to create something extraordinary with Grand Theft Auto 6," he says. ".

#789. Former Xbox First-Party Game 'Kiln' Gets A New Identity And Its Biggest Update Of All Time

📅 13 Nov 2026

Former Xbox First-Party Game 'Kiln' Gets A New Identity And Its Biggest Update Of All Time

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.purexbox.com/news/2026/11/former-xbox-first-party-game-kiln-gets-a-new-identity-and-its-biggest-update-of-all-time

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when double fine released kiln as an xbox first-party title last year, it's fair to say a lot of the xbox fanbase was baffled by it. As much as it was a good game (we gave it a 7/10 in our Pure Xbox review), it also shipped with just a singular, online-only mode that was bound to get old pretty quickly.

Double Fine ended up being let go by Xbox, turning Kiln from an Xbox first-party game into an independent game, and it received a brand-new update back in September, adding a new creative game mode along with various other features.

But today, to mark the planned end of development, it's received its biggest update of all time - adding in three new game modes, an increased level cap, a Photo Booth and loads more besides.

Here's a look at just the highlights of this new update:.

In terms of the three modes, Fire Fighter is a 4v4 mode where "both teams are in a mad dash to catch a flaming Chimenea", Stoked is also a 4v4 mode that's "all about igniting the Pyres with your team’s flame", and Local Mini Quench is a smaller version of the original Quench mode that can be played with up to three other people offline.

Offline mode is actually classed as a separate new feature as well:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "as part of being able to play locally, we’ve added an offline mode. This allows you to play and practice without needing to worry about your Ping or people. This, alongside the player hosted matches and account change, helps future-proof Kiln so that you can play it for years to come!".

Pretty cool, right? On top of that, Kiln has received a brand-new identity this week in the form of "Kiln: Reshaped", with the name change serving as a way to "let you know how much is in this update!".

Unfortunately, it does seem like Kiln's flame has already been doused for the majority of players at this point, but it's great to see Double Fine putting in the work to not only preserve it for the future, but hopefully light the spark once again for people who have fallen away from it in recent months.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, don't forget it's on xbox game pass as well, or available on the xbox store for just £6. 99 / $7. 99.

#790. Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core Free-To-Play For The Weekend

📅 13 Nov 2026

Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core Free-To-Play For The Weekend

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/ghost-ship-games-newest-roguelike-goes-free-for-a-limited-time/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it wouldn't be a proper weekend without a few free games to play, whether from xbox free play days, playstation plus, or, most recently, thanks to steam's newest downloadable goodies. Although their newest offering isn't one you'll be able to download and keep forever, PC players will be able to sink their teeth into one popular co-op shooter roguelike without any strings attached for a limited time.

While you'll have to pay to keep playing afterwards, the newest deal is a perfect chance to try out Ghost Ship Games' newest entry in the Deep Rock Galactic franchise to see if it's up your alley or not until November 16 at 11:00 AM PST, and check out all the new content added since its release back in May.

Currently released as an early access title, Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core is the second spinoff from the massively successful Deep Rock Galactic, which offers a more arcade-style co-op shooter with procedurally generated levels to play through in its faster-paced shooter experience available here on Steam.

If you're looking for some great Steam-based PC games to play alongside friends and family, these are for you.

While it isn't a genre-defining roguelike by any means, the new gameplay style aims to offer even more replayability compared to its predecessor, with plenty of new weapons, abilities, and upgrades to scavenge and unlock as you play through any of the five currently available classes in the game.

Although Rogue Core currently has a mixed review score on Steam, the free weekend also arrives not long after the latest major update to the game, bringing numerous new features for new and returning players to enjoy.

In the 6 months since release, Rogue Core has overhauled several of the biggest concerns players had in early gameplay reviews, with quality of life features for easier character upgrades, ability rerolling, new challenges, and of course, plenty of new enemies and bosses to face off against.

While Deep Rock Galactic still isn't ready for a full release just yet, its developers are sharing the free weekend as an "open house" to let players see everything that has been added since its early access debut, which still has plenty more to come in the future.

#791. 8 New TV Shows to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO (November 13-15)

📅 13 Nov 2026

8 New TV Shows to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO (November 13-15)

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/new-tv-shows-streaming-this-weekend-netflix-november-13-15/

From the return of one of the biggest fantasy series, to a new Netflix horror.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s a big weekend for new tv. VisionQuest has concluded its first season, including a post-credits scene with big implications for Avengers: Doomsday. The Lord of the Rings: Rings of Power is back with a third season, continuing the story of a Middle-earth set thousands of years before Bilbo and Frodo Baggins. The Body is also available on Netflix, delivering a fun and campy high school drama with some religious horror thrown in the mix.

Sebagaimana diketahui, thriller lovers have some shows to look forward to. It’s adapted by Slaughter herself, making her the rare novelist who’s also the showrunner for her own story. The Good Daughter, a 6-episode series based on Karin Slaughter's bestseller, has just been released. There’s also 12 12 12, starring Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan, as two men involved in a high-stakes cat-and-mouse game that starts with a robbery.

Berdasarkan laporan, we have a few picks for lovers of documentary and true crime. Murder in Galicia is streaming on Netflix, telling the story of the murder of 66-year-old Isabel Fuente, who was beaten in her sleep, with her husband claiming that some intruders had gotten inside their house.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there’s also hbo’s silent night, a series based on the murders that took place on christmas eve in 1976 in a small community in poland. Lastly, if you want something a little breezier, there’s The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County, premiering on Hulu and Disney. Happy watching!.

Berdasarkan laporan, the lord of the rings: rings of power is back with a third season, exploring the tales of middle-earth thousands of years before the events of the hobbit and the lord of the rings. Season 3 tries to course-correct a series that has never managed to get things right. Set five years after the events of season 2 and billed as a soft reboot to welcome in new watchers, the season finds Sauron establishing his power.

Diungkapkan bahwa prequels always have difficulty justifying their existence since it’s a foregone conclusion how the story will end. There’s still some of that in season 3 as the island kingdom of Númenor and the dwarven stronghold of Khazad-dûm inch closer to their dark fates. Last season, Rings of Power leaned into that inevitability in the same way as the Game of Thrones prequel House of the Dragon, building a Shakespearean tragedy from the corruption of the dwarf king Durin III (Peter Mullan) and the elven smith Celebrimbor (Charles Edwards). But the show also spends too much time taking the same approach as Solo: A Star Wars Story, providing unnecessary origins for everything from the construction plans of Lothlorien to the origins Gandalf’s hat.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the body is set in 2004 and follows a dance team at a catholic high school located somewhere in the northeast. After partying too hard and botching a dance initiation ceremony, the girls inspire a mass hysteria in the town, with residents believing they have a saint in their midst.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of the best parts of the body is its many references. Story-wise, there are clear shades of The Crucible and The Exorcist. The show’s cast of characters take these archetypes and complicate them. With dyed eyebrows and a sweet but alienating approach, Lisbeth feels like Needy from Jennifer’s Body with a dash of Brigitte from Ginger Snaps. Shephard borrows archetypes and textures from films like Bring It On, Mean Girls, and White Chicks. Anya and Elise are clear successors to Bring It On’s Torrance and Missy, who raised a generation of queer viewers with their ridiculously charged friendship. But the great thing about The Body is that even though it depicts the aughts and the social concerns of the era, it’s made in 2026, allowing the writers to revisit these tropes and probe further.

Diungkapkan bahwa set in georgia, the good daughter follows two estranged sisters reunited by a school shooting that may be closely tied to their past. The women have spent years apart due to an incident in their childhoods, when a group of men broke into their home, killing their mother and leaving one of them gravely injured.

Following a massive heist in Europe, 12 12 12 follows three timelines and two main characters: Paul (Jamie Dornan), the skilled criminal who pulled off the heist, and Jack (Anthony Mackie), a disgraced FBI agent with a personal vendetta against Paul.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, based on the real-life crime of isabel fuente, “murder in galicia” is a scripted series following a seemingly perfect aging couple based in a small town in spain. After the woman is almost beaten to death after a break-in at their house, a civil guard becomes convinced that the culprit is actually the husband.

Based on a series of notorious crimes that took place on Christmas Eve in a small town in ‘70s Poland, the 6-episode series tells the story of the three murders that were committed on a snowy night in the town, initially staged as a hit-and-run.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the spin-off series trades the internet-famous salt lake city moms and swaps them for a new location: orange county. The new reality series follows a new batch of influencers and features moments captured in famous reality TV destinations like Laguna Beach and Huntington Beach.

Berdasarkan laporan, power, the starz series that ran for six seasons, is now available on netflix in full. The show follows a wealthy New York City club owner who’s also a drug kingpin and is trying to leave his life of crime behind to protect and focus on his family.
