#792. PSA: GTA 6 Does Not Have Online Multiplayer at Launch

📅 13 Nov 2026

PSA: GTA 6 Does Not Have Online Multiplayer at Launch

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/11/psa-gta-6-does-not-have-online-multiplayer-at-launch

GTA 6 is now less than a week away from its official launch, coming to PS5 on 19th November, 2026.

It's likely to become the biggest entertainment launch of all time, with excitement at a fever pitch coming off the back of GTA 5, which is the third best-selling game ever at a staggering 235 million copies.

Something that not everyone may know, however, is that GTA 6 will be a single-player game only at first; the online component will not be available initially.

This won't come as a shock to those in the know, as Rockstar Games has described it as a solo experience and has not yet referred to any form of online play.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, it seems there are many expectant fans that are excited to hop straight into multiplayer with their buddies. In case you didn't know, you won't be able to do this when GTA 6 launches next week.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i suspect this confusion comes from just how long gta 5 has been around. The game was first released on PS3 13 years ago, and GTA Online is almost as old, launching a couple of weeks after the main game.

Re-releases of GTA 5 on PS4 and PS5 have always arrived with GTA Online as part of the package, so even though the original game didn't have online multiplayer to begin with, it's been a constant presence for millions of players for well over a decade.

Berdasarkan laporan, it makes sense that people have become accustomed to gta 5 providing gta online, and took it for granted that its sequel would include the feature from day one. This is not the case.

Berdasarkan laporan, for gta 6, it's expected that an updated version of gta online will launch sometime in 2027, though an exact date has yet to be confirmed. It won't take a full year to appear, despite what this recent Bloomberg video inadvertently suggests.

It's believed that GTA Online will come to GTA 6 in a matter of a few months, possibly launching in the first quarter of 2027.

Rumour has it that the PC port of GTA 6 will launch in a similar timeframe, and it would make sense for these two things to be aligned.

So, to summarise: GTA 6 does not feature online multiplayer at launch, but it likely won't be too far off.

#793. Review: CRKD Ult Pro Controller For Switch 1 & 2 - A Decent Pad Let Down By Awful Shoulder & Bumper Buttons

📅 13 Nov 2026

Review: CRKD Ult Pro Controller For Switch 1 & 2 - A Decent Pad Let Down By Awful Shoulder & Bumper Buttons

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/crkd-ult-pro-controller-for-switch-1-and-2-a-decent-pad-let-down-by-awful-shoulder-and-bumper-buttons

CRKD is the latest accessory manufacturer to produce a premium alternative to Nintendo’s own Pro Controller on Switch 2, but it’s one that needs a lot of refinement if it’s to become a legitimate competitor.

Berdasarkan laporan, priced at $69. 99, the Ult Pro sits below the Pro Controller and roughly at par with Gulikit’s excellent TT line, price-wise. 99 / £64. 99 / €79. It comes feature-packed with TMR (Tunnel Magnetoresistance) analogue sticks, Hall Effect triggers, four back buttons, two extra bumper inputs, four profile modes, adjustable rumble, a charging stand, and more.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the analogue sticks feel good, featuring a more convex shape that you don’t often see these days. There’s a thin ridge near the edge of the grip which helps keep you aware of where your thumbs are sitting. It’s also worth mentioning that the grips can be removed for replacement designs, but these are sold separately – it would have been nice if at least one alternative were included in the box as standard. Otherwise, the TMR technology should keep stick-drift at bay.

Berdasarkan laporan, the default d-pad design (again, you can swap it out if you want) is circular with a raised cross representing the four cardinal directions. I like this a lot: it feels quiet yet retains accuracy during gameplay, and I found it reliable for platformers like Super Mario World and action games like Contra.

Diungkapkan bahwa the abxy buttons unfortunately aren’t mechanical with a satisfying click, but they do the job well enough. Like the analogue sticks, they’re slightly convex in design and are spaced at just the right distance to allow easy, intuitive access to all of them. I also like the colours; CRKD avoided the exact same colour scheme as both the SNES and Xbox 360 pads, but it’s got the same vibe (you can also opt for an all-black controller, if you wish).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the shoulder and bumper buttons, sadly, let the side down. You can adjust the shoulder button travel distance, opting between a short, clicky input or a full, smooth trigger input. To be clear, the Switch 2 doesn’t support analogue triggers for anything except the Nintendo Switch Online GameCube pad, so your choice here is purely down to personal preference.

Diungkapkan bahwa while the full-motion trigger feels pretty good, the clicky, tactile option is horrible. Rather than offering a satisfying click, they instead feel weak and spongy, almost as if the slightest bit of force will snap (or ‘CRK’, amirite) whatever mechanism is inside to produce the clicky response. I hated this, and CRKD should address it promptly for any future revisions.

Diungkapkan bahwa as for the bumper inputs, the additional ‘l2’ and ‘r2’ inputs are far too close to the main ‘l1’ and ‘r1’ buttons on either side. So essentially, when resting your index finger across the bumpers, you’re covering both the standard button and the extra input, making it far too easy to accidentally press the wrong button. CRKD would have been wise to space these further apart and make the main bumpers larger (8BitDo’s Pro 3 is a good reference point), or just remove the extra inputs entirely.

Sebagaimana diketahui, speaking of extra inputs, the four additional buttons on the rear are perfectly fine – i’ve got no major issues with these, and they’ll no doubt prove useful for anyone looking to gain the upper hand in modern warfare 4 (or perhaps even sprint while moving the camera in ocarina of time). The only downside is that they produce quite a loud click when pressed, though I think this is down to the plastic used for the exterior casing – it feels a tad cheap for the price.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you can map any input to the additional buttons — the four on the back and the two on top — by using the ‘p’ (program) button underneath the d-pad. You also have four profiles if you want to swap between configurations. CRKD neglected to include decent instructions with the product, and the QR code for an online manual led me to a dead page, but it does at least have a video on YouTube if you need help remapping buttons and setting up profiles.

Berdasarkan laporan, with the function buttons (i. e. Start, Select, Capture), CRKD bizarrely opted for two rocking inputs. With the left one, for example, you push it up for Select and down for Capture. It’s so weird – it works, but it’s weird. There’s no dedicated ‘C’ button; instead, there's an integrated macro to navigate to the Chat app if you push down on the right rocker.

Berdasarkan laporan, you can connect the ult pro to your console via three different methods. You also have a USB dongle stored inside the charging dock, so plug this into your Switch 2 dock and you can pair that way instead. Bluetooth is standard and works exactly how you’d expect: just hold down the large, black button until it flashes blue to enter pairing mode. Finally, you can simply connect it via a USB-A to USB-C cable. The difference between these is, for me at least, not noticeable, but if you’re someone who’s particularly sensitive to lag, you might have a clear preference here.

Sebagaimana diketahui, oh, and there’s no wake-up support for switch 2. Sorry.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, finally, the ult pro lasts for around 15 hours on a single charge, and if you use the included charging dock, you’ll likely never need to worry about it dying on you. The dock design is simple and looks neat next to the TV when charging. You can also replace the rechargeable battery in the controller itself if need be, or simply use a pair of AA batteries.

Berdasarkan laporan, there’s a lot to like about the ult pro, including its tmr sticks, the d-pad, the charging dock, and the lovely coloured abxy inputs. Unfortunately, CRKD really dropped the ball with the shoulder and bumper buttons – I hate them, and they really ruin the whole thing for me.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with no wake-up support and a fairly cheap-feeling exterior case, this isn’t quite the pro controller competitor i was hoping for, but with some tweaks and refinements, i think the company could be onto something. Do I actually like those rocking function buttons, though? Honestly, I’m still not sure.

The sample used in this review was provided by CRKD.

From the pictures it actually looks like a prototype design and not a finished product even though it is.

#797. God Of War Sons Of Sparta Gets PS4 Version And New Content Next Monday

📅 13 Nov 2026

God Of War Sons Of Sparta Gets PS4 Version And New Content Next Monday

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/2026/11/13/god-of-war-sons-of-sparta-gets-ps4-version-and-new-content-next-monday

Diungkapkan bahwa it's been about nine months since sony santa monica and mega cat studios dropped god of war sons of sparta as a surprise reveal and launch during a state of play. If you haven't checked it out yet, the developers are giving you some new reasons to today, unveiling two new modes and a new platform: PlayStation 4.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you don't remember, god of war sons of sparta is a prequel spin-off of the god of war series, showing protagonist kratos as a 13-year-old soldier, long before his god-killing days. The game features 2D combat and a Metroidvania-style map, along with a fully voiced cast of characters including Scott Menville (who you might recognize as Robin in Teen Titans) as Kratos' brother Deimos, Jack Quaid (who will voice a different character in God of War Laufey next year), and TC Carson, who returns from the original trilogy as the voice of adult Kratos.

Sebagaimana diketahui, announced in a post on the playstation blog today, sons of sparta is making the jump back to sony's previous console, which is now (brace yourself) 13 years old. Sons of Sparta's 2D pixel art is far less demanding than the other God of War entries, though, so it's no surprise this was possible – it's mainly surprising that they're doing it at all.

Berdasarkan laporan, for ps5 players who already own the game, developer mega cat is also adding two new modes: hermes mode and erebus mode. Meanwhile, Erebus Mode, named after one of the domains of the underworld (you'll be familiar with it if you've played the Hades games), makes the game far deadlier as Kratos and all his foes die in a single hit. Hermes Mode, named after the Greek god of wind, mail, and speed, is a speedrun mode that encourages you to beat the game as quickly as possible, complete with a split-based timer in the upper right-hand corner of the screen. You'll have to wait until you beat the game once to unlock Erebus Mode, but you can access Hermes Mode from a fresh save by entering the following (and semi-familiar) code in the start menu: Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right, L1, R1, Touchpad.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the free update and ps4 version will be available next monday, november 16, at midnight local time. For more Sons of Sparta, check out our review. For more God of War, bad news: God of War Laufey was just delayed until May.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the rainbow six franchise has long since been solely dedicated to the massive popularity of its latest live-service shooter, rainbow six siege, which has had over a decade of new operators, updates, and numerous spinoffs for players to enjoy. While Siege has been keeping the franchise alive for quite some time now, it seems like Ubisoft is finally ready to revisit some of the older entries in their tactical shooter roster.

According to a Ubisoft source at Insider Gaming, this return is none other than the revival of the Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Vegas saga with a brand new game in development, over 18 years since the release of Vegas 2.

While details are still scarce about the recently leaked project, the Rainbow Six: Vegas title is supposedly going under the codename 'Spades' for the time being, and will more than likely be the long-awaited release of Rainbow Six: Vegas 3 rather than a simple remake of the previous games in the series.

The currently rumored Rainbow Six: Vegas 3 is far from the only game that recently started development at Ubisoft Montreal either, as at least two other projects are supposedly just starting out, albeit with even fewer details available on what the games will actually be.

Berdasarkan laporan, ubisoft is having a quieter year. Probably because it cancelled everything else.

These projects are also reportedly separate from the recently leaked Assassin's Creed games, one of which takes place in Ancient Rome under the codename Mars.

Unfortunately, all of these projects seem to be quite early into their development cycles, meaning that fans will have to wait a few more years before any of them become realized in full, let alone are ready to show to the public, as noted by Insider Gaming.

Thankfully, considering the recent Ubisoft layoffs and the reportedly rocky development of Far Cry 7, having more games to look forward to is far from the worst thing for Ubisoft fans right now, even if a few of them wind up getting canceled or changed drastically during development.

Sebagaimana diketahui, new game plus isn't the only new feature coming to the game in update 1. 2, though it is the biggest addition. If you purchased The Blood of Dawnwalker — Eclipse Edition, you'll notice that the in-game soundtrack will be extended with new songs. Streaming services will also get the new soundtrack material soon.

Berdasarkan laporan, as for general tweaks to the blood of dawnwalker, update 1. 2 will make some balance changes to enemy health pools and how often they use their abilities during combat. Some terrain geometry has also been adjusted to allow for smoother movement during combat and exploration. The Blood of Dawnwalker has been one of 2026's great surprises, but it is unclear whether it will be able to shine through a crowded field as awards season kicks into full gear.

Players have been divided by the open-world RPG's time mechanic.

#801. Data Shows New Tactical Shooter Port Struck Gold With Console Plans

📅 13 Nov 2026

Data Shows New Tactical Shooter Port Struck Gold With Console Plans

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/data-squad-tactical-shooter-port-strikes-gold-playstation/

The surprise announcement of a Squad console port hit harder than a tank rolling through an undefended spawn point.

Taking the world’s most popular tactical shooter and moving to a platform that is typically associated with run-and-gun titles like Call of Duty and Overwatch was a bold move, but the numbers are finally in, and it looks like Offworld Industries played a blinder.

The battles on the Ottoman Front are about to get deadlier as Gallipoli targets hitreg issues.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the squad console alpha test ran from october 16 to october 25, with a free experience limited exclusively to the playstation 5. During the nine days of testing, console players got to try a battle between the Ukrainian Armed Forces and the Chinese People’s Liberation Army.

Although Squad will have full crossplay between PC, PS5, and XBOX Series X/S, the test servers disabled it to give Sony’s faithful a smoother introduction to the game.

Today, OWI has finally published the data from the playtest, and the results are quite encouraging.

According to a social media post by the official Squad account today, just over 110 thousand PS5 players participated in the playtest.

Diungkapkan bahwa that number in a vacuum doesn’t say much, but what’s impressive is that the squad playtest led to over 50 thousand wishlists on playstation 5 alone, meaning a conversion rate of around 45%. Many an indie dev would caution that treating wishlists as guaranteed sales is a highway to heartbreak, and they’d be right, but at the present moment it’s still a showcase of the positive effect of the playtesting sessions.

Diungkapkan bahwa the strong reception to the squad ps5 alpha preview is also reflected in the player ratings. According to OWI, the game closed the testing sessions with a 4. The PC version of Squad has an 83% positive rating on Steam and a 4. 5 out of 5 score. 3 out of 5 score on the Epic Games Store, landing the console port slightly ahead of its peers, but ultimately in the same bracket.

Diungkapkan bahwa squad first came out in 2015, with humble beginnings as a crowdfunded spiritual successor to battlefield 2’s project reality mod. The early versions of the game feel like a far cry from what we call Squad today, especially on the technical side.

According to producer Peter Maurice (full interview here), Squad is done “turning that corner where a lot of the major tech investment is done”, and that has allowed the team at Offworld Industries to turn its focus to new platforms and content.

Taking the world’s most popular tactical shooter and moving to a platform that is typically associated with run-and-gun titles like Call of Duty and Overwatch was a bold move.

Sebagaimana diketahui, currently, squad runs on unreal engine 5. 7. The transition from Unreal Engine 4 was “a massive challenge for a small studio,” but the performance benefits were felt on PC once the game found its footing.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, according to maurice, owi has been planning a console port for as long as 3 years, but the project only transitioned from an idea into reality about a year ago, following the release of space bug shooter starship troopers extermination. The studio was able to move developers who had worked on bringing this game to console and put them to work on Squad, making the transition a lot smoother.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the next big challenge for squad’s console release will be building a community that can support itself. As Maurice explained to me, consoles do not have a “veterans that have been with us for years like on PC,” and that means players will need the game to help people learn even when a more experienced player is not around.

Diungkapkan bahwa squad is coming to playstation 5 and xbox series x/s sometime in 2027. Secret Mode’s Project Marketing Manager, Matthew Beckett, says a future playtest session is possible, but more info on that later.

MMO PIONER is shutting down less than a year after its Early Access debut.

#802. "The Series Was In Dire Straits" - Kit & Krysta Recall Zelda's Pre-BOTW Dark Times

📅 13 Nov 2026

"The Series Was In Dire Straits" - Kit & Krysta Recall Zelda's Pre-BOTW Dark Times

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2026/11/the-series-was-in-dire-straits-kit-and-krysta-recall-zeldas-pre-botw-dark-times

While many of us can now look back on the Skyward Swords of the Zelda series with fondness, those who were in the trenches at the time might recall that things were starting to feel stagnant.

The later games of the 'traditional' Zelda formula were well received critically, but the tried-and-tested gameplay wasn't working wonders for their sales numbers, and they were struggling to bring in new fans in the process.

Cue the open-world series reinvention in Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with ocarina of time back in the public eye (perhaps the most typical 'zelda' a zelda game can get), there are some who are wondering why it has been so long since we've seen the traditional format. So, naturally, former Nintendo employees Kit & Krysta are on hand to remind us all just how dark things were getting before the invigorating shot of BOTW.

"There has been some revisionist history out there lately about how the Zelda team 'ripped these [traditional format games] away from us at the peak of their popularity'," Kit Ellis said on the latest episode of the duo's podcast before setting the record straight.

Berdasarkan laporan, "the series was in, like, dire straits," krysta yang added, "it was selling like nothing". Kit recalls going to focus groups and receiving feedback like, "the fanbase is dwindling; this is not bringing in new players; the interest is getting smaller".

With the huge success of Zelda today, it's easy to forget that such a time ever existed — particularly for those who weren't all that deep on the series at the time.

Berdasarkan laporan, "it was depressing," krysta adds, "it was like, we are losing this. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, of course, breath of the wild was so immensely popular and so very unlike anything we had seen from the series before that it gave zelda the interest boost it so desperately needed. It's interesting to see how well-received the return of the classic format has been with OoT, so perhaps we'll see something slightly more traditional make an appearance in the next mainline game.

Diungkapkan bahwa the dream scenario would be nintendo leaving room for both formats to develop, but it's far too early to know what the team is cooking up for the next mainline entry. Until then, we have the pinnacle of the open-world structure and the very best of the traditional at our fingertips on Switch 2, so we're more than happy to wait and see what comes next.

Diungkapkan bahwa i really hate when people blame the level design for skyward sword's commercial struggles. The Wii was all but abandoned by the time the game launched while Xbox was in its golden age with the 360 and Sony was firing on all cylinders playing catch-up after PS3's slow start. Wolfenstein 3 Is Officially In Production

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/2026/11/13/wolfenstein-3-is-officially-in-production

Wolfenstein 3 is officially underway at MachineGames, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has announced.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the announcement of the third mainline wolfenstein title in machinegames’ trilogy comes over seven years after the launch of the fourth and most recent spin-off entry, wolfenstein: youngblood. Sharma’s announcement includes a teaser image of the script for Wolfenstein 3's first chapter. MachineGames echoed this reveal with its own post, which includes a photo of a motion capture session featuring actress Debra Wilson, who plays Grace Walker in the series.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at @machinegames. https://t. One of gaming's most important franchises, and a team that has done remarkable work bringing it forward. Looking forward to sharing more. co/YyX8LrbTvh.

Sebagaimana diketahui, machinegames’ last release was 2024’s well-received indiana jones and the great circle, but studio co-founder jerk gustafsson stated in a noclip documentary last year that he hoped to finish bj blazkowicz’s story. Based on Gustafsson’s comment, it sounds like Wolfenstein 3 very recently started production, so we probably shouldn’t expect any substantial update for a good while.

Berdasarkan laporan, this won’t be the only new wolfenstein project, as amazon is developing a live-action series based on the franchise. Until either the new game or the show releases, you can tide yourself over by reading our reviews of Wolfenstein: The New Order, Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus, and Wolfenstein: Youngblood.

Want a faster response when you're shooting? The microswitch trigger stops will see to that.

#806. MTG Is Getting Its Own Animated Netflix Show With Planeswalker

📅 13 Nov 2026

MTG Is Getting Its Own Animated Netflix Show With Planeswalker

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/mtg-magic-the-gathering-netflix-show-official-announcement/

Magic: The Gathering has been in talks for years about getting an animated debut in addition to the upcoming live-action movie, but despite rumors that the project had been canceled back in 2024, a recent reveal at this year's MagicCon Atlanta show says otherwise.

Towards the end of the preview panel, it was revealed that an animated series in partnership with Netflix is not only in the works, but is already well into production and will be released sometime in 2027, as noted in the reveal trailer on Netflix's official YouTube channel.

The official reveal of MTG's "epic fantasy saga" Planeswalker wasn't just a quick teaser either, as the Sneak Peek showed behind-the-scenes details of its creators bringing the show to life, alongside several pieces of concept art and early development footage for players to pick apart.

Fans can also rest assured that the Wizards story team behind Magic: The Gathering's lore has also been a part of the production of Netflix's Planeswalker from the very start, which will follow the struggle for power between powerful mages starring the Planeswalker Chandra alongside several other iconic characters from the trading card game.

For longtime fans of the franchise, it's been a long time coming.

Aside from the Wizards and Hasbro Entertainment teams, MTG's Planeswalker will also be headed by VisionQuest and Star Trek: Picard creator Terry Matalas as the showrunner, alongside numerous creatives like Cindy Appel and Patrick Osborne as leads on the project.

While the announcement of an official MTG show with a similar animation style as League of Legends' massively popular Arcane series is more than fans could ask for, that's far from everything revealed at MagicCon this year either, with some new books and card previews for the upcoming Nauctis set to look forward to.

Combined with the upcoming live-action film, which has already found one of its first starring actors with Maya Hawke, the world of Magic: The Gathering is about to get even bigger than ever.

But we love gaming because some studios don't just do that, they care about their own passions, and this is theirs.

8BitDo Ultimate 3E wireless controller review

With its strong build, consistent connectivity and great modular features, this is the best 8BitDo pad I've had the pleasure of using, but it's not worth the money when comparable and even better-specced controllers are near half the price.

Diungkapkan bahwa pc gamer's got your back our experienced team dedicates many hours to every review, to really get to the heart of what matters most to you. Find out more about how we evaluate games and hardware.

Pricing has remained the elephant in the room for almost all PC Gaming hardware this year, but when it comes to controllers, you don't even have the memory crisis to blame.

And yet, I feel similarly about the 8BitDo Ultimate 3E as I do all that memory-equipped hardware: This is genuinely an excellent gamepad that I have loved reaching for every day, but that price stings so badly that it becomes quite hard to recommend.

Unless, of course, you really want a dual-compatible (Xbox and PC) modular wireless controller.

✅ You want the best wireless pad for your Xbox: The Ultimate 3E acts exactly like the standard Microsoft Xbox controller, even waking up the console with the on button, except it's better in almost every way.

Diungkapkan bahwa ❌ you want the best value for money: you can get the gamesir g7 pro, with its tri-mode connectivity and charging stand for nearly half the price. Add ten bucks to the G7 Pro, and you can even get its 8K variant.

With its strong build, consistent connectivity and great modular features, this is the best 8BitDo pad I've had the pleasure of using, but it's not worth the money when comparable and even better-specced controllers are near half the price.

Sebagaimana diketahui, tri-mode for pc and xbox. Bluetooth for Mobile.

Diungkapkan bahwa this isn't just a pc controller that works wired on an xbox, like most controllers. Not only that, but it even wakes up the Xbox when you click the On button, effectively doing what the standard Xbox controller does. This is an officially licensed product with Microsoft's coveted wireless chip inside, meaning it works wirelessly on Xbox and PC. This may not seem like a big deal, but it's shockingly rare among third-party controller manufacturers right now.

Sebagaimana diketahui, to swap between pc and xbox, you just have to swap the adapter between the two. Given the price, I'd really love two adapters, as the Turtle Beach Stealth Pro II has, but it's not a huge pain, and the controller has Bluetooth and wired connectivity.

Diungkapkan bahwa in addition to coming with a charging dock, carry case, and usb type-a to type-c cable, the case comes with spare thumbsticks, face buttons, and a d-pad. That's because the Ultimate 3E is modular. You can take off the faceplate and swap around the parts above in mere moments. It's intuitive, and all the parts are built well.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you also get more modern controller upgrades, like tmr joysticks, two buttons at the back and two extra buttons on top. It does do away with some of my criticisms of the 8BitDo Pro 3 by giving you a 1,000 Hz polling rate and an aux jack, but even then, I would have hoped for 8,000 Hz at this price point. Admittedly, most players won't use 8,000 Hz polling given its battery-sucking ways, but you'd still expect a pro-level controller to have everything thrown at it.

The PC Gamer Circuit Breaker newsletter breaks down the latest PC gaming tech, and finds you the best deals on the best products.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the main difference between the ultimate 3 and ultimate 3e is that the 3e comes with rgb rings around the sticks, has rubberised grips at the front and back, and, of course, modular parts. The 3E is also heavier.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as far as modularity is concerned, it's very easy to do. For the thumbsticks and D-pad, you can simply pull them until they pop off, and then slot in the replacement. The face buttons are a little more involved, with you needing to take the faceplate off, pinch the two sides of the face button module and pull. From here, you can swap with the included face button module in the carry case, which is identical except it comes with mechanical switches.

Berdasarkan laporan, it seems unlikely you will use this modularity every day, but this level of customisation is certainly welcome to me, and does make the controller feel unique. Unfortunately, though, it doesn't opt for any peculiar modules, like the Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded, which does feel like a slightly wasted opportunity.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, given it works on pc and xbox, i'd love a touchpad module option. The Victrix even gives you the option to change the stick layout, which the Ultimate 3E doesn't. There are levels of modularity on controllers, and the Pro BFG Reloaded is one level above.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at 285 grams, the 8bitdo ultimate 3e is around 10 grams lighter than the standard xbox controller, and it feels super sturdy and comfortable in the hands. The Ultimate 3 and 3E are slightly larger than the Ultimate 2, and I can comfortably say this is the sweetest 8BitDo controller I've held. All of its buttons are easy to get to, and surprisingly, I even found myself using the two extra buttons near the bumpers. It's impeccably well-balanced and smoothly slots into my palms. 8BitDo clearly knows how to make a great-feeling controller.

If I really shake it, the controller has a slight rattle in the centre, but I never heard that in the course of usual play.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the ultimate 3e has been my pad of choice whilst trying to collect the fortnite pirate token, and i may not have gotten the loot, but i have managed to achieve a tonne of kills. It's not failed me once in its connectivity; buttons are snappy and precise, and it doesn't fatigue me after hours of bad luck in the game.

More recently, it's been my way of playing Warhammer Survivors, a very chill game where you constantly hold down the thumbsticks, and these TMR sticks are impressive—precise and smooth.

Berdasarkan laporan, the best word i can use to describe the ultimate 3e is clean. The only thing cutting through that lack of colour is the LED around the on button and the RGB sticks. Well, not after my hands get on it, but we'll get to that later. The 3E comes in a suave black model, with almost every element of the pad being a shade of black. Simply click the start button to turn on the RGB, and hold it while using the D-pad to change colour, vibrancy and mode.

Berdasarkan laporan, it reminds me of a souped-up version of nintendo's pro controller, and that is a big compliment in my eyes. The Ultimate 3 does have some gorgeous colourways, but if you want something simple yet pretty, the 3E is great.

The same can be said for the stand, which is all black with a small RGB strip which doubles as a way of telling you if your controller is charging.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, there is one blemish here: the grips can get grubby. I've been using GameSir's G7 Pro 8K for almost half a year now and I haven't managed to get its grips quite as mucky looking at the 3E. It certainly doesn't look awful with a speck of dust or grime on the grip, but it does look less clean in both senses of the word.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for the ultimate 3e, 8bitdo uses the ultimate software x, which is the same software it uses for xbox devices. This is mildly annoying as I use the standard Ultimate software for my Retro keyboard and Retro R8 gaming mouse, meaning I can't use one bit of software for all three.

Diungkapkan bahwa with this software, you can customise the range and rumble of the triggers, the deadzone of sticks, and get firmware updates. It's fairly straightforward, though after the initial setup, you can do most of the everyday customising without software, including setting controls to the extra buttons, adjusting RGB, and even changing volume.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the 1400 mah battery gets around 18 hours of play before it needs to charge again. It's not especially big, but it's not minuscule either. However, I have never once needed to consciously charge the controller, because the stand is just the natural place I'd put the controller at the end of the day. The stand looks pretty, and I've never managed to place it at such an odd angle that the controller won't charge. That's fine. I have, on many occasions, very haphazardly slotted it on top, and it's been ready to go the next day.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the benefit of this charging stand is that it has a hidden compartment underneath to slot the 2. 4 GHz connector, meaning it works as both a charging stand and receiver.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you are looking for something like the xbox elite controller that works wirelessly on xbox, the ultimate 3e is basically 8bitdo's imitation, but cheaper. And that seems to be the main sell, here.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, if you are simply looking for a great wireless controller for your pc with solid specs and a great feel, it's significantly more expensive than the comparably good gamesir g7 pro. In fact, the GameSir G7 Pro 8K even outpaces it for PC competitive performance thanks to a polling rate that is eight times higher.

Berdasarkan laporan, as such, there's only one specific niche for which i could wholeheartedly recommend the ultimate 3e, and that's if you are primarily an xbox gamer in need of a wireless controller. But for the average PC Gamer, the Ultimate 3E, even with its neat modular functions and sweet feel, is $50 more than I'd happily pay.

One thing I can say is that it has replaced every other controller when it comes to my Xbox, and that is somewhat of a win for 8BitDo, even if it feels like a begrudging one at $150.

With its strong build, consistent connectivity and great modular features, this is the best 8BitDo pad I've had the pleasure of using, but it's not worth the money when comparable and even better-specced controllers are near half the price.

In that time, he has covered the latest doodads, contraptions, and gismos, and loved every second of it. It was not until 2019, after just finishing a degree in law and media, that they decided to throw out the last few years of education, build their PC, and start writing about gaming instead. Hey, it’s better than writing case briefs.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the winner still takes a large share. 5% of the pool, plus 1,000 Club Championship points. PARIVISION collected US$750,000, or 37. Runners-up BetBoom Team received US$340,000 and 750 points, Liquipedia reported.

Berdasarkan laporan, oftentimes in game development, you can't be sure how something will work until you ship. In the case of Skyrim, one of the leads was certain the level cap wouldn't be a problem, and then players made it clear he had the wrong idea.

Sebagaimana diketahui, bruce nesmith, lead designer on skyrim and a former longtime developer at bethesda, told the examined game podcast all about his logic. "When creating the system where all the different skills would go to 100, it implied, mathematically, a level limit of 81," he explains.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i didn't think of that," he says. That's what we shoot for. "Most of the games that Bethesda produces are designed to, you've played all the content roughly around level 50. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, he qualifies this with the caveat that that's a broad generalisation, because it depends on how the players approach the game. The amount of stealth or magic you use can impact things, but you'll likely still be in the ballpark of level 50 by the time you've seen the bulk of any given Bethesda release.

Diungkapkan bahwa "so, 81, and what do i care?" nesmith continues. "I was wrong. The players didn't want to finish playing their character at 81 and start a new one. They had a character they loved, why couldn't they keep playing?".

Diungkapkan bahwa this seems like a by-product of creating something as wildly popular as skyrim. Few games will ever be as widely enjoyed and played as The Elder Scrolls 5, and that means there are plenty of people who wish the whole experience was longer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there was a course correction, as nesmith points out, in the dragonborn dlc, where you could reset skills by spending dragon souls. This was introduced in a free update with Legendary Mode afterward.

Berdasarkan laporan, for nearly two decades, rainbow six: vegas has been left in the past while siege has become the face of the franchise. The two games offer very different experiences, though. Vegas was built around a proper campaign, room-clearing, and a squad that followed your orders. It's been a long time since Rainbow Six offered anything quite like it.

It was a huge disappointment when Ubisoft cancelled each of these games, and they deserve to be revisited at some point in the future.

Diungkapkan bahwa now, insider gaming reports that ubisoft has greenlit a new rainbow six: vegas project at ubisoft montreal. It's reportedly codenamed Spades, with a third entry considered more likely than a remake. Ubisoft hasn't announced anything yet, but a new Vegas campaign would be a welcome change of pace.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, according to the report, spades is one of three projects recently started at ubisoft montreal, including another game said to be linked to rainbow six. There's no word on what that other project might be. Spades itself is believed to be in early development, so its setting, features, platforms, and release window remain unknown.

Diungkapkan bahwa the original rainbow six: vegas arrived in 2006, followed by vegas 2 in 2008. Both games streamlined some of the more demanding elements of the early Rainbow Six formula, but they didn't abandon squad tactics. Teammates could be ordered into position, stacked at doors, and sent in with different breach commands. The cover-based firefights could get hectic, but there was usually time to think about how to approach the next room.

Berdasarkan laporan, the squad ai wasn't always up to the task, either. A badly timed move could turn a straightforward room-clearing attempt into a scramble to keep everyone alive. The teammates weren't terrible, but SWAT 4 generally did a better job with its AI officers. That's one area a sequel could improve without losing the appeal of the older games.

Berdasarkan laporan, i used to watch vegas gameplay on a tv show about video games as a kid. I only got around to playing both games years later, and they were well worth it.

Berdasarkan laporan, i've played most of the tom clancy games  over the years, completing and even replaying almost all ghost recon and splinter cell titles multiple times. Vegas was more linear than some of them, but its mix of tactical gameplay and straightforward action worked particularly well.

Berdasarkan laporan, the snake cam let you check behind a door before breaching, and different entry points kept encounters interesting. Cover was useful, but the squad commands were what made the firefights memorable. Vegas also placed second in our ranking of the best Tom Clancy games, behind Splinter Cell: Chaos Theory.

Berdasarkan laporan, siege has given rainbow six a strong multiplayer identity, but there's room for something different alongside it. A new Vegas wouldn't need to follow the Siege formula. The older games had campaigns and squad-focused missions that offered a change from competitive multiplayer. It could bring back a side of Rainbow Six that hasn't had much attention in years.

Siege has given Rainbow Six a strong multiplayer identity, but there's room for something different alongside it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rainbow six tactics is another welcome development. Turn-based strategy is a good fit for the squad-focused side of the series, and it doesn't need to resemble Vegas to be interesting. A new first-person campaign and a separate tactical strategy game could happily coexist.

Berdasarkan laporan, as our coverage of rainbow six tactics pointed out, ubisoft is making it a fully single-player game without an in-game shop or microtransactions. It's currently scheduled for 2027, with Paul Bishop from Vegas 2 returning as the head of Rainbow. That connection is a nice touch, but the turn-based gameplay is interesting in its own right.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if spades does turn out to be vegas 3, it has a solid foundation to build on. Keep the squad commands, the room-clearing, and the single-player campaign; make the teammates a little smarter. There isn't much reason to turn it into something else.

The Division 2 is attempting to fuse its ongoing player bases via both Steam and Ubisoft Connect.

#816. Here's Everything We Saw During The MagicCon Atlanta Preview Panel

📅 13 Nov 2026

Here's Everything We Saw During The MagicCon Atlanta Preview Panel

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/mtg-magiccon-atlanta-preview-panel-report/

We've got all the big news from the MagicCon Atlanta Preview Panel, which focuses on in-universe updates for 2027.

The Magic: The Gathering preview panel from MagicCon Atlanta brought us a much-needed deeper look at Nauctis: The Sunken Realm, the first Magic set on the 2027 release calendar, and also confirmation of a Netflix animated show.

In this blog, we'll summarize all the big announcements from the panel, hosted by British radio and TV host (and, most importantly, Magic fan) Jack Saunders, joined by head of story Roy Graham, head designer (and vision designer for Nauctis) Mark Rosewater, and Nauctis world building lead Laurel Pratt.

The stream kicked off with the reveal that the Magic: The Gathering community has raised $10 million for Extra Life through the ongoing philanthropic efforts, including Secret Lair drops, specific Extra Life products, and straight-up donations.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it was also revealed that 100% of the money from purchases of extra life products at magiccon atlanta will be donated to extra life; for products purchased in any other way, the split is a smaller percentage. So, if you're at the show and want to pick up some of the collection, your money goes further with a direct purchase!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mark rosewater kicks this off by hyping up the move to an underwater plane and says this has been in the works for 20 years. There were a lot of challenges, including how to represent the flying mechanic! The answer. there's no flying!.

Then it was confirmed that a new mechanic is coming, called Dive, and it won't be as straightforward as a creature feature.

Diungkapkan bahwa laurel pratt then takes us through how building a set underwater works, and how the team has to use research to represent the color pie. Roy Graham then takes over to talk about The Shallows, the first area within Nauctis. Dungeons & Dragons gets a callout for being the inspiration for this set, for how the tabletop game handles similar situations.

Diungkapkan bahwa we finally get our first card for nauctis: calmwater mentor, a seal monk! it's a four-mana mono-white card, and when it enters, you search your library for up to two creature cards with power 2 or less, reveal them, put them in your hand, then shuffle your library. We also get a look at the card in the Coral Frame, which is available in boosters and collector boosters.

The next card is Goramou the Coral Taken, a green-red Shark that confirms Blood tokens are coming back as a big mechanic.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, next, we're heading to a new area: the grand marine, home of the merfolk and hominids. We then get a look at Shimmering Citadel, a white-blue dual land that enters tapped. We get some talk about the importance of Merfolk and their history in Magic, and how the team plans to fairly represent the creature type in this set. It also has the Exhaust ability, returning from Aetherdrift, which costs five mana to let you draw two cards and gain one life, but you put a depletion counter on the land.

Berdasarkan laporan, we go straight into another card, salinae, the ocean mother, an eight-mana mono-blue whale god with devotion to blue, but it's pointed out that this is the only card with it in the set. Five Whale Gods will feature in the set and be hugely important to the colors they are associated with.

Box Toppers are confirmed as returning for all booster types, and they will be known as Sunken Treasures.

Berdasarkan laporan, we move on to the abyss next, and start exploring the hulking, terrifying creatures that occupy this corner of nauctis. The first card we see here is Tecton, Malignant Ruin, which sees the return of Descent. This 5/5 costs one mana less to cast for each card in your graveyard, has Menace and Deathtouch, and whenever you sacrifice a card, you draw a card. This is an example of a Desolator, the creature type revealed in the MagicCon Detroit ticketed play events.

Berdasarkan laporan, abyssal lotus has been revealed: a zero-cost artifact that you can tap and exile for three mana of any color if you descend 8. It is the headline card of the set and comes in three variants: regular, Coral Frame, and Raised Foil Headliner.

Following the Reality Fracture panel at MagicCon Amsterdam, we know exactly what 2027 looks like for MTG, including all sets and big events.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that's everything we're getting for nauctis! roy graham stays behind with jack saunders, and they're going to talk about publishing updates for magic. There's a recap of Omens of Chaos, and confirmation that more novels are coming, tied into in-universe sets!.

We then get the recap of Untold Stories, a comic series in partnership with Dark Horse, that focused on Jace, Elspeth, and Liliana, but Roy confirms that Chandra is up next!.

Mage of Zhalfir is then hyped, with a few pages shown from the first issue, along with some backstory for the narrative.

Sebagaimana diketahui, kamigawa: titanbreach then has its moon over the neon city novel confirmed, and it will get a command tower promo card with it! author akemi dawn bowman returns, having previously worked on kamigawa: neon dynasties. It's coming on July 27, 2027.

Then comes a surprising reveal: The Incoming Student's Guide to Strixhaven, an in-world visual history of the hugely popular plane.

Two more books are then revealed: a Planeswalker Encyclopedia and a Magic: The Gathering Bestiary, both coming in September 2027.

Diungkapkan bahwa while only in early development, magic: the gathering is finally getting an animated netflix series. The show is called Planeswalkers, and it's coming in 2027!.

The story team at Wizards has been involved with the production of the series since day one, and based on the early sneak peeks we just saw, it's looking incredible.

Sebagaimana diketahui, our favorite boggarts are here to show everything that they've been getting up to on their podcast over the past year. This includes a sizzle reel of the videos they've been featured in since Lorwyn Eclipsed was released.

It's a bit of a comedy break, with nothing notable actually being revealed during this section of the show.

Jack Saunders then comes back and introduces Brian Henson of The Jim Henson Company, who talks about how Squen & Cragg came to life and the experience of working with Magic: The Gathering as a brand.

We then get a detailed look at how Squen & Cragg work, plus an amazing look at the puppeteers involved.

Squen & Cragg are then revealed to have stickers and pets that have shadowdropped in MTG Arena.

Diungkapkan bahwa the show just kinda ends from there; it was a weird and slightly disappointing end to a preview panel that should have been about in-universe sets for next year, but didn't really go any further than nauctis. We also don't feel like we got the monumental announcements promised in the lead-up, as cool as the Netflix show is.

A good show, but not what it was hyped up to be at all.

#817. Warhammer Survivors review - "It's got the heart, but not the spark."

📅 13 Nov 2026

Warhammer Survivors review - "It's got the heart, but not the spark."

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pocketgamer.com/warhammer-survivors/review/

Diungkapkan bahwa back before vampire survivors hit ios and android, there were already a number of games inspired by (or, some might say, ripping off) their formula. So much so that I was wondering if it would go the way of Fall Guys/Stumble Guys, and be outshined by others who had gotten to mobile first.

Diungkapkan bahwa but while those other games still have their fans, poncle’s arrival on mobile only increased the popularity of vampire survivors. So much so that Auroch Digital reached out to create their own spinoff, dubbed Warhammer Survivors, that seeks to do for roguelites what Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun did for boomer shooters!.

Diungkapkan bahwa so, now warhammer survivors is out in the wild. But does it hold up to the indie hit that is Vampire Survivors? Hammer time If you’ve played Vampire Survivors, then you know what to expect from Warhammer Survivors. And to their credit, Auroch Digital maintain much of the same gameplay loop and fun of dealing with hordes of enemies, albeit with some interesting twists on the formula, such as different mechanics for each faction, like toxic debuffs from Nurgle or a hive-mind aspect for Tyranids.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for fans of aos and 40,000, it's a robust offering, as warhammer survivors splits each universe into its own sub-game with its own progression. That means different levels, enemies and weapons, although many of them will feel somewhat similar in everything but looks.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you’re a vampire survivors fan, this’ll all seem quite familiar, but warhammer survivors can also feel a lot more difficult due to the slower-paced movement of your character and the more dangerous enemies. Depending on your perspective, that’s either a good or a bad thing, but it definitely makes you feel as if there’s more at stake when you get cornered.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and while the weapons and gadgets feel familiar to what we've seen before, there are enough tweaks to make them feel different. While mostly cosmetic, their positioning affects where their attacks spring from, and if nothing else, it makes you feel as if you’re leading your own Kill Team into battle. Reference Overloaded Probably the most Warhammer thing about it is the number of references and nods to the original franchise. One particularly interesting mechanic is that when you pick up a weapon your character is incompatible with, another character joins your party. Whether that’s collecting paint pots to unlock new characters, all the iconic weapons, or even power-ups inspired by various gubbins from the hobby (blast templates, my beloved).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, basically, if you’ve ever been a fan of warhammer 40,000 or age of sigmar, you’ll enjoy the nods to the hobby’s lengthy history. But if you’re a newcomer who, for whatever reason, has picked this up as your first Warhammer experience, you’ll be left feeling somewhat confused.

Diungkapkan bahwa imperium sound (& graphics) system one aspect where warhammer survivors is thrashed by the original vampire survivors is in its soundtrack and sfx. The bit-crushed music and impact of weapons don’t match up to the original, and feel more than a little flat at times. I was excited to hear about the 80s/90s rock and electronic mashup music, but nothing really hits the same way that tracks such as Mad Forest, Moms are Tough, or Gatti Amari do when you’re really in the zone.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the graphics, however, are perfectly acceptable, albeit without the same amount of charm as vampire survivors. But you’ll find all your favourite Warhammer characters crushed up into some tasty bits that make them instantly recognisable, but also feel distinctly Survivors-like, and the colourful locations manage to feel authentically grimdark while contrasting one another.

Diungkapkan bahwa oi- we’re the bloody ubersreik five! now, there is one big omission here, and, of course, it’s the setting of the old world. Not to sound like a grognard, but while Age of Sigmar is a perfectly worthy setting to draw from, Warhammer Fantasy, which kicked off the entire IP, has roared back into popularity in recent years. We get Gotrek Gurnisson, undoubtedly one of the most recognisable characters from The Old World, but no other nods to the original grimdark fantasy universe.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s a shame, because what’s already here is a great love letter to warhammer. With more updates down the line, this could be the case, and there’re plenty of spinoffs in Games Workshop’s wider line that’d make for excellent one-off levels or characters to join the battle. And I did, to the tune of around three or so hours, which isn’t much in the grand scheme of things but usually more than enough to get a feel for a game; especially a fast-paced roguelite. Hopefully, we’ll see some updates down the line, and heck, I’d even take a paid DLC to see content inspired by Warhammer Fantasy make an appearance. So here’s hoping Auroch take advantage of the vast depth of the IP. Yet, I couldn’t help but feel I was missing something that might really change how I felt about it. Grindhammer I actually put off publishing this review because I wanted to put more time into Warhammer Survivors. But every time I played, it felt like I was making only the most incremental progress, even though (as you'll find) I was chugging along at a quite even pace.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and to me, that’s my main issue with warhammer survivors. Whereas Vampire Survivors feels like it moves fast, with you quickly unlocking new stages, weapons and abilities, Warhammer Survivors is much slower in terms of progression. Add to that the fact that you have two separate universes with (mostly) completely different progression, and what should be exciting, rapid progress quickly becomes a slog.

Sebagaimana diketahui, although it’s been a while, i feel as if in five hours of vampire survivors i was already headed towards that 30-minute mark, exploring multiple levels and already well on my way to experiencing new weapon fusions and upgrades. Maybe it’s me getting older, or it’s that Warhammer Survivors simply feels smaller and less engaging than its spiritual predecessor, especially considering that even though I felt I was making slow progress, it seems I've already completed 14% of the 40k side of the equation!.

Diungkapkan bahwa a lot of the issues with progression and how slow it seems, i feel, are that aforementioned difficulty. Now, there’s a joke about game journalists and difficulty there, but let me explain. In Vampire Survivors, you’re encouraged to move, to explore the map and dodge enemies, thereby encountering more secrets and upgrades. Meanwhile, Warhammer Survivors’ more punishing damage encourages you to hunker down, and only move if you see an existing secret highlighted on the map.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that means that, while you play for the same amount of time, you feel as if you’ve found less (even if you've actually found more). And yes, it’s perfectly fun watching hordes of Tyranids fall to your bolters and las-rifle fire, but it’s not quite as exciting as whipping your way through hordes of bats. While it may be more Warhammer to pick a spot and stick to it as you fortify your position, it sort of misses the point of a fast-paced bullet heaven.

Sebagaimana diketahui, point being, i love warhammer, i love vampire survivors; so this should have me in a chokehold. But it simply doesn’t. It feels like a perfectly fine love letter to the franchise, yet it never quite hits the heights that Vampire Survivors did. And while it may feel unfair for me to continuously compare the two, it’s hard not to when Survivors is in the title.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, maybe, with the coming updates auroch have promised, it’ll be able to stand on its own two feet. Even so, I can heartily recommend it if you’re either a Warhammer fan, or you’ve completely rinsed everything Vampire Survivors has to offer. Just be aware that recommendation comes with a few asterisks.

#821. Interview: Goddess of Victory Nikke's dev team tell all about the hit shooter for its 4th anniversary

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pocketgamer.com/goddess-of-victory-nikke/4th-anniversary-dev-team-interview/

Berdasarkan laporan, with goddess of victory: nikke's fourth anniversary event just having taken place, the hit character-collecting shooter is riding high on its enduring popularity. This got us a bit curious about how things work behind the scenes with the folks at Shift Up.

Diungkapkan bahwa so, we got the chance not only to put our questions to the dev team as a whole, but also to some specific members, such as graphics group lead park sanghu! read on to find out more about what they had to say about this massive milestone year for goddess of victory: nikke. General Dev Team Over the past four years, what have been the most exciting moments for Goddess of Victory: Nikke?.

With NIKKE, we've always hoped to create events where mini-games, the 3D field, the story, the music, and the characters all come together and bring out the best in each other.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, from that point of view, over zone was probably the most thrilling moment for us. It was the first time our vision for an event landed the way we hoped it would.

Honestly, if we could pick more than one, we would say every single anniversary event, because every anniversary and half-anniversary event has been a challenge for us, and each time the response from our Commanders has been gratifying.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we think there are so many games out there in the world, each offering something different to enjoy. NIKKE has a lot to offer too, but we would say the story has played the biggest part in its success.

Berdasarkan laporan, we think a game's appeal depends on the timing being right. Fortunately, it seems the kind of experience we wanted to offer reached players at just the right time. In that sense, we've been genuinely lucky, and we're always grateful to our Commanders for the love they show to NIKKE.

Sebagaimana diketahui, our design priorities vary depending on the nikke's affiliation. For a manufacturer-affiliated Nikke, what matters is a design where the character's personality and concept come through at a glance—something that catches your interest and makes it easy to see the character's appeal.

Berdasarkan laporan, pilgrims, on the other hand, need to feel distinct from regular nikkes. We want anyone who sees them to be left with a striking, flamboyant impression, so we focus on Nikke's signature original details and a high level of design intricacy, which give it a distinctive look.

Sebagaimana diketahui, just as we previewed in the developer's note, and as demonstrated by some of the content showcased during the 4th anniversary, we plan to continue building out features and systems that let players get even deeper into the story. We will share a more detailed roadmap in a future Developer's Note, so please stay tuned.

Berdasarkan laporan, first of all, we are thrilled that we are now able to support spanish in the game. Because we dedicate so much passion and effort to our story, We hope that Spanish language support brings enjoyment to even more of our Commanders.

Berdasarkan laporan, our hope is that even more fans will be able to enjoy wonderful experiences with nikke through offline events and expanded text language options in the future. We will do everything we can to help make that a reality. Park Sanghu (Graphics Group Lead) What makes Nikke's graphical style so distinct?.

We would say Nikke's distinctive art style comes from the balance between three things: subtle rendering that brings out the full appeal of each character, a very high density of detail, and bold staging that ties it all together.

In particular, it's important to us to bring out each character's unique personality and silhouette while giving the same care to the finer details, from costumes and equipment to the texture of each material.

Sebagaimana diketahui, on top of that, we use lighting, colour, and composition to show each character at their best. We think that combination is what makes Nikke's art style so distinctive.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, our design priorities vary depending on the nikke's affiliation. For a manufacturer-affiliated Nikke, what matters is a design where the character's personality and concept come through at a glance—something that catches your interest and makes it easy to see the character's appeal.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, pilgrims, on the other hand, need to feel distinct from regular nikkes. a. Ju Jonghyeon a. k. We want anyone who sees them to be left with a striking, flamboyant impression, so we focus on Nikke's signature original details and a high level of design intricacy, which give it a distinctive look. Cosmograph (Sound Director) How did you approach the soundscape of Nikke? Stuff like the music, SFX and whatnot?.

Berdasarkan laporan, we believe that sound in games is more of a feedback element. That's why we always keep in mind what the top priority should be in each situation when working on the sound.

Diungkapkan bahwa for interactions such as character touch sfx, our top priority is to bring out each character's charm. For Maria-n in the 4th Anniversary update, we wanted to further emphasise the musical contrast between different situations. We created a clear distinction between the music before and after meeting the Commander. By reducing the overall musical density, we aimed to bring each text-based action to life through sound.

Berdasarkan laporan, we're always grateful to everyone who has continued to trust us and wait patiently. We will do our utmost to deliver a better game and an improved service.

Berdasarkan laporan, now that what could be considered part 1 of the story has largely unfolded, we believe we can offer players a fresher and more exciting experience in part 2. Please continue to support us going forward, and we wish you all good health Some pretty interesting tidbits about what Nikke's development process is like, and a couple of hints about the future! While Nikke has had a rocky month with their recent PC launcher troubles, it seems that was only a bit of a stumble. So hopefully, in the future we'll see Goddess of Victory: Nikke once more going from strength to strength.

#824. 8 JRPGs With the Most Nominations at The Game Awards

📅 13 Nov 2026

8 JRPGs With the Most Nominations at The Game Awards

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/jrpgs-with-the-most-nominations-at-the-game-awards/

Berdasarkan laporan, murillo zerbinatto is a jrpg enthusiast, writer, and editor. He has played over 300 RPGs during his gaming career, with 90% of them being JRPGs.

Diungkapkan bahwa the gaming industry is no stranger to award shows. I. Awards, and more. Nowadays, we have countless ceremonies, such as the Golden Joystick Awards, the BAFTA Games Awards, the D. E. C. However, it is hard to deny the massive influence of Geoff Keighley's The Game Awards, whether because of its sheer audience reach, the spectacle, the world-premiere announcements, or the acceptance speeches that become industry touchstones for years to come.

From Nioh to Black Myth: Wukong, these are the seven Soulslikes with the most nominations at The Game Awards.

Diungkapkan bahwa we're nearing the game awards season, so i put together a themed list to celebrate. Rather than just discussing the ceremony itself, why not look back at the JRPGs with the most nominations at The Game Awards? True to my personal branding around here, I went ahead and did just that. It is wild to think that in the past, JRPGs would barely even be considered for major awards, yet here we are. Not only do they regularly rack up nominations today, but a certain JRPG-inspired title even swept the TGAs and currently stands as the most awarded game in the event's history.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, octopath traveler caught plenty of people by surprise, myself included. Just when we thought Square Enix had left pixel art behind for good, the company proved there is still plenty of room for the visual style while elevating it to new heights with its HD-2D graphical engine. Beyond the visuals, it recaptured the nostalgia of classic Square titles through the core gameplay loop as well.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, octopath traveler drew heavy inspiration from final fantasy vi to weave together the tales of its eight protagonists. That achievement earned the JRPG three nominations: Best Art Direction, Best Score and Music, and Best Role Playing Game, all of which felt entirely fitting. It didn't walk away with a trophy, but earning those nods showed how deeply critics appreciated the experience at the time.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's not every day a jrpg competes for game of the year, so when it does, you know the game is an absolute banger. As far as I am concerned, if Xenoblade Chronicles 3 had taken home the top prize, it would have been completely deserved. To be fair, it lost both Best Role-Playing Game and Game of the Year to Elden Ring, which is entirely understandable, even if I would still hand the trophy to Monolith Soft if we were running Murillo's TGAs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, losing best score to god of war ragnarök, however? look, i know ragnarök features a wonderful composition, but anyone who has played xenoblade chronicles 3, or any xenoblade title for that matter, heck, any modern jrpg, knows that musical composition is the beating heart of the genre. But I digress, and that is just the fanboy in me talking. You could play a JRPG where every other element falls flat, and I guarantee the soundtrack would still blow you away. I am simply thrilled that a JRPG received that much recognition and spotlight back in 2022.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, speaking of best score, nier: automata nailed that category in the year it competed, and honestly, that was the bare minimum. If they hadn't given the score award to Automata, who else could possibly have taken it? I do know who beat it out for Best Role-Playing Game that year, though, and I will get to that entry soon. NieR: Automata also earned a nomination for Best Narrative, and while it didn't win, I can understand why.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the story was insanely good, touching on deep philosophical and existentialist themes that leave you chewing on their meanings for months. However, its narrative delivery and structure can feel a bit complex for some players. You have to play through the game multiple times to get the full picture, and while I had a blast on every playthrough, some folks might drop off after the first ending and miss everything NieR: Automata truly offers. Plus, I haven't played What Remains of Edith Finch, and since the TGAs are ultimately a competition, it may have offered a tighter narrative experience.

Sebagaimana diketahui, even before final fantasy xvi hit store shelves, it was already sparking heated debate. I have never minded the franchise evolving its formula, though certain corners of the fanbase got irked just hearing that Final Fantasy XVI would lean into full action combat. Regardless of the broader discourse, I loved the game. It moved 3 million copies at launch (even if Square Enix wasn't fully satisfied with the numbers) and walked away with 4 nominations at the 2023 TGAs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, had final fantasy xvi not launched in the exact same year as baldur's gate 3, it might easily have swept more categories, including best role-playing game and best performance, because let's face it, ben starr as clive was perfection. The JRPG did take home Best Score and Music with Masayoshi Soken at the helm, a victory that was overwhelmingly deserved. To this day, I still blast either the Phoenix or Bahamut theme at the gym and feel like a Dominant hoisting weights.

From Axiom Verge to Hollow Knight: Silksong, these are the ten Metroidvanias with the most nominations at The Game Awards.

Berdasarkan laporan, remember how i mentioned that nier: automata lost best role-playing game and that the outcome was pretty justifiable? well, it lost to persona 5, and given that it stands as one of my all-time favorite jrpgs and the best-selling persona entry ever, i completely understand the decision. Furthermore, in TGA history, Persona 5 was the first JRPG to compete for the main Game of the Year prize. It didn't win because it went up against The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, and really, who can complain about that outcome?.

Diungkapkan bahwa it still secured best role playing game over nier: automata, divinity: original sin ii, and final fantasy xv, which speaks to what a stacked year 2017 was for rpg fans. If the votes were up to me, Persona 5 would have swept practically every category and called it a night. It is a JRPG through and through, featuring a slow burn, extensive social sim segments, and mountains of dialogue, yet it still shattered niche barriers to reach a massive global audience. May Atlus keep on winning.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, apparently my wishes were granted in record time, because atlus kept on winning. That is an extraordinary feat, mind you. While Persona 5 earned 4 nominations, Metaphor: ReFantazio racked up 6 nominations and took home 3 major trophies: Best Narrative, Best Art Direction, and Best Role-Playing Game, edging out Square Enix's own Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. Despite Persona's massive growth, Final Fantasy remains a far more recognizable mainstream brand, making it all the more impressive that critics favored Metaphor.

Berdasarkan laporan, i adore metaphor, by the way. It is stylish, gutting, gripping, challenging, and endlessly engaging. It came dangerously close to dethroning Persona 5 as my favorite Atlus JRPG, falling just a hair short, though not quite yet. It was the very first JRPG I covered right after joining the team here at DualShockers, and I fell in love with it immediately. I don't know whether Studio Zero plans to release DLC or jump straight into a follow-up, but I will definitely be there on day one and hope to see its successor pull in even more nominations.

Diungkapkan bahwa eagle-eyed readers might notice that i left final fantasy vii remake off this list. That entry received 6 nominations, though including it felt slightly redundant since both games competed in nearly the same categories, simply swapping Best Art Direction for Best Audio Design, while Final Fantasy VII Rebirth added a Best Performance for Briana White as Aerith. She ultimately lost to Melina Juergens as Senua, which is tough luck.

Sebagaimana diketahui, even so, if we look specifically at japanese-developed jrpgs (as awkward as that phrasing sounds), final fantasy vii rebirth holds the record for the most nominations in tga history so far. The title earned nods for Best Game Direction, Best Narrative, Best Score and Music (which it won), Best Audio Design, Best Performance, Best Role-Playing Game (losing to Metaphor: ReFantazio), and Game of the Year (losing to Astro Bot). No matter how hard certain corners of the internet try to downplay Rebirth's success, critics worldwide universally acclaimed it, and I cannot wait to see Final Fantasy VII Revelation rack up just as many nominations and plenty of wins.

Diungkapkan bahwa we are well past debating whether clair obscur: expedition 33 counts as a jrpg, so i will skip the preamble. What I want to highlight here is something everyone who follows the TGAs already knows: Expedition 33 holds the record as the most awarded game in TGA history. That milestone is not only deeply symbolic for the current climate of the gaming industry, where publishers constantly chase infinite exponential profits, but it also proves that simply throwing massive budgets at a project is not the secret to making a great game.

Diungkapkan bahwa clair obscur: expedition 33 represents a union of passionate fans, sheer willpower, rich inspiration, and genuine love for art and video games distilled into something tangible, fun, emotional, and lasting. Even director Guillaume Broche himself confirmed it to me on LinkedIn. From the very moment I started playing, I could not put the controller down, completely enthralled by the journey of my Expeditioners. As proof of that obsession, I actually earned the world's first platinum trophy for the game, and I am not kidding. Not trying to gloat, just showing how transcendental my love for this title truly is.

We're not just talking about Grand Theft Auto VI and Ocarina of Time, but up to seven video games that could sweep The Game Awards.

#826. Riftbound Bans Huge Cards In Response To Lopsided Meta At Recent Major Tournament

📅 13 Nov 2026

Riftbound Bans Huge Cards In Response To Lopsided Meta At Recent Major Tournament

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/riftbound-bans-riven-broken-blade/

There are no major surprises among the banned cards, and most fan concerns have been addressed by Riot.

We knew the news was coming, but it's still nice to see that the Riftbound bans that were just revealed have addressed many fan concerns with the game, especially following a hugely lopsided meta at the Riftbound European Regional Championship in Stuttgart last weekend.

Riftbound game director Dave Guskin has revealed the 10 cards on the receiving end of the ban hammer, which are split between eight normal cards and two battlefields.

The bans are the result of "a transition from all of our sets designed before the launch of the game to an age of Riftbound where our design, playtesting, and metagame are informed by all of you [the players]," according to Guskin, so let's take a look at the cards that are no longer legal in Standard and 2v2 Constructed play.

Diungkapkan bahwa as we've already alluded to, these bans were expected after an announcement earlier this week by dave guskin, but they don't take effect until monday, november 23, 2026. This means that any events taking place between now and the effective ban date can still include the listed cards.

Diungkapkan bahwa riven, broken blade was only just released as part of the radiance set, meaning it's an almost instant ban for the overpowered legend. It was an absolute requirement, though, because the card accounted for almost half of the field in the recent European Regional Qualifier, and while it may not have won the event, it dominated every stage, even accounting for half of the deck in the top eight.

Among these banned cards are cards that are powerful right now and others, like Baited Hook, that don't actively see a ton of competitive play but could have become imbalanced thanks to the other cards included in this ban list.

This shows that the Riftbound team is thinking about more than just removing cards that are powerful right now, and they want to enter 2027 with a clean slate where the meta is much fairer, even if some legends are played more than others.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with no officially supported competitive eternal formats in place yet within riftbound, this ban effectively makes riven, broken blade a worthless card, and the secondary market is already reacting to the news. The alternative art variant of this card has gone from €16 a month ago to €6 as of yesterday, with the ban predicted. Since the ban was confirmed, listings of the alternative art variants of the card have already started to drop even further, with most listed for just €3.

Berdasarkan laporan, over on tcgplayer, for the same version of the card, the value has gone from $30 during release week to just $4. 80 today, again with listings dropping under $4 at the time of writing.

The European Regional Championship in Stuttgart was an overall success, but two major talking points kept coming up over the weekend.

Berdasarkan laporan, moving forward, to offer stability and predictability to bans in riftbound, there will be a ban window, and any card bans will be announced on the friday two weeks before each continental event and the friday two weeks after. This allows the Riftbound team to control the narrative around bans because players won't make overwhelming calls for decisions to be made on a whim, and instead they know that these announcements will be restricted to specific windows.
