Berdasarkan laporan, "if you want to make a videogame like grand theft auto, you need animators, you need musicians, you need so many people from across the creative industries to make them work. And why shouldn't it be our children in our communities who get the chance to get those jobs?".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's fascinating how things change. for instance, used to love staying up all night playing videogames; now I get mad at the world if I miss my bedtime by 10 minutes. I. In kind of a similar vein, Grand Theft Auto was once the poster child for everything insidious, dangerous, and downright wrong about videogames, but now we have a member of the UK government—a secretary of state, no less—talking about how the upcoming Grand Theft Auto 6 is something the whole country should be proud of.

Berdasarkan laporan, "my love for videogames knows no bounds, and i am an avid addict of things like animal crossing and the mario series," lisa nandy, the uk's secretary of state for digital, culture, media, and sport, told the rundown. "I'm not sure I get away with taking a day off to do it, but I think it's something that we can be really proud of.

Berdasarkan laporan, "one of the reasons that we're investing in arts and music and all of those things that give people the chance to live richer, larger lives is because we are creating jobs in these incredible industries. And if you want to make a videogame like Grand Theft Auto, you need animators, you need musicians, you need so many people from across the creative industries to make them work. And why shouldn't it be our children in our communities who get the chance to get those jobs?".

I'm as politically cynical as most folks, and sure, Nandy is using the moment opportunistically to promote her government—although, cynicism notwithstanding, I do respect her ability to stay on-message by turning a softball question about GTA 6 into talking about job creation.

Diungkapkan bahwa at the same time, though, this is a remarkable turnaround from, say, 20 years ago, when everyone in a position of authority lost their minds over the hot coffee mod for gta: san andreas. Some of you might not be old enough to remember (you have no idea how much it pains me to say that) but referring to GTA as a legitimate cultural export in the early 2000s would've got any mainstream Western politician laughed out of the room—and suggesting that it'd be cool if the children (the children!) grew up to make more games like that? Pure political suicide.

Diungkapkan bahwa as pc gamer's evan lahti wrote in 2017, "any american who played games in the '90s remembers the period of pearl-clutching and pseudoscientific fear-mongering from senators like joe lieberman, who led a call to ban violent videogames. " This was serious stuff back then, and it wasn't really until the US Supreme Court ruled that videogames, like other creative works, are protected speech under the First Amendment that the hysteria and hand-wringing started to meaningfully die down.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but now here we are, 15 years later: the miami heat are cosplaying as a vice city sports team, rockstar is holding a huge gta music festival featuring cardi b and travis scott, half the state of florida is embracing a leonida transformation (and the cops aren't even mad about it), and now we've got the uk government saying it's all quite grand—splendid, even. Time, man. It really is a river carving the bedrock of our souls.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as the biggest donkey kong fan to have ever written for gamesradar+, i've been waiting with bated breath to see what lego had up its sleeve for an 18+ set since he was announced for the kid-friendly lego super mario series years ago. Sebagaimana diketahui, the donkey kong arcade features a recreation of the original arcade machine, with the addition of a barrel lever to have donkey kong (or a plate with a sticker of him on it) send a barrel rolling down the ramps to try and take out jumpman. Diungkapkan bahwa despite the interactive elements, the donkey kong arcade is a pretty straightforward build. Unlike the Mario NES and TV set that features a rotating background, you're mostly dealing with standard Lego Technic pieces for the mechanisms in Donkey Kong.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you begin with the base of the arcade and build up, slowly crafting the construction site that big donk has climbed up with lady (aka: pauline) as you go. I especially love the pink girder pieces that adorn the set.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unfortunately, while mario is a sprite printed onto a piece, the set features nine stickers – four for the arcade machine graphics with another five for the oil barrel, fire, "help!" as well as lady and donkey kong themselves. Building upwards means that the grand finale is the "Donkey Kong" letters attached to the top of the arcade machine, which unfortunately is a bit of a damp finish, as it's the least interesting and most fiddly part of the build.

And the playable nature of this set makes for a great showpiece. But it makes great use of its height as one of the most visually appealing sets.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ❌ you don't care that much for donkey kong: ultimately this set hinges on your enjoyment of the playable gimmick and arcade nostalgia, so if you don't care for either, maybe give it a miss. ❌You're on a budget: Donkey Kong Arcade is one of the pricier Nintendo sets on the market right now (excluding some of those Pokemon sets), the Game Boy and Zelda Ocarina of Time sets could be a good alternative.

#831. 10 Great Games That Defined The Original Xbox

📅 13 Nov 2026

10 Great Games That Defined The Original Xbox

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/great-games-that-defined-the-original-xbox/

Eric Warner is a Journalist and Multimedia Producer based in New England with over 7 years of experience producing stories for multiple publications.

25 years ago, on November 15th, 2001, the gaming industry was forever changed when Microsoft officially dived into the console gaming market with the debut of its first home console, simply called the Xbox.

Designed to be a bridge between the hardware and software capabilities of PCs and the accessibility of home gaming consoles, the original Xbox console took the world by storm with its revolutionary gaming titles and services, proving that the United States can still rival Japanese gaming prospects.

With the original Xbox, and the overall Xbox brand, celebrating its momentous 25th anniversary this November, here’s a look back at 10 great exclusive games that defined the original Xbox and helped pave the way for Microsoft to become a modern gaming juggernaut.

Today, Xbox is largely known for three exclusive franchises: Halo, Gears of War, and Forza but long before the latter simulation racing series took the Xbox brand by storm during the Xbox 360 era, there was another series that stood as Xbox’s premier exclusive racing franchise: Project Gotham Racing.

Originally released as one of the Xbox’s many launch titles, the first Project Gotham Racing allowed up to four players in split-screen multiplayer to race against each other using 29 of the hottest cars of the early 21st century across San Francisco, London, Tokyo, and New York City.

With its stunt-focused Kudos point system and fun, arcade-like modes, Project Gotham Racing became one of the earliest Platinum Hits on the Xbox, leading to the development of three direct sequels, a few spinoffs, and the hit Xbox Live Arcade game, Geometry Wars.

Every great console needs its own standout amusing party game, and while Nintendo had Mario Party and PlayStation had Crash Bash, Xbox got its own distinct party game in the form of Fuzion Frenzy.

Another Xbox launch title, Fuzion Frenzy was an original party game not based on any prior IP, with the game being set in a futuristic tournament pitting four players against one another across randomized or pre-selected minigames with the goal of obtaining as many orbs and points as possible.

Chaotic minigames like Paint Panic and Falling Star quickly made Fuzion Frenzy a fan-favorite, and while it only got one sequel on the Xbox 360, many players still go back to play its wacky games to this very day (thanks to FF being backwards compatible on every future Xbox platform).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the sixth generation of consoles was a time for beginnings and a time for endings for many in the gaming industry at the time, most notably sega. The Sega Dreamcast would mark the end for its home console prospects.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, the failure of the dreamcast didn’t mark the end for several sega properties, as microsoft collaborated with sega to make the xbox the exclusive home for several dreamcast ports and sequels. Arguably the best was the funky Jet Set Radio Future.

A sequel to Jet Grind Radio, Jet Set Radio Future is a hyper stylized action game set in a futuristic Tokyo, where a group of teenagers called the GGs skate throughout the city and spray paint graffiti as a form of resistance against the dominating Rokkaku Group megacorporation.

Fans of the original Xbox who want play adventure titles that feature villains as protagonists should check out these 10 games.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the rpg giant that is bethesda is currently owned by microsoft, and is a major part of xbox’s future game investments. The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel is rumored to become a Project Helix exclusive, but long before Microsoft purchased Bethesda, the two companies first collaborated to release The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind exclusively on the original Xbox.

The first Elder Scrolls title to debut on a home console, The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind was a first and third-person RPG set in the titular ash-clouded Tamriel province of Morrowind, following a customizable prisoner who sets out on a journey to defeat the oppressive Dagoth Ur.

While Morrowind hasn’t aged as well as its successors, it paved the way for Bethesda to debut other landmark RPGs, such as Fallout, Skyrim, and Starfield on consoles, helping showcase the immense potential of western RPGs.

Berdasarkan laporan, one of the greatest innovations the original xbox featured was the creation of xbox live, as it was one of the first online multiplayer gaming services designed for home consoles and practically laid the groundwork for all modern online gaming services. Xbox Live’s debut title was MechAssault.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, set in the multimedia battletech franchise, mechassault is a third-person mech shooter game set on the planet helios. It follows a Wolf's Dragoons BattleMech pilot as they attempt to liberate the planet from the technology-worshipping faction Word of Blake.

MechAssault’s campaign is a lot of fun, but the game is far more famous for its multiplayer as it was one of the first console titles to feature Quick Matches, the ability to host and invite friends to online games, and multiplayer DLC such as new maps, gametypes, and new types of mechs like Raven and Loki.

Sebagaimana diketahui, every sixth generation console featured fantastic titles that were beloved by many but just didn’t sell well enough to receive proper sequels, resulting in these types of games becoming cult classics. There’s no better Xbox cult classic out there than Crimson Skies: High Road to Revenge.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, loosely based on the 1998 crimson skies board game, crimson skies: high road to revenge has players embody fortune hunters air pirate gang leader nathan zachary, in an alternate 20th century where planes and zeppelins became the primary mode of transportation and the u. S. split into warring nations.

Berdasarkan laporan, with an interesting world and story highly reminiscent of classic pulp books and films like indiana jones and enthralling third-person fighter plane gameplay, revenge quickly became a fan-favorite. While it never received a sequel, it has since become the unofficial mascot for Xbox’s backwards compatibility.

These classic games will require some work to play again unless you have an older-gen console.

Early on in the Xbox brand’s history, Xbox’s most famous exclusive franchises were Halo, Gears of War, and Peter Molyneux's highly ambitious fantasy RPG Fable, which is finally set to return to Xbox early next year with a reboot of the series.

The original Fable was claimed by Molyneux to be the most ambitious RPG of the sixth console generation, with the game supposedly allowing players to have children in-game, play through the protagonist’s entire life, and witness plant life grow throughout the game, among other promises.

While most of these features weren’t present in the first Fable game, the original Fable still turned out to be an incredibly charming, comedic, and overall fun RPG, thanks to its witty British humor, morality system, and vast numbers of ways to interact with NPCs such as getting married and farting on people.

Diungkapkan bahwa nintendo fans recently got to take part in the midnight launch of the legend of zelda: ocarina of time remake launch at various gaming stores. Those launch events paled in comparison to the cultural phenomenon that was the launch of Halo 2.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the original xbox was arguably the house halo: combat evolved built, and as such, most gamers in the world were excited to see how bungie would improve upon the series in halo 2, leading to the sequel receiving 1. S. pre-orders and selling over 2. 5 million U. 4 million copies in its launch day alone.

This anticipation was warranted though, as Halo 2 became the most popular Xbox Live game up until the release of Gears of War 1 and is widely regarded to feature one of the best FPS campaigns of all time thanks to the introduction of the Arbiter, dual-wielding, vehicle hijacking, and more.

The original Xbox was home to very few JRPGs, but these obscure ones might have something left exploring if you're interested.

While Fable 1 is the RPG most associated with the original Xbox, I would argue that it wasn’t the best RPG available on the console, with that honor instead going to BioWare’s epic 2003 masterpiece Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic.

Diungkapkan bahwa many star wars video games were released exclusively for the original xbox, but kotor was by far the most notable. It not only took place roughly 4,000 years before the events of the films during the Jedi Civil War, but featured one of the greatest gaming twists of all time, centered around Darth Revan.

KOTOR’s rather clunky round-based combat hasn't exactly aged well over the years, but its story and characters are still regarded as being some of the best to appear any RPG, such as Darth Malak, Jedi Knight Bastila Shan, the murderous droid HK-47, and the Mandalorian Canderous Ordo to name a few.

Finally, without a doubt, the number one exclusive video game that defined the original Xbox and arguably the Xbox brand overall was the launch title and Bungie’s revolutionary FPS Halo: Combat Evolved.

Halo: Combat Evolved was the definitive console-based FPS that truly showcased the capability of consoles to deliver an engaging, fun, and wondrous FPS experience, thanks to its cinematic quality, wide-open spaces, addictive gunplay and vehicle combat, and engrossing FPS multiplayer maps.

If Halo: Combat Evolved hadn’t been packaged with most Xbox consoles on day one, Xbox likely wouldn’t have lasted beyond the sixth generation of consoles and CE’s success ultimately led to Xbox not only obtaining a mascot with Master Chief but the creation of one of the most beloved sci-fi multimedia franchises of all time.

Berdasarkan laporan, skin distribution seems to be an issue in pretty much any game with more than one hero and clear favourites. Marvel Rivals has come under fire for it for a while now, ever since players got wise to which heroes were favourites and which had clearly been shoved to the side.

#833. How To Get Blessed Jade Pendant In Phantom Blade Zero

📅 13 Nov 2026

How To Get Blessed Jade Pendant In Phantom Blade Zero

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/phantom-blade-zero-tell-yuers-father-truth/

Sometimes, the truth comes at a great cost.

Diungkapkan bahwa in phantom blade zero, one of the main storylines has to do with yu'er, a young girl trying to heal her father. You meet her right at the start of the game, and she pops up as you continue on, all the way until you get to Pangzhen. She has been trying to take a Flesh Lily to her father, as it is the only thing that can heal him.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, once you get to the city, you'll find that she's been killed. After avenging her death, her body is taken by the Herald, who seeks to use her as a puppet going forward. When you finally make it to her home in the backstreets of Pangzhen, you're faced with the choice of telling her father the truth or shielding him from it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, interestingly, you can avoid any dialogue with yu'er's father, which is technically easier. The downside is that you don't get a positive ending or closure, and you also don't get the accessory he would give you as a reward.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the weeping creek valley, there is a missable boss that will affect your gameplay going forward. If you go to the Sha Chi Tower, on the first floor, you can find a section of the floor that you can slide down to reach a lower area of the map.

Diungkapkan bahwa in this area, you'll meet a few enemies before getting to hua, deadly betrothed. Defeating this boss grants you a White Lily, which affects whether you can interact with Yu'er's father or if you don't get a say in the matter.

You don't get the White Lily if you defeat Hua, Deadly Betrothed after meeting Yu'er's father.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you don't face this boss at all, when you defeat chang hong and go to see yu'er's father, you won't get the choice between telling him that yu'er is gone or that she is hiding. You also won't get the Blessed Jade Pendant accessory; instead, you'll get the Tarnished Jade Pendant, which is shown as a story item and can't be used.

Which skills will get you the farthest through the Wulin?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, once you're face-to-face with hua, the name of the game is dodging as much as possible and parrying only when you see a clear opening. Many of her attacks involve rings of lilies on the ground that sap your health and Sha Chi, and her grab attack is devastating.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, she'll also emit giant white lilies that fly through the air and follow you for a frustratingly long time, so keep running and dodging to avoid taking damage. She won't stop attacking while they float at you, so try not to put yourself between the flowers and Hua.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this fight will be much easier if you do it after speaking to yu'er's father, since it's an early-game boss you'll be tackling well into the campaign. However, doing so will essentially make the fight pointless, because it'll be too late to save Yu'er's father if you wait that long.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you do defeat hua before you go to see yu'er's father, you can take the white lily to him. When you speak with him, he will see Yu'er being controlled by the Herald and fall back asleep, but Soul will use the white lily to bring him back to consciousness. He will ask you where Yu'er is, and you'll be given two options: "She's no longer with us" or "She's still alive, but hiding. ".

If you tell him the truth that Yu'er is dead, he will say that he knew it all along, before you're shown a cutscene of Yu'er saying goodbye to her father in his dreams.

If you choose to spare his feelings and tell him that she's alive, he will thank you for your kindness before telling you that he knows that she is dead, also citing that she came to him in a dream.

Regardless of your choice, you'll get to speak with him about the state of the city, where he'll tell you what he knows before offering you the Blessed Jade Pendant.

Sony has announced a new batch of games to be added to its QSSR initiative which brings AI upscaling tech to the base PS5 console.

Diungkapkan bahwa as one of the daft people who purchased a ps5 pro despite it not exactly being a necessary purchase, i will admit i've enjoyed the benefits. Over the next few weeks, the tech will be implemented in Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Control Resonant, The Finals, Arc Raiders, No Man's Sky, and Hell Let Loose: Vietnam.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, meanwhile remedy's senior graphics programmer erik jansson calls the tech "the same kind of leap on the ps5 that pssr brought to ps5 pro," saying that "qssr gives control resonant a much more stable and detailed image. ".

Sony says that "developers are just getting started" with the tech, and that more games should be adding QSSR support "in the coming months.

PS6 doesn't need more power, ex-PlayStation boss says, because "true innovation" would be making a $300 console again.

#835. Ocarina of Time Remake Finally Gives Zelda’s Saddest Story the Attention It Deserves

📅 13 Nov 2026

Ocarina of Time Remake Finally Gives Zelda’s Saddest Story the Attention It Deserves

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/ocarina-of-time-remake-finally-gives-zelda-s-saddest-story-the-attention-it-deserves/

Berdasarkan laporan, covering the video games industry since 2017, with experience in news, articles, and reviews. Currently a writer at DualShockers and gaming magazines.

Diungkapkan bahwa after nearly 30 years, the remake of the legend of zelda: ocarina of time is finally here, and it's already winning over critics and fans alike – myself included. As I highlighted in my review, this new version embodies what a modern remake should be: an experience that embraces contemporary improvements without losing the old soul of the classic we all love!.

Berdasarkan laporan, and one of the things i've always loved about ocarina of time is how many curious characters are scattered throughout hyrule. Some have surprisingly elaborate backstories, while others barely give you enough information to understand what's going on. More often than not, you need to be genuinely curious to piece together their stories and figure out what they're doing in the world.

Sebagaimana diketahui, my favorite example, by far, is grog, a rather strange-looking punk who barely appeared in the original game but arguably had one of its saddest stories. Much of what made his character so fascinating came from the lovely fan theories surrounding his family and his mysterious disappearance.

Sebagaimana diketahui, to my surprise, the switch 2 remake doesn't just subtly address some of those theories, but it also expands grog's story in ways that make his already tragic arc considerably more meaningful. And to appreciate just how much has changed, we first need to revisit what made this little side story so memorable in the first place.

Diungkapkan bahwa first things first, let's remember how grog's story unfolded in the original ocarina of time. The character only appeared in two locations throughout the entire adventure: beneath a tree in Kakariko Village at night as Child Link, and later in the Lost Woods as Adult Link.

Berdasarkan laporan, in kakariko village, you'll find him sitting beneath the tree in the center of town, looking rather miserable. Talk to him, and you'll quickly discover that he's not exactly the friendliest person around. He's withdrawn, bitter, and apparently hates just about everyone – including Link, simply for daring to approach him! And that's pretty much all you get from this first encounter.

To my surprise, the Switch 2 remake doesn't just subtly address some of those theories, but it also expands Grog's story in ways that make his already tragic arc considerably more meaningful.

Sebagaimana diketahui, his second appearance, however, is where things get interesting. As Adult Link, you can find Grog in the Lost Woods, but getting him to appear requires a little detour. First, you need to talk to the Cucco Lady in Kakariko Village, who turns out to be Grog's sister. She explains that he had a falling-out with their father, the village's Master Craftsman, and eventually left home. She's worried about him, though, so she gives you an egg that eventually hatches into Cojiro, Grog's beloved blue Cucco.

Berdasarkan laporan, after using cojiro to wake up talon in kakariko village, you can take the cucco into the lost woods. That's when you'll finally find Grog again, now seven years later, sitting in a rather strange, almost lifeless state. However, showing him Cojiro seems to snap him out of it, and he asks you to take an Odd Mushroom to the Granny's Potion Shop so she can prepare a medicine for him.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's just one problem: when you return with the medicine, grog is nowhere to be found. Instead, you're greeted by Fado, one of the Kokiri children, who explains that he disappeared into the Lost Woods. She also tells you that adults who get lost in the forest turn into Stalfos – those skeletal enemies that have been giving Link a hard time throughout the adventure.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and just like that, grog's story appears to come to an end. The implication is pretty heartbreaking: the troubled young man who left home after a disagreement with his father has seemingly lost himself in the forest, never to return.

Berdasarkan laporan, but even that brief story leaves plenty of unanswered questions. What exactly happened between Grog and his father? Why was he so unhappy? And what was the medicine supposed to cure? The original game never gave us definitive answers, leaving players to connect the dots through scattered dialogue and a handful of subtle clues. Thankfully, the remake finally gives us a much closer look at what was going on!.

Some of the original's most charming quirks from Zelda: Ocarina of Time didn't make the journey.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of the most interesting additions in the remake is a new time system that allows the day-night cycle to progress naturally even while you're exploring towns and villages. Outside of more contained areas, such as dungeons and minigame shops, NPCs now follow their own schedules, appearing in different locations and going about their daily routines.

It's a relatively small change, but it makes Hyrule feel considerably more alive – and if you're a fan of Majora's Mask, you'll probably appreciate the familiar feeling of watching characters follow their own little agendas instead of simply standing around waiting for Link to show up!.

Outside of more contained areas, such as dungeons and minigame shops, NPCs now follow their own schedules, appearing in different locations and going about their daily routines.

Diungkapkan bahwa more importantly, this new system gives us additional opportunities to learn about grog when playing as child link. He's officially identified as the Master Craftsman's Son, making his connection to the village's grumpy carpenter much clearer from the beginning. For starters, you can now find him during the day near the entrance to Kakariko Village's graveyard. Talk to him (or simply get close enough to hear him mumbling to himself) and you'll discover that his hatred for practically everything is closely tied to his strained relationship with his father.

Diungkapkan bahwa and speaking of the master craftsman, the remake also gives us a better look at his daily routine. He and his assistants no longer spend all their time repeating the same actions in the same spots. Instead, they're spread throughout the village, and they even gather in front of the central tree for a meeting as the day comes to an end.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, talking to the assistants reveals that they also find their boss rather difficult to deal with. Yet, interestingly enough, none of those complaints ever seem to involve Grog. He's a grumpy, demanding man who seems to have a complaint about just about everything. While his son is clearly consumed by their strained relationship, the Master Craftsman barely acknowledges that anything is wrong – or just wants to ignore it.

Diungkapkan bahwa but my favorite addition is that you can actually follow grog around kakariko village throughout the day. He eventually gets up from his spot and sneaks behind a pile of bricks near the construction site overseen by his father. There, he quietly mutters that he needs to wait for the Master Craftsman to leave before he can go inside.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and when night finally falls, grog makes his way back to the central tree, recreating the exact scene we remember from the original game. It's such a small sequence, but it adds an entirely new layer to his character. We no longer just see a miserable young man sitting beneath a tree. We see someone who is actively avoiding his father, seemingly unable to find a way to repair their relationship. And considering what we eventually learn about Grog, that little detail becomes even more heartbreaking.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the remake also expands grog's story when playing as adult link, particularly through additional dialogue with his sister and mother. As in the original, you'll only encounter Grog in the Lost Woods once you reach the point in the Biggoron Sword side quest where Cojiro has turned blue. However, the Cucco Lady now has considerably more information to share about why her brother left home in the first place.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, according to her, grog didn't want to follow the family business. While their father expected him to become a carpenter, Grog wanted to work with animals, something he was particularly passionate about and apparently quite good at. The Master Craftsman strongly disapproved of this decision, and their disagreement eventually caused a complete breakdown in their relationship.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this is a pretty significant addition because it finally gives us a clearer picture of what happened between the two. Grog wasn't simply a rebellious young man who decided to leave home. He had his own dreams and interests, but his father couldn't accept that his son wanted a different future.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after hearing this, you can head into the lost woods and follow the original sequence. Grog is still there, seemingly trapped in the same strange state, and showing him Cojiro produces the same reaction as before. He snaps out of it and asks you to take the Odd Mushroom to the Granny's Potion Shop.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, granny also has a few new things to say! she confirms that grog has been acting foolishly by distancing himself from his family, adding another perspective to the conflict. It's a small exchange, but it helps establish that this isn't just a disagreement between a father and son. So yes, the entire family has been affected by Grog's departure.

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake has finally been released, and fans have already discovered several game-breaking glitches.

Diungkapkan bahwa unfortunately, things take the same tragic turn when you return to the lost woods with the medicine. Grog is gone, and Fado is waiting in his place. This time, however, the encounter is considerably more unsettling. She immediately notices the medicine's smell and desperately asks you to hand it over, offering a tool Grog left behind in exchange. Then, she explains that adults who enter the forest and lose their way, just like Grog apparently did, eventually turn into Stalfos.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but the story doesn't quite end there. You can return to Kakariko Village and talk to the Cucco Lady again, who provides even more information about her brother. In other words, her own life has also been shaped by the same family conflict that drove him away. She explains that she now takes care of the Cuccos because Grog left home after refusing to become a carpenter. And she’s also still hopeful that her brother is okay and will be back someday.

Sebagaimana diketahui, finally, you can take the tool grog left behind to the master craftsman, who is now waiting near the entrance to gerudo valley. He recognizes it as something he had given his son and explains that he had asked Grog to return it personally. Instead, his son apparently chose to send someone else to do the job.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's a rather dismissive reaction, especially considering everything we've learned about their relationship. Even after Grog has disappeared, his father seems more concerned about the way he returned a tool than the fact that he may never see his son again.

Sebagaimana diketahui, what always fascinated me about grog's story in the original ocarina of time was how much the game managed to communicate without ever explicitly explaining anything. It gave us scattered clues, brief conversations, and seemingly unrelated characters who slowly revealed their connections to one another. The rest was left to the players, who spent years discussing theories about Grog, his family, and what might have happened to him.

Diungkapkan bahwa the remake takes those little pieces and finally puts them together. We now know exactly why Grog left home, what caused the rift with his father, and how his decision affected the rest of his family. And while the game still leaves some things open to interpretation, his story feels much more complete.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, what i particularly love about this addition is that it doesn't try to turn grog into some incredibly important character or give him an elaborate questline that changes the entire adventure. Instead, it simply gives more attention to a person who was already part of Hyrule, allowing us to understand the struggles that were always hiding behind his grumpy attitude.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and there's something genuinely sad about realizing that the stalfos we encounter throughout the game might have once been people with their own dreams, families, and reasons for entering the forest. After all, he wasn't some nameless traveler who got lost. Grog's story makes that possibility feel much more personal. He was a young man who wanted to follow his own path, but never managed to find a way back home.

Diungkapkan bahwa we now know exactly why grog left home, what caused the rift with his father, and how his decision affected the rest of his family. And while the game still leaves some things open to interpretation, his story feels much more complete.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i also love how this expanded story fits into what makes ocarina of time so special! hyrule isn't just a collection of locations for link to explore, but a world filled with people whose lives continue beyond the moments when we interact with them. Sometimes, all it takes is a few extra lines of dialogue or a character walking to a different spot at sunset to make that world feel considerably richer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, of course, i still have one personal theory i'd rather believe. After all, if there's anyone who deserves a happy ending surrounded by the animals he loves, it's Grog. Maybe Grog didn't actually turn into a Stalfos. Maybe he discovered the secret entrance to Termina, found his way to Clock Town, and eventually became the Cucco-loving man we meet in Majora's Mask. And after everything this remake has revealed about his family, I think I'll keep believing that version of the story.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's a sad reality that several major games companies have either tried to use ai in development, or are actively doing so. Pearl Abyss, the studio behind this year's Crimson Desert, can now be counted among them, confirming the technology is being integrated across the business.

Berdasarkan laporan, the publisher and developer revealed this in a recent earnings letter. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, that much is good to hear, but my cynicism remains. #838. How To Get The Goldblaze In Phantom Blade Zero

📅 13 Nov 2026

How To Get The Goldblaze In Phantom Blade Zero

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/phantom-blade-zero-quick-hand-zhangs-treasures-pangzhen/

Pangzhen is massive, but if you know where to look, you can still fulfill Quick Hand Zhang's request.

Berdasarkan laporan, quick hand zhang is one of the more interesting mysteries in phantom blade zero, and he offers some of the finest rewards for your efforts. Four main areas on the world map contain treasures for him to find, and because Pangzhen is the largest, it can be tough to spot them all.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, luckily, those glowing green chests aren't hidden too deep in any corners, but they aren't always where you might check. Whether they're hidden after a boss or locked behind a traversal Phantom Edge, you can spot all of Quick Hand Zhang's Pangzhen treasures in no time with a little help.

Sebagaimana diketahui, to get to quick hand zhang's pangzhen hideout, make your way through myst's tavern and cross the bridge to the backstreet archway bell. Head up the stairs, and you'll find a large courtyard where you'll have to fight Wu Xuan, The Fallen General.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after defeating him, turn right from where you came in; that's north on the map. A path to the left leads up a large staircase, but go right and follow the path through a building surrounded by jars. Through that building, you'll find wooden boards you can climb, and you'll notice the glint of a throwing knife with coins hanging from it.

Diungkapkan bahwa at the top, head straight into the building with another throwing knife, and you'll find the bell for zhang's hideout (pangzhen). Head down that ladder, and you'll find Zhang waiting for you amid his many treasures.

The places some people will hide their treasure.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to get to the tiger paperweight, you've got to complete a few steps. First, start at the bell at Huang Manor Crossroads and run west across the courtyard to the bell at Myst's Tavern. The first time you come through here, you'll face a challenging fight before you can explore the area.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a locked door leads to a building called tianxiang pavilion. To get the key, go into Myst's Tavern and speak with the Leading Opera Actress puppet. She wants her fan back, which is located in the Tianxiang Pavilion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, she will tell you about someone who always hung around the pavilion and loved the scent of the performers. He will have the key, but you have to draw him out. The actress puppet will give you some of her makeup and tell you to burn it in the incense burner in the alley outside the tavern. When you do, a few enemies will attack you, and after you beat them, you'll get the key.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, from there, head back to the locked door and open it, where you'll face a lot of enemies. Clear out the first floor, and on the second floor, you'll find a glowing green chest next to some decorative panels. Open it up to find the Tiger Paperweight.

Diungkapkan bahwa after you defeat wu xuan, the fallen general, keep heading west, and you'll find a building to the left or a stone archway straight ahead. Either path leads to an open courtyard where you'll have to fight a few enemies.

At the back of this courtyard is a building with red lanterns hanging outside the door, and inside you'll see the chest that contains the Ink Stick for Quick Hand Zhang.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once you've reached the narrow alley residence 2nd floor, head out of the building and take the zipline all the way down. Take out the enemies in the area, then climb the small staircase through a wooden archway directly ahead of where you land from the zipline.

Diungkapkan bahwa you can go through that building; inside is a memory flower and the chest containing the carved-edge inkstone. If you keep going through that building, you'll also find the remains of the dog for the tale, Dahuang, after fighting a few frenzied hounds.

Diungkapkan bahwa to get the jade brush rest, you'll need to get your hands on you loong's deluge. Then go to the bell at the Marketplace in Pangzhen, head down the stairs, and make your way to the flaming brambles blocking the path straight ahead. This is the first spot in the city where you can use the Deluge.

Sebagaimana diketahui, once you've gone through the opening, take out all the enemies that are waiting for you. Then, turn towards the low rooftops just to the left of where you came in and use the Hunter's Chain Sickle to get onto the roof. Climb the wooden box with scratch marks and make a left at the top.

Diungkapkan bahwa keep to the right by the stone wall and follow it until you reach a landing. An enemy will be there that you can easily assassinate, and the chest with the Jade Brush Rest will be just to their left.

Berdasarkan laporan, once you've returned all four items to quick hand zhang, he will reward you with the goldblaze rifle. This ranged Phantom Edge lets you knock down hanging items throughout the world, in place of the Feather Bow.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in combat, you fire the goldblaze the same way you would the bow, by activating your phantom edge while it's equipped. Pulling the trigger once fires one round, but you can pull it twice to continue the firing sequence, which uses one full Remnant Spark.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a full firing sequence uses the same amount of remnant spark as firing once, so it often pays to fire twice anyway. However, the Goldblaze does the most damage against enemies that haven't taken any damage in combat yet.

Once you've found something you like, you've got to make sure it stays worth using.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the latest q3, 2026 data from market researchers mercury research suggests an increase in market share for desktop cpus of 5. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the increase in market share is almost too big to be believed, which is certainly one theory as to what's going on. A rounding error or errant data—though Mercury Research have been pretty locked in in the past. Both Intel and AMD cite their numbers when it makes them look good.

Mercury Research put its hands up to say it isn't totally sure what happened, either:.

"It's difficult to know the driver of this for sure, but we speculate that due to the lower mobile CPU demand, Intel could allocate more products to the desktop market, which normally sees a significant demand increase in the third quarter, and Intel had been under-supplying this market earlier in 2026.

"AMD, however, did not appear to have a seasonal increase, which resulted in Intel having a very large sequential and on-year gain in desktop CPU market share," Mercury Research says.

The PC Gamer Circuit Breaker newsletter breaks down the latest PC gaming tech, and finds you the best deals on the best products.

The other theory presented by the market research company is that AMD has "greater exposure" to gaming—by way of offering the best gaming chips.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we believe another component to intel's gains here is amd's greater exposure to the pc gaming market, which has suffered due to supply constraints of gaming gpus. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa mercury research say 'supply constraints' when it's more like prices are so absurd for gpus, ram, and storage as to be comical, which lends to a general malaise among gamers to building a new pc. But, either way, this theory makes some sense. Intel still holds huge sway with system builders and OEMs, the likes of which are buying up both new and old (DDR4-compatible) chips for cheap systems. And not just gaming systems, which we see both Intel and AMD get a fairly decent share of during our weekly trawling for gaming PC deals.

Diungkapkan bahwa amd also admitted it is has a supply deficit at the moment; demand is outstripping supply. It's working to close that deficit, but what it means by that is grow its datacentre chip business more in the coming months and years. After all, AMD is a datacentre company now.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i wouldn't mistake intel 'gaining market share' as a healthy sign for the company or the wider industry. Mercury Research suggested desktop CPU volumes had seen a "large drop" in Q2, 2026, and both Intel and AMD are said to have seen more than a 10% drop in shipments for mobile chips in Q3, 2026. They're fighting for scraps in the consumer market.

Intel has seen a momentous share price drop as of late due to weak sale expectations due to a crappy PC market, but AMD is set to beat Intel for total revenue by the end of year.

#841. PlayStation Adds Major Feature to Marvel’s Spider-Man 2, ARC Raiders, and More

📅 13 Nov 2026

PlayStation Adds Major Feature to Marvel’s Spider-Man 2, ARC Raiders, and More

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/playstation-adds-major-feature-to-marvel-s-spider-man-2-arc-raiders-and-more/

Daniel is a lifelong gamer with a love for various genres and gameplay styles who enjoys exploring games and playing from various angles.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a big component of what makes the ps5 an attractive console, besides just being able to play particular games you can’t play elsewhere, is the console’s various built-in graphical perks. Since the PS5 first launched in 2020, its hardware power has remained one of its definitive perks, with the PS5 Pro in particular taking matters further with the inclusion of PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution, better known as PSSR.

In this list, we discuss some of the best PS4 games to play with the PS5 Pro's Image Quality Enhancements option.

Sebagaimana diketahui, even though the ps5 already has a few years under its belt, the brand isn’t just resting on its proverbial laurels and letting its existing hardware carry it. New advancements in graphical technology are coming out all the time, and even games that looked pretty stunning when they first dropped like Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 can always look a little bit better.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to that end, playstation has added support for one of its up-and-coming graphical frameworks, quick spectral super resolution (qssr), to several more games in the ps5’s library following its initial launch last month exclusively in marvel’s wolverine and ghost of yotei. The newly-upscaled games include Marvel’s Spider-Man 2, Control Resonant, ARC Raiders, The Finals, No Man’s Sky, and Hell Let Loose: Vietnam.

Berdasarkan laporan, in case you forgot, qssr is a proprietary ai upscaling framework created in tandem between playstation and amd. This framework came about from Project Amethyst, an ongoing developmental effort between both companies that also gave rise to PSSR. According to the official announcement of the newly-upscaled games on the official PlayStation news blog, QSSR provides “sharper details, cleaner edges, and more stable images than traditional upscalers,” and since it’s built on the same platform as PSSR, it’s easy for games that already use that framework to incorporate it.

QSSR is a proprietary AI upscaling framework created in tandem between PlayStation and AMD.

Diungkapkan bahwa in that news post, playstation got quotes from all of the improved games’ developers on how qssr has affected their respective titles. Insomniac Games’ Mike Fitzgerald said that, after incorporating the tech into the launch of Marvel’s Wolverine, the studio decided to go back and add it to Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 as well. “We’re excited for players to swing back into our 2023 title and see QSSR’s exciting image stability and sharpness benefits in both Fidelity and Performance modes,” he said.

Sony has introduced a brand-new AI-powered upscaling technology called Quick Spectral Super Resolution.

Sebagaimana diketahui, remedy entertainment’s erik jansson said that “qssr gives control resonant a much more stable and detailed image, and we’ve worked closely with sony to have it ready in an update coming in december. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, embark studios’ mikael linderholm said that qssr support will be coming soon to arc raiders and the finals, and said that his studio is “very happy to see sony’s continued investment in playstation technology translate into meaningful improvements for all players. ”.

While I’m personally of the belief that graphics alone don’t automatically make a game good, it is still pretty interesting to see the degree to which graphical fidelity can be improved, especially as we start to run up against the proverbial limits of realism.

Sebagaimana diketahui, obviously, the use of ai in games is a feisty topic, particularly in presentation elements like voice acting. In the specific use case of graphics, some efforts like NVIDIA’s AI-powered DLSS5 and its widely-mocked “yassify filter” on character models is probably not the optimal way to be going about this. Rather than trying to generate and overwrite existing graphics with slop, something like QSSR is closer to the ideal, taking what’s already present and merely smoothing out the rougher edges of the environmental rendering process.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, playstation has promised that this tech will be coming to more games, ending its news post by saying, “developers are just getting started, and we’re excited to keep working with them to bring qssr to more games on ps5 in the coming months. ”.

Two classic apocalyptic shooters have received free modern graphical facelifts.

#843. 10 Best Soulslikes With Fluid Movement Mechanics

📅 13 Nov 2026

10 Best Soulslikes With Fluid Movement Mechanics

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/best-soulslikes-with-fluid-movement-mechanics/

Ronald is a video game journalist with more than 10 years of experience in the industry, working on several of the most important Spanish websites.

Soulslikes represent a subgenre of ARPGs with quite distinct characteristics, including various constraints intended to establish their aggressive and challenging nature.

Features such as combat that prioritize functionality over spectacle, as well as limited and mundane traversal methods, are a constant among Soulsborne games' descendants, precisely because they exploit these limitations to create immersive experiences.

It's an incredibly delicate balance because, if poorly executed, it leads to clunky campaigns where the mere act of moving from one place to another can become tedious, though there are also exceptions that prove the rule.

Therefore, in order to shed light on these anomalies and draw on the contributions of titles with a lighter approach to the genre, here are the ten best Soulslikes with fluid movement mechanics.

Since I first played it, I think I've been one of Elden Ring Nightreign's most fervent critics, as it's a title that constantly contradicts me to the point of including it in a list of Soulslikes despite being developed by FromSoftware.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, if there's one thing i not only can't complain about, but which i sincerely find masterful within the genre, it's the way it agilizes movement to a maximum. It gives each playthrough a dynamism uncommon in the genre.

Thanks to the characters' speed, their ability to climb walls, the spirit streams to jump to incredible heights, and the Spectral Hawk flight, which allows you to hover over areas with remarkable accuracy regarding your landing spot, simply wandering around is quite satisfying—a statement I can't make about almost any other title of this kind.

Is it cheating to include a game from the original influences' roots, which is also more of a roguelite, in this list? Perhaps, yet this is the first time the study has taken movement so seriously, so it deserves the mention.

Phantom Blade Zero is a fusion of traditional action-adventure elements with ideas borrowed from both Soulslikes and Metroidvanias, creating an extravagant yet highly satisfying cocktail.

The game boasts a staggering array of flashy weapons whose visual grandeur is breathtaking, especially in the hands of an ultra-powerful protagonist who is capable of putting those tools at the movement's mercy.

With the ability to sprint at high speed, swing on chains to cross gaps, run along walls, and use a grappling hook to reach high points, this title refuses to simply block doors on one side but instead strives to add depth to the exploration.

Unfortunately, most of these mechanics are prompts that can only be activated at specific, controlled locations, but they are more than enough to make Phantom Blade Zero a more dynamic game than average in this regard.

If you’re looking for the best FromSoftware-inspired ARPGs, I recommend the best Soulslikes based on critics' scores.

Speaking of middle ground, Nine Sols takes Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice's combat system and Hollow Knight's perspective, platforming, and exploration to create one of the decade's most wonderful indie games.

While it leans towards one or the other inspiration depending on the context, it's incredible how Yi soars across the maps once you've unlocked all of his movement tools, which are simple in concept but incredibly rewarding in execution.

Surely, it's nothing more than double jumps, dashes, and kicking enemies' skulls to get airborne, but it's enough to perfectly complement his prodigious combat mechanics.

Even if Nine Sols had terrible traversal, it would still be great because of how it shines in all the other elements, making the polished movement mechanics all the more admirable.

Especially considering it was released when Soulslikes were still in their infancy, Salt and Sanctuary was a major surprise, perfectly adapting the genre's formula to the 2D side-scrolling perspective.

With a wealth of secrets hidden behind the movement abilities you progressively unlock, it's a title that knows how to make platforming satisfying and imbue it with meaning beyond simply moving from point A to point B.

When you first change the gravity orientation, for example, you realize Salt and Sanctuary isn't just a great action RPG with challenging bosses and outstanding worldbuilding, but a game that understood that part of the Dark Souls trilogy's charm lay in how it transformed each new tool into a way to reinterpret the levels.

Years have passed, and I still believe it's the purest and most outstanding 2D Soulslike among those that don't venture too far into other genres, as few have captured the essence of their inspiration as well as this one.

Team Ninja is among the developers that have placed the most emphasis on the Soulslike genre, and while Rise of the Ronin isn't their most outstanding iteration, it certainly stands out when movement is the key factor.

Based on its open-world concept, the game boasts one of the most inventive arrays of traversal tools the genre has ever seen, offering a horse, a grappling hook, and a glider to facilitate the discovery of its expansive map.

If you compare it to direct peers like Ghost of Tsushima, it might fall short, but if the conversation turns to previous titles from the studio, such as Nioh, or games from FromSoftware, like the aforementioned Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice, the tone shifts.

Ultimately, Rise of the Ronin combines a myriad of ideas that will appeal to some and deter others, though the fact that it brings with it a form of exploration that avoids relying solely on walking and fast travel is undeniable.

If you’re still waiting for the next FromSoftware game, check out these ten Soulslikes that most people haven’t played but definitely should.

Shattered - Tale of the Forgotten King is a fascinating title due to its attempt, although often erratic, to combine 3D combat with side-scrolling platforming, which is a unique approach even outside Soulslikes' spaces.

The combat is present and functional enough to sustain the experience for the hours it lasts, yet what truly catches the eye is the movement, as it feels like Journey thanks to its flow and smoothness.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in addition to its perspective shifts, which alternate between combat and 2. 5D traversal, moving through its open world on a hoverboard feels compelling, mainly because of how unexpected it is to encounter such a mechanic in this type of game.

Indeed, there isn't much to do once you're in free-roaming areas, but since this article focuses on movement mechanics, Shattered - Tale of the Forgotten King keeps its place among the most distinguished in the genre.

While the first game in the series was pure action-adventure, and the second shifted towards open-world RPG elements, Darksiders 3 changed course once again, this time aiming to be both a Soulslike and a Metroidvania.

By merging the level design and combat system of the former with the progression and backtracking mechanics of the latter, Gunfire Games created a phenomenal symphony that truly draws on its hack-and-slash heritage.

Darksiders 3 embraces grandeur, allowing you to transform into diverse avatars to double jump and burn through barriers, glide on air currents, become an energy ball to cling to walls, or even walk on water.

If you add to all these different ways of traversing the use of Fury's whip to swing from platform to platform, the only logical conclusion left to draw is that Darksiders 3 is a marvel when it comes to moving around.

Another Crab's Treasure is among the most creatively designed Soulslikes we've had the pleasure of enjoying this decade, and its movement mechanics are anything but an exception.

The game's levels are extremely vertical and branching, so it needed movement methods that could handle its demanding platforming sections with jumps, climbs, glides, and directional grappling hooks that take you from one ledge to another in a matter of seconds.

It's no wonder the game has become a favorite among speedrunners; its open areas combined with its fluid maneuverability create the perfect breeding ground for exploring the limits of gravity and Krill's stamina.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it has incredible bosses, extensive customization, a remarkable audiovisual component, strong thematic cohesion. Another Crab's Treasure is a complete package, and thankfully, Aggro Crab didn't leave platforming out of the equation.

If you're looking for community-endorsed experiences, I recommend you try these ten Soulslikes where the user score is higher than the critic score.

After Hollow Knight established the Soulslite variant as an alternative for those who didn't want to fully commit to the formula, Hollow Knight: Silksong further solidified its fresh take on the genre.

Diungkapkan bahwa the loss of resources upon death, save points that also serve as locations to modify your character, pattern-based bosses, cryptic lore. We all know the points of convergence, but where it truly breaks away is in its movement.

Even when compared to pure platformers, Hollow Knight: Silksong possesses a unique grace when it comes to traversal, with an incredibly agile Hornet who's capable of using her abilities in unique ways to facilitate her journey through Pharloom.

Sebagaimana diketahui, grabbing ledges, bouncing off environmental elements, flying on air currents, leaping between walls, using your needle to propel yourself forward. The array of abilities available during the game is incredible and, above all, very satisfying, especially when you learn to chain them together and run without anything or anyone stopping you.

Nevertheless, beyond the games made by FromSoftware itself or titles that only tangentially touch on the genre, the purest example of a Soulslike with the most fluid movement mechanics is Valor Mortis.

Coming from Ghostrunner, One More Level leveraged its undeniable aptitude for first-person platforming and created an entire world around it, giving us an adventure where you jump, dash, swoop, and grapple with impressive ease.

Valor Mortis is already a striking project for its combination of such divergent concepts as stealth, first-person shooting, and ARPG combat based on parries, though adding such natural platforming sections on top of all that is simply incredible.

I spent the entire campaign amazed by the simple fact that Soulslikes don't move this fast and seamlessly, much less in sequences where you're speeding around in a minecart or running across platforms that are collapsing because a giant monster is attacking you with its tentacles.

Diungkapkan bahwa valor mortis is a game that can be criticized for many things, but not for its movement. In fact, this is an area where it excels so much that other games should strive to emulate its talent.

From the indie ecosystem to productions approaching AAA measures, these are ten Soulslike franchises that should come back by 2027.

#846. A.O.T 3 Final Preview: Possibly Shaping Up To Be One of the Best Anime Adaptation Video Games

📅 13 Nov 2026

A.O.T 3 Final Preview: Possibly Shaping Up To Be One of the Best Anime Adaptation Video Games

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/aot3-final-preview/

This is DualShockers' preview of Attack on Titan 3, the penultimate entry in the AOT Video Game series developed by Omega Force and published by Koei Tecmo.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the attack on titan series by hajime isayama is genuinely one of the most important works for fans worldwide. The show has sparked a massive debate over its controversial ending, but putting that aside, you can’t argue with its overall impact: brilliant storytelling and action that fans will remember for ages.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dualshockers played a. T. O. 3 at a preview event, slashing Titans and humans alike, with the entirety of Attack on Titan's story being adapted.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and now, eight years after the last game in the franchise, koei tecmo’s omega force is back with attack on titan 3. The full game launches next month in December on the PS5, Xbox Series X and S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2. At DualShockers, we had the opportunity to check out a final preview build, and I must say, as a veteran fan of both the series and the games, they’re truly going out swinging on this one.

Berdasarkan laporan, one of the biggest changes in attack on titan 3 is how it approaches its storytelling. You see, back then there was this evident problem that Omega Force could only adapt parts of the story since the anime was still airing, which meant that you weren’t going to get the full package, or at least, where the manga had reached in contrast to the show.

Diungkapkan bahwa with aot3, it still remains true to the storytelling presentation of the prior entries. But rather than simply allowing you to relive the anime's biggest moments through the familiar cast, this game once again introduces an original character for you to create and customize.

Berdasarkan laporan, our oc character suffers a devastating loss after their previous squad is wiped out during a titan encounter beyond the walls. So, after developing a fear of Titans from the incident, they're removed from active duty and assigned to instruct the 104th Cadet Corps. This gives you a chance to interact with familiar faces such as Eren, Armin, and Mikasa before eventually graduating from the instructor role and taking command of your own reconnaissance squad.

Diungkapkan bahwa this approach is very promising because it gives omega force a chance to explore parts of the attack on titan universe that don't necessarily receive the same attention in the anime. You're not another member of Eren's generation experiencing everything alongside him. But instead, you're an experienced soldier watching these young cadets grow into the people who will eventually shape humanity's fate.

There are also original story events and character interactions designed to expand on the relationships between your character and the existing cast, which is a very nice gesture for us longtime fans if we want something new from this whole experience, especially for characters that didn’t get a ton of screen time in the main show or earlier seasons.

Diungkapkan bahwa dualshockers spoke to a. T. O. 3 producer Hideo Suzuki about the new Titans, balancing grittiness with arcade action, and why there's no romance.

Of course, none of this hard work over the past 8 years would matter nearly as much without the one thing that makes AOT such an exciting property to adapt into a video game: its combat.

Sebagaimana diketahui, fortunately, omega force hasn't simply brought back the same omni-directional mobility (odm) system from attack on titan 2 and called it a day. The studio has made several adjustments to how you can move around the battlefield, giving the familiar grappling mechanics far more flexibility while also adding new layers of strategy to Titan encounters.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, previously, much of the combat revolved around attaching your odm anchors to a titan, reeling yourself towards it, and timing your attack to strike its nape. While that foundation remains intact, AOT3 has generally put more emphasis on identifying weaknesses before committing to an attack. The gameplay rhythm now feels more like a hybrid between a strategic action game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you can now target individual body parts, allowing you to damage limbs, interrupt attacks, and temporarily immobilize titans before going for the finishing blow. This is especially important because these guys are much more aggressive, with new attack patterns that require you to watch their movements rather than blindly rush toward their weak spots.

One of the biggest changes in Attack on Titan 3 is how it approaches its storytelling.

Sebagaimana diketahui, other noticeably uplifting additions include the maneuverability upgrades and defensive options. You can attach yourself to certain surfaces to reposition, use boost jumps to gain additional height, and even dive or slide along the ground to avoid incoming attacks, which is very useful when dealing with larger Titans during their one-on-one boss fight encounters where you have to stun them for the one-hit kill from their nape area.

Diungkapkan bahwa as for defensive mechanics, you can use well-timed dodges and parries to defend against incoming attacks. Combat Arts also add another layer of progression, giving you access to powerful unlockable special attacks as you increase your military rank. It's an ambitious evolution of the combat from the prior entries, one that I’m very excited to experience to a greater extent with the full release.

The overall game’s flow looks extremely ambitious, and what I mean is that the game has three working gears in motion for the full package here: interacting with your squadmates at the base, the main story missions that progress the campaign, and your Exterior missions.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the latter is one of the highlights, as it lets you freely explore the world with your squad in tow to hunt down more titans and fulfil different requests from npcs you come across. It’s essentially a way to give you more gameplay freedom instead of railroading you from start to finish to showcase the anime's main story, and doing Exterior missions also lets you reap additional rewards and useful upgrade materials, which you definitely need and can’t skip since they let you enhance your equipment.

Diungkapkan bahwa and speaking of gameplay freedom, you can put any doubts to rest about whether you can jump into this game without prior experience with how the first two games worked. There are a bunch of accessibility and control scheme options that let any player easily enjoy the story, but if you want total control, you can turn off any options that automate the combat mechanics, which I honestly prefer since you’re way more vulnerable to mistakes that way, and it makes the game more punishing.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, still, i can promise you that attack on titan 3 is genuinely worth having on your radar for the december releases. With how much I got to sample here, I can’t wait to see how more of the character interactions play out, how the talent points fully work with everything in place, along with how the noteworthy battles in the show play out here, and that includes the whole sections of Marley from Season 4 and beyond. It is a lot to look forward to on my side, but I’ll gladly march into battle head-on with my goth Scout Corps Captain.

Xbox has just released a new gameplay trailer for Fable showing one of the game’s quests, but it might not have been the best showcase since it’s being bombarded with dislikes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ever since the initial reveal trailer more than six years ago, fable has easily been one of xbox’s most highly anticipated games. That excitement has only increased with each gameplay showcase and trailer, which have shown just how far Playground Games has pushed the original trilogy’s mechanics, even if the reboot is leaving some things behind.

Berdasarkan laporan, of course, while most people are looking forward to fable, it’s also been a target for online hate campaigns ever since the second trailer. Recent showings of Fable, including one that was focused on combat, have notably had a lot of backlash, and that drama has all come to a head with the latest trailer for the game.

Diungkapkan bahwa earlier this week, the official fable youtube account shared a new trailer for the game that highlights a quest where the hero and arden investigate what’s happening to oakshire. The gameplay admittedly isn’t the most exciting thing in the world, since it mostly just shows the Hero walking through the area, getting in a fight, and talking to Arden before a big plot tease at the end.

Fable will let us hit on as many townsfolk as we want, but am I the only one who liked getting at least one proper romance option in Fable 3?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while it’s not a great showcase, the quest trailer is pretty harmless overall in my opinion and not that noteworthy. Diungkapkan bahwa one notable trend in the comments section is comparisons to dragon age: the veilguard, with one popular comment calling it “fable age: the veilguard”. Others are simply calling it out as a “disappointing” trailer that ended too soon and didn’t really show anything of substance. As one user puts it, “Is that really the best they can show?”.

The Fable account is definitely seeing these negative comments too, as it’s heart-reacted the few positive ones praising the voice acting and graphics.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s not just the youtube video that’s being slammed, either, as xbox ceo asha sharma’s post about the trailer on twitter is also full of backlash and the usual “sweet baby inc” comments over two female characters. Some of it is clearly bad faith, but I’d be very hard-pressed to say the footage was worthy of a trailer.

It's been a long, hard road back to success for Sports Interactive, but FM 27 is the game I hoped it would be and so much more.

Trees Hate You Review: You’ll Enjoy Hating Them Back

Trees Hate You uses unpredictable traps and cartoon-style humor in a short, silly rage game, though its bugs and limited challenge may frustrate some.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s a very odd time in gaming where we’re seeing a lot more games coming out than ever before. Some are better than others, but many seem to simply have some fun and interesting premises that draw you in.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one such game would be trees hate you, which is a ridiculous rage game about being targeted by trees. Sounds like it shouldn’t be very good, but surprisingly the game’s Looney Tunes-esque approach to mechanics makes it an enjoyable game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i played the game for around four hours, though a speed run could be significantly quicker, and came away enjoying most of my time with the game. It isn’t a perfect game, but it is a fun game, especially if you’re just looking for a silly little rage game.

Berdasarkan laporan, it’s not a complex or complicated game in all reality, but that’s part of its charm. You play as a person who’s being hunted by trees for some reason or another and must navigate through several locations to finally reach your destination.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there’s very little in the way of story since virtually all of the information presented is through the visuals of the game. You’ll need to make your way through many dangerous traps that will change, sometimes seemingly at random.

It isn’t a perfect game, but it is a fun game, especially if you’re just looking for a silly little rage game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there are four “levels,” three of which are separated into smaller sections to make it more digestible. Each section has a central theme and introduces some new trees while finding creative ways to make you scream obscenities.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s a pretty short and sweet game that culminates in a very, very odd ending. There aren’t really any abilities to get or anything to make the game easier. From the outset of the game, you’ve got your movement buttons and whatever brain power you can muster.

Berdasarkan laporan, super meat boy 3d is still the same series you love, now with even more ways and directions to die over and over. Here's our full review!.

Berdasarkan laporan, for a lot of rage games, each section of the game is stagnant so that you can learn from your mistakes and grow smarter. In this game, that entire ideology is completely thrown out the window, and it makes it much more interesting to play.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for almost every section of the game, when you die you end up back at the last checkpoint, but you’ll notice that something might be a little different. Sometimes it’s a new tree popping up along the path or a new path entirely.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this seemed to change at random upon death, and figuring out how to handle the changes added a new layer to the game. For some, it’s going to be frustrating in a different way, since it does change, meaning memorizing the path isn’t particularly helpful.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i thoroughly enjoyed that change of pace. As a big fan of great roguelikes, seeing that sort of game design appear here gave me pause at first until I got used to it. It managed to keep the game fresh despite the short run time.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there was a lot about this game that i thoroughly enjoyed, but there is no denying that the game felt way too short. Perhaps that was because I simply had played through some other rage games recently that prepared me for this, but still I felt it could’ve been a much longer experience.

Diungkapkan bahwa being a short experience isn’t too bad, as there are a few things that you can grind for if you really want, such as coins and hats, but at the end of the day this is a game you could beat in a single session. I suppose I was hoping to have a bit more oomph out of the game, though what we did get was more than fine.

Berdasarkan laporan, there is a challenge mode that changes up some of the levels and makes things a bit more complicated with more traps and threats, but the levels will always remain the same between deaths. It was nice to provide the option to give players more bang for their buck.

Diungkapkan bahwa the game doesn’t really waste any time on things that aren’t humorous or torturing you, which is a big bonus. As I approached the end, though, I had hoped the game would surprise me and get a bit longer or more ridiculous, but there was no such luck.

If you're looking for experiences that aren't artificially prolonged, check out these ten fastest Metroidvanias to 100%.

Diungkapkan bahwa video games are not often known for their sense of humor, and even less so for their ability to utilize visual gags. Trees Hate You has decided to right this wrong by making what effectively feels like a Looney Tunes episode into an entire game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, at first it was just some slight things, moments that felt naturally funny because of the tension and ridiculousness of the game. That changed after a few levels when trees began to do whatever they pleased, seemingly just to mess with me.

Berdasarkan laporan, there is one tree in particular that embodies this ideology entirely. One tree blocks your path early on in the game by bending at insane angles to force you in another direction. This same tree will do this for the entirety of the game.

Berdasarkan laporan, you’ll come across a path sometime later, and suddenly out of the sky the tree will reach down and block your path. This was incredibly idiotic and amazing. I had to stop and try it again just to make sure I could see what exactly was going on.

Berdasarkan laporan, it’s a pretty hilarious game, especially when you run into those annoyingly funny moments that make you feel like you’ve been outsmarted by the trees. Even if you’re not a big fan of this kind of humor, it’s still enjoyable to see all the unique ways the trees manage to get you.

Berdasarkan laporan, this is going to be something that i think gets to be a little divisive amongst people who play the game. On the one hand, the game isn’t quite as difficult as it could be, but on the other hand, the changing mechanics could make it more difficult for some.

Berdasarkan laporan, i would’ve liked to see the game be a bit more difficult the first go around, but there is a challenge mode. It sort of balances out, giving everyone a chance to enjoy something about the game, but there were only a few sections that really got to me.

It’s a pretty hilarious game, especially when you run into those annoyingly funny moments that make you feel like you’ve been outsmarted by the trees.

Diungkapkan bahwa it feels like the game is more about trial and error rather than conquering any difficult mechanics, and that’s more than okay, but it does take away some of the feeling of accomplishment. In reality, it feels like the game is more designed to watch others fail than to be played itself.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ironically, there’s a lot of time to sit with what happens when you die in some crazy fashion. You’ll respawn at a checkpoint with virtually no risk, meaning you’ll never need to complete a past section a second time.

Berdasarkan laporan, trees hate you is an interesting rage game that leans more heavily into the absurdity of the genre than the actual rage. Still, it’s a hilarious and ridiculously fun game. You’re going to walk away from the game having enjoyed yourself immensely despite some of the more pressing issues. There are annoying bugs that will force you to start from a prior checkpoint, but all in all, the game is a very good time.

If you’re looking for a true video game challenge, I suggest you try these ten hardest Metroidvanias to 100%.
