The finale of the Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy dares to expand even further from its world to character customization.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you thought final fantasy 7 revelation was going to rein things in after the maximalist scale of final fantasy 7 rebirth, then think again. This is, after all, the finale of the Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy, so it's got to go out with a bang. Square Enix has also, so far, designed each instalment to be its own standalone RPG with a raft of new gameplay features rather than just a mere iteration of the next episode of the story.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while final fantasy 7 revelation is already confirmed to be the largest entry to date – literally so with a file size estimated to be up to 200gb – there's plenty of new features that make this stand out from the already colossal achievements of its predecessors. This may still be a single-player story-driven party-based action RPG set over a planet-sized open world, but the developers have cooked up a lot more that demonstrates why it wasn't just called Final Fantasy 7 Remake Part 3.

There's potentially still more that Square Enix will reveal as the finale's April 8 launch date approaches, but from our hands-on time and official announcements made so far, these are the eight new features coming to Final Fantasy 7 Revelation that we feel is going to make this the most definitive of all the remake releases to date.

With the remake trilogy drawing to a close early 2027, we get ready for the epic conclusion with our Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Big Preview across hands-on impressions, dev access, and deep dives into the whole adventure so far.

Diungkapkan bahwa final fantasy 7 rebirth had already given us the impossible with an open world that really does encompass a world, and while final fantasy 7 revelation adds to that with still several more locations, including mideel and wutai, its planetary scale has been magnified with verticality. You're not just fast-traveling to locations, but you have Cid's airship, the Highwind, which you can use to fly over any location and then jump out and parachute down seamlessly in real-time.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's already a huge change from the original game where you could only access part of the overworld if you had enough space to land the highwind. Instead of just warping to a set checkpoint, it also means if there's a nearby side quest marker, you can glide that way directly, or there might be another secret at a higher elevation you hadn't noticed before that's worth trying to land at to investigate. It's certainly a way to make revisiting places feel fresh again in Final Fantasy 7 Revelation.

Berdasarkan laporan, while final fantasy 7 rebirth had a new chocobo for each region, final fantasy 7 revelation reunites you with yellow-feathered chocobo piko from the grasslands, this time as your sole mount. That might sound like something this instalment is reining in, but what it actually means is Piko will feel like a permanent addition to the party. Not just a mount for getting you from A to B, they'll actually level up and can even fight alongside you in battle.

Diungkapkan bahwa old-school fans may lament that there won't be chocobo-breeding like the original game, but i think having piko grow and unlock new abilities, both in terms of traversal and combat, during your journey makes for a more meaningful companion than any other gaming mount. It's not like The Witcher 3's Roach was ever useful in a fight.

Sign up to our Switch 2 Spotlight newsletter to make sure you get the very latest news on Nintendo's new console and its games every week.

Sebagaimana diketahui, although cid highwind and vincent valentine were introduced in final fantasy 7 rebirth, they become fully playable party members in final fantasy 7 revelation. While it will be exciting getting to grips with Cid's dragoon-style fighting style or Vincent's Galian beast transformation, you'll also be able to select them or any of the other party members as the playable character during exploration.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, final fantasy 7 rebirth did also try to mix things up occasionally in dungeons where the party would get split up or put you in control of a certain character in story-specific missions. Nonetheless, this small but meaningful change means you can spend more time controlling your favorite character while out in the wider world. It also makes sense given the story will cover the section when central protagonist Cloud will be out of action. And if you play as Vincent, it might be the closest we'll get to a Dirge of Cerberus remaster – it could still happen, right?.

Berdasarkan laporan, arguably the most significant new feature in final fantasy 7 revelation is the fits (function-integrated tactical suitwear) system, which may also sound rather similar to dresspheres for any final fantasy 10-2 fans. Essentially, you can give each party member new threads or armor that also give them new classes that recall classic Final Fantasy jobs, such as Knight, Black Mage, or Summoner.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there's real style to this too as each outfit is tailored to each character rather than wearing the same job uniform. The abilities that come with each outfit are also actually additions rather than changing your class entirely, so if Tifa is dressed as a white mage, rest assured you can still kick ass with her divekick as before. That also means, if you're not looking to think too deeply about builds and just like the outfits as a cosmetic, then that's totally viable too.

Diungkapkan bahwa the black materia is going to be a crucial plot point in final fantasy 7 revelation, as it's what allows sephiroth to summon meteor, and its ominous presence in the sky is going to be inescapable as you play through the game. Its activation will however also cause significant change to the world, notably the emergence of Weapons roaming the world.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, perhaps more significant is how the effects of black materia may alter the world's terrain. We can only speculate at this point what that can mean, but taking the addition of the Highwind and Piko into account as new ways of traversal, don't be surprised if the Grasslands suddenly has new structures or a rupture in the ground that require more verticality in traversal to explore. Call it the Tears of the Kingdom effect, but it should also mean you aren't just going back to explore the exact same regions as you left them in Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth.

Equipping Materia to use spells or gain buffs remains a key aspect of Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, though being treated as its own standalone game, I won't be surprised if that means having to upgrade them and find new Materia again, even if you might start with a default number of them as with Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth.

Berdasarkan laporan, but, one area this finale plans to go further is how many materia you can potentially link together. While we have already had gear that could link two Materia together, there may also be armor that can link three Materia together. That could mean being able to Magnify Materia to two separate spells so that they both reap the benefits, or potentially other uses that I'm still racking my brain over.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, synergy was a cool feature introduced in final fantasy 7 rebirth where you can have two party members team up together in battle. These ranged from real-time Synergy Skills like Aerith calling another party member to be her bodyguard or Tifa getting someone to launch her towards an enemy, to Synergy Abilities as show-stopping as Limit Breaks. How do you top that? Triple Synergy!.

Berdasarkan laporan, given the three-person party size that was also true of the original game, it seems such a logical conclusion to have them all unite in one killer combo. That said, given the complexity of coordinating three characters simultaneously, I suspect this may just be limited to an ultimate ability that may only be available in specific situations, but expect them to leave a lasting impression.

Diungkapkan bahwa players looking for a proper challenge in final fantasy 7 revelation don't need to finish the game to unlock a hard mode. Given how long this finale is going to be, that's already a tall order. But it also doesn't mean it's going to be hard mode available from the start but with that mode's item restrictions or enemies with double the health as with past games.

What it actually means in Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is that because of the huge amount of side quests available and freedom to explore from very early on, there is absolutely nothing stopping you from taking on the toughest side quests and bosses even if you've vastly underleveled, while there are of course also the Weapons roaming the land, just tempting you to go pick a fight, whether or not you're ready.

Berdasarkan laporan, epic games ceo tim sweeney has been in a bit of a one-sided beef with valve co-founder and ceo gabe newell for a while now, lately about steam's ai disclosure that requires developers to include a label informing steam users of ai-generated content. Sweeney has had a number of complaints about Valve's storefront over the years, which makes sense as he owns one of its main competitors, the Epic Games Store, but he's been doubling and tripling down on the AI disclosure issue as of late. In a new interview, he not only sharply rebukes the AI label, but embraces AI in game development to degree rarely seen by him or other industry leaders.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, talking to gamesbeat, sweeney gives one of the most bullish takes on ai generation in games i've seen in my many years covering this topic. Get on-board or die, is essentially his perspective.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "it's really clear to me that large-scale game developers–setting aside indies, where there's always going to be specialties and niches, large-scale game development will be totally changed by ai," sweeney says. "Teams that don't adopt it will absolutely be left behind and rendered uneconomical, non-viable compared to their peers. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa sweeney says he's against any kind of legislation to curb the use of ai in game development in the us because it would give other countries the advantage. No game developer has 75% to 95% profit margins that they can put at risk by not being as productive as possible. "Everyone is going to be adopting it," he says. "When one team can make a game four times more efficiently – 10 times more efficiently soon, perhaps – than another team can make the same game, there's just no possibility of competing the old way. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, there has been massive backlash to ai in games from players, voice actors, artists, and indie developers, but messaging from big studios and publishers generally ranges from cautiously optimistic to vocally and enthusiastically supportive. Meanwhile, a report from GDC found that 55% of respondents said AI was having a negative impact on the industry. Still, Sweeney wants to make sure companies aren't being bullied into choosing human workers over AI.

Berdasarkan laporan, "because there's a big resistance movement against ai that seems concentrated on trying to bully developers into not adopting it by attacking individuals, by review-bombing projects and so on, i've been trying to make my views known to as many game developers as possible," he says. "We have to power through this and build awesome games, use maximum acceleration, because it is a survival issue for all the companies in the industry. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, sweeney has called valve's ai policy "abhorrent," politically motivated, and nonsensical among other things, and we can add another descriptor to the pile today: toxic. When GamesBeat pushes back and suggests Steam's AI label is there to inform players, Sweeney says he doesn't "buy it in the slightest," pointing to Steam's user review system as a means to let players know about "a game's quality, scope, entertainment value and so on. " Ultimately, he says AI can be a force for good and bad in game development, and he sees Valve's mandatory disclosure as a judgment on the technology as a whole.

Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more.

Diungkapkan bahwa "you can build good games and bad games without ai. "If we were to identify AI as associated with bad games, that's just unfair to developers who use AI to make good games. You can build good games and bad games with AI. You can repeat those distinctions for all engines, all development tools, all methodologies, all countries of origin, all teams and so on," says Sweeney. It's a guilt by association pattern that all developers need to push back on. ".

#866. How to get Go Safari Balls in Pokémon Go

📅 23 Nov 2024

How to get Go Safari Balls in Pokémon Go

Tanggal: 23 Nov 2024 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/pokemon-go-guide/483165/go-safari-balls-how-to-get/

These high catch rate balls will help you grab rare Pokémon quickly.

These high catch rate balls will help you grab rare Pokémon quickly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you can get go safari balls as part of pokémon go wild area events, and can only be used during event hours. No, seriously — they disappear after the event ends.

Berdasarkan laporan, these balls are based off of the regular camouflaged-print safari balls from the mainline games. Usually, you can only use Safari Balls in the Safari Zone, a special area where wild Pokémon roam and you can’t actually battle them. You can throw treats and rocks at them to try to increase their catch rate, but ultimately, you just had to huck Safari Balls at them to catch some of these rare critters.

Pokémon Go has its own take on Safari Balls, and we explain what Go Safari Balls do, and how to get more.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, go safari balls are special poké balls that have a higher catch rate. While the catch rate isn’t 100% known, it is known to be much better than an Ultra Ball.

Sebagaimana diketahui, they are particularly effective against "mighty pokémon", which also debut as part of the go wild area event, but know you can use them for anything. This includes Galarian birds, which have a notoriously low catch rate, so make sure to use your Daily Adventure Incense during the event period to increase your chances if you haven’t got them yet.

For those with a paid Go Wild Area ticket, during the raid’s catch phase, Premier Balls will also be swapped out for Go Safari Balls in raids and Max Battles — but know any leftovers will be discarded and not kept for other encounters.

Berdasarkan laporan, remember, these are an event exclusive ball and will disappear at the end of the event on sunday, nov. 15 — so be sure to use them before 6 p. m. in your local time on Sunday rolls round.

Pokémon caught in Go Safari Balls can be transferred to Pokémon Home, but the appearance of the ball is changed into a greenish "Strange Ball" once transferred.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there are a few ways to get more go safari balls during the event, though not very many options for players looking to avoid spending. That being said, you’ll want to start playing early to complete the research if you want to get and use your allotment of Go Safari Balls before they vanish.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, note that even the paid balls will disappear on sunday, nov. 15 at 6 p. m. in your local time, so make sure you use them up.

#868. GTA 6 PS5 Codes Potentially Being Stolen from Physical Copies Using Flashlight Trick

📅 14 Nov 2026

GTA 6 PS5 Codes Potentially Being Stolen from Physical Copies Using Flashlight Trick

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/11/gta-6-ps5-codes-potentially-being-stolen-from-physical-copies-using-flashlight-trick

A potentially problematic manufacturing oversight may be resulting in some GTA 6 codes being stolen from retail PS5 cases.

Some reports claim that by pointing a strong flashlight at the side of the case, it’s possible to shine light into the empty Blu-ray box in such a way that it makes the code printed on the insert visible.

Remember, GTA 6’s physical release is a code-in-box, and doesn’t have a Blu-ray disc.

There is some debate about whether the included poster insert blocks the light and makes this impossible; some say they’ve been able to replicate the issue, while others say it can’t be done with a sealed copy.

Berdasarkan laporan, it’s also worth noting that the us release specifically has a camouflaged pattern around the code, as shown by resetera user mattmo831. That means you can certainly shine light into the box, but you can’t read the code on the other side.

Some PEGI units don’t have the camouflage pattern, so technically the code is visible using this trick, although again there’s still debate over whether the poster blocks the light in sealed copies.

It’s worth pointing out that codes aren’t activated at the point of purchase like other digital vouchers, so assuming the flashlight method works, it would be perfectly possible to pilfer a working copy of the game.

I think this story will explode if it turns out to be true, but it all just depends on how many PEGI copies don’t have the camouflage pattern and whether the inserted poster blocks the light or not.

As far as I can see, there aren’t an enormous number of people who’ve complained upon buying the physical version that their code has been redeemed – but if this method works, the publicity around it will now surely see the probability increase.

As the refounding theory finally starts to settle in, now we've got a shifting Great Calamity to deal with.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Berdasarkan laporan, the legend of zelda timeline has gotten yet another confusing new update, shifting the events leading to breath of the wild by 9,900 years and directly contradicting established lore. It's such an about-face for the existing story that series fans are pretty sure it's just a mistake, but the new word comes straight from Nintendo of America, which is often treated as gospel.

Berdasarkan laporan, the zelda timeline splits into three different branches based on the end of ocarina of time, but those branches all converge in the misty history leading up to the events of breath of the wild and tears of the kingdom. Earlier this year, Nintendo updated the Japanese version of the timeline and made clear that the founding of Hyrule depicted in flashback during Tears of the Kingdom shows the start of a new Hyrule, well after the one depicted in Ocarina of Time and other games has faded into history.

Sebagaimana diketahui, now, nintendo of america has updated the official english-language timeline to confirm the refounding – well, i say "confirm" but i'm sure it'll remain contentiously debated among the most dedicated purists. Either way, the update has made another curious tweak to the rest of the backstory.

Diungkapkan bahwa up until now, we've understood the timeline depicted in tears of the kingdom's flashbacks like this: hyrule is (re)founded, ganondorf appears to invade, and is sealed away as part of the imprisoning war. 10,000 years pass from that Great Calamity, and that brings us to Breath of the Wild. Untold generations pass, and the evil entity known as Calamity Ganon eventually emerges and ravages the kingdom before being pushed back by Sheikah technology. Calamity Ganon reemerges, Link hibernates for 100 years, and the game begins.

Sebagaimana diketahui, according to the new timeline, the imprisoning war happens, 9,900 years pass, and then the great calamity happens. Then it's just 100 years before Ganon reemerges – now referred to as "the second Great Calamity" – kicking off Link's century-long hibernation leading into Breath of the Wild.

Berdasarkan laporan, in other words, the first great calamity, which was originally placed 10,000 years before breath of the wild, now takes place just a century or two before the game's events. This is despite the fact that Breath of the Wild is full of people trying to unlock the secrets of a pre-Calamity world that's long since faded into myth.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, how are zelda fans taking the sudden break in established lore? well, you can read the reddit threads for yourself, but i imagine you can already guess the tone of the responses. The Zelda timeline is notoriously convoluted, and while Nintendo has kept it up since at least 2003, Shigeru Miyamoto always maintained that it's "not that important to us. ".

Sign up to our Switch 2 Spotlight newsletter to make sure you get the very latest news on Nintendo's new console and its games every week.

Diungkapkan bahwa perhaps that's why eiji aonuma shut down attempts to add further nods to the timeline ocarina of time, and why a new official timeline update can so suddenly make an astronomical shift to established lore. Don't worry – regardless of how this detail shakes out, I'm sure the timeline will be broken in all-new ways soon enough.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nintendo pulled back the horror from one of the legend of zelda: ocarina of time remake's most terrifying enemies: "maybe we've gone a step too far. ".

#872. 25 Years Later, Frodo’s Best Lord of the Ring Quote Proves He's the Ultimate Fantasy Hero

📅 14 Nov 2026

25 Years Later, Frodo’s Best Lord of the Ring Quote Proves He's the Ultimate Fantasy Hero

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/frodo-best-quote-lord-of-the-rings/

Berdasarkan laporan, an inherent tragedy follows every character in the lord of the rings, which isn’t surprising, given that peter jackson’s epic fantasy trilogy is adapted from the works of j. Tolkien. R. R. The author has never been shy about exploring grim topics, and in a 1968 interview with the BBC, Tolkien said that all stories are about one thing: death.

Berdasarkan laporan, though grim, tolkien’s perspective is not necessarily mistaken. His sentiments also emerge through the characters in his stories, including Frodo Baggins, first introduced in The Fellowship of the Ring. Through Frodo’s struggle to carry the One Ring to the fires of Mount Doom, Tolkien’s outlook is reflected in how his characters confront hardship and life’s darker aspects.

Berdasarkan laporan, hardship often invites self-reflection when a quiet moment offers the chance to look back. Across The Lord of the Rings trilogy, characters both minor and central reflect on the events that shaped their respective journeys. Frodo, in particular, experiences several moments of introspection throughout the story, as he considers the weight of his quest and the changes it has brought.

However, one moment stands apart: a poignant quote in which he lets his vulnerability show, a line that has remained with fans of Peter Jackson’s trilogy for decades.

Sebagaimana diketahui, though frodo delivers many memorable lines throughout the lord of the rings, one stands out for its brevity and profound resonance. In just a few words, it captures the immense burden of his quest and the sacrifices he must make along the way.

During a quiet moment in the shadowy, foreboding Mines of Moria, where the Fellowship entered after their route over the Misty Mountains was blocked, Frodo seeks solace and reassurance from Gandalf.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in just a few short words, frodo’s best quote reveals the exact headspace the young hobbit is in. He says:.

Berdasarkan laporan, “i wish the ring had never come to me. I wish none of this had happened. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, because frodo says this so early in his journey, it's easy to dismiss his attitude. After all, we know in hindsight that his real struggles are only just beginning. In fact, things become much more difficult for him and the rest of the Fellowship almost immediately after he says this.

Dismissing Frodo’s words as mere childish sulking willfully misreads why the young Hobbit is so forlorn in the first place.

Diungkapkan bahwa fans should remember that frodo and his fellow hobbits (samwise, merry, and pippin) grew up in the shire, a peaceful community largely untouched by strife and malice. Their lives there were far removed from the dangers and conflicts of the wider world, so setting off on a perilous adventure would have seemed extraordinary.

Diungkapkan bahwa even bilbo baggins, frodo’s uncle, was viewed as reckless when he left the shire to join gandalf and thorin’s company of 12 dwarves on a quest to reclaim erebor and its treasure from the dragon smaug. Bilbo’s adventure was not regarded as an example to follow, but as an unusually risky departure from the safe and familiar life the hobbits knew.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with that context in mind, frodo’s words to gandalf make a lot of sense. He’s a fish out of water, still wrestling with the fact that, because his uncle Bilbo left the One Ring to him, he must now face a destiny far bigger than himself.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, moreover, frodo cannot simply walk away from his mission without putting the rest of middle-earth at risk. The One Ring’s influence follows him throughout the trilogy, constantly tempting him to give in to its power.

Sebagaimana diketahui, yet frodo is not the only one vulnerable to its pull: even his most steadfast allies, including aragorn, are not immune. If someone as resolute as Aragorn can be tempted by the Ring, Frodo has little choice but to shoulder the burden himself. He must keep carrying it, knowing its power could endanger anyone who tries to take it from him — at least until Sam arrives and helps him bear the weight of the journey.

Berdasarkan laporan, frodo’s task is neither joyful nor one he would have chosen. He is a hobbit burdened by a quest to save the world, because he is the only one who can. He isn’t a hero seeking an adventure like his uncle. By accepting his responsibility to the rest of the Fellowship and continuing despite not wanting to, Frodo proves he is the perfect hero.

#875. Petit Planet Preview: Living the Cozy Life

📅 13 Nov 2026

Petit Planet Preview: Living the Cozy Life

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/petit-planet-final-preview/

Diungkapkan bahwa the latest major entry in hoyoverse's catalog sends us to distant planets. We explore the multiplayer mini-games and friendly neighbors and planet customizations at a recent event!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, hoyoverse is well known for their free-to-play gacha experiences, telling surprisingly intricate stories all while compelling their player base to get their favorite characters. That looks to change in their latest entry, Petit Planet.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is a big deviation from what we’ve become accustomed to when it comes to hoyoverse, as while aspects to the overall formula remain, a lot of it has been modified to accommodate a cozier experience. This is all about building a life on a small planet with all your friends, be them NPCs or those online.

We were invited out to talk to the developers a couple of weeks ago and play a newly updated build of Petit Planet, and we couldn’t have had a cozier experience.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, before getting into anything, it should be said how much more of a multiplayer game this is compared to any of the other hoyoverse games we’ve had in the past. Genshin Impact has multiplayer functionality, which somewhat carried into Honkai: Star Rail (which uses its events well for cooperative and competitive play), but Petit Planet looks to up it to another level.

Berdasarkan laporan, this is supposed to resemble something like animal crossing, having players not only be able to visit each other, but interact with them to a great degree. You can send friend requests and then easily access their world, although the number of things to do there is contained. It’s going to the Grand Bazaar that really turns things up.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this is a social hub-like area where players can go and play games with one another. For example, there's a rhythm game four players compete in, along with an Uno type game. Each of these games have a maximum number of four players to utilize, although there are possibilities for more. Being that the game isn’t out, this likely will be the groundwork for even more mini-games to come.

Participating in this mini-games seem to give you a Jelly currency, which can then be exchanged from various vendors for emotes, some of which can be interacted with other players, and other articles of clothing.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, because this is a life sim, there will be several things to do in the world on a daily basis, especially given this is a free-to-play hoyoverse game. There are daily and weekly challenges that can be accomplished, from chopping down trees to interacting with the Neighbors, and each generate different types of currency.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, because this is a free-to-play experience, there are quite a few different curries you will be able to obtain through daily activities but of course spend with your hard-earned money. While this wasn’t in the build we had, there’s no denying that’s how the game will generate its income from. It will still allow players to do their daily and weekly activities to generate some of these currencies, ensuring you don’t have to swipe, but remember this is still a HoYoverse game at the end of the day.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as for what you’ll be able to participate in, there are various energy-spending activities, from gathering materials from around your world to catching bugs and sea life. All of this contributes to the overall progression, although we aren't entirely sure what the endgame will truly be.

Diungkapkan bahwa this feels like a game where you can sit back and chill with friends, slowly building upon a world without much pressure or fomo. Regardless, there are still things that can be done in the world to ensure for some sort of progression, but whether there's a true endgame is still up for debate.

Diungkapkan bahwa this wouldn’t be a cozy game without npcs that roam around the worlds, and petit planet has a bevy to see. We’ve already been introduced to a number of the cute and cuddly cast in the past, but there’s even more we got to see in the latest demo. Each neighbor has their own function for why they are in your world, but mainly it’s for you to build and expand upon the relationships.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the neighbors come with their own progress tree, going up three levels and seemingly able to go down if you neglect them. You'll be able to bring them onto your planet and set up little houses for them, and that’s not all. They'll have their own stories and journeys to go through from meeting them, talking them over time and giving them gifts, unlocking various moments with them.

By obtaining Footprints and the other currencies in Petit Planet, you'll be able to exchange them for various in-game cosmetics, such as clothing, which include facial wear and full outfits, and various placeable items.

Diungkapkan bahwa making sure your home is homey is key to immersing yourself into the petit planet system, as there are numerous options to choose from when building your perfect little abode. Whether it’s the furniture, the appliances or simply the wallpaper, there’s a staggering number of customizable options.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on top of that, building out your planet itself is just as important, as setting up roads to your neighbors and modifying the different accessories are put around things such as gardens lets you do so much more. It’s your personal little place you want to call home, even though the chilly planet we got to play on is relatively small. Here’s hoping there’s ways to expand upon it.

Petit Planet will be out by the end of the year on December 4 for PC and Mobile devices, with a Nintendo Switch 2 launch sometime in 2027.

#876. 20 Years Later, A Classic Nintendo DS Puzzle Game Officially Returns

20 Years Later, A Classic Nintendo DS Puzzle Game Officially Returns

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/professor-layton-nintendo-ds-remake-release-date-2027/

20 years later, Professor Layton’s Nintendo DS debut is getting a remake.

Diungkapkan bahwa next year will mark the 20th anniversary of level-5's beloved professor layton series. To celebrate, the company has announced it is remaking Professor Layton and the Curious Village.

Berdasarkan laporan, level-5 announced the remake with a teaser trailer on its youtube channel. Professor Layton and the Curious Village was first released in 2007 on the Nintendo DS handheld, with a global release bringing the game to a wider audience the following year. It debuted the series' signature puzzle-solving mechanics while introducing players to the titular hero and his apprentice, Luke Triton. It was met with widespread acclaim upon its release and launched a series that is still going strong nearly 20 years later.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the game sees layton and luke exploring the village of st. Mystere in search of the Golden Apple. A recently deceased baron declares that whoever finds the mysterious artifact will inherit his fortune, and the residents help the leading duo along while also engaging them in a series of puzzles.

Berdasarkan laporan, beyond the 2027 release window, level-5 hasn't shared a specific release date. For what it's worth, the original game released on Feb. 15, 2007, so perhaps we could be looking at a February launch. The remake has been confirmed for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Windows PC.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the remake looks to be in the same style as the upcoming professor layton and the new world of steam. While not confirmed, it is possible Professor Layton and the Curious Village will include the use of generative AI in some way, as Level-5 has gone on record in defense of technology in game development. The teaser site highlights the remake's new 3D rendering and high-resolution. Professor Layton and the New World of Steam is the first original title in the series since 2013.

Level-5 will finally deliver Professor Layton and the New World of Steam in 2026.

#878. HBO’s 5-Part Crime Drama Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History

📅 14 Nov 2026

HBO’s 5-Part Crime Drama Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/the-wire-season-4-recommendation/

The Wire’s fourth season provided a far deeper look at Baltimore’s problems.

The Wire’s fourth season provided a far deeper look at Baltimore’s problems.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at the turn of the 21st century, hbo was the place for prestige crime drama. Jordan. The series is still one of the best shows of all time, and provided breakout roles for huge stars like Idris Elba and Michael B. The launch of The Sopranos in 1999 paved the way for the 2002 premiere of The Wire, which focused on drug dealers in Baltimore and the police officers trying to disrupt their operations. But while it was compelling from the beginning, The Wire truly achieved perfection in season 4 when the scope expanded beyond the drug trade to examine the cycle of institutional failure.

Sebagaimana diketahui, season 1 of the wire was tightly focused on the drug empire of avon barksdale (wood harris) and his business-savvy second-in-command stringer bell (elba). Showrunner David Simon quickly established a brilliant mix of humor and pathos. Season 2 shifted the focus to the city’s port system, a jarring change as many characters faded into the background to make room for the tragic tale of the Sobotka family. The show could find comedy in something as simple as cops struggling to get new furniture into their office, and then gut audiences with the death of a relatable drug dealer. Season 3 was the most tightly linked to the show’s first season, largely completing the story of the Barksdale gang.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that made season 4 perfect for a soft reboot, a shift that was defined by star dominic west all but disappearing after his relentless detective, jimmy mcnulty, was demoted for pissing off his bosses too many times. The detectives he previously worked with in the major crimes unit continue their work, investigating a vicious new gang that’s filling the void Barksdale left behind. Lester Freamon (Clarke Peters) effectively steps into the McNulty role of pursuing the truth, even when his supervisors would love for him to be a little less dogged, bringing a new methodical nature to the investigations instead of McNulty’s brash confidence. (Simon worked as a journalist at The Baltimore Sun for 12 years before creating The Wire. criminals beats are familiar, they become just one part of a far more ambitious season that fully capitalized on Simon’s knowledge of the city. But while the cops vs. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, the season’s largest secondary plot involves the students at a baltimore middle school where former cop roland pryzbylewski (jim true-frost) begins teaching. You want to root for all of them, from the ambitious Randy Wagstaff (Maestro Harrell) to the fiercely protective Michael Lee (Tristan Wilds). The young actors do a phenomenal job establishing likable characters in terrible circumstances. By the end of season 4, the system has profoundly failed almost all of these kids, driving them to lives of addiction and violence. The Wire was always good at making most of its characters sympathetic, but seeing children trapped in such a brutal cycle really drives home the show’s themes of how crime thrives when institutions fail.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that theme also plays out in the mayoral campaign of tommy carcetti (aidan gillen). Gillen’s oily performance as a political survivor who would doom his city to satisfy his own ambitions was what landed him the role of Littlefinger in Game of Thrones. Carcetti was introduced in season 3 as an ambitious city council member, but he really shines in season 4 as he runs on reforming the Baltimore Police Department — and then quickly breaks his promises. Carcetti is even more compelling a character because he feels like a man who could have done good if he’d been willing to make sacrifices rather than feed his own ego.

Berdasarkan laporan, the wire season 4 is able to build so many new arcs because of the strong foundation established in the previous three seasons. The cops and drug dealers alike feel world-weary as they deal with a more violent new generation represented by Marlo Stanfield (Jamie Hector) and his vicious enforcers Snoop (Felicia Pearson) and Chris Partlow (Gbenga Akinnagbe). The show is dense with rich characters who have grown significantly over the years even as they continue to struggle with many of the same problems. Combined with the dark fate of most of the kids and Carcetti’s broken promises, the season creates the bleak feeling that everyone is trapped in a cycle of misery and decay.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, season 5 gave most of the wire’s characters satisfying ends to their arcs and delivered a scathing critique of the downfall of american newspapers, commentary that has only become more profound 20 years later. There are no bad seasons of The Wire, but season 4 perfectly achieved the show’s goals. But overall, it’s a big step down from season 4, spending too much time on a goofy fake serial killer plot and not enough on the nuanced character-driven stories that made season 4 feel so authentic. It’s an alternately funny, tragic, and profound look at the complex ways that people are betrayed by systems that never really give them a chance to succeed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, xbox wants more fallout, and after a yearslong drought of new games, bethesda softworks is making it happen. Bethesda plans to release remasters of both Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas for modern platforms, the company said in July in a massive roadmap of the developer's future. Those remasters are part of a larger plan to reinvest in Fallout games — including Fallout 5, which is currently in pre-production — and a new untitled project at Obsidian Entertainment.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we have multiple fallout projects in active development right now," bethesda said in an official announcement this summer. That includes Fallout 5, which is described as the studio's "long-range destination," and "a major Fallout 76 expansion" planned for 2027 called Raven Rock, which will serve as a prequel story to Fallout 3.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bethesda also confirmed two long-standing rumors, announcing remasters for fallout 3 and fallout: new vegas. The studio did not provide any further details or a release window, but the projects have reportedly been in the works for many years. The existence of a Fallout 3 remaster dates back to at least 2020, when the project's existence was revealed through court documents related to the Federal Trade Commission's (FTC) litigation regarding Microsoft's buyout of Activision Blizzard.

Diungkapkan bahwa fallout 3 and fallout: new vegas' remasters follow last year's release of the elder scrolls 4: oblivion remastered, which was co-developed by virtuos and bethesda game studios. Bethesda also marked the 10-year anniversary of Fallout 4 in 2025, with the release of Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition. That rerelease included the original game, all six of the previously released DLC add-ons, as well as over 150 items pulled from the Fallout 4 Creation Club.

Sebagaimana diketahui, fallout 3 was originally released in 2008 for playstation 3, windows pc, and xbox 360. The game was the third major installment in the Fallout series, and the first to be developed by Bethesda after acquiring the rights to the franchise from Interplay Entertainment. C. Fallout 3 is set in and around Washington D. 200 years after a devastating nuclear war, and players control a 19-year-old Vault dweller in search of their missing father.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fallout: new vegas followed in 2010, and was developed by obsidian entertainment. It was set in the Mojave Desert and casts players as a courier who becomes embroiled in a conflict between various factions who are vying for control of the region.

Diungkapkan bahwa in addition to new fallout games, a third season of the fallout tv series is in the works and recently wrapped filming. Bethesda Game Studios is also hard at work on the next game in its fantasy role-playing game series: The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel is now in development.

Former Obsidian dev Chris Avellone dishes on contentious conversations with Bethesda after Dead Money.

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/call-of-duty-endowment-valor-pack-remembrance-day-veterans

The Call of Duty Endowment is marking Remembrance Day and its 17th anniversary by encouraging Modern Warfare 4 and Warzone players to pick up its Valor Pack, with all of Activision's net proceeds going towards helping veterans find jobs.

The Call of Duty Endowment Valor Pack - which has been available since Modern Warfare 4 launched on 23rd October - was designed by the Endowment and Infinity Ward with US Marine Corps veteran and Medal of Honor recipient Kyle Carpenter in mind.

The items include a melee weapon blueprint inscribed with "Worth Fighting For", plus items called Relentless and Still Standing.

According to the Call of Duty blog, 100 percent of Activision's net proceeds from the pack (after VAT and sales tax) go to the Endowment.

To mark Remembrance Day, players who owned it and launched either game before 6pm GMT on 12th November also received double XP tokens and a DMZ survival kit.

"Veterans bring incredible skills into the workplace after military service," said Carpenter.

The Endowment, which supports veterans in the UK as well as the US, says it has now helped place more than 180,000 into "high-quality jobs", and wants to reach 200,000 by 2030.

Berdasarkan laporan, other partners are also raising money, with pilot's round-up campaign raising more than £4. 7 million ($6 million) for the Endowment since 2019. Polaris will also donate around £19,500 ($25,000) if players collectively complete 5 million rides in its DAGOR vehicle across Modern Warfare 4 and Warzone by 25th November.

Berdasarkan laporan, it comes two weeks after activision apologised to bereaved families of the itaewon crowd crush victims and confirmed it would remove real footage of the tragedy from call of duty: modern warfare 4. Players discovered that the game's opening cinematic uses short news clips to depict fictional civilian casualties during a North Korean invasion of South Korea. Those clips have since been found to include archive footage from the 2022 Itaewon disaster, in which around 160 people died.

The latest report from GDC shows a slight uptick in AI use, but negative sentiment towards the tech still dominates.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, use of generative ai remains one of the most contentious topics in the games industry. Developers who see a bright new future in the tech have increasingly clashed with those concerned by the ethical, artistic and labour implications tools like ChatGPT and Claude Opus bring to the medium. The divisive nature of the subject was starkly revealed in a new report, which calculated that 40% of game developers are actively using generative AI, while more than half of developers believe LLMs and agentic coding tools have a negative impact on the industry.

Sebagaimana diketahui, these were the conclusions of the latest state of the game industry report from the game developer's conference (via eurogamer). The report surveyed over 2,600 respondents from all corners of the industry. Of those surveyed, 40% of respondents said they used generative AI as part of their job, a slight increase from 36% from last year.

Berdasarkan laporan, of those surveyed, the report found that older professionals were more likely to use generative ai, with 54% of workers over 45 stating they use the tech. The report also states that men were more likely to use AI tools than women, and that indie developers were less likely to use it than studios working on premium, free-to-play, and mobile-exclusive games.

Berdasarkan laporan, among those who have embraced generative ai, the most common use of it was for research and brainstorming. Nearly three-quarters of AI advocates said they use it for this function, while over half (56%) said they use it for code generation and debugging. Use of generative AI seems to drop sharply for tasks viewed as being more creative, however, with 22% saying they use it for concept art and visual ideation, and only 7% using it for player-facing features.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, although use of generative ai has increased, the perception of the technology's impact on the industry remains predominately negative. 55% of those surveyed said that generative AI is having a negative effect on the games industry, an increase of 1% from the start of 2026, and up 25% from 2025. Meanwhile, 35% said the impact was mixed, with only 8% believing that generative AI is having a positive effect.

Diungkapkan bahwa the report concludes (with the help of ai 'sentiment analysis' tools, it should be noted) that games industry professionals are "forming more nuanced view on generative ai, rather than taking an all-or-nothing stance". At the same time, the report highlighted new concerns that AI use leads to "skill atrophy and loss in professional and personal development" while developers are taking a dimmer view of "using generative AI for player-facing features. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, there are other factors that explain the increase in ai usage alongside a growing negative sentiment. A casual Google search in 2026 technically counts as using AI, regardless of how you feel about the presence or quality of the resulting AI summary. At the same time, the effects of AI on the games industry—particularly agentic coding tools—have become more pronounced in 2026. Whether you are pro or anti AI, the tech is becoming harder to avoid. Platforms like Steam and itch are wrestling to deal with a dramatic increase in AI slop games, while use of the tech among developers has triggered heated debates in spaces like the IGF awards.

Diungkapkan bahwa it will be interesting to see how these opinions shift in the next twelve months, given the current situation within the broader ai industry. After years of unprecedented growth, big tech has been rocked by a series of scandals and growing doubt among investors about the long-term profitability of generative tools. Will 2027 be the year that the so-called 'AI bubble' finally bursts? And if it does, how will that impact the proliferation of generative AI among the games industry and tech more broadly?.

In the lead up to GTA 6's long-awaited launch, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has called out companies like Anthropic and OpenAI for allowing users to plagiarize and clone pre-existing games using generative AI.

Sebagaimana diketahui, generative ai's usage in game development has been highly controversial for many reasons, but in recent months, ai copycats have become an increasingly prevalent issue. Some Steam developers even cancelled demos or playtests out of fear their games would be cloned and put up for sale before their official release dates. Copycats of popular games like Mecca Chameleon can sometimes flood the storefront in no time, too.

"I think all companies should be protecting intellectual property, their own and everyone else's," Zelnick says when asked if he'd like to see more AI companies restrict users from reverse engineering games, in an interview with IGN.

"And if you're in the intellectual property business, which Anthropic is and OpenAI is, then it seems ironic on the one hand to stomp on someone else's IP and hope that yours is protected," he adds.

Sebagaimana diketahui, anthropic recently added a new rule to claude's backend code to block users from "recreating someone else's specific game," after lots of developers essentially had their work ripped off in mere minutes. The restriction might also stop Claude from being used in the tidal wave of vibe-coded recompilations we've seen in recent months - Mario Kart Wii, Banjo-Tooie and The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening included.

Berdasarkan laporan, "using claude to infringe ip is against our usage policy," anthropic's member of technical staff addy osmani said at the time. "Original games, genre games, and games built from your own designs and assets are meant to keep working. ".

#890. Rings of Power Just Changed the Nazgul in 1 Terrifying Way: ‘They Still Have a Human Side’

📅 14 Nov 2026

Rings of Power Just Changed the Nazgul in 1 Terrifying Way: ‘They Still Have a Human Side’

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/rings-of-power-season-3-nazgnagol-vs-nazgul-explained/

Sauron's Nine Rings offer healing and unimaginable power, but the price is far worse than death.

Sauron's Nine Rings offer healing and unimaginable power, but the price is far worse than death.

Berdasarkan laporan, the lord of the rings: the rings of power season 3 sees sauron begin to recruit the nine lieutenants that will one day become the nazgûl, or ringraiths. ” Rather than immediately enslaving their wearers, Sauron's rings heal their injuries, cure terrible afflictions, and grant them extraordinary power. R. While details in J. R. Tolkien’s lore are a bit scarce when it comes to the gradual transformation of the Ringwraiths, Rings of Power initially presents the rings as miraculous gifts that transform the Men who wear them into Nazgnagôl, or "Ring-servants. The catch is that every gift brings its recipient closer to surrendering his freedom.

For Rings of Power co-creator Patrick McKay, depicting that transformation is one of the biggest reasons to make the series in the first place.

"Part of the opportunity of this show is to dramatize what the introduction of these powers, the rings, mean to all these peoples in this world," McKay tells Polygon.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as part of the series, mckay and his fellow showrunner j. D. Payne wanted to establish why anyone would willingly accept a ring from Sauron, the self-proclaimed Dark Lord, in the first place.

The LOTR showrunners and star reveal why now is the perfect time to feature an essential character.

Berdasarkan laporan, "it was very important to j. and I that there was a reason you would want to wear one, which is that it would give you wealth and power," McKay says. "The idea that, in the lore, thousands of years from now, they're enslaved to Sauron's will, they've lost their humanity, and they're ghost-like wraiths, that's a long way off. D. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "that's the bill coming. Right now, it's the good times. ".

Note: Spoilers follow for the first four episodes of Rings of Power season 3.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, executive producing director charlotte brändström wanted the nazgnagôl to feel recognizably human while also possessing an unsettling supernatural presence. That begins right at the start of season 3, when a Nazgnagôl shows up in a battle between Elves and Orcs where Galadriel (Morfydd Clark) confronts the Nazgnagôl — and is handily defeated before escaping.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i slowed down everything around them," brändström says, explaining that she filmed the characters at either 36 or 48 frames per second. She also introduced echoes and reverberation into their movements and voices.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the nazgnagôl's unnerving composure is just as important as their supernatural abilities. "We could feel their power by the fact that they never needed to hurry," she says. "They know the power they have. ".

Despite their terrifying appearances and abilities, Brändström emphasizes that the Nazgnagôl haven't completely transformed into the monsters audiences recognize from The Lord of the Rings.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "they still have a human side to them at that moment. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, that distinction is crucial. Tolkien's Nazgûl are terrifying precisely because they have become so thoroughly enslaved to Sauron that almost nothing remains of their former identities. The Rings of Power is exploring how that happens, beginning with men who have understandable reasons to accept the rings and gradually revealing the price of their newfound power.

Berdasarkan laporan, by the time season 3 begins, sauron has already recruited three kings of men to become nazgnagôl. Early in the premiere episode, we’re given a look at the brutal audition process when five leaders from Rhûn sent by the Dark Wizard (Ciarán Hinds) arrive in Mordor to forge an alliance between the two kingdoms. Sauron recounts how their ancestors ruled Rhûn for a thousand years before the wizard showed up and cursed their flesh and that of their descendants.

Diungkapkan bahwa after an orc kills the two that are most loyal to the dark wizard, sauron reveals a small box holding the remaining rings of power but says he can only spare one. Then he drops a sword on the ground, implying that the last man standing can claim it. After he undergoes a painful transformation, the wizard’s curse is cleansed, and Sauron dubs him “the fairest of the Nine. The victor is Khamûl the Easterling (Zubin Varla). ” Newly empowered, Khamûl is later able to confront and overpowers the Dark Wizard to effectively seize control of Rhûn.

Berdasarkan laporan, khamûl is also a significant figure in tolkien's mythology. He's the only Nazgûl identified by a personal name, apart from the title of the Witch-king of Angmar. As detailed in Unfinished Tales, Khamûl is associated with the East and ranks second among the Nine. That makes his connection to Rhûn fitting, although the specific circumstances of his recruitment and his confrontation with the Dark Wizard are unique to Rings of Power.

Diungkapkan bahwa we later see the same violent ritual play out with men from the southlands, which includes theo (tyroe muhafidin). Sauron rationalizes that this is why Theo was previously drawn to the sword hilt that essentially unlocked Mordor at the end of season 1. After Theo wins the contest, Sauron conducts a dark ritual that supposedly identifies his lineage: according to the Great Deceiver, Theo is descended from “a noble house of old” that were “the sworn servants of Mordor” supposedly born with special powers. Whether or not all of this is true, Theo does accept the ring.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in an interview with nerdist, muhafidin described theo's growing resentment toward arondir, whom he holds partly responsible for failing to protect bronwyn. “I think we find him at the beginning of the season kind of void of that hope and angered by the pain the world has dealt out to him,” he said. Sauron manipulates that desperation and offers Theo great power. By the time Theo really starts to question what the ring might cost him, it’s already too late.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the most devastating demonstration of the nazgnagôl's predicament comes during the climactic battle at gundabad in episode 4. After Arondir discovers the long-lost Celeborn (Jamie Campbell Bower) in a cell, they attempt to escape the Orc stronghold with Galadriel (Morfydd Clark) on the back of a Great Eagle. But then a Nazgnagôl confronts Arondir, and Theo takes off the mask.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rather than immediately attack, theo urges arondir to leave. Unlike the Nazgûl, Nazgnagôl like Theo here still have their autonomy to an extent. Sauron’s influence and corruption have yet to completely take over. Arondir refuses to abandon Theo, and for a moment, it seems like he might actually take the ring off. Then Sauron arrives and forces Theo to kill Arondir as if he’s already exerting total control.

Berdasarkan laporan, arondir's death is doubly heartbreaking because theo recognizes the man standing before him. But whatever humanity remains inside him isn't enough to prevent the Dark Lord from asserting control. We all remember the Nazgûl as these terrifying, faceless, and inhumane wraiths. Are the Nazgnagôl more or less frightening when we can still see the people beneath the mask long before they’re totally destroyed?.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, indiana jones and the great circle offered such a great depiction of everyone's favourite nazi thumping archaeologist that it's hard to imagine developer machinegames building that game any differently. Yet according to design director Jens Andersson, getting the Indy feel of The Great Circle right represented a significant challenge for the Swedish studio.

Berdasarkan laporan, one of the hardest problems machinegames struggled with was the presence of guns in the game, specifically how to stop players from just blasting through armies of nazis without making guns less fun to use. Speaking to FRVR, Andersson explained that having satisfying firearms in The Great Circle was "non-negotiable" as "we have a lot of people at Machine[Games] that love guns".

Berdasarkan laporan, since machinegames wanted the great circle to be true to spielberg's films, they needed guns to be a part of indy's toolset and not the default response to every problem. One partial solution was to make reloading slow, encouraging players to use other tools like Indy's whip or his fists, but this alone wasn't enough.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we had so many designs to try and get around that," andersson continued. "For example, a GTA star level system when you shoot someone and reinforcements [start] coming in. They take down a guy, they see a gun on the floor, and they clear the whole area with just guns. "Because we were so afraid that this would be the default thing that the player would do. " The thinking here seems to have been to discourage players from going overboard with using loud weapons. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the end, the solution machinegames stumbled upon was to provide alternative, breakable melee weapons ranging from frying pans to violins. These abundant, lightly comedic tools encouraged players to embrace the improvisational nature of how Indy fights, offering a quick knockout both in stealth and when the player's ammunition ran dry.

Sebagaimana diketahui, remarkably, andersson says that breakable weapons "got in very late" during development. But when the studio "saw how effective it was, that's when we started putting all this weird stuff in. The violin, all of this weird stuff that makes it a little slapstick-y, but not slapstick. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this system proved instrumental in getting the final balance of indy's combat right, where stealth and fisticuffs are the primary approach, while guns tend to be a last resort. You stealth up, you hit someone from behind, the breakable weapon system was super important to do that. I know a lot of people are frustrated about that, but many more people love it," Andersson says. "We penalised shooting so much in that game. "The thing that really fixed it was that we made melee combat so interesting, fun, and easy. Not easy challenge-wise, but just it's easy to get into. 'Oh, there's a new weapon, it's a fly swatter, I want to try this. '".

Diungkapkan bahwa ultimately, indy's dynamic combat was a bit part of what made it machine games' best game to date, earning it a score of 86 in pc gamer's indiana jones and the great circle review. Whether we'll see another Indy game from Machine Games is still up in the air. But if it does happen, it probably won't be soon, as the studio has just confirmed that's it's working on Wolfenstein 3.

Here are the 5 ways the DC Universe can continue in a post-James Gunn world.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Diungkapkan bahwa nobody outside of the newly formed skydance could have foreseen that james gunn and peter safran would be out as the heads of dc studios this early. The dynamic duo only took control four years ago, wiping the slate (almost) clean as they rebooted the franchise and set about forging a new shared universe.

Berdasarkan laporan, yet, here we are. Gunn and Safran are no longer DC chiefs (despite David Ellison naming them as the franchise’s continued caretakers last month), and Jeremy Latcham, best known for his work on the first stages of the Marvel Cinematic Universe alongside Kevin Feige, is now at the helm. What does that mean for Superman’s future on the big screen? It’s not entirely clear, but there are a few directions Latcham could take the DC Universe.

Sebagaimana diketahui, below you'll find our theories on the five potential paths for dc heading forward now that all those best-laid plans for dcu chapter one are out the window. Before we wildly speculate, you might also want to refamiliarize yourself with all the upcoming DC movies and TV shows that were previously announced.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the gunn/safran regime released three movies, and two of them – superman and clayface – were widely embraced (the less said about supergirl, the better; even gunn failed to mention the movie in his departing message). On the TV side, Peacemaker, Lanterns, and Creature Commandos all scored well with critics, and reports indicate 19 million people watched HBO’s Lanterns. In other words, there’s a lot of goodwill towards Gunn and Safran’s universe, and their fingerprints remain all over DC’s upcoming output, namely the Gunn-directed Man of Tomorrow, set to release next year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, something’s obviously not working; otherwise gunn and safran would still be in the job. This was surely Gunn’s plan to some degree (reports indicate a third Superman movie would have started to bring the pieces together), but Latcham might push to get there a little sooner. Latcham could very well continue with the characters of Gunn’s universe, but instead of spotlighting side characters like Clayface, he could refocus the franchise on its big hitters – Batman, Wonder Woman, Aquaman, etc – and have them cross over with David Corenswet’s Superman in Justice League. It’s also worth noting that Latcham has a history with Gunn, having executive produced Guardians of the Galaxy, so he’s a known fan of the director-turned-DC-chief-turned-director’s work.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, of course, there’s a bat-shaped shadow looming over any conversation about the future of the dc universe. Robert Pattinson is cinema’s current incarnation of the Caped Crusader and is set to return in The Batman 2. Despite Gunn previously saying that he would introduce a new Batman in the previously announced The Brave and the Bold, many people believe that having a new Bats alongside Battinson would be both confusing for general audiences and potentially overexpose Bruce Wayne.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so, what’s latcham to do? he could fully commit to director matt reeves’ version of gotham and center the entire cinematic universe on it. Latcham could revive the previously dead spin-off series about the Gotham City Police Department, and potentially revisit previously pitched series based around Catwoman and Poison Ivy. After all, The Batman was hugely successful at the box office – more so than Superman – and Reeves has proven himself a deft hand at expanding the universe with The Penguin. He could then start broadening out the universe to add non-Batman characters, gradually building an entirely new DC Universe.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rather than simply build out from the batman, a relatively clean way to handle things might be to merge gunn with reeves’ universes. These are popular incarnations of Superman and Batman, and both have sequels coming to cinemas soon (plus Wonder Woman might be in Man of Tomorrow, if Adria Arjona is playing the character). Why not smash them all together in a new Justice League?.

Berdasarkan laporan, the biggest issue would be deciding whether a team-up movie would have superman’s warm tone or the batman’s cold one. Actually, that’s not quite the biggest issue: the practicalities of getting Robert Pattinson, plus his castmates Scarlett Johansson, Sebastian Stan, and Colin Farrell, to sign up for another decade of movies is another.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for latcham, all three scenarios carry baggage. Continuing either the Gunn-verse or Battinson-verse (or both!) would mean sticking to foundations built by someone else, and these may not align with Latcham’s own vision. In fact, despite Gunn’s farewell message stating that his characters will live on, other reports have signalled that Latcham will “dismantle” the DC Universe as we know it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if that holds, the producer could very well be looking to recast batman and superman, which would mean introducing a third distinct version of both superheroes in just over a decade (not to mention multiple other versions that cropped up in the flash). If Latcham were to kickstart an all-new, fresh-faced DC Universe, it wouldn’t be a surprise to see him hard-launch with a Justice League movie: just ignore everything else – we’ve seen everyone’s origin stories too recently for a do-over – and get straight to the main event.

Diungkapkan bahwa frankly, very few people want to see the dc universe rebooted so soon after the last restart. And a friendly note to Latcham to say, maybe you could go back and firmly establish what is and isn’t canon, pruning any leftovers from the previous Snyderverse and… Wait. Instead, a sharpening of the current franchise’s direction, with Latcham prioritising a new Justice League movie with Corenswet’s Superman, seems the most likely route ahead. Snyderverse? Could it be?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s not going to happen. Henry Cavill’s Superman facing Dwayne Johnson’s Black Adam. But also, the return of the Snyderverse would surely be the wildest thing to ever happen to DC, right? Ben Affleck back in the suit. The hierarchy of power changing!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, news of gunn and safran leaving dc studios has some fans tweeting out for latcham to #restorethesnyderverse. There’s little chance of anything Snyder-related returning, but as Wonder Woman herself, Gal Gadot, once sang during our pandemic pandemonium: “Imagine”. However, Zack Snyder’s Justice League was a success on streaming, but not a colossal one – certainly not enough to justify continuing its story. The Bat-Ball’s in your court, Latcham.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, man of tomorrow releases in theaters on july 9, 2027. While we wait, check out one writer's thoughts on why James Gunn’s brave and bold vision for the DCU deserved better than an early grave.

Diungkapkan bahwa sam woods is thegamer’s senior reporter. These have included roles such as SEO Editor, Managing Editor at DualShockers, and Global Head of Gaming, and he's also been seen on the BBC. He’s been in games journalism since 2020 and has undertaken a variety of roles in that time. He was promoted to the Senior Reporter position in 2025 following a series of high-quality reports and exclusives for TheGamer.

Berdasarkan laporan, since 2020, sam has written over 3,000 articles and specializes in telling the stories of the people behind the games. He’s also interviewed some of the world’s biggest musical artists to find out how the medium has inspired their work, and TV and Film actors about their roles in video game adaptations. He’s interviewed the biggest game directors, some of the industry’s top talents, told the stories of how indie games came to be, and spoken to players about what really makes them tick. He even hosted a PAX panel in 2021 and made a documentary in 2024 surrounding the creation of a Disney game.

Diungkapkan bahwa alongside this, sam focuses on breaking news. These articles have been picked up by the biggest gaming sites, including IGN, GameSpot, and PC Gamer. He got the scoop on Perfect Dark’s cancellation, provided context on some AI drama, and revealed that Lady Dimitrescu’s actress would love to step back into the character’s giant shoes. He also loves to dive into the numbers behind the games.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sam’s journey in games journalism has taken him all over the world. He’s covered Gamescom in Germany, Summer Game Fest in Los Angeles, and Tokyo Game Show in Japan, each on three occasions.

He’s been learning Japanese since 2024 with the intention of identifying and translating Japanese-language news and bringing it to English-language audiences first, something he’s done countless times.

Sam’s first review was 2020’s Battletoads reboot, and he’s since reviewed games in The Legend of Zelda, Super Mario, and Pokemon franchises.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the nintendo 64 was era-defining for kart racers. Mario Kart 64, like Mario 64 before it, helped to ease the world-famous plumber into the 3D era, and it was rivaled heavily, maybe even surpassed, by Diddy Kong Racing. I even remember having a great time with Mickey's Speedway USA, Lego Racers, and Micro Machines.

Sebagaimana diketahui, playstation, of course, tried to get in on the action with crash team racing, but really, only one series has stood the test of time: mario kart. It's one of the best-selling franchises in the history of gaming, and Mario Kart 8 Deluxe is Nintendo's second-best-selling game of all time.

As more and more games begin to make their way to browsers, unfortunately, with the help of Claude and vibecoding, one player has taken things back to Mario Kart's first 3D outing, creating a web browser version of Mario Kart 64, designed exclusively for online racing.

Berdasarkan laporan, mario kart 64 online is an online-only version of mario kart 64, playable completely through your web browser. It was designed by Oliver Sauter and is based on the SpaghettiKart engine decompilation.

It features all 16 tracks from the main game, including fan favorites like Bowser's Castle, Yoshi Valley, and Kalimari Desert, alongside all four Battle Mode courses.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's very well streamlined, with a new race starting every 30 seconds, and it works with a mouse, keyboard, and controllers. It has a leaderboard and even features camera and microphone support. It's not likely to be around for long, though.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nintendo is on the warpath again, targeting fan-ported pc titles. Just yesterday, we reported on how the company had DMCA'd four popular fan ports, including Skyward Sword, Super Mario Galaxy, Mario Tennis Fever, and Mario Kart: Double Dash. Because this Mario Kart 64 port distributes an unlicensed copy of the game, it's a prime target for the litigious company.

Sebagaimana diketahui, vibecoded multiplayer ports are all the rage within gaming at the moment. While they rely heavily on AI for creation, titles like Need for Speed: Underground 2, Halo: Combat Evolved, and SoulCalibur 2 are currently all playable in your browser. It may not be the case for much longer, though.

Diungkapkan bahwa claude has now been programmed to make things a lot harder for players to slopcode these games, and it has also been told to ignore any prompt containing the word "pokemon". Clearly, as they should be, these AI companies are scared of game developers, and hopefully we soon move back to the older method of decompilation, with players coming together to decode binary 0s and 1s.

Berdasarkan laporan, worlds 2027 will be shared between two countries. The Swiss Stage goes to Nagoya, Japan. The quarter-finals and semi-finals move to the Suwon Convention Center in South Korea. The title decider goes to Seoul Arena, which is still under construction.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the city is backing the event with public money. 369 billion won (about US$1. Seoul has set aside 1. 02 million) in its proposed 2027 budget to host the Worlds final and Fan Fest, Sheep Esports reported.

I had done enough reading about online marketplace fakes and their proverbial real capacity that my immediate reactions defy sharing here in public, but tested the thing in Switch 2 again. The 512 Gb Express SanDisk gambled with at a regional online marketplace (after the only Minsk retailer previously stocking it messaged me back about not getting any more stuff shipped in) arrived last Sunday night, getting properly recognized by the console right on pickup. and it does work there?🤔 Everything from the previously installed stuff to the newly added FFXIV trial and the retrieved Gamecube app downloaded and proceeded to run without a hitch. then repeatedly heating up and autoejected in the laptop beyond 4 Gb of data (from the backups to avoid redownloading). Knocking on wood here, but the bullet may have been ultimately dodged.

Sebagaimana diketahui, anyhoo, the gen 10 storage expansion with roughly 80 gb left of it even urged me to pull the trigger on the juicy ffviir discounts after all, although both games are 10 gb bigger, unlikely to get completed before xenoblade 3's bloa- er, upgraded filesize arrives (not to mention next year's genesis) and still probably best benched at least until i finish crisis core. Right - so the aforementioned 256 Gb card became predictably vacant and I'm still too unenthused about last gen's period of juggling multiple cards per console (what with repeatedly powering on and off in the process) to use it properly, so I really just went and boosted Mariko's storage towards many a previously shelved playthrough instead. #899. Clone Drone in the Danger Zone finally brings its limb-slicing combat to mobile

📅 14 Nov 2026

Clone Drone in the Danger Zone finally brings its limb-slicing combat to mobile

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pocketgamer.com/clone-drone-in-the-danger-zone/official-launch-android-ios/

Sebagaimana diketahui, we’ve been keeping a close eye on clone drone in the danger zone since it was first announced for mobile. And now, the voxel-based hack ‘n slash finally launched on iOS and Android. On top of that, the studio has marked the occasion with a 10-year Anniversary Update as well.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you haven’t come across it before, you play as a human whose mind has been uploaded into a robot gladiator, fighting to survive in an arena run by an empire of intelligent machines. The combat is very direct. Instead of depleting a health bar, you’re slicing your opponents apart bit by bit, one arm and leg at a time.

Sebagaimana diketahui, away from the arena, there’s a story about linking up with the resistance and fighting back, along with co-op and pvp, and the odd stint at the controls of a spaceship or a dinosaur. It’s done very well for itself on PC, too, with more than two million copies sold.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the 10-year anniversary update is also out now and it adds three new challenges. One of them is the long-anticipated Saw Dog, which sounds about as friendly as you’d expect, and another is a more story-driven Challenge. Our last piece on it also mentioned new Endless mode levels and QoL fixes.

Diungkapkan bahwa back when the mobile version was first announced, doborog said the hardest part of the port was getting the controls right. Combat built around aiming a swing at a particular limb is a lot to ask of a touchscreen, and it’s the one part that doesn’t carry over from PC automatically.

Berdasarkan laporan, plenty of pc indies have made the jump well, dead cells and vampire survivors among them, but both are far more forgiving about exactly where your hits land. If the controls hold up, the multiplayer crowd it has built on Steam gives it a better start than most ports get.

Clone Drone in the Danger Zone is out now on mobile.

If you want something else to swing a sword at, check out our list of the best action games on Android.
