#900. GTA 6 Included In Official PlayStation Lease Bundle For £18

📅 14 Nov 2026

GTA 6 Included In Official PlayStation Lease Bundle For £18

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/gta-6-ps5-lease-bundle-uk/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you don't have a console but want to play gta 6 at launch, the idea of shelling out £519-£789 for a ps5, and then another £69. 99 for a copy of the game itself, is less than appealing — over half a grand for one game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, in the uk, you can actually lease a console, and playstation has officially listed three brand-new gta 6 bundles. The idea of leasing a console you don't own, to play a game you can't even buy anyway — only license — is a little murky, and veers a bit into Klarna for Uber Eats territory, but it's less daunting than paying £588. 99-£858. 99 for one game.

The official PlayStation Flex page now has three GTA 6 bundles:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you're only grabbing the bundle for gta 6, there's not much point paying extra for the ps5 1tb since the game is digital exclusive anyway. 49, beat GTA 6 in a month, and then return the console. However, this doesn't mean that you can pay £18. In fact, the deal is a lot worse than it looks on paper.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unlike standard ps5 leases, the gta 6 bundle does not allow for monthly rolling. 49/mo for a PS5 825GB Digital Edition is a 36-month contract, which adds up to £665. 64 in total. £18. You must pick a fixed lease term, either 12 months, 24 months, or 36 months. That's a lot steeper than buying the console and game outright.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so, while the idea of paying £18/mo for gta 6 and a ps5 might sound more enticing than the upfront costs, a lump sum of £588. 99, it's far from a bargain. At least then, you get to keep the console after your fixed term. Better yet, if you have a good enough internet connection, just buy an Xbox One and stream it. If you can't afford the console and game right now, you'd be better off buying them on a credit plan that you pay back monthly. They go for around £115 on eBay.

Diungkapkan bahwa there is the option of a 12-month contract when leasing a ps5 with gta 6, but the monthly payment increases to £29. 95, equal to £359 a year. You're saving around £229. 99 in total that way, which is a little easier to stomach, but it's still steep for a console you don't get to keep, and a game you don't own.

Diungkapkan bahwa the legend of zelda: ocarina of time's switch 2 revival sold in droves earlier this month, moving more than 5 million copies in its first four days and leading to speculation about what comes next. For Kit Ellis and Krysta Yang (Nintendo of America's former marketing and PR leads), the series' future doesn't look so different to its past.

Diungkapkan bahwa speaking in the most recent episode of the kit and krysta podcast, the duo wonder if it's now a "foregone conclusion" that nintendo will also remake majora's mask in the same style as ocarina of time's 2026 re-up. Diungkapkan bahwa nintendo pulled the same trick almost three decades ago when majora's mask came out less than two years after ocarina of time on the n64, which is almost unfathomable with how long 2026 development cycles can be. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "it may not be the next game," ellis continues. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the duo also speculate that if nintendo wants to release a zelda game every year, it'll likely rotate between new 2d entries, new 3d ones, and remakes. A Majora's Mask remake built off of the Switch 2's Ocarina of Time seems like an easy decision.

"It just doesn't make sense for them not to do it," Yang adds.

#902. Torchlight: Infinite brings back its permadeath server as Assassin's Creed crossover looms

Torchlight: Infinite brings back its permadeath server as Assassin's Creed crossover looms

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pocketgamer.com/torchlight-infinite/assassins-creed-crossover-announcement/

Nothing is true, everything is permadeath.

Berdasarkan laporan, my first question when i heard that torchlight: infinite was getting an assassin’s creed crossover was whether anyone had thought about the practicalities. All those hooded assassins, all those monsters, and not a haystack in sight. Ubisoft's finest are going to have to improvise. The collaboration is confirmed for January 2027, with more details expected over the coming weeks.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there's something a little more immediate to get sucked into, though. Make it through and you'll be chasing better rewards and a spot on the leaderboards. The Unbound, Torchlight: Infinite's hardcore server, has returned with the arrival of SS14 Tartarus. First introduced during SS13 Afterlight last summer, it gives you a fresh start with the rather significant caveat that death is permanent. Make one mistake, and well, there's always next season.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this time around, xd has introduced two notable changes to the usual formula. Move to Cast automatically triggers your Core Skill at intervals while you're travelling across maps, and also attempts to activate your Core Spell Skill's burst.

Diungkapkan bahwa unshackled destiny is the other big addition, removing the limit on how many destinies you can install. Socket restrictions still exist, but at least there’s decently enough room to experiment with character builds.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there are also five new compasses to mess around with, each offering a different boost to runs. They cover everything from guaranteed Scarlet Moon Incantation bosses in Lunaria to better Legendary Gear chances through Dark Surge, alongside improvements to Overrealm and Outlaw encounters. All five are available for free, with one usable per map.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there's a catch, naturally. These Compasses make enemies more dangerous as well as improving your rewards. That's an interesting trade-off in a regular run, but considerably less amusing when permadeath is involved.

The Unbound is live worldwide in Torchlight: Infinite as part of SS14 Tartarus, while the Assassin's Creed collaboration arrives in January 2027.

In the meantime, our Torchlight: Infinite codes might help you get your hands on some useful rewards.

#905. Marvel Legendary 2nd Edition review: "Reboots an already-great card game into something even better"

Marvel Legendary 2nd Edition review: "Reboots an already-great card game into something even better"

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.gamesradar.com/tabletop-gaming/marvel-legendary-2nd-edition-review/

Keep exploring and earning more as a member.

Diungkapkan bahwa when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Berdasarkan laporan, the marvel legendary 2nd edition core box improves on the original in nearly every way, delivering what remains one of the best classic deck building systems out there. For Marvel and deck builder fans that may have missed out on the original box, this is an incredibly easy recommendation, but for folks that may just want to replace their old box, you will need to weigh whether the elements here are worth it.

One of the best cooperative deck builders out there.

Some great new art and the new neoprene playmat is a nice step up.

Includes improvements that were originally added expansions are now included right from the start.

Compatible with already released Marvel Legendary products.

Did not really improve the storage solution or alleviate setup/teardown hassle.

Not as strong value proposition for owners of the original core box.

Sebagaimana diketahui, why you can trust gamesradar+ our experts review games, movies and tech over countless hours, so you can choose the best for you. Find out more about our reviews policy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when it comes to the deck building genre of card games, these popular options have featured all manner of different properties and styles over the years, with one of my favorites being legendary: a marvel deck building game (henceforth referred simply as marvel legendary) from upper deck. In fact, this was where I first got my introduction to the deck builder landscape; ever since watching Wil Wheaton's Tabletop episode featuring it, this has been one of my go-to types of games to play.

Diungkapkan bahwa now, upper deck has released a new edition of the base marvel legendary, bringing with it some refinements and updates that the team has picked up in the past 14 years since the original box came out, along with fan-favorite mechanics that were introduced in later expansion content. All of this results in superior, yet still very familiar, new starting point for anyone wanting to assemble some Marvel heroes and save the day – and one of the best card games overall for Marvel fans.

Diungkapkan bahwa this new 2nd edition of marvel legendary retains the same cooperative deck-building mission as the original, now with a nice neoprene mat gameboard, replacing the classic folding cardboard one. Prior to the game starting, players pick the heroes that they will build their decks with, a total of 15 choices, followed by the villain you will face off against, what their dastardly scheme will be, and the various henchmen and other foes assisting them.

Berdasarkan laporan, from there, in typical deck-building fashion, over the course of numerous rounds, players will purchase and enhance their decks with hero cards from a shared pool, taking out villains, rescuing captured civilians, and thwarting enough of the mastermind’s schemes and bashing them in the face until either the heroes or villains come out victorious. It’s a tried-and-true formula that has served Upper Deck for many years and many spin-offs, and it all began with Marvel Legendary, and it still is just as fun today.

Players: 1-5Ages: 14+Game type: Deck-buildingComplexity: ModerateLasts: 30-60minsDesigner: Devin LowPublisher: Upper DeckPlay if you enjoy: Gwent, Magic: The Gathering.

Berdasarkan laporan, legendary adopts a rotating and ever shifting marketplace of cards for folks to pick from, an approach more akin to ascension as opposed to a static shop like dominion. Having each power of hero card feature its own unique piece of artwork is a great touch, that while fixed in later expansions, was sorely lacking in the original core box. It’s an approach I have always favored, and considering all of the new redone art in this box, I appreciated this direction even more, since it lets me see more cards. Same with the various schemes you will contend with.

Berdasarkan laporan, by and large, all the new artwork is an improvement, though some fall a bit flatter, with the “wound” cards that will clog your deck. Previously, these featured a gruesome image of Wolverine getting blasted, his body contorting with pain as his classic X-men costume is shredded. Now, it’s just Iron Man in pristine looking armor holding his shoulder like he threw a slightly too-fast baseball, and pulled a muscle. I mean, I guess that’s a wound…technically?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for folks that don’t own the original core box of marvel legendary, this new box is an amazing and spectacular jumping on point for one of the most established deck builders out there. Even if you never touch any of the previously released expansions (that are compatible with this new box, by the way), you still have a fully stocked game that will keep things exciting for years to come. I. At $100 msrp, it’s a hefty price tag for what is basically new artwork, some rebalanced cards, a couple and card types like sidekicks and S. H. Things become slightly more complicated if you do already own the older box. E. L. D Officer Specialists being included (originally released in expansions).

Hardware nerds unite, sign up to our free tech newsletter for a weekly digest of the hottest new tech, the latest gadgets on the test bench, and much more from the team at GamesRadar+.

Sebagaimana diketahui, even when it comes to the heroes and villains being offered, there is a good deal of crossover between the two boxes. On the heroes side, Deadpool from the OG box has been swapped out for Miles Morales, and Doc Ock has been added to the Mastermind list to represent the web-head’s rogues gallery, along with some adjustments to the henchmen and villain offerings. Again, all of this is great for new players, it’s just something for returning owners to be aware of before they drop the cash on the new box.

Diungkapkan bahwa there’s a reason that marvel legendary would go on to spawn tons of expansions, and with the legendary series spinning off to feature other properties like the matrix, predator, and now even dc. It’s just a damn good game that has withstood the test of time.

Berdasarkan laporan, sure, it can still take a bit to set up and pack up, thanks to all the various little decks of cards you need to shuffle together, but the end result has always been worth the hassle. I look at my dinged up, faded, and scratched original core box sitting on my game shelf and remember back to all the fun game nights that it’s been a part of, and this new 2nd Edition Core Box will let the sweet prince finally rest. It’s served its time, and I can’t wait for the future game nights this new box will make.

Diungkapkan bahwa ✅ you like deck building games and don’t have the original core box: if you're a fan of the genre, you owe it to yourself to try this. ✅ You're looking for a thematic cooperative game: Want something memorable to bring to your next game night? This is it.

Berdasarkan laporan, ❌ you already own the original box: you will need to weigh whether or not the new art and rebalanced cards are worth the price tag. ❌ You prefer your deck building games to be purely competitive: Marvel is full of teams, so it's no surprise this spin-off follows the same formula.

#906. This 3D Pet SIM You Never Played Has Over 12,000 ‘Overwhelmingly Positive’ Reviews

This 3D Pet SIM You Never Played Has Over 12,000 ‘Overwhelmingly Positive’ Reviews

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/wobbledogs-3d-pet-sim-steam-overwhelmingly-positive/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, have you ever wanted to raise your own genetically mutated pup? well, there's a steam game focused on exactly that, and it probably deserves more success than it's managed in the four years since it launched. Wobbledogs, from developer Animal Uprising, is described on Steam as "a 3D pet simulation where you raise your own hive of mutating dogs. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's as much a comedic game as it is a simulator, for two reasons. Firstly, the dogs look ridiculous. They're made up of an amalgamation of shapes, including lengthy, cuboid torsos and enormous tails, somewhat reminiscent of the creatures in the early noughties British children's show Bamzooki.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, secondly, wobbledogs has some wacky physics in play, which means it's a good laugh just observing your pets. "Two dogs with separate body structures will experience the world in different ways," reads the "about this game" section on Steam.

Berdasarkan laporan, impressively, each wobbledog also has a simulated genetics system. "As they age, they periodically enter a pupal state and physically mutate. The foods they eat fill their guts with different flora… [which] influence the dogs' mutations, letting you craft and mold them to fit your own idea of canine (im)perfection!".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, wobbledogs is very much a make-your-own-fun sort of game though, so there are no explicit goals other than enjoying yourself. You can create and design habitats for your dogs, and you'll unlock more cosmetic decorations and objects as you play. "Give your dogs a relaxing place to sleep, set up a maze, or even cultivate a garden. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i fed a family only doritos for like eight generations to try to give them long legs and they ended up incredibly orange," reads one positive review. "This game is absolutely amazing. I get struck with waves of happiness every time I play," reads another.

Diungkapkan bahwa it can also be an alarming game, however, as this review explains: "got my first dog pancake. Played with him, fed him, loved him. Was best friends with Randy. Got some more dogs for Pancake. Always happy and playful. Pancake played with them. Watch Pancake grow older & change with the minutes. I loved Pancake.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "proceeds to die right in front of me. My other 4 dogs then come over & eat his dead body right in front of me, all while I'm still in shock that dogs can die in this game. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, a weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rest in peace, pancake. 99, but regularly goes on sale for as little as $4. Wobbledogs is currently $19. 99, so I'd recommend putting it on your wishlist and holding fire until it drops again.

#908. Apple's Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History

📅 14 Nov 2026

Apple's Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/apple-sci-fi-thriller-masterpiece-severance-one-of-the-best-seasons-in-tv-history/

Diungkapkan bahwa in 2022, apple was three years into its streaming experiment and still trying to find its footing. Aside from Ted Lasso, the tech giant hadn't released any breakout hits. And while a few sci-fi shows like For All Mankind and Foundation had fans, they weren't exactly mainstream success stories. Then everything changed when Apple took a bet on an unknown showrunner (with backing from an A-list actor) to create something revolutionary.

Berdasarkan laporan, dan erickson and ben stiller didn't just change apple tv with severance, which firmly established the streamer as the home for groundbreaking new sci-fi. They also delivered a perfectly timed anti-work masterpiece at exactly the right time, tapping into the cultural zeitgeist with a perfect season of television that still hasn't been surpassed (even by the show's own very good second season).

Berdasarkan laporan, while both seasons of severance are phenomenal, it’s hard to describe how expertly erickson’s first nine-episode season conveys the despair of the “work-first” attitude prevalent in modern society. Erickson, who worked in a literal door factory while writing early versions of the series, takes that attitude to its most literal extreme: imagining a dystopian future where companies surgically split their employees' consciousness to create an "innie" who knows only work and an "outie" who has no idea what their own job entails.

Berdasarkan laporan, the series opens with helly (britt lower) waking up on a table in one of the company’s main offices. Waking up at work already sounds disastrous, but like Helly, audiences learn from the disembodied voice of fellow innie Mark Scout (Adam Scott) in real time what being a Lumon employee means for her: a lifetime of all work and very little play. Naturally, Helly does not vibe with the new life her outie has chosen for her and does everything in her power to escape.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the line between personal and work has grown increasingly blurred over the years, further exacerbated by the covid-19 pandemic, which forced us to reckon in real time with how little consideration is given to workers and their lives, as long as the numbers go up. This way of thinking drives Helly to be fundamentally opposed to anything and everything her bosses at Lumon try to get her to do.

Berdasarkan laporan, yet every time helly rages against the machine, she remains trapped in the system. Her outie wants her to be there, creating a truly odd juxtaposition where, despite sharing the same body, Helly is wrangling with her own psyche for control. Each time she tries to escape, she is forced back into that sad, narrow corridor. It’s a little like arguing with yourself over whether you should get takeout, only with much more dire circumstances.

Diungkapkan bahwa though there is a level of attraction to such a literal divide of work and pleasure — mark uses the severance program to avoid the grief of the death of his wife years before — it comes at a great cost. In an attempt to create a healthy work-life balance, Lumon and those who choose to be severed have instead condemned their inner selves to lives devoted to work, pursuing goals they neither understand nor chose.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this leaves us with several compelling questions that the nine episodes of severance’s first season try to answer. Who is real? Is it our outer selves who agreed to take on this severance procedure, or is it the innie that’s been condemned to a life of toil? Is there really a true divide?.

Diungkapkan bahwa through helly’s acts of insurrection, she stirs something in her fellow innies that those in charge at lumon (all of whom, notably, are not severed) can’t fully suppress. Even before Helly, innies like Mark, Irving (John Turturro), and Dylan (Zach Cherry) had a vague interest in their outer selves. By the time Helly starts pointing out the imbalance between their lives, rebellion (big and small) is all but inevitable.

Diungkapkan bahwa severance season 1 unfolds as a maze of shifting identities, false starts, red herrings, and untrustworthy narrators, with each episode leaving you feeling as though your emotions have been tossed into a blender. The series is disorienting by design, constantly keeping you guessing about what’s real and whom you can trust, all while building to a mind-blowing cliffhanger finale.

Sebagaimana diketahui, severance’s second season is just as tantalizing as the first, but feels less cohesive overall, spending more time with the outies and lumon’s inner workings. Although those elements are compelling, some storylines introduced in season one — like Burt and Irving’s strange but sweet relationship — fizzle out in an unsatisfying way. Season 2 is still very good, with some high highs and few lows, but it doesn’t hold a candle to the masterpiece that was Severance season 1.

#909. Resident Evil 1 Remake “Might Not Resonate” With Modern Fans, Capcom Says

📅 14 Nov 2026

Resident Evil 1 Remake “Might Not Resonate” With Modern Fans, Capcom Says

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.thegamer.com/capcom-reveals-why-it-didnt-remake-resident-evil-1-first/

Sebagaimana diketahui, capcom's recent lineup of remakes started with resident evil 2, throwing us back into the chaos of a raccoon city under siege by zombies, tyrants, lickers, and even alligators. It might seem like a weird place to start, rather than the inciting incident where Jill Valentine and Chris Redfield skulked through Spencer Mansion, but longtime series producer Jun Takeuchi has revealed that the team worried it would alienate modern audiences.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "the reason we didn't choose resident evil 1 as the first remake is because it's such a stoic game," takeuchi said in nikkei entertainment!'s celebration of the series' 30th anniversary (translated by fandom). "Because it focuses so heavily on the horror derived from its stoicism, we were concerned that it might not resonate with today's game fans.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "furthermore, the raccoon city incident is essentially the starting point of the resident evil saga, so we felt that experiencing that was the best way to introduce the origins. ".

Of course, there was a remake of Resident Evil in 2002 for the GameCube, which was remastered for PS4, PC, and Xbox One in 2015—but it remains dutiful to the fixed camera angles and tank controls of the original, unlike the newer remakes, which adopt an over-the-shoulder viewpoint.

Berdasarkan laporan, fans have been clamoring for another resident evil remake in-line with the newer games, and given the slower, more methodical horror of grace ashcroft's sections in requiem—and just how well that was received—i'm not sure the argument holds up anymore. But just because Capcom shot down a Resident Evil remake once before doesn't mean it has been completely ruled out.

Sebagaimana diketahui, according to reputable leaker dusk golem, who first reported that leon kennedy would return as a playable character in requiem, the original resident evil is getting a remake, with full production set to begin after veronica has wrapped up. "RE1: is just recently entering development, so it's likely anywhere from 4–7 years out from releasing, presuming it comes out at all since it's in early development and RE games get scrapped all the time," he explained.

Berdasarkan laporan, dusk golem also alleged that a resident evil zero remake is underway, corroborating an mp1st report. It'd be a little odd to tackle the prelude to the Mansion Incident, following STARS Bravo Team en route to the Arklay Mountains to investigate the same cannibalistic murders, and not the first game it leads directly into.

So, while Capcom may have feared that the original game wouldn't resonate with new fans, rumors suggest something has changed, and after Veronica in 2027, we'll be revisiting Spencer Mansion—again.

Requiem is the closest Capcom has ever come to capturing the paranoia of the original Resident Evil games.

#911. 20 Years Ago, the Best Sci-Fi Show of the Century Delivered the Most Epic Space Battle in TV History

📅 14 Nov 2026

20 Years Ago, the Best Sci-Fi Show of the Century Delivered the Most Epic Space Battle in TV History

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/battlestar-galactica-season-3-exodus-20-year-anniversary-adama-maneuver/

The Adama Maneuver wasn’t even the most spectacular part of Battlestar Galactica’s greatest space battle.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to liberate the humans trapped under cylon occupation, admiral william adama (edward james olmos) jumps the titular battlestar galactica directly into the atmosphere of new caprica. The warship plummets toward the settlement and deploys Viper fighter jets amidst the chaos before jumping back into space moments before it would have crashed, likely obliterating the planet on impact.

Sebagaimana diketahui, two decades later, this spectacle from battlestar galactica season 3’s “exodus, part 2” remains unforgettable sci-fi tv. From a tactical standpoint, the “Adama Maneuver” is absolutely bonkers and one of the riskiest spaceship tactics, perhaps ever (sorry, Vice-Admiral Holdo). It’s dazzling and horrifying, and still one of the coolest things ever broadcast on science-fiction television. What if the ship had gotten torn apart from ripping through the atmosphere? What if the FTL drive malfunctioned or didn’t activate in time? Somehow, it’s also not even the most visually impressive sequence in the episode.

Diungkapkan bahwa minutes later, while the galactica is damaged and surrounded by enemy ships, lee adama (jamie bamber) arrives aboard the pegasus. He buys his father enough time to escape, evacuates his own crew, and transforms the most advanced remaining warship in humanity's fleet into an enormous battering ram. Pegasus tears through one Cylon basestar, explodes, and sends a flaming flight pod spinning into another. It’s both a spectacular death scene and the decisive blow in the battle to liberate New Caprica.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in one extended sequence, “exodus, part 2” ends the most frustrating period in battlestar galactica’s story, reunites its scattered cast, and restores the series’ core premise: one battered battlestar protecting the remnants of humanity as they search for earth. No one is able to recover from the trauma that easily, perhaps least of all the visual-effects artists who were forced to destroy the Pegasus.

'Pegasus' transforms what looks like a miracle into a total nightmare.

Diungkapkan bahwa “exodus” was initially conceived as a single episode, written by bradley thompson and david weddle and directed by félix enríquez alcalá. And most of that happened in the first part of “Exodus. Against the backdrop of this militarized occupation, there was also the resistance’s ongoing ground operations, Sharon Agathon’s (Grace Park) infiltration of the Cylon compound, Kara Thrace’s (Katee Sackhoff) imprisonment by Leoben Conoy (Callum Keith Rennie), and Ellen Tigh’s (Kate Vernon) betrayal, which led to her being poisoned before her execution. But the rescue of New Caprica eventually became too large for one hour. ” There was simply too much story happening — and honestly too much to fully recap here.

Berdasarkan laporan, according to moore, who talked about the production on a series of podcast episodes released alongside the show, splitting “exodus” into two episodes also helped the production absorb the considerable cost of the new caprica storyline. The opening of season 3 required new sets, location shooting, large numbers of extras, and significantly more visual effects than an ordinary episode. By turning the material into a two-parter — episodes 3 and 4 in the overall season — the producers were able to stretch that expensive infrastructure across another hour of television.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that history helps explain the rhythm of “exodus. The resistance prepares for its uprising. Samuel Anders (Michael Trucco) discovers that Ellen betrayed the resistance to save her husband, Saul Tigh (Michael Hogan). Adama orders Lee to protect the civilian fleet and continue the search for Earth if Galactica doesn’t return within 18 hours. ” Part 1 is full of tension as it essentially tightens the spring. Sharon retrieves the launch keys for the civilian ships. Then Part 2 releases all that tension almost all at once.

Berdasarkan laporan, saul poisons ellen rather than surrender her to the resistance for execution. Anders rescues Kara from Leoben’s apartment. The civilian ships begin to launch. Laura Roslin (Mary McDonnell) retakes Colonial One. The uprising begins. That’s when Galactica falls out of the sky.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, during his podcast commentary, moore watched the sequence and remarked that the episode had better win the emmy for visual effects. The episode also received Emmy nominations for its direction and sound editing. “Exodus, Part 2” won the 2007 Emmy for Outstanding Special Visual Effects for a Series, along with the Visual Effects Society award for Outstanding Visual Effects in a Broadcast Series. Less than a year later, it did. But the episode still had a larger spectacle in reserve.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once galactica jumps out of new caprica’s atmosphere, adama discovers that four cylon basestars are waiting for him. Already damaged by the free fall, the ship has little chance of survival. As he often does when facing certain death, Adama quietly tells his crew that it has been an honor to serve with them.

Berdasarkan laporan, except lee disobeys a direct order and jumps the pegasus in to assist. Lee orders the crew to abandon ship, sets its weapons to fire automatically, and pauses on the empty bridge to offer his command one final “Thank you. Pegasus immediately destroys one basestar and draws enough fire to allow Galactica to escape. ” Then he and the dwindling crew set it on a direct collision course with the enemy ships.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, destroying pegasus had always been part of the general plan for the new caprica storyline, even if the writers changed the circumstances across various drafts. At one point, the creative team considered destroying Galactica instead and moving the military crew onto the newer, better Pegasus. But that would have meant abandoning the title of the series.

Berdasarkan laporan, the pegasus sets occupied valuable studio space, and maintaining two capital ships forced the production to divide its personnel and background performers between separate locations. The creative team also wanted to build new Cylon basestar interiors for the stories that followed. There just wasn’t enough room to do it all.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the visual-effects team nevertheless became attached to the ship. When its artists learned that Pegasus was scheduled for destruction, they hung a large “SAVE THE PEGASUS” banner outside their workspace, directly across from Moore’s office. “It was very funny and it was really endearing,” Moore said, “but we destroyed the Pegasus anyway — so goodbye, Peggy. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the ship’s destruction became an enormous undertaking for atmosphere visual effects. Because its ships, explosions, weapons fire, and debris interacted so extensively, much of the work couldn’t be simplified through pre-compositing. Lead compositor Brenda Campbell later recalled that the climactic sequence contained roughly 250 to 300 elements in each compositing flow, spread across approximately 10 shots. Campbell had about a week and a half to finish it.

Diungkapkan bahwa the scale extended into the background. Some battle shots featured hundreds of individually animated Cylon Raiders that hadn’t even appeared in the original previsualization. The artists then added camera movement, flares, and the unusually heavy layer of grain that helped Battlestar Galactica’s digital effects match the show’s handheld, documentary-inspired photography.

Diungkapkan bahwa the collision destroys the first basestar outright. Then one of Pegasus’ burning flight pods breaks away, careens through the battle, and strikes another. Humanity may have lost the Pegasus, but at least it took out three Cylon basestars in the process.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in a way, “exodus” delivers a satisfying reset to the show’s original structure. But its characters return to that version of normalcy carrying more trauma than ever before. After spending four episodes grounded on New Caprica, Battlestar Galactica resumes its familiar “scrappy military ship on the run” format. The occupation is over, but the damage it caused has barely begun to reveal itself.

Diungkapkan bahwa that’s what separates “exodus” from an impressive hour of action television. The heroes escape, but they cannot return to who they were before New Caprica. It delivers the enormous catharsis its story demands, but it never pretends that liberation alone is a simple fix for anything. Neither can the fleet: Humanity is free again, but it has sacrificed its most powerful warship to get there.

Berdasarkan laporan, twenty years later, it’s easy to understand why the visual-effects artists wanted to save “peggy” — and why the writers knew they couldn’t. The Adama Maneuver may be the image everyone remembers, but the destruction of Pegasus gives “Exodus” its emotional climax. If the artists couldn’t save their favorite ship, they could at least give it a death spectacular enough to ensure nobody would ever forget it.

#912. Zelda Fans Who Loved Ocarina of Time Need to Play This Game Next

📅 14 Nov 2026

Zelda Fans Who Loved Ocarina of Time Need to Play This Game Next

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/zelda-link-past-retrospective-35-years/

Sebagaimana diketahui, by now, you’ve probably had time to play the legend of zelda: ocarina of time remake on the nintendo switch 2. You’ve marveled at what a great job it does of bringing the classic Nintendo 64 adventure to a new generation, with visual improvements and quality-of-life changes to make it more palatable for that new audience. Maybe you’ve even run through it a second time.

Diungkapkan bahwa as good as ocarina of time might be, however, it’s just one game. Once you’re finished with that grand adventure, you’ll need to decide what to play next. And assuming you’re not tired of Hyrule and Zelda just yet, there’s one game you definitely should consider for your next conquest. It can’t keep you busy forever. That game is The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, and it did a brilliant job of introducing key elements that players loved about Ocarina of Time several years later, including an intricate world that changes over the course of the epic adventure.

Diungkapkan bahwa incredible as it may seem, the legend of zelda: a link to the past is already 35 years old. How can so much time have passed already? I have vivid memories of terrific games I played before Link’s first Super Nintendo outing ever occurred. 21, 1991. It arrived in Japan on Nov. Time clearly flies as fast for some of us, every bit as readily as it did for Link in Ocarina of Time.

Berdasarkan laporan, when a link to the past hit japan in 1991 and then launched in north america five months later, it provided the most meaningful update the zelda series would see for decades. Up to that point, there were only two console releases. Both of them were wildly different. A Link to the Past cemented what a Zelda game should be, offering its grandest open world yet, stuffed with thrilling dungeons built on a foundation of everything that came before them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the game began with link following his uncle out into the rain in search of the imprisoned princess zelda. He freed her and then began a search for three magical pendants, the better to someday vanquish an evil wizard. As his quest neared its apparent conclusion, Link learned that it had really only just begun. He soon found himself traveling frequently between two realms: the Light World and the Dark World.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the dark world is a link to the past’s grandest innovation. Players spent hours exploring every corner of Hyrule, from the warm desert sands in the southwest to the cascading waterfalls and mountains in the north. Sand dunes turned to fetid swamp. A lake became a glacier, and a thriving village turned into a hideout for bandits. They might have thought they knew everything. Then another dimension came along and turned all of that on its head. Truly, the alternate realm lived up to its title.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but the dark world offered more than just a dreary aesthetic. Actions Link took in one realm allowed him to make progress in the other, in ways large and small. A Heart Piece might rest on a ledge that lay out of reach. Players got to know the landscape more intimately than ever before, or else they could never reach some of the places where their greatest adventures waited. Or a dungeon entrance might lie out of reach, but a trip between worlds would reveal a new path. A trip between dimensions added a walkway that finally granted access. In the end, Link’s ingenuity and bravery provided the strength necessary to defeat a familiar foe: Ganon.

Berdasarkan laporan, ocarina of time built on much of that same design, with just enough differences to make it all feel fresh. He meets Zelda early in his adventure. Link wakes to find an insistent fairy by his side, instead of having his dreams disturbed by a telepathic plea. Instead of traveling to another realm, the lad simply wakes in a different time period. Three dungeons later, circumstances force them apart. It is a dark one, every bit as disastrous as the Dark World in the previous game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you’ve just finished exploring that structure in ocarina of time, the time is right to experience the super nintendo version that pioneered its best attributes. You’ll be able to better appreciate just how much impact a classic 2D game had on the series as it evolved into 3D. They often represent an evolution of everything that came before them. It should serve as a reminder that the best entertainment experiences of today don’t come from nowhere. For people who enjoy the evolution of a medium, there’s true joy in exploring those roots, even now. And few games deserve your attention as much as A Link to the Past.

Zelda's ability to endure over decades is a miracle.
